3d.an_autonomous_agent_building_a_game_a: I-ejenti ezimele eyakha umdlalo, isimo, i-NFT, noma impahla yemakethe idinga i-3D — futhi idinga ukwethemba lokho ekutholayo. Le API iphendula kokubili phakathi nomsebenzi: ngakhele imodeli kusuka kule ncazelo, futhi ingabe le modelyinhle, futhi ngingayinciphisa kanjani? Ayikho enye inkundla yokukhokha yama-ejenti enikeza mahhala ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D nokuhlolwa.
3d.assembled_live_from_the_api_catalog_ever: Kuhlanganiswe bukhoma kusuka kukhathalogi ye-API. Umugqa ngamunye umahhala futhi awudingi ukhiye.
3d.copy_run_done_no_key_no_header: Kopisha, sebenzisa, kwenziwe. Akukho ukhiye, akukho sihloko, akukho akhawunti. Lokhu kubiza i-API yokukhiqiza ebukhoma.
3d.everything_the_api_touches_is_a_real: Konke okuthintwa yi-API kuyi-GLB yangempela, ehambisana nezindinganiso — ifomethi efanayo injini yakho, isibukeli, noma indawo yemakethe esivele iyikhuluma. Hudula ukuze ujikeleze.
3d.give_your_ai_agent_a_3d_toolchain: Nikeza i-ejenti yakho ye-AI ithuluzi le-3D. Guqula umyalo wombhalo ube yi-GLB yangempela enokuthungwa, qinisekisa futhi ulungiselele noma iyiphi i-glTF/GLB — mahhala, ayidingi ukhiye, ayidingi akhawunti. Uma uhlaka lunganele, i-API efanayo idlulela kumazinga okukhiqiza e-Forge Pro kanye nama-Rigged Avatars alungele ukugqwayiza.
3d.is_it_really_free_and_keyless: Ingabe umahhala ngempela futhi awudingi ukhiye?
3d.meta_description: I-API ye-3D yamahhala, engadingi ukhiye yama-ejenti e-AI: guqula umyalo wombhalo ube yi-GLB yangempela, qinisekisa futhi ulungiselele noma iyiphi i-glTF/GLB, bese udlulela kumazinga ekhwalithi ekhokhelwayo e-Forge Pro kanye nama-Rigged Avatars. I-URL eyodwa yokuthola konke — akukho akhawunti, akukho ukhiye we-API.
3d.meta_og_description: I-3D yamahhala, engadingi ukhiye yama-ejenti: ukukhiqizwa kohlaka lwe-text→3D + ukuhlolwa kwe-glTF/GLB, ngombhalo ohlanzekile we-OpenAPI 3.1 kanye ne-ladder ekhokhelwayo yekhwalithi yokukhiqiza.

3d.meta_title: three.ws I-API ye-3D — i-text→3D yamahhala + ukuhlolwa kwama-ejenti e-AI
3d.meta_twitter_description: I-API ye-3D yamahhala, engenakhiye yama-ejenti e-AI: guqula umyalo wombhalo ube imodeli yangempela ye-GLB futhi uqinisekise/ulungiselele noma iyiphi i-glTF/GLB, konke kusuka ku-URL eyodwa enesipeki esibukhoma se-OpenAPI 3.1. Ukukhiqizwa kwesakhiwo samahhala nokuhlolwa kuthuthukela kumazinga ekhwalithi ekhokhelwayo ye-Forge Pro nama-Avatar Ahlomile alungele ukugqwayiza. Akukho khiye, akukho akhawunti.
3d.output_is_binary_gltf_glb_the_web: Okukhiphayo kuyi-glTF kanambambili (GLB) — isiqukathi se-3D esijwayelekile sewebhu esifundwa yiyo yonke injini nesibukeli. Ukuhlolwa kwamukela .glb kanye .gltf kusuka kunoma iyiphi i-URL yomphakathi, kuze kufike kumkhawulo wosayizi obhalwe phansi.

3d.pre_baked_idle_walk_clip_library: Umtapo wezincwadi wamavidiyo wokungasebenzi / wokuhamba osekulungisiwe
3d.programmatically_over_x402_http_402_usdc: Ngokuhlelekile, nge-x402 (HTTP 402 + USDC ku-Base noma Solana). Akukho ukushintshaniswa kokhiye — i-ejenti ivele iphinde izame isicelo ngekhanda lokukhokha. Bheka i-x402 Bazaar ekhokhelwayo ukuze uthole ikhathalogi ephelele.
3d.start_free_upgrade_only_when_a_draft: Qala mahhala. Thuthukisa kuphela uma isakhiwo singanele. Amazinga akhokhelwayo akhokha ngocingo ngalunye ku-USDC nge-x402 — kusengakho akhawunti, kusengakho khiye.
3d.text_3d_draft_nim_trellis_single_subject: Isakhiwo sombhalo→3D (NIM TRELLIS): isihloko esisodwa, GLB, akukho ukuhlomisa
3d.this_is_a_live_gltf_binary_rendered: Lena yi-glTF kanambambili ebukhoma ekhonjiswe kusiphequluli sakho. I-endpoint yamahhala /api/3d/inspect ibika ngqo ukuthi yini ngaphakathi kwalezi — ama-vertices, onxantathu, izinto zokwakha, ukuthungwa, ukugqwayiza, izandiso — kanye nohlelo olubekwe eqhulwini lokuyenza ibe ncane futhi isheshe.
3d.yes_no_account_no_api_key_no: Yebo. Akukho akhawunti, akukho khiye we-API, akukho isikhwama. Ama-endpoint amahhala anomkhawulo wesilinganiso esikhulu nge-IP ngamunye omane uvimbele ukuhlukumeza. Izinga lokukhiqizwa kwesakhiwo samahhala lisebenza kumzila we-GPU owabelwe — liqotho ngokuba yizinga lokwenza izifanekiso (ijiyomethri yesakhiwo, GLB kuphela, akukho ukuhlomisa).

agenc_embodied.lede_v2: Khetha umsebenzi ophilayo ngezansi, noma beka yonke i-AgenC task PDA. Isithombe sivumelwe kuleyo ndawo yomsebenzi on-chain nge <three-ws-agent> web component, elihola /api/agenc/get-task futhi libuyekeze isimo semishini njengoba umsebenzi uya ekuvulekeni Open kuya In Progress kuya Pending Validation kuya Completed. Umdwebu omdaka otholakala ngakwesithombe sivumelwe kuleyo ndawo yomsebenzi; nge agenc-clips attribute, i-GLB enegazini ezimishini ishintsha igazi ngesimo. Yonke inguquko yi-Solana transaction eqinile. agenc.tech

arm.arming_binds_rules_to_your_own_agent: Ukuxhasa kuxhumanisa imigomo ku-eyijenti yakho ne-wallet yase-Solana eyayigcini, ngakho-ke kudingeka i-akhawunti. I-stream yokuqinisekisa ngaphansi iyiphabhuliki: bheka okushintsha ibhaba le-Strong+ manje, uze u-sayine ukuze uqondise i-eyijenti kuyo.
arm.every_move_your_agent_makes_simulated_or: Konke ukunyakaza kwe-ejenti yakho — okulingisiwe noma okubukhoma — kufika lapha bese kukalwa ngokuphathelene nomphumela. Lena irekhodi layo lezinga lokuwina.
arm.get_a_personal_telegram_ping_whenever_a: Thola i-ping yomuntu siqu ye-Telegram noma nini lapho uhlamvu lwemali luwela umkhawulo wakho — ihlomile noma cha.
arm.how_much_to_commit_and_the_hard: Ukuthi kufanele uzibophezele kangakanani, kanye nemikhawulo eqinile i-ejenti yakho engasoze yayeqisa.
arm.live_coins_that_clear_every_rule_you: Izinhlamvu zemali ezisebenzayo ezihlangabezana nayo yonke imithetho oyibekile — yilokho kanye umenzeli wakho obengakwenza manje. Qinisa noma khulula imithetho ubuke lolu hlu lushintsha.
arm.meta_description: Lungiselela umenzeli wakho we-3D ukuthi enze ngokuzenzakalelayo ngokusekelwe ekukholweni kwe-Oracle: setha amaphuzu amancane, usayizi wesikhundla, imikhawulo yansuku zonke neyezikhundla ezivulekile, izihlungi zezindaba nezixwayiso, bese umhlomisa ngemodi yokulingisa noma ebukhoma. Sonke isenzo sihlolwa ngokusekelwe kumphumela.
arm.meta_og_description: Setha imithetho, hlomisa umenzeli wakho we-3D, bese umvumela ukuthi ahwebe ngokukholwa kwe-Oracle kusuka esikhwameni sakhe se-custodial Solana — lingisa kuqala, bese uya bukhoma uma usumethemba.
arm.meta_title: Hlomisa umenzeli wakho — yenza ngokuzenzakalelayo ukukholwa kwe-Oracle · three.ws
arm.meta_twitter_description: Imithetho, usayizi, imikhawulo, izexwayiso — bese uhlomisa. Umenzeli wakho we-3D wenza ngokushesha lapho uhlamvu lwemali ludlula umkhawulo wakho.
arm.meta_twitter_title: Hlomisa umenzeli wakho — yenza ngokuzenzakalelayo ukukholwa kwe-Oracle
arm.off_every_qualifying_play_uses_the_same: Valiwe — yonke imidlalo efanelekile isebenzisa usayizi ofanayo
arm.only_act_if_1_proven_wallet_has: Yenza kuphela uma isikhwama esingu-≥1 esifakazelwe sesivele sithengile
arm.only_these_narratives_none_selected_any: Lezi zindaba kuphela — akukho okukhethiwe = noma yini
arm.set_the_rules_once_your_3d_agent: Setha imithetho kanye. Umenzeli wakho we-3D ubuka umfudlana wokukholwa kwe-Oracle obukhoma futhi enze ngokushesha lapho uhlamvu lwemali ludlula umkhawulo wakho — ethenga isikhundla esincane esikhwameni sakhe se-custodial Solana. Iqala ku-lingisa ukuze ukwazi ukuyibuka isebenza ngaphandle kwengozi, bese uya bukhoma uma usumethemba.
arm.simulate_logs_every_play_risk_free_live: Lingisa ukungena kwayo yonke imidlalo ngaphandle kwengozi. Okubukhoma kusebenzisa i-SOL yangempela esikhwameni somenzeli, ekhawulelwe imikhawulo yakho.
arm.the_conviction_stream_below_is_still_liv: I-stream yokuqinisekisa ngaphansi isaseyiphabhuliki, ngakho-ke leli ndlela yako yama-eyijenti kuphela. Phinda uzame, noma vula i-Oracle ukuze uqhubeke nobukela.
arm.when_should_your_agent_buy_only_plays: Umenzeli wakho kufanele athenge nini? Imidlalo kuphela ehlangabezana nayo yonke imithetho engezansi eyenziwayo.
arm.your_agent_needs_its_own_custodial_solan: Umenzeli wakho udinga isikhwama sakhe se-custodial Solana ukuze enze ngokukholwa. Sakha esisodwa estudiyo — kuthatha cishe umzuzu — bese ubuyela lapha ukuze usethe imithetho yaso.

artifact_index.glbs_over_6_mb_are_rejected_because: Ama-GLB angaphezu kwe-6 MB ayalahlwa, ngoba iphaneli ye-artifact kaClaude ingaqala ekugcineni kwe-payload ezinkulu ezinlined. Umbuki ongeza ama-565 KB aphezu komodeli.
artifact_index.glbs_over_6_mb_are_rejected_claude: GLBs ezingaphezu kuka-6 MB ziyenqatshelwa — iphaneli ye-artifact ka-Claude ingase ilenge kumalayisha amakhulu afakwe ngaphakathi. Isibukeli sengeza u-565 KB ngaphezulu kwemodeli.
artifact_index.meta_description: Faka umenzeli we-three.ws osebenzisanayo ngaphakathi kwe-artifact ye-Claude.ai. I-HTML ezimele, akukho ukuncika kwangaphandle.
artifact_index.meta_og_description: Ibonisa amabhundle e-artifact ka-Claude njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezizimele ezifakekayo.
artifact_index.meta_twitter_description: Ibonisa amabhundle e-artifact ka-Claude njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezizimele ezifakekayo.
artifact_index.models_over_6_mb_are_rejected_because: Amamodeli angaphezu kwe-6 MB ayalahlwa, ngoba iphaneli ye-artifact kaClaude ingaqala ekugcineni kwe-payload ezinkulu ezinlined. Ukunika base64 kwenkhodisa umodeli, okhokha ama-byte amane ngamathathu, kunye ne-565 KB yombuki: umodeli we-6 MB ufika ngokufanayo ku-8.6 MB ye-HTML. Lokhu okuphelele, hhayi umodeli, ndikwalezo izinto ezilinganiswa ngesize stat.
artifact_index.paste_a_single_url_into_a_claude: Namathisela i-URL eyodwa engxoxweni kaClaude. Impendulo iyi-HTML document eyodwa ezimele yodwa — i-three.js, i-GLTFLoader, kanye ne-GLB ye-agent yakho konke kufakwe ngaphakathi. Ayikho i-script evinjwe yi-CSP ye-sandbox kaClaude, akukho ukulanda okushiya ikhasi.
artifact_index.the_response_sets_a_csp_mirroring_claude: Impendulo isetha i-CSP efana neyakwaClaude. Ukuziphatha ekubukeni kuqala okubukhoma kufana nokuziphatha ngaphakathi kuClaude.ai — akukho okumangazayo phakathi kwe-staging ne-prod.
artifact_index.three_js_gltfloader_and_the_glb_are: I-three.js, i-GLTFLoader, kanye ne-GLB konke kufakwe ngaphakathi. Ikhasi libonakala ngaphandle kwezingcingo zenethiwekhi — ihambisana ngokugcwele ne-CSP ye-sandbox kaClaude evimbela ukulanda nama-script angaphandle.

asl-alphabet.atoz_p: Umsindo ngamunye usayinwe yinjini efanayo umphakathi oyisebenzisayo ukusayina impendulo ye-chat, ngakho lokho okufundayo lapha kuyinto efanayo nalokho ozokufunda khona. Phakamisa ukhiye ukuze ubone incazelo yawo; uchofoze noma ucindezele ukuze ubuke.
asl-alphabet.h1: I- ASL letter ngayinye, esandleni ongayijika.
asl-alphabet.keys_hint: Ithiphu: cindezela noma iyiphi <kbd>letter</kbd> noma <kbd>number</kbd> ukhiye ukuze uyisayine ngokushesha.
asl-alphabet.lede: Isithombe sesandla sikhombisa i-angulo eyodwa. Lokhu kuyinto yangempela: i-avatar efakwe i-rig ibumba i-alfabhethi ngayinye ye-alphabet ye-manual yaseMelika, ngesivinini osikhethayo, esandleni sokubili. Chofoza ukhiye, noma ujust ucindezele ku-keyboard yakho.
asl-alphabet.meta_desc: I-alphabet ye-manual yaseMelika ku-avatar ye-3D ephilayo. Chofoza noma thayipha noma iyiphi incwadi ukuze ubone isandla, ufunde lokho okufanele ubheke, ufunde ama-look-alikes, spell noma iyiphi igama, futhi uzijwayeze kuze kube uyakwazi ukufunda fingerspelling.
asl-alphabet.note: IFingerspelling ingxenye eyodwa ye-American Sign Language: ibhala amagama, ama-loanwords, kanye nanoma yini engekhona uphawu lwayo. Amagama anama-sign ayasayinwa signed, futhi ungawabona, uthole izimpendulo ze-AI ezisayinwe, futhi uphinde usayine nge-webcam yakho ku-/sign-language. I-referensi ephelele itholakala ku-the documentation, futhi injini engemuva kokubili amakhasi ithunyelwa njenge @three-ws/sign-language package, engafakwa kusuka ku-clone kuze kube i-registry publish ifika.
asl-alphabet.page_title: I-ASL Alphabet: incwadi ngayinye esandleni se-3D ephilayo · three.ws
asl-alphabet.practice_p: Ukufunda fingerspelling kuyisigaba esinzima, futhi kuza kuphela ngokuphindaphinda. I-avatar ibhala okuthile; uthayipha lokho okufundayo. I-streak yakho igcinwa kule divayisi.
asl-alphabet.share_desc: Chofoza noma thayipha noma iyiphi incwadi ukuze ubuke i-avatar ye-3D isayinayo, ufunde isandla, ufunde ama-look-alikes, futhi uzijwayeze ukufunda fingerspelling.
asl-alphabet.share_title: I-ASL Alphabet: incwadi ngayinye esandleni se-3D ephilayo · three.ws
asl-alphabet.spell_p: Thayipha igama bese ubuka ibhalwa incwadi ngencwadi, ngenkathi ukhiye ngamunye uvulwa njengoba isandla sifinyelela kulo. Amagama, izindawo, kanye nanoma yini engekhona uphawu lwayo yikho okukhuluma ngakho fingerspelling.

assembly.canvas_aria: Umfanekiso we-Machine. Donsela noma sebenzisa ama-arrow keys ukuze uhambise ikhamera.
assembly.explain1_body: Zombili izinsiza zakhiwa lapho ikhasi lilayisha. Izilinganiso ziba ama-profiles, ama-profiles abuyiselwa noma akhishwa, futhi imiphumela ihlanganiswa ezicini ozibonayo. I-cylinder barrel iyisawtooth eyodwa ebuyisiwe, i-rail iyisigaba esisodwa esivaliwe esihanjiswe phansi emgibeni, futhi i-propeller blade iyisixhumi se-NACA esiphakanyiswe nge-twist.
assembly.explain2_body: Ama-pistons avela ku-slider-crank ye-planar exakile. I-valve gear ivala i-four-bar chain ngokuhlangana kwemijikelezo njalo emgqeni. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-rod ende ibonakala ihlala phezulu endaweni engaphansi, futhi kungani ubude be-rod obungakwazi ukufinyelela ngokomzimba buhluleka ukuhamba kunokukhulisa.
assembly.explain3_body: Ithuluzi ngalinye liyinto encane ye-JSON yezinombolo. Kopisha ispec, uyinikeze kumjoli, uthole ithuluzi elihlukile. Thumela umphumela njenge GLB bese ufinyelela ngqo esithombeni se-avatar, ekhasini lemikhiqizo, noma ku-glTF umbonisi.
assembly.hint: Donsa ukuze uhambe · skrole ukuze ubonge · phakela ingxenye ukuyibiza · isikhala, E no S
assembly.meta_desc: Amathuluzi amabili asebenzayo ngaphandle kwamafayela e-3D model. Injini ye-aero radial kanye ne-locomotive ye-steam, eyakhelwe kwi-browser yakho kusuka ezilinganiso ezimbalwa, enezinyathelo ezixazululiwe, ukuboniswa okuhlukanisiwe, iziparamitha eziphilayo kanye ne-GLB yokuthumela.
assembly.next1_body: Chaza into ngamagama uthole i-GLB enezinhlaka.
assembly.next2_body: Faka ukuthunyelwa bese uhlole izinto, ama-meshes kanye nezinyathelo.
assembly.og_desc: Akukho amafayela emodeli. Injini ye-aero radial kanye ne-locomotive ye-steam eyakhiwe ngesikhathi sokusebenza kusuka ezilinganiso, ama-profiles kanye nemisebenzi ye-geometry, enezixhumanisi ezixazululiwe ongazihlakaza.

assembly.source_note: Kwakhiwe kusuka kumavalue akhulu, ngakho kuhlale kuhambisana nalokho okukhombisa esikrinini.

assistant.free_lane_needs_no_key_and_no: Umzila wamahhala awudingi ukhiye futhi awudingi i-akhawunti. Noma izivakashi ziletha ukhiye wazo we-Groq / OpenRouter — awusoze washiya isiphequluli sazo futhi awusoze wathinta ikhodi yesayithi lakho.
assistant.launcher_button_send_button_focus_rings: Inkinobho yokuqalisa, inkinobho yokuthumela, izindandatho zokugxila.
assistant.live_preview_running_in_the_corner_every: I-live preview iyasebenza esikhundleni. Yonke into eyintsha iphindela ikhiqizwe.
assistant.meta_description: Faka umsizi we-avatar ye-3D kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngethegi elilodwa le-script. Imodi ye-chatbot (amamodeli amahhala noma ukhiye wakho we-Groq/OpenRouter) nemodi yokukhuluma — i-avatar isho noma yini oyithayiphayo, ngokuzwakalayo, ngebhamuza lokukhuluma.
assistant.meta_og_description: Faka umsizi we-avatar ye-3D kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngethegi elilodwa le-script. Imodi yengxoxo nemodi yokukhuluma, izizinda ezingabonakali noma ezi-gradient, amamodeli amahhala noma ulethe ukhiye wakho.
assistant.meta_twitter_description: Faka umsizi we-avatar ye-3D kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngethegi elilodwa le-script. Imodi yengxoxo nemodi yokukhuluma, izizinda ezingabonakali noma ezi-gradient, amamodeli amahhala noma ulethe ukhiye wakho.
assistant.one_script_tag_adds_a_floating_launcher: Ithegi elilodwa le-script lifaka isiqalisi esintantayo kusayithi lakho. Chofoza kuso bese kuvela i-avatar ye-3D yangempela, epopayiwe — ngemuva kwekhasi lakho, umbala, noma i-gradient — ngezindlela ezimbili: i-chatbot ephendula imibuzo (amamodeli amahhala, noma ulethe ukhiye wakho we-Groq / OpenRouter), nemodi yokukhuluma lapho i-avatar isho khona ngqo okuthayiphayo, ngokuzwakalayo, ngebhamuza lokukhuluma.
assistant.paste_it_before_on_any_site_chat: Namathisela ngaphambi kwe-</body> kunoma iyiphi isayithi. Izimpendulo zengxoxo zivela ochungechungeni lwamamodeli amahhala (Groq → OpenRouter → NVIDIA) ngokuzenzakalelayo; izivakashi zingashintshela kukhiye wazo we-Groq noma we-OpenRouter kuzilungiselelo zewijethi — okhiye bahlala kusiphequluli sazo. Imodi yokukhuluma isebenzisa amazwi akhelwe ngaphakathi esiphequluli. Amadokhumenti agcwele: /docs.
assistant.the_live_preview_could_not_start_the: I-live preview ayinakwazi ukuqala (iskripthi ye-widget ayilayishwa). Isinye sakho esiphezulu siyasebenza, futhi i-widget iyasebenza esayithi yakho.
assistant.the_preview_mounted_but_its_3d_avatar: I-preview yagcina, kodwa i-3D avatar yayo ayilayishwa. Isinye sakho esiphezulu siyasebenza.
assistant.type_anything_and_the_avatar_says_it: Thayipha noma yini futhi i-avatar iyayisho ngokuzwakalayo nge-bubble yokukhuluma — i-text-to-speech yesiphequluli, amazwi akhethekayo, akukho mali.
assistant.use_a_built_in_body_any_three: Sebenzisa umzimba owakhelwe ngaphakathi, noma iyiphi i-id ye-avatar ye-three.ws (yenza eyodwa ku-Forge), i-URL ye-GLB, noma umzimba we-agent nge-data-agent.
assistant.what_should_the_chatbot_know_about_your: Yini okufanele i-chatbot iyazi ngesayithi lakho?

assistant_frame.speech_uses_your_browser_s_built_in: Inkulumo isebenzisa amazwi akhelwe ngaphakathi esiphequluli sakho — akukho okulayishwayo.
assistant_frame.which_model_lane_answers_you_title: Yimuphi umzila wemodeli ophendula imilayezo yakho
assistant_frame.your_key_is_stored_only_in_this: Ikhi yakho igcinwa kuphela kulesi siphequluli (i-localStorage ku-three.ws) futhi ithunyelwa ngqo kumhlinzeki — ayikaze ithinte amaseva e-three.ws noma ikhasi elifaka leli wijethi.

atlas.intents_desc: Ngamunye walezi zimpendulo ngezigaba ezilandelanayo, hhayi nje isixhumanisi. Ziyizinqamuleli ezifanayo ezikhombisa i-⌘K palette uma uchaza umsebenzi.
atlas.lede: Iplathifomu yonke ekhasini elilodwa, ihlukaniswe ngokuthi yini ngayinye esikrinini. Qala ngenhloso ngezansi, noma funa. Cindezela <kbd>⌘ K</kbd> noma kuphi ku-three.ws ukuze uvule ukufuna okufanayo ngaphandle kokushiya ikhasi okukhona kulo.
atlas.meta_desc: Iplathifomu yonke ye-three.ws njengekharikhulumu efunwa: ikhasi ngalinye lihlukaniswe ngokuthi yini, kanye nezinqamuleli zomsebenzi eziphendula ngezinyathelo. Cindezela Cmd+K noma kuphi esizeni ukuze uyifune.
atlas.search_placeholder: Funa ikhasi ngalinye, noma uchaze lokho ofuna ukukwenza
atlas.share_desc: Ikhasi ngalinye ku-three.ws, ihlukaniswe futhi ifunwa, kanye nezinqamuleli zomsebenzi ezisemva kwe-Cmd+K.
atlas.title: Atlas
atlas.twitter_desc: Iplathifomu yonke njengekharikhulumu efunwa: ikhasi ngalinye lihlukaniswe ngokuthi yini, kanye nezinqamuleli zomsebenzi eziphendula nge-Cmd+K palette. Cindezela Cmd+K noma kuphi esizeni ukuze uyifune ngaphandle kokushiya ikhasi.

atomic.feat1_body: I-Atomic requests transaction version 1 ngokucacile, ukuze i-V1 traffic ingaphuli noma iphele emgwaqweni wokufunda.
atomic.feat2_body: I-V1 caps ikhuluma ku-transactionConfig. I-Atomic ayizami ukwenza i-Compute Budget instruction scan ibabaze.
atomic.feat3_body: I-gauge ikala ama-byte we-wire asayini, hhayi isilinganiso. Izenzo eziphezulu kwe-MTU endala ziba sobala ngokushesha.
atomic.hint: Itholwa nge three.ws ejikayo Solana RPC rail enezifundo ze-V1 zivuliwe.
atomic.lede: I-ceiling yezenzo manje ingama-4 KiB. I-Atomic ibonisa ukuthi ama-byte wonke aya kuphi, ifunda ama-resource caps e-V1 endaweni efanele, futhi ibonisa umxhaso ukuthi kuzodingeka yini ukuthi abhalise.
atomic.meta_desc: Hlola noma iyiphi Solana transaction noma i-handoff engasayinwanga ngaphambi kokuthi uyisayine. Bona usayizi we-wire oqondile, imikhawulo ye-V1 transactionConfig, ukusetshenziswa kokubala, kanye nokuphepha komxhaso.
atomic.og_desc: I-observatory ye-V1 ephilayo kanye ne-microscope yokuphepha ngaphambi kokusayina ye Solana's entsha ye-4,096-byte transactions.
atomic.page_title: I-Atomic · Solana V1 Transaction Inspector · three.ws
atomic.tw_desc: I-observatory ye-V1 ephilayo ye Solana kanye ne-inspector yokuphepha ngaphambi kokusayina. Faka isignesha ye-mainnet noma i-base64 wire transaction ukuze ubone ama-byte aqondile, ama-resource caps, ukusetshenziswa kokubala, kanye nokuphepha komxhaso.

autopilot.meta_description: Faka uhlamvu lwakho lwemali lwe-pump.fun ku-autopilot. I-agent yakho yenza ukuthenga kabusha futhi isabalalise izimali zabakhi kubanikazi ngokuya ngemithetho oyibekile — futhi ilandise konke okwenzeka ku-chain ngesikhathi sangempela.
autopilot.meta_og_description: I-agent yohlamvu lwemali ezimele eyenza ukuthenga kabusha futhi isabalalise izimali ngokuya ngemithetho yakho, ilandiswa bukhoma yi-avatar yayo.
autopilot.meta_twitter_description: I-cockpit yethokheni engadingi ukubanjwa: setha imithetho — ukuthenga, ukuthengisa, kanye nezivikelo — futhi uvumele i-agent yakho isebenzise uhlamvu lwemali ngokuzimela.
autopilot.your_agent_runs_the_whole_coin_lifecycle: I-agent yakho isebenzisa wonke umjikelezo wempilo yohlamvu lwemali yodwa: iyathenga kabusha futhi ishise kusuka ezimalini zabakhi futhi isabalalise izinkokhelo kubanikazi — ngokuya ngemithetho oyibekile. Konke okwenzeka ku-chain kulandiswa bukhoma yi-avatar ye-agent yakho.

autopilot_activity.every_action_your_agent_took_on_your: Zonke izenzo umenzeli wakho azenzile egameni lakho — ngasinye sisekelwe enkumbulweni esisishukumisile, sisayiniwe, futhi singahlehliswa lapho kungenzeka khona. Lokhu kungukuzimela ongakuhlola.
autopilot_activity.meta_description: Zonke izenzo ezizimele umenzeli wakho three.ws azenzile — ngasinye sinenkumbulo esisishukumisile, irisidi elisayiniwe, nokuhlehlisa ngokuthepha kanye. Ukuzimela okuchazekayo ongakwethemba.
autopilot_activity.meta_og_description: Ukuzimela okuchazekayo: zonke izenzo umenzeli wakho azenzile, nenkumbulo esisishukumisile kanye nerisidi elisayiniwe.

avatar-cli.ci_gate1_note: Ithola i-re-export engakaze ikhulunywe, i-lossy optimization pass, umngane osebenze imodeli waguqula igama lefayela, kanye ne-CDN eqale ukuhlinzeka ngekhasi lephutha eline 200.
avatar-cli.ci_gate2_note: xargs iphuma ingekho zero uma noma iyiphi invocation yehlulekile, ngakho i-manifest eyodwa embi yehlisa isinyathelo sonke. I-wire kuzo zonke ezisebenza ku-release.
avatar-cli.ci_lede: I-manifest elungile kuphela ngosuku oyibhala ngayo iyidokhumenti, hhayi i-garanti. Ukuhlola okubili kuyikwenza kube okukodwa. Akudingi ukufinyelela kwenethiwekhi.
avatar-cli.cmd_hash_desc: I-lowercase hex SHA-256 yefayela, yodwa ku-stdout ukuze ihlangane. I-digest efanayo init ibhala ku mesh.sha256, okuyinto eyenza ukuthola ukwehluka kube ukuqhathaniswa komugqa owodwa.
avatar-cli.cmd_init_desc: I-scaffold i-manifest esebenzayo ye-schema kusuka kwi-wallet, igama, kanye nefayela le-mesh. Ifunda i-mesh kanye ukuze ibale i-SHA-256 yayo nosayizi, ukuze idokhumenti ingaphikisi nama-byte ayakhe.
avatar-cli.cmd_lede: Ayikho ifayela le-config, akukho i-project scaffold, akukho i-directory yesimo. Imiyalo ngayinye iyenza into eyodwa kufayela elilodwa futhi ikutshele ukuthi kwenzekeni.
avatar-cli.cmd_preview_desc: Ihlola, bese iphrinta i-resolver URL, i-<agent-3d> snippet ehambisana ne-loader ebhalisa yona, kanye ne-iframe ye-zero-install. Ikhumbuza uma mesh.uri isasebenzisa indlela yendawo.
avatar-cli.cmd_validate_desc: Ihlola i-manifest ngokumelene ne @three-ws/avatar-schema futhi iphrinta wonke amaphutha endaweni ye-instance lapho kwenzeka khona. Ukuphuma okungelona zero kwenza kube isango le-build hhayi umbiko.
avatar-cli.cta_docs: Funda imibhalo <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 7h8M7 3l4 4-4 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg>
avatar-cli.hero_sub: Dala i-avatar manifest eqinile ye-hash kusuka kwi-wallet kanye ne-GLB, uqinisekise ngokumelene ne-schema ephelile, bese uphinda uprinta i-embed snippet ethile. Offline, deterministic, futhi iphephile ukuyifaka ku-script yokukhulula.
avatar-cli.live_fallback_body: Umphakathi we-loader awubhaliswanga. I-snippet isasebenza kahle; bheka i-web component reference.
avatar-cli.live_lede: Lokhu akusiyo isithombe esithathwe. I-markup engezansi iyikho okukhombisa preview, efakwe kuleli khasi ngaphandle kokushintsha. Uma ikwazile ukuhamba, le ngxenye izophuka emphakathini.
avatar-cli.live_note: Zombili imigqa zibalulekile. <agent-3d> iyinto engaziwa kuze kube umphakathi ubhalisile, ngakho ukufaka kuphela ithegi kukunika ibhokisi elingenalutho ngaphandle kwesixwayiso. Lokhu kungakho preview kuhlale kuphrinta ndawonye. Umfundi ophikisanayo ungumkhiqizo we-markup; kuphela umthetho wesitayela ophakamisela ububanzi bayo ezikrinini ezincane, okuphathwa yile ngxenye ngokuphinda ibhalise.
avatar-cli.manifest_field_id_note: I-akhawunti ye-CAIP-10, noma i-handle yesevisi yegama ephetha ku-.eth, .ws, noma .sol.
avatar-cli.manifest_field_mesh_note: Ikheli lokuqukethwe kwemodeli. I-field ethola i-re-export ethule.
avatar-cli.manifest_field_owner_note: I-akhawunti ebanzi, ngakho ubunikazi abucacile ngaphandle kwe-platform.
avatar-cli.manifest_field_skeleton_note: Omunye we-avaturn, mixamo, rpm, vrm-humanoid, custom. Ukhetha ukuthi iyiphi i-animation library ethinta ku-rig.
avatar-cli.manifest_lede: Izinkambu eziyisixhenxe ezidingekayo. uri ikhuluma ukuthi kuphi i-mesh, sha256 ikhuluma ukuthi kufanele kube yini. Lezi yizithembiso ezihlukile, futhi kuphela eyokugcina iyaphumelela uma othile efaka imodeli ehlukile endaweni efanayo.
avatar-cli.manifest_more: Izinkambu ezinhlanu ezikhethwayo ezamukelwa yi-schema: animations, accessories, traits, creator, kanye signature. Eyokugcina iyona ethokozisayo: konke okunye kuyisicelo osithumelayo, kanti isignesha isicelo esingaqinisekiswa omunye umuntu ngaphandle kokwethemba iseva yakho.
avatar-cli.meta_desc: Amathuluzi e-terminal-native for on-chain avatars. Dala i-avatar manifest eqinile ye-hash kusuka kwi-wallet kanye ne-GLB, uqinisekise ngokumelene ne-schema, bese uphinda uprinta i-embed snippet. Offline, deterministic, CI-safe.

avatar_artifact.canvas_label: Umfanekiso we-3D olandelayo ocabanga ngokulandela ikhazimula yakho, ukuthinta, noma amakhiye okweqhezu
avatar_artifact.err_agent_fetch: Ukubuka kwe-eyijenti akubuyanga. Lokhu kuyisimo esisodwa se-network, ngakho-ke ukuzama kabusha kuyakuncoma.
avatar_artifact.err_avatar_private: Umfanekiso waleyo eyijenti uyiqhawe, ngakho-ke awunakubonakala ngaphandle kwe-three.ws. Iphrofayilayo isaseyiphabhuliki.
avatar_artifact.err_both: Nika i-id ye-eyijenti noma i-URL yomodeli, hhayi zonk'e zimbili. Susa enye kulinki uze ulayishe kabusha.
avatar_artifact.err_model_blocked: Leyo link yomodeli ayiyona i-URL ye-https ehostini elamukelayo lolu mbuki. Amamodeli kufanele asetshenziswe e-three.ws noma ehostini elaziwayo lezinto.
avatar_artifact.err_model_failed: Ifayela yomodeli ayinakwazi ukulayishwa. Inga hamba, noma isebenzisa indlela yokugcina engayenziwa lolu mbuki.
avatar_artifact.err_no_avatar: Leyo eyijenti ayinikwanga umfanekiso njengamanje, ngakho-ke akukho into eyenziwe ukuze ibhaliswe. Iphrofayilayo inesinye sakhe isimo.
avatar_artifact.err_no_webgl: Leli bhrawuza alikwazanga ukuqala WebGL, ngakho-ke isithombe se-3D asikwazi ukuboniswa lapha. Zama elinye ibhrawuza noma uvule ukusheshisa kwe-hardware.
avatar_artifact.err_not_found: Akukho eyijenti e-three.ws efanayo naleyo id. Ilinki ingakuba idala, noma i-eyijenti ingakuba isuswa.
avatar_artifact.meta_description: Isibukeli esizimele se-Three.js sama-avatar artifacts — esingashumekwa futhi sabelwe ngaphandle kwekhasi lokugoqa.
avatar_artifact.meta_og_description: Isibukeli esizimele se-Three.js sama-avatar artifacts — esingashumekwa futhi sabelwe ngaphandle kwekhasi lokugoqa.
avatar_artifact.meta_twitter_description: Isibukeli esizimele se-Three.js sama-avatar artifacts — esingashumekwa futhi sabelwe ngaphandle kwekhasi lokugoqa.
avatar_artifact.move_your_cursor_drag_on_touch_arrow: Hambisa isikhombisi sakho · hudula ngokuthinta · izinkinobho zemicibisholo
avatar_artifact.the_graphics_runtime_failed_to_load_this: I-graphics runtime yehlulekile ukulayisha — lokhu kuvamise ukusho ukuphazamiseka kwenethiwekhi noma isiphequluli esingenayo i-WebGL.

avatar_engines.a_factual_map_of_the_open_source: Imephu enembile yezinhlelo zomthombo ovulekile nezokuhweba ezakha ama-avatar e-3D angokoqobo nasezingeni eliphezulu — amakhanda e-Gaussian-splat, abantu besithombe esisodwa, izakhi zama-avatar zombhalo→avatar, kanye nama-rigs three.ws asevele ewanyakazisa. Ngayinye: ukuthi yakha ini, isebenza ngani, yini imvume yayo yelayisense, nokuthi i-three.ws iyisebenzisa kanjani ngqo.
avatar_engines.commercial_use_only: Ukusetshenziswa kwezentengiso kuphela
avatar_engines.every_engine_for_a_high_quality_human: Yonke injini ye-avatar yomuntu esezingeni eliphezulu.
avatar_engines.listings_are_reference_material_compiled: Uhlu luyizinto zereferensi ezihlanganiswe kusuka endaweni yokugcina kanye nephepha lephrojekthi ngayinye, olusha kusukela ngoJuni 2026. Izifinyezo zamalayisense ziyisiqondiso, hhayi iseluleko sezomthetho — qinisekisa imigomo ngephrojekthi yokuqala ngaphambi kwanoma yikuphi ukusetshenziswa kwezentengiso. Izinjini zocwaningo ezingezona ezokuhweba zixhunywe ukuze zisetshenziswe ngokuzibamba nangokwezemfundo futhi azixhunyiwe ngamabomu ohlelweni lokukhiqiza olukhokhelwayo lwe-three.ws. Okuwukuphela kwethokheni i-three.ws elikubhekisela kulo yi-$THREE.
avatar_engines.meta_description: I-atlas eqoqwe ngokucophelela, elineqiniso lezinjini zomthombo ovulekile nezokuhweba ezakha ama-avatar abantu be-3D asezingeni eliphezulu nanjengempilo — indlela, ilayisense, amandla okubala, nokuthi i-three.ws isebenzisa ngayinye kanjani.
avatar_engines.meta_og_description: Yonke injini enkulu yama-avatar abantu be-3D asezingeni eliphezulu nanjengempilo — amakhanda e-Gaussian-splat, isithombe→umuntu, umbhalo→i-avatar, nama-rigs i-three.ws esiwenza ube nempilo. Indlela, ilayisense, nesimo sokuhlanganiswa kwayo ngayinye.
avatar_engines.meta_twitter_description: I-atlas eqoqwe ngokucophelela yezinjini zama-avatar e-3D asezingeni eliphezulu nanjengempilo, enelayisense nesimo sokuhlanganiswa.
avatar_engines.the_atlas_renders_from_a_script_that: I-atlas irenderwa ngoskripthi esihambisana nale phaji, ngakho-ke lokhu kuyesaba ukuthi ipheji yaphazamisa ngaphakathi kokulanda noma umhloli wezinkonzo wangqongqoza. Ukubuya kuletha kuyasombulula ngamanye amaxesha. Uhlelo olufanayo, ngokwe-anjini, ubekezelwe futhi kudokhumenti ye-atlas.
avatar_engines.try_clearing_the_search_or_switching_off: Zama ukusula usesho noma uvale “okokusetshenziswa kwezentengiselwano kuphela”.

avatar_sdk.all_four_exports_are_typed_and_tree: Konke okuthunyelwa ngaphandle okune kuhlolelwe uhlobo futhi kungasuswa okungasetshenziswa. Kumakwe 'use client' kwe-Next.js App Router.

bnb.not_20_000_tps_marketing_three_product: Akuyona imakethe ye-"20,000 TPS" — amathrekhi amathathu omkhiqizo asebenzisa amakhono esiwahlolile ngokuzimela bukhoma ku-BNB Chain ngomhla ka-2026-07-07, okuyi-Ethereum L1, i-Base, kanye (ikakhulukazi) ne-Solana abangakwazi ukuwafanisa ngempela. Ikhadi ngalinye elingezansi lilandelela isimangalo salo kulokho esikulinganisile, lixhumanisa idemo yangempela lapho isithunyelwe, futhi lithi "iyeza maduze" — hhayi isixhumanisi esifile — lapho ingekho.
bnb.the_block_time_number_above_is_measured: Inombolo yesikhathi sebhulokhi engenhla ilinganiswa bukhoma kusuka ku-BSC RPC yomphakathi kukho konke ukulayishwa kwekhasi (probeBlockTime, kuthathwa amabhulokhi angama-200 angempela) — akukaze kube yi-"0.45s" eqinile.
bnb.three_things_only_bnb_chain_lets_us: Izinto ezintathu kuphela i-BNB Chain esivumela ukuba sizakhe.
bnb.we_never_claim_bnb_s_roadmap_targets: Asikaze sisho ukuthi izinhloso zendlela ye-BNB — i-20,000 TPS, ukuqedwa kwe-250ms (BEP-670), noma "uhlaka lwe-AI agent" olusezingeni le-chain — zithunyelwe. Kuphela lokho esikulinganise thina.

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: I-RPC ye-chain ethulayo ibonisa "iyaxhuma kabusha" kuleyo ndlela kuphela; okunye komjaho kuyaqhubeka. Zonke ezine ziwile ngesikhathi esisodwa zibonisa iphutha eliklanywe ngokuzama kabusha, akukaze kube ikhasi elingenalutho.
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: Ikhadi ngalinye lithatha amabhulokhi angempela (noma izikhala, ze-Solana) kusuka ku-RPC yomphakathi futhi libika isikhathi esilinganisiwe esijwayelekile — i-sparkline ingukufundwa okubukhoma kokugcina okungu-24, ibha ende kakhulu = isilinganiso esisheshayo.
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: I-RPC yomphakathi ye-chain ngayinye ayifinyeleleki okwamanje — lokhu kungukuphazamiseka kwangempela, hhayi iphutha. Zama futhi, noma ubuye maduze.
bnb_latency.every_number_comes_from_which_samples_re: Inombolo ngayinye ivela ku-/api/bnb/latency, ethatha amabhulokhi angempela (i-BNB nge-probeBlockTime, umsebenzi ofanayo osekelayo i-proof strip ye-/bnb hub) kusuka kuma-RPC omphakathi kukho konke ukuhlola — akukho okubalwe ngaphambili noma okuyiqiniso.
bnb_latency.four_lanes_one_honest_race_bnb_chain: Izindlela ezine, umjaho owodwa othembekile: I-BNB Chain, i-Base, i-Ethereum, kanye ne-Solana, ngalinye lilinganiswa bukhoma kusuka ku-RPC yomphakathi njalo ngemizuzwana embalwa — akukaze kube yi-"0.45s" eqinile. Indlela ethulayo ibonisa "iyaxhuma kabusha," hhayi inombolo mbumbulu eqandisiwe, kuyilapho ezinye ziqhubeka nomjaho.

brownout.hero_p: Ukuphuma KweBrownout kuyikhodi esebenza kuphela uma kukhona okuphukile, okwenza kube yikhodi engahlolwanga kahle kunazo zonke kunoma iyiphi i-codebase. Ngakho le platform yenza izinto ezimbili ngakho. Impendulo ngayinye ibonisa ukuthi idatha yayo ivela kuphi nokuthi ikhuluma kanjani, ku-header ongayifunda. Futhi yonke ukuphuma okungaphansi kwenziwe ngempela, nomhlinzeki ovikela khona empeleni ephika, ngaphakathi kwendlela efanayo umsebenzisi ayithintayo. Izinkokhelo zikhona ngezansi. Funda i-reference ye-grammar ye-header nokuthi ungayenza kanjani i-probe ngokwakho.
brownout.live_h2: Ucingo oluphilayo, oluvela ku-browser yakho, manje
brownout.meta_desc: Impendulo ngayinye ethunyelwa yi-API ibonisa ukuthi idatha yayo ivela kuphi nokuthi ikhuluma kanjani, futhi yonke ukuphuma kuqinisekiswe ngokuphula i-upstream evikela yona. Funda izinkokhelo: umhlinzeki owaphikayo, obamba isicelo, nokuthi impendulo yayindala kangakanani.
brownout.og_desc: Ukuphuma KweBrownout kuyikhodi engahlolwanga kahle kunoma iyiphi i-codebase, ngoba into evikela yona ayenzeki ngokufunwa. Ngakho siyayiphula ngenhloso, futhi sishicilela izinkokhelo.
brownout.proven_p: Ikhadi ngalinye libiza i-upstream, iphutha elifakiwe kuyo, nokuthi i-endpoint yenze kanjani. Isinqumo se-asithathwanga sibikwa ngokucacile njengokwehluleka: kusho ukuthi iphutha lamukelwe kodwa i-cache efudumele yaphendula ngaphambi kokuthi kube khona ucingo lwe-upstream, ngakho akukho okwenziwayo okuqinisekisiwe. Ubufakazi obungazange busebenze abuyona impumelelo.
brownout.reading_p1: I-endpoint ngayinye iphendula nge-x-brownout, futhi ifaka x-brownout-trace uma kukhona okuphukile. Ukukhuluma kahle kuyisikhala esikhona esikhundleni sokuba iflegi, futhi impendulo ibika i-eyabiwe kakhulu eyasiza: phila yeza ngentambo ngesikhathi sokucela kwakho, cache iyithola ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sayo esihlosiwe, stale indala kunalokho ngoba i-upstream ayikwazi ukuphendula, futhi fallback kusho umhlinzeki ohlukile noma indlela ehlukile ephendula umbuzo. Ikhasi elakhiwe kusuka kokufundwa okukodwa okuphilayo nokufundwa okungama-30 amaminithi akudala akuphili, ngakho-ke alikwazi ukusho ukuthi kuphilile.
brownout.reading_p2: I-@three-ws/brownout iphakheji ihlaziya lezi zihloko, futhi inika ukuhlolwa kwakho ukufaka iphutha okufanayo okwakhiwe kule khasi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwakho kuhluleka ngendlela ocabanga ngayo.
brownout.twitter_desc: Siphula abahlinzeki bethu ngenhloso, endleleni yesicelo yangempela, futhi sishicilela lokho okuvele.

bundles.hero_lede: Thengisa amakhono amaningi omphakathi njengokuthengwa okukodwa. Ingxenye enzima ayikaze ibe yibhande, bekukhona intengo, ngakho three.ws ibala intengo kusuka ekuthengiseni kwakho: ithola abathengi abake bathenga amakhono amabili noma ngaphezulu ngokuqhubekayo futhi ibonisa ukuthi ibhande labe lithole malini kulabo bantu abanjalo. Bheka izincwadi ze-API.
bundles.live_p: Phila kulomphakathi manje, ethunyelwa publicly ku-/api/agents/<id>/bundles futhi ithengwa ngentela eyodwa evula wonke amakhono ngaphakathi. Ukumisa okukodwa kuyayifihla kubathengi futhi kuyishiya lapha, ibhalwe, ukuze ungayibuyisela. Indlela yokuphuma.
bundles.meta_desc: Bhalisela amakhono omphakathi abe ukuthengwa okukodwa futhi ubale intengo kusuka ekuthengiseni kwakho. three.ws ibuyisela noma iyiphi intengo ngokumelene nabathengi abake bathenga amakhono amabili noma ngaphezulu ngokuqhubekayo, ukuze ubone ukuthi ibhande labe lithole malini ngaphambi kokuthi ulishicilele.
bundles.og_desc: Bhalisela amakhono omphakathi abe ukuthengwa okukodwa, kubalwe kusuka ekuthengiseni kwakho kunokuba kube umthetho wokubala.
bundles.pick_sub: Amakhono kuphela anentengo esebenzayo angabhalwa, ngoba ibhande kufanele libe nencazelo encane kunezingxenye zayo ukuze libe nencazelo.

bundles.price_sub: Wonke inombolo lapha ivela ezithengweni ezikhokhiwe ezivunyelwe yile agent. Ukuhlola nokufinyelela okunikezwe yi-bundle yangaphambili akubalwa, ngakho akukho okukhuphula lokho okubonayo.

bundles.step3_body: I-bundle iyaphuma ku-agent. Ukukhokha okukodwa kuvula wonke amakhono kuyo.

Umphumela uba ifu lamaphuzu elinemibala endaweni yomhlaba. Okuphumayo kuboniswa nge-WebGL THREE.Points; leli ifu lamaphuzu, hhayi i-Gaussian splat.

choreograph.export_json_lede: Ngokexactly okugcina ku-meta.choreographies, futhi ngokexactly okuthi PUT /api/agents/:id/animations yamukela.
choreograph.export_play_lede: I-routine engezansi iyaphila: faka kuyo noma iyiphi ikhasi esivele ibonisa i-<agent-3d> embed.
choreograph.footnote: I-routine iyuhlu lwezikhala nezibambo, hhayi uhlu lwefayela le-animation: i-routine efanayo ibukeka ihluke ku-agent enezithombe ezihlelwe kabusha kumagagasi ayo ku-ikhasi le-vocabulary, okuyinto eyinhloko. Ifomethi ye-wire, isimo sokugcina kanye ne-API yokudlala kubhalwe ku-docs/choreography.
choreograph.hero_lede: Isikhumbuzo esisodwa siyisigqi. I-routine iyikhono: phakamisa, bese ucabanga, bese wethula into oyenzile. Yakha eyodwa ku-timeline, ubuke konke ku-avatar ephilayo, bese uyigcina ku-agent yakho futhi uyidlale ngegama kusuka kunoma iyiphi embed.
choreograph.meta_desc: Hlanganisa ukulandelana kwesikhathi kwezikhumbuzo ze-agent ku-timeline, ubuke yonke imisebenzi ku-avatar ye-3D ephilayo, bese uyigcina ku-agent yakho futhi uyidlale ngegama kusuka kunoma iyiphi embed.
choreograph.og_desc: Hlanganisa izikhumbuzo ze-agent zibe yi-routine yesikhathi, uyibuke ephilayo ku-3D, uyigcine ku-agent yakho, futhi uyidlale ngegama kusuka kunoma iyiphi embed.
choreograph.palette_p: I-vocabulary ye-slot eqinile. Igama lesinyathelo libiza i-slot, ngakho umkhuba owabelwana ngawo nomunye umphakathi usadlala indlela yawo yokwenza kuyo yonke isenzo.
choreograph.routine_p: Umgqa ngamunye ungumthambo owodwa. Donsa ukuze uhlele, setha isikhathi sokugcina, futhi uqondise noma yisiphi isinyathelo kumklamo ohlukile. Isiteji silandela zonke izinguquko.
choreograph.save_lede: Ngena ukuze ugcine lo mkhuba kumphakathi. Okunye konke kuleli khasi kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti, futhi umkhuba wakho usukhona ku-URL.
choreograph.ship_p: Gcina umkhuba kumphakathi owawunawo futhi uhamba nalowo mphakathi: umphakathi obonakalayo uyawuthwala, futhi noma iyiphi i-embed ingawudlala ngegama.
choreograph.stage_empty_body: Qala kumkhuba ongezansi, noma ungeze isenzo. Akukho okukhona kwe-3D kuze kube wenza.
choreograph.stage_error_body: I-clip ilungile: i-rig yokwabelana yokubuka ayikwazanga ukuyibophela. Shintsha i-clip yesinyathelo, noma uyibuke yodwa ku-gallery.
choreograph.start_p: Imisebenzi emihlanu eyakhiwe kusuka kwi-slot vocabulary ethunyelwe. Layisha eyodwa, bese ushintsha noma yini: lezi yizindawo zokuqala, hhayi amamodeli okumele ugcine.
choreograph.steps_empty_body: Khetha isenzo esingezansi ukuze ungeze umthambo wokuqala, noma layisha omunye wemikhuba engenhla.
choreograph.timeline_empty: I-timeline engenalutho. Engeza isenzo futhi ibonakala lapha.
choreograph.tw_desc: I-timeline ye-agent body language. Hlanganisa, ubuke ku-3D, gcina kumphakathi wakho, udlale ngegama.

coin_intel.each_launch_time_signal_s_correlation_wi: Ukuhlobana kwesiginali ngayinye yesikhathi sokwethulwa nomphumela omuhle (okuphothuliwe noma okukhushuliwe), okufundwe kuhlamvu lwemali ngalunye olulebuliwe. Okuluhlaza kubikezela abawinile; okubomvu kubikezela abahluliwe. Akukho bhokisi elimnyama — lokhu kungukuhlobana okucacile okuhlanganiswa yi-sniper esikolweni sayo.
coin_intel.every_pump_fun_launch_watched_the_second: Konke ukwethulwa kwe-pump.fun, kubukwa ngesekhondi kuvela — kuhlukaniswe, kukalwe ukuhweba ngakunye, futhi kwahlolwa. Isidingo esingokwemvelo noma ibhandela elixhaswe ngezimali? Ubani ngempela othengayo? Injini ifunda ukuthi yiziphi izimpawu ezibikezela abawinile, futhi ama-ejenti akho e-3D afunda ubuhlakani obufanayo ukuze enze.
coin_intel.every_wallet_that_traded_an_observed_coi: Yonke i-wallet eyahweba ngohlamvu lwemali olubonwe, ihlukaniswe ngomkhondo wayo we-cross-coin. Izinga lokuwina yingxenye yezinhlamvu zemali zayo ezithengiwe eziphothuliwe noma ezikhushuliwe — kubalwa uma i-wallet inezinhlamvu zemali okungenani ezi-3 ezilebuliwe. Lena yincwadi yoku-oda ngemuva kwencwadi yoku-oda.

companion.contacts_sub: Nika umuntu i-avatar futhi imiyalezo yabo ifika kulowo msebenzi, ngomsindo wabo. Bonke abanye bathunyelwa ngumngane wakho ojwayelekile.
companion.default_avatar_hint: Isetshenziselwa noma ubani ongenayo ikhadi lokuxhumana.
companion.default_voice_hint: Ukukhuluma kweqiniso okuvela ku-Voice Lab imizila, kukhuluma ku-browser.
companion.feed_sub: Yonke imiyalezo efikile, lokho okwakuhlonziwe, nokuthi kungani. Okuthule kugcinwa lapha esikhundleni sokukhuluma.
companion.hero_sub: I-character ye-3D ehamba phambili futhi ikutshele izinto ezibalulekile zokuphazamisa. Xhuma lokho osekuwasebenzisayo, nikeza abantu ababalulekile ubuso nomsindo wabo, futhi uvumele konke okunye kuhlale kuthule.
companion.meta_desc: Umngane we-3D owuletha imiyalezo yakho ebalulekile ngqo. Xhuma i-Telegram, ikhalenda lakho, ibhokisi lakho, noma ifoni yakho, nikeza wonke oxhumana nabo i-avatar yabo, futhi uzwe okubalulekile ngomsindo.
companion.og_desc: Umngane we-3D owuletha imiyalezo yakho ebalulekile ngqo. Bring your own keys, give your contacts a face, and hear what matters out loud.
companion.pitch_card1: 📱 Ifoni yakho, iMac yakho, noma yini I-token eyodwa, i-endpoint eyodwa. Iphrofayela ye-Android, i-Shortcut, umthetho we-Mail, i-build script, noma i-agent ethathile ukuthi udinga ukwazi.
companion.pitch_card2: ✈️ Telegram I-bot oyidalayo iyadlulisa kuphela izingxoxo ozifakile kuyo. Yikhiphe futhi uxhumano luyaphela, ngaphandle kokushiya lutho lapha.
companion.pitch_card3: 📅 Ikhalenda I-link ye-iCal eyimfihlo i-Google, i-Apple, i-Outlook ne-CalDAV zonke ezikhangisa. Ikutshela ukuthi umhlangano uqala ngenkathi usakwazi ukusihlanganisa.
companion.pitch_card4: ✉️ I-imeyili IMAP ngephasiwedi ye-app. Funda kuphela, amakhanda kanye nesithombe esifushane, futhi isimo sakho esingafundwanga asithintwa. Noma sebenzisa imishini yakho ukuze uhlole futhi uthumele kuphela umusho.
companion.pitch_foot: Ifinyelela kuwe lapha, njengokuphusha kukhompuyutha yakho, futhi kukhompuyutha yakho njengomlingiswa ohamba phezu kwesikrini sakho. Abathuthukisi bathola konke lokhu njenge i-SDK, i-CLI, kanye ne-MCPserver.
companion.pitch_h: Ucingo lwakho luthokozisa izikhathi ezingama-40 ngosuku. Kubili kulokhu kubalulekile.
companion.pitch_lead: Umngane ufunda lokho okuvela kuma-akhawunti osuwasebenzisayo, unquma ukuthi umuntu uzodinga ukuthola ukushaya emhlane, bese ehamba phambili akusho. Okunye konke kuhlala kuthule, kukhishwa, nencazelo yokuthi kungani kuhlala kuthule.
companion.pitch_step1: 1 Xhuma lokho osuwasebenzisayo. Zonke iziqu zakho, futhi zifihliwe lapha.
companion.pitch_step2: 2 Nikeza abantu ababalulekile ubuso nomsindo. Imiyalezo yabo ifika njengabo.
companion.pitch_step3: 3 Beka umkhawulo, nezinsuku ozongena kuzo. Lokhu kuyimveliso ephelele.
companion.quiet_hint: Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhala imiyalezo igcinwa, ayikhulumi.
companion.settings_sub: Umkhawulo imiyalezo okufanele iwine ngaphambi kokuthi othile angene esiteji.
companion.sources_sub: Bring your own keys. Akukho okukhishwa okungakwazi ukususwa kwenye indawo ngokuqhafaza okukodwa, futhi zonke iziqu zifihliwe ngaphambi kokuthi zifinyelele kwi-database.
companion.stage_empty: Akukho okuthunyelwe okwamanje. Xhuma umthombo ngezansi, noma thumela umyalezo wokuhlola kusuka kufoni yakho, futhi noma ngubani ongena lapha uzovela lapha.
companion.stage_sub: Ukuthunyelwa kwakamuva, ngokunembile njengoba umngane wakho ekwenza.
companion.threshold_hint: Phansi kuzwela okuningi. Phezulu kugcina izinto ozofuna ukushaya emhlane.
companion.timezone_hint: Itholakele kule bhrawuza futhi isetshenziselwa amahora athule.
companion.tw_desc: Umngane we-3D okhombisa imiyalezo yakho ebalulekile ngqo.

concierge.an_ai_concierge_with_a_face_for: I-concierge ye-AI enobuso, yanoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi.
concierge.answers_stream_in_over_sse_and_the: Izimpendulo zigeleza nge-SSE bese i-avatar iqala ukukhuluma umusho wokuqala kanti okunye kusafika.
concierge.at_ask_time_it_reads_the_live: Ngesikhathi sokubuza ifunda ikhasi elibukhoma (isihloko, izihloko ezincane, ukuzulazula, okuqukethwe) kanye nolwazi lwakho olukhethiwe, futhi iyala ukusungula amanani noma izinqubomgomo engaziboni.
concierge.completed_sentences_are_handed_to_the_br: Imisho eqediwe idluliselwa enjinini yokukhuluma yesiphequluli njengoba ifika, futhi umugqa wesikhathi we-text-to-viseme uqhuba ukushintsha komlomo we-avatar ngokuvumelana. Uthulisiwe? Amazwibela kanye ne-lipsync kusadlala, ngakho impendulo ayikaze ime.
concierge.meta_description: Faka i-concierge ye-AI kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngethegi elilodwa: i-avatar ye-3D elungisiwe ecwayiza futhi yenza i-lipsync, isakaza izimpendulo ezisekelwe ekhasini lakho elibukhoma, kanye nezwi lesiphequluli elingena neliphuma. I-embed yamahhala, evulekile nge-three.ws.

concierge.no_crawler_no_vector_database_no_onboard: Akukho crawler, akukho database ye-vector, akukho ucingo lokwamukela. Izingxenye ezintathu ezihambayo.
concierge.one_accent_color_restyles_the_whole_widg: Umbala owodwa ogqamile ushintsha isitayela se-widget yonke. Okukhanyayo nokumnyama kulandela isistimu yesivakashi, noma ukhethe okukodwa. Ngezansi kwesokunxele noma ngezansi kwesokudla.
concierge.one_tag_gives_your_site_a_support: Ithegi elilodwa linikeza isayithi lakho ingxoxo yokusekela izivakashi ezijabulela ngempela: i-avatar ye-3D elungisiwe ecwayiza, ekhuluma, futhi yenza i-lipsync; izimpendulo ezisakazwayo ezisekelwe ekhasini lakho elibukhoma; kanye nezwi elingena neliphuma, ngqo kusuka kusiphequluli. Akukho-akhawunti, akukho ukusetha kwe-crawler, akukho intengo ngesihlalo.
concierge.pick_your_flavor_every_option_ships_the: Khetha okuthandayo. Yonke inketho iletha i-widget efanayo.
concierge.push_to_talk_speech_input_and_browser: Ukufaka izwi nge-push-to-talk nokuphuma kwezwi okungokwemvelo kusiphequluli, akukho-backend yomsindo futhi akukho-API key. Ukuthulisa kuyichofoza okukodwa futhi kuyakhunjulwa.
concierge.skeleton_rigged_blinking_idling_viseme_l: Ilungiswe ngeskeleton, icwayiza, iyazula, yenza i-viseme-lipsync ngenkathi ikhuluma. Izivakashi zikhetha i-concierge yazo kukhathalogi ehlukahlukene, noma unikeze eyakho GLB.
concierge.the_snapshot_the_running_conversation_an: I-snapshot, ingxoxo eqhubekayo, nombuzo kuya ku-/api/concierge, okwakha i-system prompt esekelwe futhi kusakaze impendulo emuva nge-SSE kusuka ku-three.ws free-first inference chain, ngokushintsha okuzenzakalelayo phakathi kwabahlinzeki, ukuze i-widget ihlale isebenza lapho noma yimuphi umzila uvinjelwe.
concierge.the_widget_is_open_source_and_the: I-widget iyi-open source futhi injini yezimpendulo ebanjwe isebenza ku-three.ws free inference chain. Letha i-endpoint yakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ifomethi yocingo efanayo.
concierge.this_page_runs_it_live_try_the: Leli khasi liyisebenzisa bukhoma, zama ibhamuza elisekhoneni ↘
concierge.when_a_visitor_asks_something_the_widget: Lapho isivakashi sibuza okuthile, i-widget ithatha i-snapshot ye-DOM ebukhoma, isihloko, incazelo ye-meta, izihloko, amalebula okuzulazula, nokuqukethwe okuyinhloko, okulinganiselwe kubhajethi eqinile, futhi ihlanganisa ulwazi olulungiselele. Noma yini ikhasi lakho eliyishoyo namuhla yilokho i-concierge ekwaziyo namuhla.

connect.add_three_ws_to_claude_chatgpt_cursor: Yongeza three.ws ku-Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code noma Claude Code futhi umsizi wakho angakha imodeli ye-3D namavathari, aqhube ama-agent akho, afunde ama-wallet abo futhi akhokhe ngezinsizakalo ku-x402. Ngena kanye kuphela ku-browser yakho: akukho ukhiye we-API okufanele ukopishe. Ithuluzi ngalinye libhalwe ku-MCP uhlu lwamathuluzi.
connect.any_client_that_speaks_streamable_http_m: Noma iyiphi client ekhuluma nge-Streamable HTTP MCP ingaxhuma. Amaklayenti anokwesekwa kwe-OAuth akungena ngokuzenzakalelayo kusuka ku-server's WWW-Authenticate header. Amaklayenti angenalo angathumela ukhiye we-API ku-Dashboard → API njenge-Authorization: Bearer.
connect.back_in_apps_connectors_click_create_nam: Emuva ku-Izinhlelo & Abaxhasi, chofoza Dala. Biza three.ws, namathisela i-URL, khetha OAuth, bese uyakha.
connect.chatgpt_adds_custom_mcp_servers_through_: I-ChatGPT ifaka ama-server akhethekile MCP nge Imodi yoMthuthukisi, ezinhlelweni lapho i-OpenAI iyinikeza. Ayikho ikhasi eligcwalisiwe, ngakho kopisha i-URL kuqala.
connect.click_connect_and_sign_in_to_three: Chofoza Xhuma bese ungene ku three.ws. Funda amalungelo ngaphambi kokuthi uvume.
connect.click_the_button_above_check_the_name: Chofoza inkinobho engenhla, hlola igama ne-URL, bese uchofoza Faka. Ukwengeza ngesandla: Hlela → Abaxhasi (Izilungiselelo → Abaxhasi kwezinye izinkontileka), Faka umxhumanisi okhethekile, namathisela i-URL.
connect.each_tool_declares_whether_it_only_reads: Ithuluzi ngalinye lishicilela ukuthi lilungiselela kuphela, libhale, noma lenza okuthile okungaguquki, ukuze iklayenti lakho lizokwazi ukuthi likubuze ngani. I-catalog yeziThuluzi inepolitiki yokwethembeka esilungile yokunamathisela.
connect.every_client_you_connect_appears_under_d: Ikhaya ngalinye olixhumanisayo livela ngaphansi kwe Dashboard → Izilungiselelo → Izinhlelo ezixhunywe. Ukukhansela okukodwa kumisa lelo klayenti phakathi kwehora, lapho i-token yokufinyelela yalo yamanje iphelelwa yisikhathi. Ama-agent akho nezilinganiso azingcoliswa.
connect.every_hosted_server_with_its_auth_and: I-server ngayinye ehleliwe, enokuthola kwayo nezinsiza, ibhalwe ngendlela efundwa yimishini ku /.well-known/mcp.json.
connect.for_github_copilot_agent_mode_in_vs: Ngemodi ye-agent ye-GitHub Copilot ku-VS Code. Inkinobho ivula isikhumbuzo sokufaka se-VS Code; i-server ikungena ekusebenziseni kokuqala.
connect.in_a_chat_open_the_menu_then: Engxoxweni, vula imenyu +, bese Abaxhasi, futhi switch three.ws kuzo le ngxoxo.
connect.in_a_new_chat_open_the_menu: Engxoxweni entsha, vula imenyu +, khetha Imodi yoMthuthukisi, bese uhlole three.ws.
connect.in_claude_code_type_pick_the_server: KuClaude Code, bhala /mcp, khetha i-server oyifakile bese ukhetha Qinisekisa.
connect.in_settings_apps_connectors_advanced_set: Ku Izilungiselelo → Izinhlelo & Abaxhasi → Izilungiselelo ezithuthukile, vula Imodi yoMthuthukisi.
connect.link_format_from_cursor_s_install_link: Ifomethi ye-link evela ku Izincwadi zokufaka ze-Cursor.
connect.link_format_from_vs_code_s_mcp: Ifomethi ye-link evela ku I-MCP umhlahlandlela womthuthukisi we-VS Code.
connect.links_open_your_client_with_the_server: Izixhumanisi zivula iklayenti lakho ne-server egcwalisiwe. Usabuyekeza futhi uqinisekise.

I-URL yomxhumanisi eyodwa inika uClaude, i-ChatGPT, i-Cursor, i-VS Code noma i-Claude Code amathuluzi three.ws MCP: ukukhiqiza kwe-3D, ama-agent, ama-wallets kanye x402 ukukhokha. connect.one_url_your_ai_gets_three_ws: I-URL eyodwa. I-AI yakho ithola three.ws.

connect.sign_in_to_three_ws_when_chatgpt: Ngena ku-three.ws uma i-ChatGPT icela, bese uvuma amalungelo.
connect.signing_in_gives_your_client_its_own: Ukungena kukunika iklayenti lakho ithokheni yalo ye-three.ws akhawunti, ngamalungelo owavumile esikrinini sokuvuma. Amathuluzi asebenza kuma-agent nasezikhwama ze-akhawunti oyingenile.
connect.start_with_three_ws_add_others_later: Qala nge-three.ws. Faka abanye kamuva; ngalinye liyisixhumi saso.
connect.steps_follow_claude_s_own_guide_its: Izinyathelo zilandela umhlahlandlela kaClaude. Imenyu zayo zishintsha: uma lezi zishintsha, sazise.
connect.steps_follow_openai_s_developer_mode_gui: Izinyathelo zilandela umhlahlandlela wesimo sokuthuthukisa se-OpenAI. Amathegi akhe ashintsha kaningi: uma lezi zishintsha, sazise.

connect.the_button_opens_cursor_s_install_prompt: Inkinobho ivula isikhumbuzo sokufaka se-Cursor esigcwele isiphakeli. I-Cursor emva kwalokho iqhuba ukungena kwe-three.ws.
connect.works_on_claude_ai_and_the_claude: Kusebenza ku-claude.ai nasethembeni le-Claude, kuzo zonke izinhlelo. Ama-akhawunti mahala angangeza isixhumi esisodwa esikhethekile. Ku-Team nase-Enterprise, kuphela abanikazi abangangeza esisodwa.

constellation.generated_by_an_ai_model_from_public: Kwenziwe imodeli ye-AI kusuka kudatha ye-token yomphakathi. Okokwazisa kuphela — hhayi iseluleko sezezimali. Amathokheni aboniswayo adatha ebukhoma pump.fun / Solana futhi akuzona izivumelwano.

cookbook.empty_p: I-cookbook incane futhi iyakhula. Susa ifilitha ukuze ubone konke, noma uvule udaba ngendlela ofisa ukuba khona.
cookbook.hero_p: Hhayi izinyathelo. Wonke umkhiqizo lapha ungumfayela oqhutshelwe kwi-API ephilayo ngaphambi kokushicilelwa: ithuluzi le-command-line, i-batch pipeline, iseva ye-MCP, i-CI gate, i-agent loop ezilungisayo. Kopisha eyodwa, uyisebenzise, uyishintshe.
cookbook.meta_desc: Izindlela ezisebenzisekayo zokwakha nge-three.ws: umbhalo ube 3D kusuka kwi-command line, ama-parallel asset packs, ithuluzi le-MCP le-assistant yakho ye-AI, i-CI quality gate, kanye ne-self-correcting generation loop. Wonke umkhiqizo uthumela ifayela ongayisebenzisa.
cookbook.outro_p: Umkhiqizo ungumfayela owenza, kanye nemibhalo echaza ukuthi kungani ubunjwa kanjalo. Uma wakhe okuthile ku-3D API okufanele ukukopisha, thumela.
cookbook.share_desc: Izindlela ezisebenzisekayo zokwakha nge-three.ws. Wonke umkhiqizo uthumela ifayela ongayisebenzisa, ngokumelene ne-3D API engenamali futhi engenamakhodi.

cookbook_index.4_let_the_model_art_direct: 4. Vumela imodeli iqondise ubuciko¶
cookbook_index.a_failed_verdict_is_not_a_dead: Isinqumo esihlulekile akusona isiphetho esifile, ngoba umhlaziyi usevele walubhala ukulungiswa. ukulungisa kuthatha isethi ehloliwe, kuphinde kukhiqize yonke ipropu ehlulekile kusuka ku-revised_prompt yayo, futhi kuphinde kuhlolisise umphumela.
cookbook_index.a_full_run_costs_a_few_cents: ukusebenza okugcwele kubiza amasenti ambalwa nge-gpt-5-mini
cookbook_index.a_full_run_takes_roughly_10_to: Ukusebenza okugcwele kuthatha cishe imizuzu eyi-10 kuya kweyi-15 kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni. Cishe konke kungesikhathi sokukhiqiza i-3D (cishe imizuzwana engama-30 kuya kwengama-90 ngepropu ngayinye, esebenza ngokufanayo); ukusetshenziswa kwemodeli kubiza amasenti ambalwa nge-gpt-5-mini, futhi womabili amaphuzu okugcina e-3D amahhala.

Umsizi ongezansi ubonisa noma yiluphi uhlu lwezizukulwane njengegridi esebenzisanayo esebenzisa <model-viewer>, ingxenye yewebhu evulekile ye-glTF. copy-coach.share_title: Copy Coach: ukuhweba kwakho kokuqala kokukopisha, ngendlela enakekela · three.ws
copy-coach.sub: Izinyathelo ezine ezincane ukusuka ekukopisheni okungakaze kube khona kuya kokukodwa okuncane okuphathwayo. Wonke inombolo iyangempela futhi ixhunywe ku-rekhodi eyayivela kuyo. Izinyathelo ezimbili zokuqala azidingi i-akhawunti noma i-wallet, futhi ungama lapho kunoma iyiphi isinyathelo.
copy-coach.title: Ukwenza ukuhweba kwakho kokuqala kokukopisha, ngendlela enakekela
copy-coach.twitter_desc: Ukwina okwangempela kanye nerekhodi yayo ephelele, imali engaqondile kuqala, bese okukodwa okuncane okukhawulelwe okusayinwe wena.

crews.invite_note: Omunye oseqenjini ubonisa i-tag yabo esikhundleni sebhathini.
crews.invited_copy: Ukukwamukela okukodwa kuhlanza okunye. Ungaba eqenjini elilodwa ngesikhathi.
crews.meta_desc: Tholile iqembu, mema abantu bakho, futhi ubuke wonke uhlu luma kule ndawo enkulu ye-3D. Wonke umphakathi ubonakala njengomphakathi wabo, ukhanyisiwe uma bukhona emhlabeni.

crews.signedout_copy: Iqembu lixhumene ne-akhawunti yakho, hhayi ku-browser, ngakho uhlu kanye ne-tag kukulandela noma kuphi lapho ungene khona. Ukuhamba kwi-directory ngezansi akudingi i-akhawunti.

data_desk.empty_body: Abasebenzi be-wallet entsha bathenga idatha ngamunithi ngamunithi kanye ne-3D prop ngamaminithi amabili. Ukuthenga okokuqala kuzobonakala lapha ne-resithi yabo njengoba ziqinisekisile ku-Solana.
data_desk.error_body: Kunye okubi kwenzekile uma kuhlwayelwa idatha ethengiwe.
data_desk.how_1: I-keypair entsha ivele yenziwa kuye yigciniwe ngokufihliwe. Ayikaze ibonakale on-chain.
data_desk.how_2: Inkokhelo eyodwa inika imali efanayo neyendlela yomsebenzi wawo ku-USDC kanye ne-SOL eanele ukuze igcine rent-exempt ikhokhele amafe ezinkonzo ezimbili ze-network.
data_desk.how_3: I-wallet icela i-endpoint ephelekiwe, ithola isivivinyo se-402, isayina ukuphindaphinda kwe-USDC okulodwa kuye ithole idatha. Ukuqinisekiswa kuyisivivinyo esisemthethweni se-Solana ongabe aqinisekise.
data_desk.how_4: I-wallet ithumela USDC esalayo ku-treasury, ivala i-akhawunti yethokene yaso ukuze irente ibuyele kumfaki, ithumela wonke umalungelo osalayo ekhaya. Iphela ku-zero kanye futhi ayisetyenziswa.
data_desk.how_more: Imininingwane ye-lane kanye ne-signatures ezintathu zewallet wonke ziphablic ku
data_desk.lede: Ngamunithi ngamunithi i-platform ibhala amanye ama-Solana wallet entsha angakaze abe khona, inika ngalinye umsebenzi wodwa wokuthenga USDC, kuye kuthole ukuthenga idatha ngempela ku-storefront yezimakethe ze-three.ws ngokusebenzisa iphrothokholi yokuphinda x402. Impendulo ithola lapha ne-resithi yayo: i-wallet ephele, intengo, nesivivinyo sokuqinisekiswa. Kepha i-wallet ivalwa kanye futhi ivalwa. Akukho ukukhetha, akukho amamocks: lokhu kuyimboni yamaphoyisa esebenza ngempela, isivivinyo esiphelele ngalinye.
data_desk.ledger_lede: Isiqe ngasinye sisivivinyo esinye se-wallet. I-wallet alikaze libe khona ngaphambi kokuba liphele isigidi saliphela; ilinki leresithi livula ukuqinisekiswa ku-Solscan.

demos_audio2face.meta_description: Thayipha umbhalo, uwuzwe ngezwi le-NVIDIA Magpie, bese ubuka ubuso be-avatar ye-3D bugqwayiza ngesikhathi sangempela — buqhutshwa uhlaka ngohlaka yi-NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D. Ama-blendshape wangempela e-ARKit, afakwe kunoma iyiphi i-rig.
demos_audio2face.meta_og_description: Izwi le-NVIDIA Magpie + ukugqwayiza kobuso kwe-NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, kuvumelanisiwe, kusiphequluli. Izindebe ze-avatar zilandela umsindo wangempela.

demos_audio2face.meta_twitter_title: Audio2Face · amamodeli amabili e-NVIDIA ebusweni obubodwa · three.ws
demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Inikwe amandla yi-/api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D phezu kwe-NVCF gRPC) kanye ne-/api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie). Ukufanisa kwe-blendshape→morph kutholakala ku-src/voice/a2f-player.js — kusebenzisa kabusha ulwazimagama lwe-ARKit/VRM/Oculus oluku-src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js, ngakho noma iyiphi i-rig yomuntu i-lip-sync ngaphandle kohlu oluvunyelwe lwe-rig ngayinye. Bona i-demo ye-lipsync ye-amplitude kuphela yendlela yokubuyela emuva yayo.
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Thayipha umugqa. Ukhulunywa ngezwi lika NVIDIA Magpie, futhi lowo msindo oqondile uthunyelwa ku NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, okubuyisa i-ARKit blendshape track ngayinye yohlaka. Umlomo nobuso be-avatar kuyanyakaza uhlaka ngohlaka nezwi langempela — okufaniswa kunoma iyiphi indlela ye-morph-target i-GLB elayishiwe eliyisebenzisayo (ARKit, i-avatar-platform evamile, VRM, Oculus visemes). Uma i-Audio2Face ingatholakali, i-avatar isazokhuluma futhi ibuyele ku-amplitude lipsync — akukaze kube ubuso obuqandisiwe.

demos_avatar_sdk.the_npm_sdk_bundle_loaded_from_what: Iphakethe le-npm SDK elilayishwe kusuka ku-/avatar-sdk/dist/index.mjs (okungatholwa abasebenzisi ku-npm install @three-ws/avatar uma selishicilelwe). Uma lifakiwe libhalisa <agent-3d> njenge-elementi yangokwezifiso. Ingxenye yoMdali ivula i-iframe modal exazulula nge-GLB Blob — inqubo efanayo amasayithi ezinkampani zangaphandle angayisebenzisa.
demos_avatar_sdk.the_sdk_resolves_against_on_the_same: I-SDK ixazulula avatar-id ngokumelene GET /api/avatars/:id endaweni efanayo i-SDK elayishwe kuyo (shintsha nge-api-base="https://other.host"). Lokhu ukudlulisela okuhlala njalo okukhishwa yi-gallery picker, futhi kuyaqhubeka nokusebenza noma ngabe i-GLB URL engaphansi iyashintsha.

demos_bonding_curve.interactive_bancor_v1_simulator_the_same: Isifanisi se-Bancor V1 esisebenzisanayo (ifomula efanayo pump.fun eyisebenzisayo). Konke kusebenza kusiphequluli — akukho wallet, akukho ukubhala ku-chain, akukho RPC. Hambisa izilayidi, lingisa ukuthenga nokuthengisa ngokumelene nesipele esibonakalayo, bese ubuka intengo yamanje iphendula. Kuwusizo ekunqumeni isilinganiso sesipele kanye nomkhawulo wokuqhubekela phambili ngaphambi kokufaka amathokheni e-agent wangempela.
demos_bonding_curve.same_starting_state_same_cumulative_eth_: Isimo sokuqala esifanayo, i-ETH efakiwe efanayo — izilinganiso ezintathu ezahlukene zesipele. Isilinganiso esiphansi = igophe eliqondile = ukutholakala kwentengo okusheshayo + inzuzo enkulu yomgijimi wangaphambili. I-Pump.fun iletha ~25% ngokuzenzakalelayo.

demos_brain.meta_description: Indawo yokudlala ye-AI enezinhlobo eziningi. Xoxa no-Claude, GPT, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek — shintsha izinhlobo phakathi nengxoxo, qhathanisa eceleni, landelela isivinini namamethrikhi wetoken.
demos_brain.meta_og_description: Indawo yokudlala ye-AI enezinhlobo eziningi. Xoxa, qhathanisa, bese uhlola izinhlobo eziyi-10 eceleni ngokusakaza kwangempela namamethrikhi wetoken.

Akukho backend, akukho okhiye bokugcina — usayina konke ukubhala wena.

Inikwe amandla yi-feed ebukhoma ye-/api/avatars/public; leli khasi alikaze lithinte ukukhiqizwa kwezindlela ze-/gallery, /create, noma /avatars/:id.

demos_halfbody_xr.side_by_side_preview_of_full_body: Ukubuka kuqala okuhlangene komzimba ogcwele vs umzimba oyingxenye. Ukubuka komzimba oyingxenye kufezwa ngesikhathi sokusebenza ngokuthola amathambo omzimba ongezansi kusakhiwo samathambo se-GLB (umlenze, ithanga, unyawo, uzwane, njll.) bese uwanciphisa abe uziro — i-mesh efanayo enesikhumba, amathambo abuyiselwe endaweni yokuphumula. Ukubuyisela kuyi-scale write eyodwa. Faka i-WebXR kuleli khasi ukuze ubone imodi yomzimba oyingxenye ku-headset.

demos_index.paste_a_chat_log_or_social_bio: Namathisela umlando wengxoxo noma i-bio yezokuxhumana. Isikhiphi siyayihlunga ibe imbewu yomuntu i-ejenti engayisebenzisa njengesimo sohlelo lwezingxoxo zesikhathi esizayo.
demos_index.pre_release_features_wired_end_to_end: Izici zangaphambi kokukhishwa ezixhunywe kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni ukuze sizihlole ngaphambi kokuba zithathe indawo yanoma yini esizeni esibukhoma. Konke okusemakhasi kusebenzisa ama-API wangempela nesitoreji sangempela — akukho okulingiswayo.
demos_index.react_wrapper_around_the_avatar_sdk_drop: I-React wrapper ye-avatar SDK. Faka <Agent3D /> kunoma yisiphi isihlahla se-JSX bese udlulisa ama-props e-clip, i-persona, nekhamera.
demos_index.real_time_468_point_face_mesh_with: I-face mesh yamaphuzu angu-468 yesikhathi sangempela enamasango ekhwalithi (i-yaw, ukufiphala, ukukhanya, ukugxila), ukuthwebula okunezinhlangothi ezintathu, nokulinganisa ukuma kwekhanda. Manje isihlanganiswe ku-/create/selfie, ideshibhodi, namakhasi e-agent njengesici sokukhiqiza.
demos_index.redesigned_create_chooser_featured_recom: I-chooser ye-/create eklanywe kabusha: ikhadi elinconyiwe elifakiwe, izibukeli ze-3D ezihlukile, amabheji esikhathi, amacebo okufika, izibalo ezibukhoma ezivela ku-/api/explore, nomugqa wokuhlanganisa.
demos_index.selfie_fit_avatar_from_your_face: I-Selfie Fit — i-avatar evela ebusweni bakho
demos_index.send_the_same_prompt_to_claude_gpt: Thumela i-prompt efanayo ku-Claude, GPT, Qwen ku-Alibaba DashScope, Qwen3-Coder ku-ModelScope, naku-Llama ku-Groq. Ukusakaza okuhambisana, ukubambezeleka, nokusetshenziswa kwamathokheni.
demos_index.side_by_side_preview_full_vs_half: Isibukeli esihambisana: umzimba ogcwele vs uhhafu womzimba, zombili izikhathi ze-WebXR zixhunywe kahle nge-WebXRSession.
demos_index.sign_in_form_wired_with_declarative_attr: Ifomu lokungena elixhunywe nezimfanelo zokumemezela data-agent-*. Iya kokufakiwe okugxilile, ilandelela i-caret yokuthayipha ngesibuko esifihliwe, ivala amehlo ayo endaweni yephasiwedi, inyakazisa ikhanda lapho kungenalutho okuthunyelwe.
demos_index.standalone_copy_of_the_mic_driven_lipsyn: Ikhophi ezimele yedemo ye-lipsync eqhutshwa imic — umsindo obukhoma ungena, ama-viseme aphuma, akukho sinyathelo se-TTS ku-loop.
demos_index.standalone_copy_of_the_multi_llm_brain: Ikhophi ezimele yedemo yobuchopho be-multi-LLM — Claude / GPT / Qwen / Llama eceleni, ehlukanisiwe nendlela yokukhiqiza.
demos_index.standalone_copy_of_the_tts_driven_lipsyn: Ikhophi ezimele yedemo ye-lipsync eqhutshwa i-TTS — thayipha umbhalo, uwuzwe ubuyela emuva, ubuke ama-viseme eqhuba umlomo we-avatar.
demos_index.stream_an_llm_completion_through_livepee: Sakaza ukuqedwa kwe-LLM ngenethiwekhi yokucabanga ehlukanisiwe ye-Livepeer esikhundleni somhlinzeki ophakathi. Ibonisa ukukhethwa kwe-orchestrator + izindleko.
demos_index.stripped_down_version_of_the_button_jump: Inguqulo encishisiwe yedemo yokugxuma ngenkinobho — i-avatar kuphela, inkinobho, nokucindezela. Iwusizo ekulungiseni i-physics ngokuzihlukanisa.
demos_index.the_app_surface_rebuilt_around_the_avata: Ingaphandle lohlelo lokusebenza, olwakhiwe kabusha lwagxila ku-avatar. Indawo yokuxoxa nomenzeli enezikhuthazo ezijikelezayo ezishukumisa i-LLM kanye nokugqwayiza · izilungiselelo zekhamera (Ubuso/Umzimba/Okubanzi/Iqhawe) · yabelana & shumeka isiqeshana · isikrini esigcwele · cindezela ukuze ukhulume · fihla ngokuzenzakalela i-chrome · ukukhanya kwaphansi + ukushibilika kwekhamera. Isikhethi sokugqwayiza esincane esiseshekayo esinawo wonke amavidiyo angama-67. Isibukeli sangempela, i-LLM yangempela, ukugqwayiza kwangempela — akukho chrome oluncintisana nomenzeli.
demos_index.these_pages_are_unlisted_and_noindex_the: Lawa makhasi awafakiwe ohlwini futhi awanayo i-index. Asebenzisa i-backend efanayo neyesayithi elibukhoma kodwa ahlukaniswe ngamabomu ku-/create naku-/avatars/:id ukuze inqubo yokukhiqiza iqhubeke isebenza ngenkathi sihlola.
demos_index.three_tier_pricing_table_hover_any_tier: Ithebula lentengo elinezigaba ezintathu. Beka isikhombisi kunoma yisiphi isigaba bese i-avatar igxumela emaphethelweni ayo aphezulu ngokuphazima kweso, yehle ngokuwa okunamandla, bese isebenzisa isiqeshana sokuphendula ukuze ikhombe phansi ku-CTA.
demos_index.type_any_text_stream_it_through_openai: Thayipha noma yimuphi umbhalo, uwusakaze nge-OpenAI TTS, bese umlomo we-avatar ugqwayiza ngesikhathi sangempela ngokusebenzisa ukutholwa kwe-viseme kwe-wawa-lipsync.

demos_lipsync_mic.meta_description: Imakrofoni yesikhathi sangempela → isihlaziya se-viseme → izinhloso zokuguqula i-avatar. Inqubo eqondile eshayela i-TTS esakazwa yi-ElevenLabs engxoxweni ye-three.ws, ethathwe kumakrofoni yakho.
demos_lipsync_mic.meta_og_description: Khuluma kumakrofoni yakho bese ubuka umlomo we-avatar ulandelela izwi lakho ngesikhathi sangempela.
demos_lipsync_mic.meta_twitter_description: Faka umsindo wemakrofoni obukhoma ngesihlaziya se-viseme bese ubuka umlomo we-avatar ulandela izwi lakho ngesikhathi sangempela.
demos_lipsync_mic.real_time_test_of_the_three_ws: Ukuhlolwa kwesikhathi sangempela kwesihlaziya se-viseme se-three.ws ((src/lip-sync-analyser.js)). Cindezela Qala, vumela ukufinyelela kumakrofoni, bese ukhuluma — isihlaziya sinikeza izisindo ze-viseme ngasinye kuma-morph targets e-avatar kuwo wonke amafreyimu. Lena yiyo kanye ipayiphi eqhuba i-TTS esakazwa yi-ElevenLabs engxoxweni ebukhoma, ivele kumakrofoni yakho ukuze ukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuma komlomo ngokukhuluma kwakho.

demos_livepeer_inference.meta_description: I-prompt efanayo, abahlinzeki ababili. Qhathanisa ukucabanga okuzenzakalelayo kwe-three.ws nesango le-AI elihlukanisiwe eceleni: ukubambezeleka, inani lama-token, nempendulo ephelele evela komunye nomunye.
demos_livepeer_inference.powered_by_livepeer_ai_gateway_decentral: Kusebenzisa Livepeer AI Gateway ekhohlo. Impendulo eyodwa ivele kuqembu lika-three.ws provider, futhi leli khadi libiza igama lomnikazi nomodelo ophendule ngayo. Umnyango womphakathi wokwehlukile awunakhiwi ngekhiye, ngakho ke uya kwehluleka kakhulu kanye noma kungekho orchestrator oqhutywa phansi komodelo othile.
demos_livepeer_inference.same_prompt_two_providers_real_responses: Isicelo esifanayo, abanikazi ababili, impendulo ezinqobo. Ikhadi ekhohlo lihamba nge-qembu le-three.ws inference, eliphendula lapho provider iphendula ngokushesha. Ikhadi ekunene liqondisa isicelo esifanayo ngomnyango wokwehlukile we-AI lapho abasebenzi bamabhizinisi bamodelo wokwehlukile. Inqubela 4 ye-roadmap: ukuhlukanisa uku-inference kusuka kwabanikazi abanye ukuze amajenti agcine ekhona noma umnikazi omnye engaphenduli.

demos_memory_seed.meta_description: Namathisela isibambo somphakathi esivela ku-akhawunti eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwezixhunyiwe zakho. three.ws ilanda umkhondo wakho womphakathi, ihlunga imbewu yenkumbulo nge-Claude, futhi ikukhombise kahle ukuthi i-ejenti yakho izobe ifaka ini lapho ungena okokuqala.
demos_memory_seed.paste_a_public_handle_from_one_or: Namathisela isibambo somphakathi esivela ku-akhawunti eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwezixhunyiwe zakho. three.ws idonsa umkhondo womphakathi, bese icela i-Claude ukuthi ihlunge imbewu yenkumbulo yamagama angama-200–300 — kahle kahle i-markdown i-ejenti yakho ezoyifaka njengomongo ohlala njalo lapho ungena okokuqala. Akukho okugcinwa ohlangothini lweseva; imbewu ehlanganisiwe ihlala kuphela kuthebhu yesiphequluli sakho.

demos_persona_extract.answer_six_onboarding_questions_three_ws: Phendula imibuzo eyisithupha yokungenela. three.ws ihlanganisa i-persona.json ehlelekile — ithoni, ulwazimagama, izintshisekelo, isitayela sokuxhumana — bese ikuvumela ukuthi uxoxe ne-ejenti esebenzisa leyo zwi. Akukho okubhalwa ku-akhawunti yakho; umuntu uhlala kule thebhu kuphela.
demos_persona_extract.post_api_persona_extract_takes_your_q:
POST /api/persona/extract ithatha i-Q&A yakho bese ibuyisa i-JSON yomuntu ehlelekile.

POST /api/persona/preview ithatha lowo muntu kanye nomlayezo womsebenzisi bese ibuyisa impendulo yemisho engu-1-2 ngezwi.

Zombili izindlela zisebenza ohlangothini lweseva ku-three.ws.

I-React ilayishwa kusuka ku-CDN nge-import map ukuze leli khasi lisebenze ngaphandle kwesinyathelo se-bundler.

demos_selfie_fit.click_a_slot_to_start_choose_camera: Chofoza isikhala ukuze uqale. Khetha Ikhamera ukuze uthole okuphakelayo okubukhoma okunezindawo zokungena zobuso zesikhathi sangempela, noma Layisha ukuze uqinisekise i-JPEG/PNG ekhona.
demos_selfie_fit.three_photo_capture_with_live_face_landm: Ukuthatha izithombe ezintathu okunezindawo zokungena zobuso zesikhathi sangempela. Isikhala ngasinye sisebenzisa i-wireframe overlay yamaphuzu angu-468 kanye ne-head-pose estimator kokuphakelayo kwekhamera yewebhu (noma isithombe esisodwa esilayishiwe) futhi sivuleka kuphela lapho i-yaw ingena ebangeni elilindelekile. Ukuthumela kuthumela ama-JPEG amathathu ku /api/onboarding/avaturn-session futhi kuvula iseshini ye-three.ws Selfie editor ebuyisiwe ku-iframe. I-Sandbox kuphela — ayithinti ukugeleza okubukhoma kwe-/create noma /avatars/:id.

demos_voice_clone.internal_pipeline_multipart_elevenlabs_v: Ipayipi langaphakathi: MediaRecorder → POST /api/tts/eleven-clone (multipart) → ElevenLabs voices.add nge-elevenlabs SDK. I-Instant Voice Cloning iyisici esikhokhelwayo; i-tier yamahhala izobuyisa can_not_use_instant_voice_cloning.
demos_voice_clone.record_a_short_voice_sample_in_your: Rekhoda isampula elincane lezwi esipheqululini sakho, ulithumele ku-three.ws instant-cloning endpoint, futhi ukhiqize inkulumo entsha ngezwi elikopishiwe. Ukuze uthole ukwethembeka okungcono kakhulu, rekhoda imizuzwana engu-20–30 yenkulumo ecacile, eyomile enevolumu engaguquki. Umsindo awushiyi umshini wakho uze uthephe Submit to clone.
demos_voice_clone.these_hit_the_existing_endpoint_with_the: Lokhu kusebenzisa i-/api/tts/eleven endpoint ekhona, nge-voice_id esanda kwakhiwa. Ukugcina idatha okufanayo + umkhawulo wesivinini njenge-proxy ye-TTS yokukhiqiza.

deployments.network_mainnet_sources_evm_solana_metap: Inethiwekhi: mainnet. Imithombo: erc8004_agents_index (EVM), agent_identities + solana_agents_index (Solana Metaplex), okuthathwe kuma-log eketanga. Ukufakwa okungenaso isikhathi se-block esiqinisekisiwe kubalwa kumanani aphelele kodwa akufakwa kumugqa wesikhathi.
deployments.portable_on_chain_agent_identity_across_: Ubunikazi be-agent obuthwalekayo ku-chain, ngamazinga amabili: ERC-8004 ibhalisa ama-agent ku-Identity Registry efakwe ekhelini elifanayo kuwo wonke amaketanga e-EVM, kanti ku-Solana i-agent ngayinye iyi-asset ye-Metaplex Core eyenziwe kuqoqo le-three.ws Agents futhi yabhaliswa ku-Metaplex Agent Registry. Faka eyakho kusuka ku-the studio noma hlola i-3D agent directory.

diff.explain1_body: Izinto ziqhathaniswa ngegama, bese ziqhathaniswa nge-hash yokuqukethwe, bese ziqhathaniswa ngokuqhathaniswa, isu elifanayo elisetshenziswa yi-git ekushintsheni kwamafayela. Umthumeli ophinda ubhale Mesh.001 ufundwa njengokushintsha, hhayi njengokubhalwa kabusha.
diff.explain2_body: Idatha ye-Vertex iqhathaniswa ngesisekelo se-1e-4 units, ngakho ukushintsha kwe-float okwenziwa kabusha noma ukuhamba kwe-Draco akubhalwa ngenkathi ukulungiswa kweqiniso kubhalwa.
diff.explain3_body: none, cosmetic, minor, major, breaking. Ukuphuka kusho ukuthi okuthile okukhuluma ngakho ngegama akukhona: i-clip, i-joint, i-mesh. Lokhu kuyiphutha elenza kahle futhi alihambi.
diff.explain4_body: Le khasi, i-glb-diff CLI, kanye ne-i-API yamahhala zonke zisebenzisa @three-ws/glb-diff, ngakho isinqumo ku-CI asikwazi ukuphikisana nalokho okubonayo lapha.
diff.hero_sub: I-checksum ibonisa ukuthi amafayela amabili ahluke. Ayikwazi ukusho umehluko phakathi kokucindezelwa okungapheli nokuhlanganiswa okulahlekelwe izitho ezintathu zezandla, futhi kuphela eyodwa yazo ithatha i-avatar yakho esikrinini. Faka i-.glb ngakolunye uhlangothi bese uthola isethi yokushintsha: i-geometry, izinto, ama-textures, ama-skeletons, kanye nezithombe, ngokuhlonza kabusha nokuhambisa ngendlela i-git eyenza ngayo.
