guards.hero_p: Le khodi ayinayo i-CI. Lokho okuvikela yona kunesethi yokuhlola encane, esheshayo ehlanganiswe ezindleleni ezingekho emthethweni: i-prebuild, i-gate, i-deploy build, kanye ne-git pre-push hook. I-guard ngayinye ngezansi ikhona ngoba okuthile kwaphuka kanye. Funda i-full reference noma i-tutorial yokuyibhala.
guards.meta_desc: I-guard ngayinye yokuhlinzeka evikela i-three.ws codebase, kanye nesigaba esisodwa esisebenza kuso. Le repository ayinayo i-CI, ngakho ukuhlela kuqinisekiswa ngokuhlola okusheshayo okuhlanganiswe kwi-prebuild, i-gate, i-deploy build, kanye ne-git pre-push hook.
guards.more_p: I-guard engahlanganisiwe endleleni engapheli ivikela lutho, futhi i-guard engakaze iqinisekiswe ayikhiphi lutho. Bhala i-checker, uyinike i-npm script, uyirekhode ku-data/guards.json ngenkohlakalo okufanele iyiphikise, futhi uyihlanganise esigabeni. npm run audit:guards ikutshela uma i-registry neziqinisekiso zingavumelani; npm run prove:guards igijima i-guard ngayinye ngokumelene nenkohlakalo yayo eyamukelekayo futhi ikutshela ukuthi isasebenza yini.
guards.og_desc: Ayikho i-CI, ngokudinga. I-Check ngayinye evikela le khodi, lokho evikela khona, kanye nesigaba esisebenza kuso.
guards.twitter_desc: Ayikho i-CI, ngokudinga. I-Check ngayinye evikela le khodi, nendawo esebenza kuyo.

handle.meta_description: I-avatar ye-3D ebukhoma ku-three.ws — ngifake noma kuphi.

heatmap.meta_description: I-heatmap yemakethe ebukhoma yama-cryptocurrency aphezulu — ithayela ngalinye elinosayizi ngokuya nge-market cap futhi linombala ngokuya ngokunyakaza kwalo kwezinsuku ezingama-24 noma eziyi-7. Bona ukuthi imali iya kuphi shazi.
heatmap.meta_og_description: I-heatmap yemakethe ebukhoma — uhlamvu lwemali ngalunye olunosayizi ngokuya nge-market cap futhi lunombala ngokuya ngokunyakaza kwentengo yalo. Bona ukuthi imali iya kuphi shazi.
heatmap.meta_twitter_description: Imephu yokushisa yemakethe ebukhoma — uhlamvu lwemali ngalunye lulinganiswe ngobukhulu bemakethe futhi lufakwe umbala ngokuhamba kwentengo yalo.
heatmap.the_whole_market_in_one_view_every: Yonke imakethe ibonakala ngasikhathi sinye — ithayela ngalinye liyihlamvu lemali, elinganiswe ngobukhulu bemakethe futhi lifakwe umbala ngokuhamba kwentengo yalo. Okuluhlaza kukhombisa ukukhuphuka, okubomvu kukhombisa ukwehla. Chofoza noma yiliphi ithayela ukuze ubone iphrofayili yalo ephelele.

herald.card_budget_body: I-floor ebalulekile, umkhawulo wesilinganiso, amahora athule, dedupe nge-TTL, kanye nesikhawu sokuvuselela. Ukuntuleka yikho okugcina ukuphazamiseka kusebenze.
herald.card_feed_body: Poll i-JSON endpoint, bhalisela i-SSE, xhumanisa ibhasi yakho yezenzakalo, noma uthathe i-rail ethunyelwe. Umthombo ungamashumi amahlanu emigqa.
herald.card_gpu_body: Ayikho WebGL, i-iframe, ukunciphisa ukuhamba: umethuli wekhadi uthatha phezu, endaweni ephilayo, engakhanselwa nge-Escape, ngaphakathi kwesitayela sakho.
herald.def_batch: Kukhuluma ngemuva kokuphazamiseka, ngaphambi kokuthi okunye kuhlanganiswe kumugqa owodwa.
herald.def_dedupe: I-key efanayo ikhuluma kanye, noma ngabe i-feed iyiphinda kangaki.
herald.def_freshness: Ukudala kunalokho umlando, futhi umlando uphakathi kwe-inbox.
herald.def_minimportance: I-floor yokuphazamiseka. Ngaphansi kwayo, akukho okukhonjiswa.
herald.def_quiet: I-window yendawo, iphakanyiswa ngemuva kokuphuma, isibonelo [22, 7].
herald.defaults_foot: I-API ephelele, ama-recipe kanye ne-rail contract zikhona ku-documentation, futhi three.ws isebenzisa lokhu ukuhlinzeka ngezaziso zayo notifications.
herald.defaults_sub: Khethwe ukuze ukuwafaka kule khasi kungakwenzi kube yinhle.
herald.hero_lede: Umyalezo ungumqondisi okufanele uwubone, ethreyini okufanele uyivule, iphikisana namashumi amane abanye. Lokhu kuphikisela: umlingiswa we-3D ungene ekhoneni lekhasi lakho, ubheke kumuntu osebenzisa yona, futhi ubatshele, nge-link yento ephathelene nayo. Umugqa owodwa wekhodi. Ukuphuma okutholakalayo uma i-GPU ingekho. Futhi i-CLI ethumela isaziso uma ukwakha kwakho kuphothuliwe.
herald.install_sub: Akukho isinyathelo sokwakha esidingekayo, futhi umzimba we-3D ungakhethwa.
herald.meta_desc: I-3D character ingena ekhasini lakho ithi umsebenzisi kwenzekeni. I-SDK evulekile, umugqa owodwa wekhodi, ukwehliswa okutholakalayo, kanye ne-CLI ethumela izaziso uma ukwakha kwakho kuqediwe.
herald.play_sub: Konke okungaphansi kusebenzisa i-library yangempela kule tab. Shintsha imithetho, thumela umyalezo, futhi ubuke lokho umshini okhetha. Akukho okukhona lapha okungumfanekiso.
herald.r_quiet: Izinsuku zokuthula 22:00 kuya ku-07:00 (kukhona kuphela 90+ okudlula)
herald.rail_body: Le tab ilalela kwi-rail yakho yokuthumela ngenkathi ubhalisile. Thumela umyalo on the left kusuka kunoma iyiphi indawo futhi i-avatar yakho izokhuluma lapha.
herald.rail_note: I-key idinga i-herald:announce scope. Yikhiphe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi; akukho okunye okungabhekisela kwi-avatar yakho.
herald.share_desc: I-3D character ingena ekhasini lakho ithi umsebenzisi kwenzekeni. Umugqa owodwa wekhodi, ukwehliswa okutholakalayo, kanye ne-CLI ethumela izaziso uma ukwakha kwakho kuqediwe.
herald.term_h: Kusuka kwi-terminal yakho, kuya esikrinini sakho
herald.term_sub: Noma yini engakwenza isicelo se-HTTPS ingafinyelela kule tab ye-browser osuvele uyivule. Umyalezo uhlale uthunyelwa kumaseshini omfundi, ngakho i-key ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa ukuphazamisa omunye umuntu.

hero_demo.a_golden_angle_starfield_drifts_slowly_w: Inkambu yezinkanyezi ye-golden-angle ihamba kancane ngenkathi ikhamera isondela kancane kuphoyinta ukuze kube ne-parallax. prefers-reduced-motion ikhombisa isithombe esisodwa esinganyakazi.
hero_demo.a_lit_avatar_centered_in_deep_space: I-avatar ekhanyisiwe, egxile esikhaleni esijulile phezu kwezindandatho ezikhanyayo eziyindilinga — ukukhanya, inkambu yezinkanyezi ehambayo, kanye ne-pointer parallax. Faka noma iyiphi i-GLB bese nje iyasebenza.
hero_demo.an_over_the_emissive_rings_and_starfield: I-UnrealBloomPass phezu kwezindandatho ezikhipha ukukhanya nenkambu yezinkanyezi ithwala ~70% wobuhle. Umkhawulo ophezulu ukuze kukhanye kuphela ijiyomethri ekhanyayo.
hero_demo.five_additive_rings_tilted_into_a_disc: Izindandatho ezinhlanu ezingeziwe ze-TorusGeometry, zitshekelwe zaba idiski futhi zifakwe umbala ngaphesheya kwe-accent gradient. Ziyaphefumula futhi zijikeleza ngokuphambene ukuze zinikeze ukujula.
hero_demo.give_your_agent_a_stage_worth_screenshot: Nikeza i-agent yakho isiteji esifanele ukuthwetshulwa isithombe.
hero_demo.meta_description: Isiteji seqhawe se-3D esifana nefilimu sama-agent e-three.ws — i-avatar ekhanyisiwe egxile esikhaleni esijulile phezu kwezindandatho ezikhanyayo eziyindilinga, inkambu yezinkanyezi ehambayo, nokukhanya okuthambile. I-Pointer parallax, ephephile ekunyakazeni.
hero_demo.meta_og_description: Isiteji seqhawe se-3D esifana nefilimu — i-agent ekhanyisiwe phezu kwezindandatho ezikhanyayo eziyindilinga, inkambu yezinkanyezi, nokukhanya.
hero_demo.meta_twitter_description: Isiteji seqhawe se-3D esifana nefilimu sama-agent e-three.ws — i-avatar ekhanyisiwe, izindandatho ezikhanyayo, inkambu yezinkanyezi, ukukhanya.
hero_demo.the_atmosphere_renders_in_its_own_webgl: Umkhathi ubonakala ngaphakathi komongo wawo we-WebGL ukuze ukhanyiswe ngamandla ngaphandle kokufiphaza isihloko. I-avatar iyi-<agent-3d> ejwayelekile phezulu — ukugqwayiza, izwi, nezinkokhelo kufakiwe, kungathintwanga.

holo.hero_sub: Isithombe se-holographic foil sticker, esikhiqizwa bukhoma. Umugqa wokufa-cut, i-foil enezinhlamvu, ukukhanya okukhanya, kanye nekona elikhishwayo konke kubalwa kwi-browser yakho: akukho zithombe, akukho amafayela emodeli. Phendulela ngempela ngendlela ofuna ngayo, noma bhala umbhalo wakho bese uthola ukuthi u-cutwe ube isithombe.
holo.how_body: Iphuzu lihlukaniswe, lidilizwa ngedisk ngendlela umkhiqizi engeza umkhawulo, futhi libhalwa emigqeni ye-vector nge-squares ezihambayo, kuhlanganiswe nezimbobo. I-foil iyinto ebonakalayo enezinhlamvu ezincane, futhi i-peel iyisiyingi se-vertex-shader, ngakho ukukhanya ku-lip ebhujiswa kuyikho.
holo.meta_desc: Isithombe se-holographic foil sticker esikhiqizwa bukhoma kwi-browser yakho. Phendulela ngempela, khulula ikona, shintsha ama-foils, die-cut noma yisiphi umbhalo ube isithombe, futhi ulande ifreyimu njenge-PNG. Konke ku-procedural, akukho assets.
holo.next_anim_desc: I-clip ngayinye ye-animation kwi-library, iboniswa bukhoma kwi-rig yangempela.
holo.next_create_desc: Dala i-avatar e-rigged, e-animated kusuka kumyalo noma isithombe.
holo.next_render_desc: Hlanganisa ama-renders e-avatar angempela ngokumelene ne-API bukhoma futhi kopisha umyalo ofanayo.
holo.share_desc: Isithombe se-holographic foil sticker esikhiqizwa bukhoma kwi-browser yakho: phendulela, khulula, die-cut umbhalo wakho, ulande i-PNG.
holo.stage_aria: Isithombe se-3D holographic sticker esisebenzisanayo. Donsa noma usebenzise ama-key we-arrow ukuze uphendule.
holo.title: I-Holo Sticker
holo.webgl_error: Le page idinga WebGL futhi i-browser yakho ayinikezanga umongo. Vula i-hardware acceleration noma zama enye i-browser, bese u-reload.

home.01_studio_selfie_to_rigged_avatar_in: 01 Studio I-Selfie ibe i-avatar elungisiwe ngemizuzwana. I-Browser-native, isheshiswe yi-GPU — ayikho isofthiwe okumele ifakwe. ↗
home.02_registry_optional_blockchain_identity: 02 Registry Ubunikazi be-blockchain obukhethekayo. Ama-agent atholakala, ayathwaleka, futhi angafakazelwa kunoma iyiphi i-A2A noma iklayenti le-MCP. ↗
home.03_embed_web_component_one_tag_any: 03 Embed I-web component ye-<agent-3d>. Ithegi elilodwa. Noma yimuphi umphathi. I-Lazy-loaded, i-CSS ehlukanisiwe, isingathwe yi-CDN emhlabeni wonke. ↗
home.04_pay_per_call_http_native_usdc: 04 Pay-per-call Izinkokhelo ezincane ze-USDC ze-HTTP-native. Khokha ngekhono, umlayezo, noma iseshini. 0% imali yeplatifomu ngesikhathi se-open beta. ↗
home.05_walk_multiplayer_3d_worlds_crdt_synce: 05 Hamba emhlabeni we-3D wabadlali abaningi. Izindawo zama-avatar ezivumelaniswa nge-CRDT, izwi lesikhala, ukulawula nge-joystick — konke kuthegi eyodwa yokushumeka. ↗
home.06_sdk_javascript_python_rust_mint_sign: 06 SDK I-JavaScript, i-Python, i-Rust. Mint, sayina, fakazela, bonisa, khokha. Inelayisensi ye-Apache-2.0. Itholakala ku-npm. ↗
home.0_fee_during_beta_keep_100_of: Imali ekhokhwayo engu-0% ngesikhathi se-beta — gcina u-100% wemali engenayo ngenkathi ipulatifomu ikhula
home.a2a_v1_a2a_agentid_agent_to_agent: A2A /v1/a2a/:agentId Indawo yokugcina yomgomo we-agent-to-agent
home.a_complete_platform_not_a_widget_voice: Ipulatifomu ephelele — hhayi i-widget. Izwi, ukuthwebula ukunyakaza, abadlali abaningi, nezinkokhelo ezakhelwe kuwo wonke ama-agent — ngobunikazi be-blockchain obungakhethwa.
home.a_full_stack_platform_for_3d_ai: Ipulatifomu ephelele ye-3D AI agents: kusukela ku-selfie kuya ku-agent eshicilelwe, kusukela ekushumekeni kuya ekuzuzeni.
home.a_live_slice_of_forge_the_same: Ucezu oluphilayo lwe-Forge, umgudu ofanayo wokuguqula umbhalo ube yi-3D onika amandla ikhasi lonke. Chaza into bese i-GLB enokuthungwa, ekwazi ukulandwa, iyavela lapha, ngokuvamile kungakapheli umzuzu. Vula Izinketho ukuze uthole izinketho ezigcwele: amazinga ekhwalithi, ukukhetha injini ebukhoma, isilinganiso sobukhulu, kanye nokuthuthukisa okusheshayo kokucela. I-Forge ephelele yengeza okokufaka kwezithombe nemidwebo, ukuhlanganiswa kwezibuko eziningi, izihlungi zokwenza isitayela, kanye ne-retopology.
home.a_live_slice_of_pose_studio_the: Ucezu oluphilayo lwe-Pose Studio — i-rig efanayo, izilungiselelo ezizenzakalelayo, nezilawuli zamalunga. Zungeza isithombe, chofoza ingxenye yomzimba ukuze uyibeke, noma thepha isilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo ukuze uguqule ukuma konke. Bese usebenzisa isitudiyo esigcwele sama-keyframes, ama-avatar akho, kanye nokuthumela nge-PNG/GLB.
home.a_taste_of_what_s_running_across: Ukunambitha kwalokho okusebenza kuwebhu namuhla. Chofoza noma yimuphi u-agent ukuze ukhulume, uhlanganise kabusha, noma uthathe ikhodi yawo yokushumeka.
home.agent_action_loop_arm_your_3d_agent: I-loop yesenzo se-agent — hlomisa i-3D agent yakho ukuthi ithenge ngokuzenzakalelayo ezingeni eliphakeme noma eliqinile
home.any_environment_drop_your_own_3d_scene: Noma iyiphi indawo — faka isigcawu sakho se-3D GLB noma usebenzise esinye sezindawo zeklabhu ezakhelwe ngaphakathi
home.api_keyget_a_key: Ukhiye we-APIThola ukhiye ↗
home.browse_public_agents_in_the_marketplace_: Phequlula ama-ejenti omphakathi emakethe. Forka ubuntu, izwi, namakhono e-ejenti ngayinye. Shicilela eyakho bese uvumela abanye ukuthi bayixube kabusha.
home.bullet_create: Dala i-ejenti ye-AI ye-3D ngomyalo wombhalo noma isithombe ozishuthe sona cishe ngomzuzu

home.claim_yourname_threews_sol_as_a_solana: Funa i-yourname.threews.sol yakho njenge-subdomain ye-Solana Name Service. I-Brave iyihambisa ngqo ku-showcase yakho; ama-agent akukhokhela nge-USDC ngegama, hhayi ngekheli. Sithwala izindleko zegesi.
home.conversations_revenue_engagement_retenti: Izingxoxo, imali engenayo, ukuzibandakanya, ukugcinwa — konke ngesikhathi sangempela. Bona ukuthi yimaphi amakhono angenisa kakhulu.
home.drag_any_glb_into_the_browser_full: Hudula noma iyiphi i-GLB esipheqululini. Izithombe ezigcwele, ukukhanya, nezinto zokwakha — ngokushesha, kunoma iyiphi idivayisi.
home.drop_a_selfie_or_click_to_upload: ↑ Faka i-selfie noma chofoza ukuze ulayishe
home.drop_a_web_component_into_notion_ghost: Faka ingxenye yewebhu ku-Notion, Ghost, WordPress, Framer, noma uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza — ayikho i-SDK edingekayo.
home.drop_into_any_page_react_vue_svelte: Faka <agent-3d> kunoma iyiphi ikhasi. React, Vue, Svelte, i-HTML elula. Izwi, inkumbulo, izithombe, nezinkokhelo kufakiwe. Ilayishwa kancane ngokuzenzakalelayo.
home.edit_the_code_below_the_preview_updates: Hlela ikhodi engezansi — isibukisi sibuyekezwa ngokushesha. Shintsha ama-avatar, qala izithombe, shintsha izici. Kopisha imigqa emibili uma usuqedile.
home.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_with_livekit_st: Ukuhlanganisa izwi le-ElevenLabs nokusakaza kwe-LiveKit. I-webcam face mocap iqhuba izinkulumo ze-avatar yakho nokuvumelanisa izindebe ngesikhathi sangempela — ayikho i-hardware edingekayo.
home.embed_a_full_multiplayer_3d_world_onto: Shumeka umhlaba ogcwele wabadlali abaningi be-3D kunoma iyiphi ikhasi. Izivakashi zifika njenge-avatar yazo, zibona omunye nomunye ehamba ngesikhathi sangempela, futhi zingaxoxa ngezwi ngaphakathi kwesigameko.
home.every_component_is_open_real_and_shippin: Yonke ingxenye ivulekile, ingokoqobo, futhi iyathunyelwa namuhla. Sebenzisa eyodwa. Sebenzisa zonke. Ziyahlanganiseka.
home.every_model_you_generate_or_import_gets: Yonke imodeli oyidalayo noma oyingenisayo ithola inkinobho ethi Buka ku-AR. Kumakhalekhukhwini, thepha kanye ukuze uyibeke endaweni yakho yangempela ngekhamera. Kudeskithophu, skena i-QR bese uyibeka kusuka kufoni yakho. I-WebXR ku-Android, i-Quick Look ku-iOS. Ayikho i-app. Akukho ukulanda.
home.every_new_pump_fun_mint_graded_for: Yonke iminti entsha ye-pump.fun, ihlolwe ngokuqiniseka emahoreni angama-24 adlule.
home.every_three_ws_agent_can_run_an: Yonke i-ejenti ye-three.ws ingasebenzisa i-sniper eseketheni: ibuka ukwethulwa okusha kwe-pump.fun ngesikhathi sangempela, ihlole ngayinye, isuse izivikelo zayo zobungozi, ithenge, bese iphuma ngokwayo — stop-loss, take-profit, trailing, noma timeout. I-loop eyodwa, ezimele ngokugcwele, efakazelwa eseketheni.
home.every_tip_payment_trade_and_token_launch: Konke ukunikeza, ukukhokha, ukuhweba, nokwethulwa kwethokheni ku-three.ws kuseketheni futhi kungaqinisekiswa yi-explorer. Nakhu ngesikhathi sangempela — futhi imephu ephelele yemali ye-3D ihlala ku-Agent Galaxy.

home.meta_desc: Dala i-ejenti ye-AI ye-3D kusuka ku-selfie ngemizuzwana engu-60. Faka ithegi elilodwa le-HTML ukuze uyifake kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi. Ama-ejenti acabanga ku-IBM watsonx.ai (Granite); ngokuzikhethela akhokhise ngengxoxo ngayinye ngezinkokhelo ezincane ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.
home.meta_og_description: Dala i-ejenti ye-AI ye-3D ephila kusuka ku-selfie — yifake kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngemizuzwana engu-60. Izwi, imemori, izinkokhelo, kanye nobuchopho be-IBM watsonx.ai (Granite) konke kwakhelwe ngaphakathi.
home.meta_twitter_description: Dala i-ejenti ye-AI ye-3D ephila kusuka ku-selfie — yifake kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngemizuzwana engu-60. Izwi, imemori, izinkokhelo, kanye nobuchopho be-IBM watsonx.ai (Granite) konke kwakhelwe ngaphakathi.
home.multiplayer_sync_crdt_based_position_syn: Ukuvumelanisa kwabadlali abaningi — ukuvumelanisa isikhundla okusekelwe ku-CRDT nge-WebSocket, kubhekana namakhulu abasebenzisi abasebenzisa ngesikhathi esisodwa
home.not_a_render_not_a_video_a: Akuyona i-render. Akuyona ividiyo. Umlingiswa we-3D wangempela ohlezi kulombhalo, egxumela enkinobheni, exhumana nekhasi ngesikhathi sangempela.
home.one_click_launch_name_ticker_image_and: Ukuqalisa ngokuchofoza okukodwa — igama, i-ticker, isithombe, kanye nesamba sokuqala kusethwe kusuka kuphrofayela ye-ejenti yakho
home.one_embed_tag_same_tag_zero_backend: Ithegi elilodwa lokufaka — ithegi elifanayo le-<walk-embed>, akukho ukusetha kwe-backend
home.optionally_record_your_agent_on_the_bloc: Ngokuzikhethela rekhoda i-ejenti yakho ku-blockchain ukuze noma ubani akwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngeyakho ngempela — namanye amathuluzi e-AI angayithola futhi ayibize. Ukuthengiselana okukodwa, izimali ezingaphansi kwesenti. Yakhelwe ku-Metaplex Core, ERC-8004, A2A, kanye ne-MCP.
home.oracle_reads_every_pump_fun_launch_the: I-Oracle ifunda konke ukuqalisa kwe-pump.fun ngokushesha nje lapho kuvela futhi ihlanganisa amasignali amane azimele abe isikolo sokukholwa esisodwa esingu-0–100: ubani othengayo (ubufakazi be-wallet eqinisekisiwe), kanjani (isakhiwo sokuthenga esingokwemvelo vs esihleliwe), yini (ukulandisa kwamasiko kanye nokusabalala ngokushesha), futhi ihamba kanjani (umfutho). Izikhala eziqinile zesakhiwo zisho ukuthi uhlamvu lwemali oluhlanganisiwe alusoze lwathola amaphuzu aphezulu — isikolo sithembekile, asincengi.
home.paste_this_where_you_want_the_model: Namathisela lokhu lapho ufuna khona imodeli
home.pay_per_call_is_an_open_http: Ukukhokha ngocingo kuyi-protocol yokukhokha ye-HTTP evulekile — i-ejenti yakho iphendula ngekhodi yesimo engu-402 futhi izivakashi zikhokha nge-USDC ngaphambi kokuvula amakhono akho. Akukho ukusika kwesikhulumi ngesikhathi se-beta evulekile.
home.per_user_metering_built_in_rate_limits: Ukulinganisa ngomsebenzisi ngamunye — imikhawulo yesilinganiso eyakhelwe ngaphakathi kanye namazinga okubhalisa
home.place_your_agent_in_the_real_world: Beka i-ejenti yakho emhlabeni wangempela nge-WebXR ku-Android noma i-Quick Look ku-iOS. Akukho ukufakwa kohlelo lokusebenza okudingekayo.
home.point_your_camera_at_a_flat_surface: Khomba ikhamera yakho endaweni eyisicaba ukuze ubophe imodeli.
home.post_v1_agents_create_agent_from_avatar: POST /v1/agents Dala i-ejenti kusuka ku-avatar + umyalo
home.post_v1_chat_send_a_message_stream: POST /v1/chat Thumela umyalezo, sakaza impendulo
home.profitable_trades_agents_have_closed_aut: Ukuhweba okunenzuzo okwenziwe ama-ejenti ngokuzimela, ngaso sonke isikhathi.
home.put_this_model_on_any_site: Beka le modely kunoma iyiphi isayithi
home.save_your_agent_to_the_blockchain_as: Gcina i-ejenti yakho ku-blockchain njengobunikazi obungadayiswa ku-Solana — idalwe ngomsebenzi owodwa ngezimali ezingaphansi kwesenti. Yiba nayo, yidayise, futhi uvumele amanye ama-ejenti ayithole futhi ayibize ngokuzenzakalelayo.
home.scan_with_your_phone_to_place_this:
Skena ngefoni yakho ukuze ubeke
le modely esikhaleni sakho sangempela.
home.score_conviction: Linganisa ukukholwa
home.scores_every_launch_the_instant_it_appea: Linganisa konke ukwethulwa — ngokushesha nje lapho kuvela ku-on-chain, ngaphambi kokuba isixuku sakheke
home.selfie_3d_avatar_in_a_minute_or: I-Selfie → i-avatar ye-3D ngomzuzu. Noma layisha eyakho GLB. Faka umyalo wobuntu, khetha izwi ku-ElevenLabs noma ku-LiveKit, bese uxhuma i-AI. Noma phequlula imakethe ukuze uthole i-ejenti eselungisiwe.
home.set_your_price_from_0_001_per: Setha intengo yakho — kusukela ku-$0.001 ngomyalezo kuya ku-$100 ngeseshini
home.smart_wallet_pedigree_did_the_proven_mon: Umlando we-smart-wallet — ingabe imali eqinisekisiwe yangena kusenesikhathi? Izinga labo lokuwina lingakanani?
home.something_went_wrong_try_a_simpler_singl: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Zama umyalo olula, onesihloko esisodwa.
home.structure_detection_bundles_snipers_conc: Ukutholwa kwesakhiwo — amabhundela, abashayi, amafulegi okugxila, ukuziphatha konjiniyela
home.the_first_3d_agent_platform_with_native: Ipulatifomu yokuqala ye-3D agent enokuhlanganiswa kwe-Pump.fun yomdabu. Ukuchofoza okukodwa kusuka kudeshibhodi yakho ye-agent kuye kuthokheni ebukhoma ku-Solana.
home.these_are_real_models_from_the_forge: Lezi yizinhlobo zangempela ezivela kugalari ye-Forge, ezakhiwe abasebenzisi ngomyalo wombhalo. Kuselula, thepha inkinobho engezansi ukuze ubone imodeli yamanje ibambelele endaweni eyisicaba eduze kwakho ngesilinganiso sangempela.
home.three_ws_agents_are_onchain_native_launc: Ama-agent e-three.ws angawomdabu we-onchain. Qalisa i-meme coin, i-fan token, noma i-governance token ngqo kusuka kudeshibhodi ye-agent yakho — akukho ukubhala ikhodi, akukho CLI, akukho ukuxuba ama-wallet.
home.top_multiple_a_scored_launch_has_reached: Ukuqaliswa okuhamba phambili okuningi okushaye amagoli kufinyelele kusukela ekuqaleni kwayo.
home.trade_from_chat_visitors_buy_sell_and: Hweba kusuka engxoxweni — izivakashi zithenga, zithengise, futhi zinikeze amathiphu zisebenzisa ikhono le-Pump.fun elakhelwe ngaphakathi le-agent
home.trending_dashboard_track_your_token_acro: Ideshibhodi elithrendayo — landelela ithokheni yakho kuyo yonke i-Pump.fun leaderboard ngesikhathi sangempela
home.turntable_talking_agent_animation_galler: I-Turntable · I-Ejenti Ekhulumayo · Igalari Yezithombe Ezinyakazayo · Iphasipoti Ye-Ejenti · Ukuvakasha Kwe-Hotspot
home.two_lines_of_html_no_sdk_install: Imigqa emibili ye-HTML. Akukho ukufakwa kwe-SDK, akukho ukugoqa kwe-iframe, akukho sinyathelo sokwakha. Isebenza ku-React, Vue, Svelte, naku-HTML elula. Ilodwa kancane ngokuzenzakalelayo, isingathwe yi-CDN emhlabeni wonke.
home.type_a_description_or_take_the_suggestio: Thayipha incazelo — noma thatha isiphakamiso — bese kuba khona i-mesh yangempela enokuthungwa lapha, imvamisa kungakapheli umzuzu.
home.type_a_description_snap_a_selfie_or: Thayipha incazelo, thatha i-selfie, noma layisha i-GLB. Faka umyalo wobuntu, khetha izwi, xhuma i-AI yakho. Shicilela emakethe noma uyigcine iyimfihlo.
home.upload_a_photo_webcam_shot_or_existing: Layisha isithombe, isithombe se-webcam, noma i-GLB ekhona. I-pipeline yethu ikhiqiza umlingiswa we-3D ogcwele, onyakazisekayo ohambisana namafomethi e-VRM namajwayelekile e-glTF/GLB avatar. Iphinda iqondise kunoma yisiphi isiqeshana sokugqwayiza ngokushesha.
home.upload_a_selfie_drop_an_imag_arialabel: Layisha i-selfie — donsela isithombe lapha noma cindezela ukuze ukhethe ifayela
home.visitors_talk_to_your_agent_with_text: Izivakashi zikhuluma ne-ejenti yakho ngombhalo noma ngezwi. Ikhumbula kuzo zonke izikhathi. Khokhisa ngengxoxo ngayinye ngemali encane yokukhokha ngocingo. Yethula ithokheni yayo ku-Pump.fun. Buka ikhula.
home.voice_in_scene_livekit_spatial_audio_tie: Izwi-esigcawini — I-LiveKit spatial audio eboshwe endaweni ye-avatar
home.walk_dance_gesture_emote_a_growing_libra: Hamba, dansa, yenza isenzo, bonisa imizwa — umtapo wezincwadi okhulayo wama-idle loops nezithombe ezinyakazayo ezivuselelwe ezihlanganayo ngaphandle komthungo. Layisha okwakho GLB, FBX, noma okuthwetshulwe yi-BVH.
home.walk_minimap_aria: Hamba i-minimap. Sebenzisa u-W A S D noma izinkinobho zomcibisholo ukuhambisa i-avatar yakho.
home.walk_your_avatar_through_live_environmen: Hambisa i-avatar yakho ezindaweni ezibukhoma. Izivakashi eziningi zihamba ndawonye ngesikhathi sangempela — izindawo ezivumelanisiwe nge-CRDT, ukulawula nge-joystick noma ikhibhodi, kanye nokuba khona kwe-WebSocket.
home.watch_a_pumpportal_feed_streams_every_ne: Buka. I-PumpPortal feed isakaza yonke i-pump.fun mint entsha ngokushesha nje lapho idalwa — i-ejenti ibona ukwethulwa ngesikhathi nje zikhona.
home.watch_new_launches: Buka okwethulwa okusha
home.wire_your_agent_to_any_tool_via: Xhuma i-ejenti yakho kunoma yiliphi ithuluzi nge-MCP. Ivumele ithole futhi ibize amanye ama-ejenti nge-A2A. Yakha amaphakethe amakhono bese uwathengisa emakethe.
home.your_agent_reacts_as_it_speaks_thinks: I-ejenti yakho iyasabela njengoba ikhuluma, icabanga, iphumelela, futhi yehluleka — imizwa ixhunywe ngqo kumphumela wemodeli, ayibhalwanga.
home.your_agent_remembers_every_visitor_acros: I-ejenti yakho ikhumbula wonke umvakashi kuwo wonke amadivayisi nezikhathi. Xhuma emithonjeni yakho yedatha noma sebenzisa inkumbulo ye-vector eyakhelwe ngaphakathi.

home_connect.auth_failed_body: Amatoken ayisodwa ngasinye ngomugqa kanti ayalula ukuyigcina uma uycopier. Yenza entsha phansi kwe-{{path}}, kanti ufake lonke ustring.
home_connect.bad_url_body: Sebenzisa i-URL yephelele ye-https ye-Home Assistant yakho.
home_connect.cancelled_body: Ayikho indlu eyaxhumaniswa futhi ayikho itokhini elayigciniwe. Phinda uzwake uma usemukelwe.
home_connect.card_sub: Konke kuhamba ngokwe-ikhaya lakho elodwa. Lokho esigcinayo, futhi lokho esingagcini nokho, kushicilelwe ngaphambi kokuxhumana.
home_connect.disconnected_body: I-access token esibegile siyisusiwe. Susa itokhini kwe-Home Assistant njengoba ufuna ukuba liphelile ezinye izikhali, phansi kwe-{{path}}.
home_connect.insecure_body: Le phaji iserviwe nge-https, futhi ubrauzari akayi kuvula uxhumano olungagciniwe lusuka kuyo. Sebenzisa idilesi ye-https ye-khaya lakho.
home_connect.insecure_short: Idilesi ye-http eyodwa ayinayo ukuyifikelela kule phaji.
home_connect.label_hint: Ibonakala kwi-ayijenti yakho nasekushicilelweni kokusebenza. "Ikhaya", "I-ofisi", noma yiluphi.
home_connect.landed_anyway_body: Wakhansela ngaphambi kokuba iqhubeka nokuhlola, kodwa indlu yakho yaphendula ngaphambi kokho, ngakho ke iyaxhumana. Yixhumise phansi uma akusho lokho owakufuna.
home_connect.need_token_body: Yenza eyodwa kwe-Home Assistant phansi kwe-{{path}}.
home_connect.need_url_body: Yile i-URL ye-https oyisebenzisayo ukufika ekhaya lakho ngaphandle kwawo.
home_connect.not_yours_body_none: Kungenzeka iyaxhumiswe, noma ilinki ingelowo akawona. Awunakho izindlu ezixhumiwe.
home_connect.not_yours_body_some: Kungenzeka iyaxhumiswe, noma ilinki ingelowo akawona. Izindlu zakho zikhona ezansi.
home_connect.private_host_body: three.ws ihamba e-intanethi, ngakho ayinayo ukuyifika idilesi eyodwa ekhaya lakho. Kukhona izindlela ezimbili ezinqoto.
home_connect.private_host_bullet_1: Sebenzisa idilesi yakho ye-remote ye-https. I-Home Assistant Cloud ininika eyodwa, futhi ne-reverse proxy yakho inayo. Lokho kusebenza namhlanje, netokhini osayo.
home_connect.private_host_bullet_2: Noma uze ubeke ukuba ikhaya lidayile phuya ku-three.ws, nge-bhathana ezansi. Integreyshini encane kwe-Home Assistant, akukho phothi elixhumisiwe, futhi akukho itokhini ye-Home Assistant elayigciniwe lapha.
home_connect.quota_bullet_1: Yixhumisa indlu ongayisebenzisi futhi leyo izoxhumana.
home_connect.quota_bullet_2: Noma hamba uye kuphlan iqaza elinamandla okuphatha izindlu eziningi.
home_connect.signed_out_point_1: I-ayijenti yakho ifunda wonke umuzi, ukukhanya, ukuvimbela nokuhlola okwakhishwa ngekhaya lakho.
home_connect.signed_out_point_3: Ukuvimbela, ukuvala nokuzivimbela akubuzi. Ukuvula, ukuvula nokuvula kuyabuza njalo.
home_connect.signed_out_sub: Izindlu zakho zixhumene ne-akhawunti yakho ye-three.ws, ngoba ikredenshiyali evula ikhaya lakho igciniwe ngokugcwaliswa kwe-encryption ngayo futhi ayikho kule brauzari.
home_connect.token_help_note: Ithokhini iguqulwe ngaphambi kokuba ibekwe futhi ayisayi kudluliselwa esikhungweni lesi. Ukususa kuyo eHome Assistant kuyisusa ngokushesha ukuxhumana kwethu, noma sithola yini.
home_connect.token_hint: Idluliselwe ku-three.ws kanye, iguqulwe ekugcineni, futhi ayisayi kudluliselwa esikhungweni lesi noma ibekwe kule browser.
home_connect.token_step_1: Vula iHome Assistant yakho bese uthinta igama lakho phansi kwesayibhabha.
home_connect.token_step_3: Landela kuze ufike ku-Long-lived access tokens bese ukhetha Create token.
home_connect.token_step_4: Yibize "three.ws" bese ucophe ithokhini. IHome Assistant ibonisa kanye.
home_connect.unreachable_bullet_1: Uma idilesi ithile, hlola ukuthi indlu ikhonlayini futhi ifinyelelwe ngaphandle kwenetwork yakho.
home_connect.unreachable_bullet_2: Uma ifinyelelwa ekhaya kuphela, three.ws ayinayo indlela yokufinyelela. I-add-on eqala ngaphakathi kwenetwork yakho ndiyo ndlela.
home_connect.url_hint: I-URL ye-https oyisebenzisa ngaphandle kwendlu: iHome Assistant Cloud, noma i-reverse proxy yakho.
home_connect.verifying_sub: Lokhu kwenziwa ku-instance yakho ngokushesha. Kuthatha isekhondi noma ezimbili.

home_floorplan.canvas_aria: I-floorplan. Amakhiye okuya phambili/phambili ayisuza iqhosha elikhethiwe, ama-plus nama-minus ayilungiseza ubukhulu.
home_floorplan.conflict_body: Babeka inguqulo {{version}} ngesikhathi usebhala. Akulutho olahlekelwe: khetha eyodluliselwa.
home_floorplan.empty_body: Indlu yakho ye-3D isebenzisa i-grid eyodwa. Beka iqhosha ngezansi ukuze uqale ukudweba into eqondile.
home_floorplan.filed_body: Lokho kwabhalwe kuHome Assistant yakho, ngakho ke kuzobonakala ezidashibhodini zakho kanye nenkulumo yakho.
home_floorplan.first_room_body: Akukho into edlulele kule ndlu. Yenza iqhosha elokuqala bese iplan iqala lapha.
home_floorplan.no_areas_body: IHome Assistant ayinazo izindawo le ndlu. Yenza iqhosha ngezansi, bese ususela izinkonzo zakho ukuze zibe yona: lokho kubhala iqhosha kuHome Assistant yakho, hhayi lapha kuphela.
home_floorplan.readonly: Ungabona le floorplan. Ukuguqula kudinga umnini noma i-admin.
home_floorplan.reset_body: Amaqhosha agcwalisa i-grid ngokwesizinda ngasinye isiqephu, ngaphambi kokuba udwebe iplan futhi.
home_floorplan.room_made_body: Yenziwe e-Home Assistant yakho, ngakho-ke ungabeka izixhobo kuyo lapha uze usebenzise khona.
home_floorplan.saved_body: Indlu yakho ye-3D manje iyalandela leli sakhiwo.
home_floorplan.took_theirs_body: Izinguquko zakho azigciniwe. Bheka kabusha ugcine futhi uma unayo intando.
home_floorplan.tray_empty: Yonke imigwaqo lelo khaya kuyo isakhiwo.
home_floorplan.tray_hint: Draga eyodwa ibe emgwaqweni. Lokhu kubeka isixhobo e-Home Assistant, ngakho-ke sizobonakala ezidashibhodini zakho nasekwenziwa kwesikhombisi sezwi.
home_floorplan.tray_hint_readonly: Ukubeka isixhobo emgwaqweni kudinga umnini noma i-admin.
home_floorplan.unreadable_body: {{reason}} Indlu ye-3D isebenzisa ukulungiswa kwangokuziphatha. Ukubhala ugcine kushintshe isakhiwo esigciniwe.

home_join.lede: Ubani unikeze ukuvumeleka ekhaya abalixhumisile kwe-three.ws. Ngaphambi kokuyamukela, leli phepha likuxelela ukuthi likhaya liphi, ungakwenza yini lapho, futhi ungakwenzanga yini. Ilinki lisebenza kanye.
home_join.meta_description: Yamukela isivumelwano sokungena ekhaya elixhumiwe. Ilinki likuxelela ukuthi likhaya liphi futhi kuyiqiniso ungakwenza yini lapho ngaphambi kokufika, futhi lisebenza kanye.
home_join.meta_og_description: Isivumelwano sokungena emndenini: likhaya liphi, ungakwenza yini lapho, futhi ungakwenzanga yini.
home_join.meta_title: Ungene ekhaya · Yamukela isivumelwano sokungena emndenini · three.ws
home_join.meta_twitter_description: Isivumelwano sokungena emndenini: likhaya liphi, ungakwenza yini lapho, futhi ungakwenzanga yini.
home_join.noscript_body: Ukugamukela isivumelwano kuyifunda ekhasi lakho, ngakho-ke leli phepha lidinga iJavaScript. Isivumelwano ngokwase kuyaqhuba futhi lisebenza: vula iJavaScript ubuye uve ilinki.
home_join.title: Wavunywa ekhaya

home_manage.disconnect_body_1: Ithokhini lesivumelwano esithola siyashiswa ngokushesha futhi umshayeli wakho uphinde angeke anesivumelwano ekhaya leli. Imvume yakho eqinileyo ne-log yezenzo ziyagcinwa ukuze ukuze ukwazi ukufunda ukuthi kwenzekani.
home_manage.disconnect_body_2: Lokhu akususi ithokhini phakathi kwe-Home Assistant. Susa khona uma ufuna ukususa phezu kwesibili.
home_manage.grants_empty_body: Yonke imvula, yonke imvume nokuvula kuyema kubuza. Uma uvumela eyodwa, ibonakala lapha ne-revoke.
home_manage.grants_summary: Oku umshayeli wakho angakwenza ngaphandle kokubuza.
home_manage.health_failed_body: Phinda ulode iphepha ukuze uzame futhi.
home_manage.health_summary: Ukufikelela, okwenzeka umshayeli wakho, nokuthi yini into enhle noma embi.
home_manage.log_empty_body: Uma umshayeli wakho uvula ilayithi noma aphikisane nokuvula umnyango, kuyofika lapha nobani obuze futhi kwenzekani.
home_manage.log_end: Lokhu yilonke imbali esigcinayo leli khaya.
home_manage.log_summary: Yonke into eyenziwe ngumshini wakho, kanye neyonke eyala ngayo.
home_manage.mcp_off_body: Faka ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Model Context Protocol Server e-Home Assistant, phansi kwe-Settings, Devices and services, ukuze umshini wakho uthole izixhobo ezichazile ukuthi uzifuna. Konke sekuyasebenza ngaphandle kwalo.
home_manage.mcp_off_title: Khethiwe: vula i-Model Context Protocol server.
home_manage.mcp_on_body: Umshini wakho usebenzisa izixhobo ezichazile owavula e-Home Assistant, ngemimiselo yakho yokuvula.
home_manage.mcp_on_title: I-Model Context Protocol server ihlanganisiwe ({{tools}} izixhobo).
home_manage.only_this_house: Yonke imuzi eyinxulumene isebenza ngokujwayelekile, ngakho-ke leyo ithi ngomuzwakho ngaphandle kwethu.
home_manage.platform_body: three.ws inesinkinga sokufika emuzini ongexene nayo manje. Akukho into endlini yakho eyadinga ukuqala kabusha futhi i-access token yakho ihle. Siyalungiselela, nomuzi wakho uzobuya usebenze ngakho konke.
home_manage.platform_title: Lokhu kuyizinkinga zethu, hayi indlu yakho.
home_manage.retries_paused: three.ws yimise izama-zama zakhe imizuzwana, iyozama kabusha ngokuyaziyo.
home_manage.status_auth: I-Home Assistant yaphika i-token esigciniwe. Xhumana kabusha nge-entha.
home_manage.status_down_never: Ayiphenduli manje. Isimo esishaqile sibonakala ngezansi.
home_manage.status_down_seen: Ayiphenduli manje. Yiphendula {{ago}}, nalokho kubonakala ngezansi.
home_manage.sub: Umshini wakho ungafunda konke lapha. Yonke into evula, evula noma ivula uvimba iyema ibuze, ngaphandle uma uyinike izimvume ngezansi.

home_plan.lede: Lokhu iqhinga lakho liyikhupha, lokhu usebenzayo, nangabe liphinda futhi. Yonke imigomo ilapha ngaphandle kokuthi ucarile kangakanani, ngoba imigomo oyibona ngesikhathi iseyikustopha awukaboni. Ukuvula umnyango, ukuvala igeyiji noma ivalvhu kanye nokuvula ialama ake kuyikho okuyimelwe ukwaphuka ngomugomo, ngaloluphi uqhinga.
home_plan.meta_description: Lokhu iqhinga lakho lika-three.ws liyikhupha emizini eyinxulumene: imizi, amabhodi omndeni, iskrini eziphilayo, imizuzu yezwi neziviri zomshini, nabesetshenziswe nangabe liphinda futhi. Ukuvula, ukuvala igeyiji nokuvula ialama ake kuyimigomo.
home_plan.meta_og_description: Lokhu iqhinga lakho likhupha emizini eyinxulumene, lokhu usebenzile, nangabe liphinda futhi. Imisebenzi yephephile ake yimigomo.

home_plan.noscript_body: Leli phepha lifunda ubusetshenziswa bakho obuphilayo kwi-akhawunti yakho, ngakho-ke kudinga iJavaScript. Imigomo yakho nemizi yakho ayiwa ngenkinga, futhi yonke imisebenzi yephephile iyasebenza: iqhinga alikwazi ukukustopha ukulivula.

home_satellite.lede: i-Home Assistant iyayigcina into eyimfundo: igama lokuvusa, ukubaluleka kwezwi, umqondo, impendulo, futhi yonke imishini endlini yakho. Into engayinayo yisitho. Hlanganisa isatelayithi se-three.ws futhi ipayipulayini efanayo oyisebenzisa manje inayo, ibhalwe ngomlomo ngokufanayo nokukhuluma kwayo, kuwo wonke usikrini endlini. Vala le phepha futhi umncedisi wakho uyaqhubeka ukusebenza njengabe ebesenza ngalo.
home_satellite.meta_description: Jika ipayipulayini yezwi le-Home Assistant efilayo ku-agenti ye-three.ws kuyithole ubuso, umehluko, ukubhalwa ngomlomo nokubhalwa ngomlomo kanye nesitho. i-Home Assistant igcina igama lokuvusa, ukubhalwa kwezwi kanye neimpendulo; three.ws ngubuso.
home_satellite.meta_og_description: Umncedisi wakho wezwi we-Home Assistant ungumlomi oneringi ye-LED. Mnika ubuso, ukubhalwa ngomlomo kanye nesitho esijikeleza kuwe.
home_satellite.meta_title: Isatelayithi yezwi · Mnika umncedisi wakho we-Home Assistant ubuso · three.ws
home_satellite.meta_twitter_description: Umncedisi wakho wezwi we-Home Assistant ungumlomi oneringi ye-LED. Mnika ubuso, ukubhalwa ngomlomo kanye nesitho esijikeleza kuwe.
home_satellite.noscript_body: Leli phepha liyavula iseshini eliphilayo le-odiwe kanye nokubonisa umfanekiso we-3D, ngakho-ke kudingeka i-JavaScript. Isatelayithi ngokwayo ayidingi: isebenza ngakwesokudla kwe-Home Assistant enetwork yakho kugcina ipayipulayini yakho yezwi isebenza uma kunomabhulowuzu evuliwe noma cha.
home_satellite.noscript_guide: Funda incwadi yokuqala ukwazisa izinyathelo zokufaka ngokobhalo olulula.

home_scene.err_token_body: I-access token ephakade elikhaya lalixhumene ngalo alisebenzi.enza entsha e-Home Assistant (iprofile yakho, Security) uze uxhumise futhi.
home_scene.err_unreachable_body: three.ws ayikwazi ukufika kule Home Assistant. Uma ikhona kuphela kwenetwork yakho yekhaya, iserver eseyiphambili asikwazi ukuroutha kuzo: sebenzisa i-remote https URL yakho, noma qhuba i-three.ws add-on phakathi kwenetwork.

hood_desk.every_number_on_this_desk_is_read: Inombolo ngayinye kule desk ifundwa ngempela ku-Robinhood Chain (4663): izilinganiso kanye nomlando kusuka ku-RPC ye-chain kanye ne-Blockscout indexer, i-Stock Token NAV kusuka kumafidi e-Chainlink ku-chain, amanani ezimali ukusuka ku-Uniswap pool ejulile. Ama-Stock Tokens ayizikweletu ezihlanganisiwe ezikhishwe yi-Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Ltd futhi angase anganikezwa, athengiswe, noma anikezwe kubantu base-US; le desk ibonisa zona futhi ayikaze ithumele umyalo kuyo. Akukho okukhona lapha kuyisixwayiso sokutshalwa kwezimali.
hood_desk.meta_description: I-desk yokuhweba ephilayo ye-Robinhood Chain (4663) ibhange: inani lelibhuku, umlando wesilinganiso, iphepha lokusebenza ku-chain, izikhundla ezibiziwe ngokumelene ne-Chainlink NAV kanye ne-Uniswap, i-NAV premium ridge, ukuhamba kwabanye, kanye ne-memecoin movers. Idatha yangempela ku-chain, akukho okhiye be-API, akukho siginesha.
hood_desk.meta_og_description: Namathisela noma iyiphi ikheli le-Robinhood Chain bese uthola ibhuku layo lonke: umlando wezilinganiso, iphepha lokusebenza, izikhundla ezibiziwe, i-NAV premium ridge kanye nokuhamba kwabanye.

hood_portfolios.constituents_weights_schedule_the_origin: Izakhi, izisindo, uhlelo, umyalo ophumayo kanye nesithombe somhlaba zibhaliwe futhi zisayiniwe. I-hash ifakwa ku-chain; idokhumenti ibhekiswe kokuqukethwe. Ayishintshi, ngakho lokho okuthengile akukwazi ukushintsha ngaphansi kwakho.
hood_portfolios.deliver_every_constituent_to_mint_receiv: Deliver every constituent to mint, receive every constituent to redeem. I-fund ayithengisi lutho ukuze ivumele othile ukuba bangene noma baphume, ngakho ayidli slippage futhi ayidingi i-price oracle ukuze isebenze.
hood_portfolios.elsewhere_refining_an_index_with_a_follo: Ezinye izindawo, ukuhlela i-index ngomyalo olandelayo kushintsha i-index osuyibambe. Ku-chain lokho akuyona impahla, kuyichaza ye-rug: i-manifest iyona kuphela into umnikazi ethembele kuyo. Ngakho ukuhlela kukhipha i-portfolio entsha enomkhombandlela omdala. Abanikazi be-original bagcina kahle lokho abakuthengile, futhi i-fork ikhokhela umndeni wayo ingxenye ethile yemali yayo. I-budget, hhayi umthetho, ngakho uku-fork i-portfolio yakho izikhathi ezingama-50 akukwazi ukukhokhela kakhulu kunokuyiforki kanye.
hood_portfolios.four_steps_and_only_one_of_them: Izinyathelo ezine, futhi eyodwa kuphela yazo ibandakanya imodeli. Izinqumo ezithakazelisayo zenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi noma yini ithinte i-chain; okwenzeka ku-chain kuyinto engathandeki kakhulu.
hood_portfolios.meta_description: Chaza i-portfolio ngesigwebo bese uthola ibhaskithi yangempela ye-Robinhood Chain assets: izikhwama ezihlanganisiwe, ama-crypto majors kanye nezimpawu ezikwi-chain ku-index eyodwa. Izisindo ziqinisekiswa ku-chain njenge-manifest esayiniwe, zigcinwa ngendlela, futhi zibalansiswa ngesikhathi esikhangisiwe.
hood_portfolios.meta_og_description: Isigwebo esisodwa, i-portfolio ephumayo. Izikhwama ezihlanganisiwe, ama-majors kanye nama-memecoins ku-index eyodwa ku-Robinhood Chain, nezisindo eziqinisekisiwe ku-chain futhi zibalansiswa ngesikhathi esikhangisiwe.

hood_portfolios.nothing_here_is_investment_advice_and_a: Akukho lapha okukhuluma ngokuqashwa, futhi ibhaskithi eyenziwe ayiyona isiphakamiso. Izikhwama ezihlanganisiwe ku-Robinhood Chain ziyi-debt securities ezihlanganisiwe ezikhishwe yi-Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Ltd futhi zingase zinganikezwa, zithengiswe noma zikhishwe kubantu base-US; leli khasi liyisiboniso kuphela. I-portfolio ebamba izimpawu ezikwi-chain ingalahlekelwa yonke inani layo, futhi i-equity leg elimisiwe limisa ukuhoxiswa kubo bonke kuze kube umkhiqizi wayo uqala kabusha.

Bhala isigwebo bese isikrini sihlela lelo mhlaba lonke ngokumelene naso. Okubuyayo kuyibhaskithi yangempela enezisindo ezihlosiwe, egcinwe ngendlela yi-vault elungisa kabusha ngesikhathi esikhangisiwe.
hood_portfolios.when_the_published_interval_comes_due_th: Lapho isikhathi esishicilelwe sifika, ukuhweba kuhanjiswa njengokuthengiswa kwezintengo ezihamba phansi okungagcwaliswa noma iyiphi ikheli. Akukho umsebenzi ovumela umphathi ukuthi ahwebele izimpahla ze-fund. Iphothifoliyo ngayinye ibuyekezwa kabili, ngesikhathi sayo futhi ayivuselelwa, ukuze ubone ukuthi ishejuli yenze kanjani empeleni kunokucabanga ukuthi iyasiza.
hood_portfolios.your_prompt_and_the_chain_s_holdable: I-prompt yakho kanye nezwe elingabambeka lihamba kumodeli. I-token ngayinye ebuyiselwa ibhekwa emhlabeni lowo, ngakho noma yini eyenziwe iyashiywa, ayilungiswanga ibe into enokwenzeka.

I-token idinga ipulazi eliphilayo kanye nenani elifundekayo ukuze ikhethwe, ngoba umphakathi ongathengwa awukwazi ukufakwa ebhasini noma ukuvuselelwa, noma ngabe umthamo wayo mkhulu kangakanani.

ibm_hello.3d_payments_trading_intel_identity_and_p: I-3D, izinkokhelo, ubuhlakani bokuhweba, ubunikazi, kanye nobufakazi okudalulwe kunoma iyiphi i-ejenti ye-AI nge-Model Context Protocol — amaphakethe e-npm angu-31 namaseva angu-6 abanjwe endaweni yokubhalisa yomphakathi.
ibm_hello.a_guided_tour_of_x402_micropayments_and: Uhambo oluqondisiwe lwe-x402 izinkokhelo ezincane nama-ejenti e-AI e-3D — ngayo yonke idemo ekuleli khasi esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela. Awukwazi ukuyibuka bukhoma? Ukuqoshwa kuhlala lapha ngemuva.
ibm_hello.a_plain_to_a_paid_endpoint_no: I-GET elula ku-endpoint ekhokhelwayo — ayikho inkokhelo enamathiselwe okwamanje.
ibm_hello.a_prompt_becomes_a_textured_auto_rigged: I-prompt iba yi-GLB enombhalo, e-auto-rigged (Microsoft TRELLIS ku-NVIDIA NIM), bese ihamba, yenza i-pose, futhi ihlala emhlabeni owabiwe — amademo ayisithupha abukhoma kuleli khasi, akukho okwenziwe mbumbulu.
ibm_hello.agents_and_visitors_pay_for_a_single: Ama-ejenti nezivakashi bakhokhela ucingo olulodwa lwe-API ngemvume engenagasi — ku-USDC noma $THREE, kuxazululwe ku-Base noma ku-Solana mainnet. I-rail evulekile x402, bukhoma kuleli khasi.
ibm_hello.amounts_are_deliberately_tiny_a_cent_or: Amanani mancane ngamabomu (isenthi noma ngaphansi), futhi amademo amahhala — ama-avatar, i-pose, igalaksi, imihlaba, i-AR — awadingi i-wallet nhlobo.
ibm_hello.anchor_a_3d_agent_to_physical_space: Bopha i-ejenti ye-3D esikhaleni esingokoqobo bese uyibona ngekhamera yakho, ngamaphini angokoqobo owabeka eduze kwakho — uhlala ulawula yonke imvume. I-AR iyisipiliyoni sefoni, ngakho-ke kungcono ukuyivula kudivayisi yeselula; indawo ebukhoma ingezansi, futhi i-prompt yekhamera ivuleka kuphela uma ukhetha ukuyenza isebenze.
ibm_hello.browse_the_endpoint_bazaarcallable_paid_: Phequlula i-Endpoint BazaarAma-endpoint e-agent akhokhelwayo, angabizwa ngaphezu kwe-x402 →
ibm_hello.describe_a_character_three_ws_generates_: Chaza umlingiswa; three.ws ikhiqiza i-mesh enombhalo, ihlanganisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ithambo, bese iyifaka ngqo enjinini ye-avatar — lapho imi khona, iphefumula, futhi iphephetha. Kumahhala, akukho wallet. I-rig efanayo yendawo yonke evumela noma yimuphi umuntu ukuthi agqoke umtapo wethu wezithombe, osebenza bukhoma kusiphequluli sakho.
ibm_hello.draft_0_05_fast_preview_geometry_best: Idrafti$0.05 I-geometry yokubuka kuqala esheshayo. Kungcono ukuzama ukuhamba. ~40s
ibm_hello.every_agent_carries_portable_identity_an: I-agent ngayinye iphethe ubunikazi obuthwalekayo kanye nedumela ku-chain, kanye namalayisense amakhono akhiqizwe njenge-1/1 SPL NFTs — ukufinyelela okuqinisekisekayo ngaphandle kwesizindalwazi endleleni yokwethenjwa. Solana + EVM.
ibm_hello.every_avatar_here_is_generated_and_rigge: I-avatar ngayinye lapha ikhiqizwa futhi ihlanganiswe ngokwesidingo — akukho mtapo wethempulethi, akukho balingiswa abalungisiwe. I-rig ihambisana nethambo eliyinhloko le-three.ws, ngakho-ke iziqeshana ezifanayo zokungasebenzi, zokuhamba nezokubonisa imizwa zidlala kunoma yini oyichazayo. Ufuna isithombe→3D, ukulayisha kwakho kwe-GLB, noma ukubuka kuqala kwe-AR? Vula ithuluzi eliphelele le-Forge ↗ Umzila wamahhala unomkhawulo wehora ukuze uhlale ukhululekile kuwo wonke umuntu; uma umatasa ukutshela kahle ukuthi uzame nini futhi. Ukukhiqizwa kusebenza ku-NVIDIA NIM futhi kubuyela emuva ngokuzenzakalelayo emigwaqweni, ngakho imodeli ihlala ibuya.
ibm_hello.every_avatar_three_ws_generates_lands_on: I-avatar ngayinye three.ws ekhiqizwayo ihlala ethambeni elilodwa eliyinhloko — ngakho-ke i-rig efanayo iyazibeka zonke. Zungezisa i-mannequin, bamba isitho ukuze usinyakazise (i-inverse kinematics ezandleni nasezinyaweni), susa ijoyinti ngama-slider, noma thepha i-preset ukuze uguqule isimo sonke. Yiyo kanye i-rig engemuva kwe-Pose Studio ephelele, esebenza bukhoma ekhasini.
ibm_hello.every_coin_on_three_ws_is_a: Yonke imali ku-three.ws iyindawo ye-3D ama-agent nezivakashi ababelana ngayo ngesikhathi sangempela — ngena, khetha i-avatar, bese uhamba emhlabeni osabela emsebenzini we-on-chain obukhoma. Khetha igama nomzimba ngezansi ukuze ungene; isebenza ngosayizi ogcwele, khona kanye ekhasini.
ibm_hello.every_demo_below_runs_against_real_produ: Yonke idemo engezansi isebenza ezinhlelweni zangempela, zokukhiqiza ze-three.ws: khokha amasenti ambalwa ukuze uguqule umbhalo ube imodeli ye-3D, wakhe i-avatar ehlanganisiwe kusuka emshweni, uyibeke ngesandla, undize umthala we-3D wama-agent amephwe yi-IBM Granite, ungene emhlabeni owabelwe, noma ubeke i-agent ku-augmented reality. ibm_x402_demo.the_button_above_is_powered_by_one: Inkinobho engenhla inikwa amandla yi-script eyodwa nje efakwayo. Noma yisiphi isici esine-data-x402-endpoint sivula ukugeleza kwe-wallet ngokuchofoza — akukho-framework, akukho-build step, akukho-SDK.
ibm_x402_demo.the_same_pipeline_on_the_house_no: Ipayipi elifanayo, mahhala. Ayikho i-wallet, ayikho i-API key, akukho ukukhokha — isebenzisa i-Microsoft TRELLIS ku-NVIDIA NIM ngokubuyela emuva okuzenzakalelayo kuzo zonke izindlela zokukhiqiza, ngakho i-GLB enokuthungwa ihlala ibuyela ukuze ijikelezwe futhi ilandwe.
ibm_x402_demo.the_stream_will_appear_here_the_moment: Ukusakaza kuzovela lapha ngokushesha nje lapho kuqala.
ibm_x402_demo.this_calls_a_real_three_ws_api: Lokhu kubiza i-API yangempela ye-three.ws — ukuhlola ukutholakala kwe-ticker-symbol — ngengxenye yeshumi ye-centi ku-USDC, kuxazululwe ku-chain. Intengo engezansi ifundwa bukhoma kusuka empendulweni ye-402 yeseva.
ibm_x402_demo.this_pays_the_same_x402_rail_as: Lokhu kukhokha ngendlela efanayo ye-x402 njengedemo engezansi — inkokhelo encane eyodwa ye-USDC isebenzisa ipayipi langempela le-text→3D (i-Microsoft TRELLIS ku-NVIDIA NIM) bese ibuyisa i-GLB enokuthungwa ongayijikeleza futhi uyilande. Intengo engezansi ifundwa bukhoma kusuka empendulweni ye-402 yeseva.
ibm_x402_demo.want_image_3d_auto_rigging_ar_preview: Ufuna isithombe→3D, ukuzenzakalela kokulungisa, ukubuka kuqala kwe-AR kanye negalari ephelele? Vula ithuluzi eliphelele le-Forge ↗
ibm_x402_demo.you_ll_need_the_phantom_wallet_on: Uzodinga i-wallet ye-Phantom ku-Solana — ebambe intengo yemodeli ku-USDC ku-Solana mainnet. Lokhu kusebenzisa imali yangempela USDC — intengo ekhonjiswe ngenhla — kusuka ku-wallet yakho. Inkokhelo ngokwayo iyisiginesha engenagasi: imali yenethiwekhi ixhaswa umxhasi we-x402, ngakho-ke ayengezwa ezindlekweni zakho. Ukukhiqizwa kuqala uma inkokhelo isiqinisekisiwe futhi kuthatha cishe umzuzu. Awunayo i-wallet? Forge eyodwa mahhala ngezansi — ayikho i-wallet, ayikho ikhi, ayikho inkokhelo.
ibm_x402_demo.you_sign_a_gasless_usdc_authorization_re: Usayina imvume ye-USDC engenagasi, uyithumele kabusha ngekhanda le-X-PAYMENT, bese ucingo luyahlala ku-chain — idatha yakho ibuyela kuwe.

integrations.a_3d_agent_that_reads_your_page: I-agent ye-3D efunda ikhasi lakho futhi iqondise izivakashi kokuqukethwe kwakho — ilungele imibhalo, amakhasi okufika, namabhulogi. Akudingi ukusetha.
integrations.a_floating_3d_character_fixed_to_the: Umlingiswa we-3D ontantayo ogxile ekhoneni lanoma iyiphi isayithi. Uyahamba, uyashukuma, futhi uyakhuluma — ngethegi eyodwa ye-script. Ayikho i-backend edingekayo.
integrations.a_full_chat_interface_with_a_live: I-interface yengxoxo ephelele enomlingiswa we-3D obukhoma. Izwi noma umbhalo. Ubuchwepheshe obufanayo obusemuva kwe-PumpBot — yifake kunoma iyiphi isayithi ngemizuzwana.
integrations.a_rotatable_animated_3d_avatar_transpare: I-3D avatar ejikelezayo, egqwayizayo — ingemuva elibonisa ngale, ilungele i-OBS, ingabhalwa ngokuphelele nge-JS. Isebenza njenge-web component kunoma yiliphi ikhasi.
integrations.builders_are_already_using_these_integra: Abakhi sebevele basebenzisa lezi zihlanganisi kumasayithi wangempela — kusukela kuma-token chat bots kuya kuma-3D docs guides.
integrations.drop_3d_agents_chat_widgets_walk_compani: Faka ama-3D agent, ama-chat widget, abangane bokuhamba, nedatha ye-token ebukhoma kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi — ayikho i-backend, ayikho i-framework, akukho ukungqubuzana.
integrations.follow_along_for_builds_demos_and_conver: Landela ukuze uthole ukwakha, amademo, nezingxoxo nethimba.
integrations.get_updates_on_new_integrations_agent_to: Thola izibuyekezo ngezihlanganisi ezintsha, amathuluzi e-agent, nezinguquko zephrothokholi.
integrations.let_claude_cursor_or_any_mcp_compatible: Vumela uClaude, iCursor, noma yimuphi umsizi we-AI ohambisana ne-MCP ukulawula ama-ejenti akho e-3D — enze i-render, akhulume, enze izenzo, futhi abonise imizwa ngamathuluzi akho e-AI.
integrations.live_price_chart_and_market_data_with: Intengo ebukhoma, ishadi, nedatha yemakethe enomlingiswa we-3D osabela ekunyakazeni. Yakhelwe imiphakathi yamathokheni namawebhusayithi e-launchpad.
integrations.meta_description: Ama-ejenti e-3D afakwayo, amawijethi engxoxo, kanye nama-avatar afakwe kunoma yiliphi isayithi. Ithegi yeskripthi eyodwa. Inikwe amandla yi-three.ws.

integrity.agent_wallets_on_three_ws_are_custodial: Izikhwama zama-ejenti ku-three.ws zingezokugcinwa — sigcina okhiye futhi sisayinele wena. Ngakho senza ukugcinwa kubonakale, hhayi ukuthembisa nje. Njalo ngamahora ambalwa sithatha isithombe sesimo sesikhwama ngasinye ku-chain, sakhe isihlahla se-Merkle, bese sifaka impande ku-Solana. Ngezansi kukhona impande yakamuva kanye nokwenziwa kwayo okuyisisekelo — kukuqinisekise ku-chain wena ngokwakho. Unesikhwama? Qinisekisa ubufakazi bakho bokufakwa →
integrity.meta_description: Izikhwama zama-ejenti ezingezokugcinwa ze-three.ws zithembekile ngokubonakalayo. Njalo ngamahora ambalwa inkundla ifaka impande ye-Merkle phezu kwesimo sesikhwama ngasinye ku-chain ku-Solana. Qinisekisa impande yakamuva ku-chain wena ngokwakho — akukho-akhawunti, akukho-kuthembela okudingekayo.
integrity.meta_og_description: Ukugcinwa okubonakalayo, okusekelwe ku-chain kwesikhwama ngasinye se-ejenti. Qinisekisa impande yakamuva wena ngokwakho — akukho-kuthembela okudingekayo.
integrity.meta_twitter_description: Ukugcinwa okungafakazelwa, okuboshelwe ku-chain kuso sonke isikhwama se-agent. Ziqinisekise wena.

irl_privacy.a_list_map_feed_or_directory_of: Uhlu, imephu, okuphakelayo, noma uhla lwemibhalo lapho kubekwe khona ama-agent
irl_privacy.a_placed_agent_appears_to_someone_only: I-agent ebekiwe ibonakala kumuntu kuphela uma eseduze ngomzimba ngamamitha ambalwa. Hamba kude futhi ngeke isafinyeleleka — ayikho indlela yokuyibuka usuka ngaphesheya kwedolobha.
irl_privacy.agents_you_place_without_signing_in_expi: Ama-agent owabeka ngaphandle kokungena ngemvume aphelelwa yisikhathi ngokwawo ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-7. Noma yini oyibekayo ingeyakho ukuyisusa ngokushesha ku-dashboard yakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

irl_privacy.an_ambient_reaction_a_heart_or_a: Ukuphendula okuzenzakalelayo (inhliziyo noma igagasi) uma othile ehlanganyela ne-agent enibhekene nayo nobabili

irl_privacy.approximate_keeps_your_exact_position_of: Okulinganiselwe kugcina indawo yakho eqondile ingekho kumaseva ethu ngenkathi upheqa: ama-ejenti aseduze abonakala ngokungacacile kancane. Ukubeka kuhlala kuqonde lapho ukhetha khona.
irl_privacy.every_agent_you_ve_placed_is_listed: Wonke ama-ejenti owabeke abhalwe kudeshibhodi yakho, abonakala kuwe kuphela. Susa noma yimaphi ngokushesha, futhi izikhonkwane ezingaziwa ziphelelwa yisikhathi ngokwazo ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-7.
irl_privacy.how_your_camera_motion_and_location_are: Isetshenziswa kanjani ikhamera yakho, ukunyakaza, nendawo
irl_privacy.irl_is_a_phone_camera_experience_built: I-IRL iyisipiliyoni sekhamera yefoni esakhelwe phezu kwezinzwa ezintathu. Ngayinye isetshenziselwa ukubonisa isimo kudivayisi yakho — futhi ngayinye iyinto oyinikezayo, futhi ongayishintsha, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
irl_privacy.lets_you_place_an_agent_at_a: Ikuvumela ukuthi ubeke i-ejenti endaweni yangempela futhi uthole eziseduze nawe. Sihlola kuphela okungaphakathi kwamamitha ambalwa lapho ukhona manje — hhayi indawo ebanzi — futhi indawo yakho ayilokothi yabiwe nabanye abasebenzisi.
irl_privacy.meta_description: Ku-three.ws IRL, i-ejenti ebekiwe iyimfihlo ngendawo: ibonakala kuphela kubantu abame ngokoqobo ngaphakathi kwamamitha ambalwa kuyo — ayilokothi ibe kumephu, ohlwini, noma kumkhombandlela womphakathi. Nansi ngqo okwabiwayo, okungabiwa, nokuthi isetshenziswa kanjani ikhamera yakho, ukunyakaza, nendawo.
irl_privacy.meta_og_description: Ama-ejenti abekiwe ayimfihlo ngendawo — atholakala kuphela mathupha, awabhalwa noma abekwe kumephu. Yini eyabiwayo, yini engeyona, nokuthi izinzwa zakho zisetshenziswa kanjani.
irl_privacy.meta_twitter_description: Ama-ejenti abekiwe ayimfihlo ngendawo — atholakala kuphela mathupha, awabhalwa noma abekwe kumephu.
irl_privacy.open_location_privacy_from_the_irl_top: Vula Indawo & yobumfihlo kusuka kubha ephezulu ye-IRL ukuze ulungise noma yikuphi kwalokhu. Zivaliwe noma ziyimfihlo ngokuzenzakalelayo — uzivula wena, hhayi ngenye indlela.
irl_privacy.private_by_location_discovered_in_person: Iyimfihlo ngendawo, itholakala mathupha, ilawulwa nguwe. Usulungele ukuletha ama-ejenti akho emhlabeni wangempela?
irl_privacy.questions_about_how_your_data_is_handled: Imibuzo mayelana nokuthi idatha yakho iphathwa kanjani? Funda inqubomgomo yethu yobumfihlo ephelele noma thumela i-imeyili ku-privacy@three.ws.
irl_privacy.reads_your_phone_s_gyroscope_so_agents: Ifunda i-gyroscope yefoni yakho ukuze ama-ejenti ahlale ekhiyiwe endaweni njengoba ujika ubheka nxazonke. Isetshenziswa ngesikhathi sangempela ukubeka isimo; akukho okuthunyelwa ngaphandle kwedivayisi yakho.
irl_privacy.renders_the_live_ar_passthrough_so_agent: Ibonisa ukudlula kwe-AR okubukhoma ukuze ama-ejenti abonakale ebambelele emhlabeni wangempela ngemuva kwawo. Ividiyo idwetshwa esikrinini sakho kuphela — amafreyimu awake alayishwe noma agcinwe.
irl_privacy.there_is_no_list_no_map_and: Alukho uhlu, akukho mephu, futhi akukho mkhombandlela wokuthi ama-ejenti akuphi — hhayi kwabanye abasebenzisi, futhi akukho emphakathini. Izindawo zakho ozibekile zibonakala kuwe kuphela, kudeshibhodi yakho. Bonke abanye bangathola i-ejenti kuphela ngokuba seduze kwayo mathupha.

launch_week.267_8k_impressions_25_3k_engagements_9: 267.8K ukubonwa. 25.3K ukuzibandakanya. Izinga lokuzibandakanya: 9.4%. 5.1K ukuvakasha kwephrofayela. 7.2K ukuthandwa, 1.5K ukuphinda okuthunyelwe, 845 izimpendulo, 198 amabhukumaka, 61 ukwabelana. Isilinganiso semphendulo nokuthandwa: 11.7% — sesingene kakhulu endaweni yengxoxo ebukhoma. Abalandeli abaqinisekisiwe: 359. Ulandelayo: 11.
launch_week.a_real_time_3d_agent_runtime_on: I-runtime yomenzeli we-3D yesikhathi sangempela ku-Three.js + glTF. Ingxoxo yabahlinzeki abaningi (Claude, GPT, Groq, OpenRouter) enemizwa eqhutshwa umuzwa. Ukuhlanganiswa kwesikhwama se-Solana sendabuko. Amakhono okuhweba e-Pump.fun njengamathuluzi omenzeli. Kuhlehliswe ubunjiniyela be-sdk yonke ye-pump-fun-agent-payments — I-Anchor IDL, ama-PDA, ukuhlaziya umcimbi, ungqimba lwe-x402 — manje umthombo ohlelekayo. I-Solana vanity grinder. Umsayini-kanye wokudala uhlamvu lwemali lwe-Pump.fun. Okuphakelayo okubukhoma kwe-pump.fun.
launch_week.anthropic_claude_openai_gpt_groq_openrou: I-Anthropic (Claude), i-OpenAI (GPT), i-Groq, i-OpenRouter — konke ngemuva kwesixhumi esibonakalayo sengxoxo esisodwa ngokusakaza bukhoma ngesikhathi sangempela nge-Server-Sent Events. Umenzi ufunda umuzwa womsebenzisi futhi usabela ngemizwa + ukugqwayiza. Izingcingo zomsebenzi, ukusetshenziswa kwethuluzi le-MCP, izinto zobuciko. Umthombo ovulekile ongu-100%.
launch_week.april_29_2026_nichxbt_posted_three_ws: Ephreli 29, 2026. @nichxbt wathumela three.ws — inkundla yomthombo ovulekile yama-ejenti e-AI e-3D akhulumayo, akhumbulayo, aphethe izikhwama zemali, futhi akhiqize ku-chain. Ukubukwa okungu-135,000 emahoreni okuqala angu-24. Ngalolo suku: iphakheji ye-npm isebenza, ifakwe ohlwini ku-Registry ka-Anthropic MCP, ifakwe ohlwini ku-x402scan njenge-endpoint ekhokhelwayo, amakhono okuhweba e-Pump.fun omdabu athunyelwe, ijenereyitha yekheli le-vanity Solana isetshenzisiwe, idemo ye-ejenti yezwi + X Spaces.
launch_week.asymmetric_posture_is_a_signal_following: Ukuma okungalingani kuyisignali. Kulandelwa abangu-11. Kulandela abangu-3,675. Izinombolo zithi: singabashicileli, hhayi ipulazi lokulandela emuva. Abalandeli abaqinisekisiwe (359, ~10%) bathambekele kubasebenzisi abanamandla — ngqo iqembu elikhokhelayo, elakhelayo, nelikhulisa lokho esikuthumelayo ngokulandelayo.
launch_week.beyond_the_analytics_dashboard_three_ws_: Ngaphezu kwedeshibhodi yezibalo, three.ws yafika ezinkombandleleni, ezirejistini, nasezinkundleni ezibaluleke kakhulu kwithuluzi lonjiniyela lomthombo ovulekile.
launch_week.cloud_infra_googlecloud_web3_startups_pr: I-Cloud + ingqalasizinda: @GoogleCloud (uhlelo lwe-Web3 Startups), @alibaba_cloud (ukufakwa ohlwini lwe-Marketplace). Ukushintshanisa: @Coinbase + @CoinbaseWallet, @Bybit_Official, @JupiterExchange, @CoinGecko, @CoinMarketCap, Investing.com.
launch_week.copy_pasteable_version_below_every_metri: Inguqulo ekopishwayo-namathiswayo ngezansi — yonke imethrikhi ihlelwe kahle, yakhelwe ukuthunyelwa ngqo.
launch_week.cross_pollinated_authors_compound_the_we: Ababhali abaxubene bayahlanganisa. Okuthunyelwe okukhulu komuntu ngamunye kwaleli sonto (ukubukwa okungu-135K) kwavela ku-@nichxbt, hhayi ku-@trythreews. I-RT kaMeyi 7 evela ku-@zhusu (ukubukwa okungu-50K) yazuza ngomsebenzi, hhayi ngegama lomkhiqizo. Sebenzisa kokubili — izwi lomsunguli lokulandisa, umkhiqizo wezimemezelo ze-ecosystem.
launch_week.drag_and_drop_glb_viewer_with_pbr: Isibukeli se-GLB se-Drag-and-drop ngokunikezwa kwe-PBR, izindawo ze-IBL, ukucubungula ngemuva (i-bloom, i-tone mapping, i-FXAA). I-Studio three.ws yokuhlela i-avatar nokugqwayiza. Idemo esebenzisanayo yokugqwayiza okungu-32. Ukungasebenzi okwenziwe ngendlela, ukuvumelanisa izindebe, imizwa eqhutshwa umuzwa. Ukufaka umugqa owodwa nge-web component <agent-3d>.
launch_week.each_name_below_was_earned_in_the: Igama ngalinye elingezansi lazuzwa ngesonto elifanayo. Isixhumanisi ngasinye siwuhlu lomphakathi noma isimemezelo.
launch_week.elevenlabs_edge_tts_for_agent_voice_demo: I-ElevenLabs + I-Edge TTS yezwi le-agent. Idemo ye-agent ejoyina ngokuzenzakalela i-X Space ebukhoma, icela ukukhuluma, ilalele, bese iphendula. Ukubhalisa kwe-WebSocket event — inkokhelo yamukelwe → i-animation yokugubha; ukuthenga kabusha kuqala → i-agent isabela bukhoma; ukuhoxiswa → kubhalwe ku-identity timeline.
launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: Ukuhlanganisa izwi le-ElevenLabs kusuka kumasekhondi angu-3-10 enkulumo, ukukhipha ubuntu kusuka kwinhlolokhono emfushane yokuqala, nokufaka imemori evunyelwe kusuka kuma-akhawunti axhunyiwe — i-avatar ayisona nje wena, i-agent enza njengawe.
launch_week.erc_8004_agent_registration_on_evm_solan: Ukubhaliswa kwe-agent ye-ERC-8004 ku-EVM. launch_week.three_live_paid_endpoints_solana_token_t: Ama-endpoint amathathu abukhoma akhokhelwayo: /api/x402/mint-to-mesh (ithokheni ye-Solana → i-avatar ye-3D enetimu, $0.01 USDC), /api/x402/model-check (i-validator ekhokhelwayo glTF), /api/insights/revenue-vision (isu le-agent elinikwe amandla yi-Claude, $0.001 USDC). launch_week.three_live_x402_paid_endpoints_mint_to: Ama-endpoint amathathu abukhoma akhokhelwayo x402 — mint-to-mesh, model-check, revenue-vision — atholakala ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-/.well-known/x402.json. Ukuqinisekiswa kusezingeni lomugqa nge-Khronos gltf-validator. I-Lip-sync analyser ishayela ama-morphs omlomo ngezwi le-ejenti ngesikhathi sangempela. Ukulayisha ngokudonsa nokulahla, i-OrbitControls enokuzungeza okuzenzakalelayo okungalungiseka, kanye ne-dat.GUI yesikhathi sangempela yokulungisa bukhoma.

Okuthunyelwe okukhulu okukodwa (Solana Hackathon, ukubukwa okungu-42K, ama-RT angu-621) kwashaya ngoMgqibelo. I-Crypto X ivukile lapho iningi lamaqembu okumaketha lingekho. Thumela ngempelasonto.

legal_privacy.if_you_are_a_california_resident_the: Uma ungumhlali waseCalifornia: izigaba zolwazi lomuntu siqu esiluqoqayo zibalwe kuSigaba 1, izinhloso kuSigaba 2, nabamukeli kuSigaba 4. legal_privacy.if_you_connect_a_home_assistant_instance: Uma uhlanganisa isiqinisekiso se-Home Assistant, itokheni yokungena onika yona ingumthelela wendlu emphakathini. Siyayifihla phansi kwezinto ezifanayo esisebenzisayo ukugcina ama-khi womthwalo, asiyibonisi futhi, kwaye siyayisusa ngokushesha uma uqeda ukuhlanganisa indlu. Imisebenzi eyivula indlu (ukuvula, ukuvula, ukukhipha) kuyadingeka ukuthi kube khona ukwamukela okusobala komuntu, okungenziwa yimodeli ye-AI, ngaphambi kokuthi ulinikeze imvume emele kanye nento eyodwa.
legal_privacy.if_you_use_the_selfie_flow_the_photos_yo: Uma usebenzisa indlela yeselfie, izithombe ozithola (isithombe esisodwa esibuka phambili kanye nezithombe ezimbili ezingakhethiwe zokubuka ngasecaleni) zifakwa kwisesebenzi sethu sokwakha kabusha kanye nezisetyenziswa ukwakha i-3D avatar yakho. Zihlala nezirekodi zokuzalwa ukuze isiphumo singazaliswa kabusha, singalungiswa kabusha kanye nokubekwa kabusha ukuze kutholakale ubuchwepheshe, futhi azibonakala kuphela ekhawunti yakho. Zishiywe uma ushiyayo isiphumo noma ikhawunti yakho, ngokubhekene nezikhathi zokugcina ezisigatsheni 5. Asizisebenzisi ukuzalisa imodeli, asizabelani nababhalisi abangabazali, futhi asiziquketheli noma sizigcine ithempleyithi yobuso noma yinye into eyobayometriki kuyo. legal_privacy.legal_acceptance_records_your_acceptance: Amarekhodi okwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni (ukwamukela kwakho Imigomo Yesevisi kanye Nokudalulwa Kobungozi) agcinwa impilo yonke ye-akhawunti yakho futhi ngemuva kwalokho isikhathi eside njengoba kudingeka ukusungula noma ukuvikela izimangalo zomthetho. legal_privacy.wallet_address_email_optional_username_d: Ikheli lesikhwama semali, i-imeyili (ongayifaka), igama lomsebenzisi, igama elibonakalayo
legal_privacy.wallet_addresses_and_on_chain_registrati: Amakheli esikhwama semali kanye nokubhaliswa okuse-chain kuyinto esobala ngenxa yobuchwepheshe be-blockchain. Sifaka ohlwini idatha esobala etholakala ku-chain (ERC-8004 izigameko, i-Metaplex metadata) ukuze kunike amandla uhla lwemibhalo lwama-agent. Asidali amaphrofayili ahlanganisa ubunikazi obuse-chain nolwazi lomuntu siqu olungaphandle kwe-chain ngaphezu kwalokho okuhlinzeka ngokusobala. Qaphela ukuthi noma yini ebhalwe ku-blockchain esobala ihlala njalo futhi ingaphandle kokulawula kwethu; asikwazi ukuyisusa.
legal_privacy.we_do_not_collect_advertising_identifier: Asiwaqoqi nakancane ama-identifier okukhangisa, sisebenzise ama-pixel okulandelela ezinkampani zangaphandle, noma sithengise idatha yomuntu siqu kunoma iyiphi inkampani yangaphandle.
legal_privacy.we_do_not_sell_your_personal_data: Asithengisi idatha yakho yomuntu siqu, futhi asiyabelani ngayo ukuze kusetshenziswe ukukhangisa okusekelwe ekuziphatheni okungaphandle komongo. Sabelana ngolwazi kuphela no:
legal_privacy.we_do_not_store_the_names_of: Asigcini amagama ezindlu zakho, izixhobo noma izinto ezibonakalayo, futhi asigcini imiphumela yazo. Akukho rekodi yezilayithi ezivuliweyo, noma nini. Umgwaqo wezindlu ufundwa ngokuziphakamisa kwakho kwaye ugciniwe ekhumbulweni kuphela ngesikhathi ukuhlanganisa kuvuliwe. Imvumo yezwi ayigciniwe kuye.
legal_privacy.we_may_update_this_privacy_policy_we: Singase sibuyekeze le Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo. Sizokwazisa ngezinguquko ezibalulekile nge-imeyili noma ngesaziso esibonakalayo kuSevisi. Usuku oluthi "Olusebenzayo" kanye nenguqulo phezulu kubonisa ukubuyekezwa kwakamuva.
legal_privacy.we_protect_your_data_with_industry_stand: Sivikela idatha yakho ngezinyathelo ezijwayelekile embonini: I-TLS ekudlulisweni, isitoreji esibethelwe, ama-token eseshini afakwe i-hash kanye namakheli e-IP, iziqinisekiso ezinesilinganiso, kanye nokungena kwamalogi okuhlola. Ayikho isistimu ephephe ngokuphelele; uma sithola ngokuphulwa okuthinta idatha yakho yomuntu siqu sizokwazisa wena kanye, lapho kudingeka, abalawuli ngaphandle kokulibala okungadingekile nangaphakathi kwezikhathi umthetho osebenzayo ozidingayo (ngokwesibonelo, amahora angama-72 kubaphathi ababhekele ngaphansi kwe-GDPR).
legal_privacy.we_retain_your_account_data_for_as: Sigcina idatha ye-akhawunti yakho inqobo nje uma i-akhawunti yakho isebenza. Ama-akhawunti asusiwe asuswa kancane izinsuku ezingama-30 (ukuze abuyiselwe), bese esuswa unomphela. Ama-token eseshini aphelelwa yisikhathi ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingama-30. Ama-nonce aphelelwa yisikhathi ngemuva kwemizuzu emi-5 bese esuswa phakathi kwamahora angama-24.
legal_privacy.we_will_respond_within_30_days_or: Sizophendula zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30 (noma ngokushesha uma umthetho udinga). legal_risk.nothing_on_the_service_including_scores_: Akukho lutho ku-Service — okuhlanganisa izikolo, izimpawu, izilinganiso zokuqiniseka, amasu, amabhodi abaholi, ukuziphatha kwe-ejenti, imibhalo, noma yikuphi okuqukethwe okukhiqizwe — kuyiseluleko sezezimali, sokutshala imali, sezomthetho, sokubalwa kwezimali, noma sentela, noma isincomo sokuthenga, ukuthengisa, noma ukubamba noma iyiphi impahla. legal_risk.plain_summary_three_ws_is_experimental_s: Isifinyezo esilula: three.ws isofthiwe yokuhlola — umzamo wokuqamba izinto ezintsha, hhayi umkhiqizo wezezimali. legal_risk.protocol_risk_smart_contracts_bonding_cu: Ubungozi bephrothokholi. Izinkontileka ezihlakaniphile, ama-bonding curves, ama-DEX routers, amabhuloho, kanye nama-protocol okukhokha i-Service ehlangana nawo angaba nobuthakathaka noma enze ngokungalindelekile.

legal_risk.the_agent_can_execute_trades_payments_an: I-ejenti ingakwazi ukwenza ukuhweba, izinkokhelo, nokudlulisa egameni lakho ngaphandle kokukubuza futhi, ngaphakathi kwemingcele oyimisayo, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kuhlanganise nalapho ungekho.
legal_risk.the_service_asks_you_to_accept_this: I-Service ikucela ukuthi wamukele lesi Sitatimende kanye ngesiphequluli ngasinye ngaphambi kwesenzo sakho sokuqala semali yangempela. Ukwamukela kwakho kuyagcinwa ngenguqulo futhi kuyarekhodwa, kuhlanganise nosuku nesici obusisebenzisa. Uma lesi Sitatimende siguquka kakhulu, inombolo yenguqulo iyakhula futhi uzocelwa ukuthi usamukele futhi ngaphambi kwesenzo sakho esilandelayo semali yangempela. Ukwenqaba kukugcina ku-platform — awukwazi nje ukwenza izenzo zemali yangempela uze wamukele.
legal_risk.the_service_is_an_ongoing_experiment_in: I-Service iwumzamo oqhubekayo wesofthiwe ye-agentic ne-on-chain. Inikezwa "njengoba injalo" futhi "njengoba itholakala", ngaphandle kweziqinisekiso zanoma yiluphi uhlobo, ezishiwo noma ezisuselwe. Izici zingase zingapheleli, zingashintsha noma zinyamalale ngaphandle kwesaziso, futhi zingaba namaphutha. Iphutha, ukuphazamiseka, ukwehluleka kwenethiweki, ukuhlelwa kabusha kwe-chain, iphutha le-RPC, noma ukwehluleka kokuncika komuntu wesithathu kungabangela ukuthi ukuthengiselana kuhluleke, kwenziwe ngokungalindelekile, noma kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwemali.

legal_tos.the_service_generates_3d_models_images_t: Le Nkonzo ikhiqiza amamodeli e-3D, izithombe, umbhalo, nokunye okuqukethwe isebenzisa izinhlelo zokufunda ngomshini. legal_tos.the_service_interoperates_with_third_par: Isevisi isebenzisana nabantu besithathu esingabaphethe, okuhlanganisa amanethiwekhi e-blockchain, abahlinzeki bama-wallet, abasizi bezinkokhelo, abahlinzeki bemodeli ye-AI, nemithombo yedatha. materialize.lede: Khetha noma yimuphi umodeli, lokhu kukala ukuthi ngempela ungaphrinta yini, kulungisa uma kungenzeki, kukhombisa ku-isikali sangempela edeskini lakho ku-AR, futhi kubeka intengo yento yangempela. Kukhokhelwa ku-USDC ku-Solana, kuphrintwa kumishini yangempela, kuthunyelwa emnyango wakho.
materialize.meta_desc: Thatha noma iyiphi three.ws ukudalwa ukusuka kumodeli ejikijwayo kuya ekuphrinteni okwenziwe ngempela. Ukuhlaziywa kokuphrintwa okuphila, ukuboniswa kwe-AR ngosayizi weqiniso ku-deski yakho, intengo ehlukanisiwe, kanye ne-USDC ukukhokha ku-Solana.
materialize.note_agents_p: I-pipeline efanayo iboniswa kuma-agent azimele ku-x402, ngakho imodeli i-agent esanda kuyakha ingakhiqizwa ngaphandle komuntu. Bheka isikhombimsebenzisi se-API.
materialize.note_price_p: Wonke umfanekiso uvela kummesh uqobo: umhlaziyi ubala ivolumu yeqiniso ye-solid yemodeli elungisiwe, kanti intengo iyona volumu ngempahla oyikhethile. Akukho okucatshangwa kusukela ebhokisini elilinganiselwe.
materialize.note_usdc_p: Ayikho i-card processor. Ukhokha inani eliqondile elishiwo ku-USDC ku-Solana, i-oda ivulwa ngokumelene nesikhumbuzo esisayiniwe, kanti intengo ayinakushintsha phakathi kwesikhumbuzo nentela.

motion.a_motion_is_a_handful_of_beats: Ukunyakaza kuyisixuku se-beats: lapho umzimba ukhona ngesikhathi esisodwa, isikhathi esithathwa ukufika lapho, nokuthi isikhathi esingakanani sime. Uma usuhlanganisa okuthile, i-beat ngayinye ibonakala lapha futhi ungayiphonsa kuyo.
motion.an_arm_is_not_two_bones_on: Ingalo ayiyona amathambo amabili esikhwameni esinqunyiwe. I-clavicle igijima ibheke endaweni ekude, efanele amacentimitha ayishumi kuya kweyishumi nanhlanu, futhi iningi lokwenza ukufinyelela kubonakale njengokuthi umzimba wonke ufika kunokuba ingalo ihlisiwe.
motion.ankles_are_placed_in_world_space_against: Izinyawo zibekwe endaweni yomhlaba phansi. I-hips zikhululekile ukuwa, ukugoba nokujika, futhi imilenze iyayithola nge-inverse kinematics, okuyinto eyenzeka empeleni emzimbeni futhi yenza ukuthi ukuhamba lapha kubonakale njengokuhamba.
motion.describe_a_movement_in_plain_language_kn: Chaza ukuhamba ngolimi oluqondile. Ukuhamba okwaziwayo kuphendula ngokushesha; noma yini enye ibhalwa yimojuli yolimi ibe ifomethi ye-score efanayo.
motion.every_other_way_to_get_a_new: Noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuthola ukuhamba okusha idinga idatha ongenayo: isigaba sokubamba, umtapo wezithombe ogunyaziwe, noma imodeli yokusabalalisa eqeqeshwe kuyo. Lokhu kudinga umusho, ngoba umzimba womuntu uyinkinga ye-kinematics esixazululiwe uma othile ebhala phansi ukuthi kufanele ube kuphi futhi nini.
motion.is_the_same_compiler_this_page_runs: npm i @three-ws/motion iyisikhangiso esifanayo leli khasi lisebenza, ngaphandle kwezidingo futhi ngaphandle komdali. Funda imibhalo noma uthinte i-API ngqo.
motion.meta_description: Chaza ukuhamba ngolimi oluqondile bese ubona noma iyiphi i-avatar ye-3D iyikhipha. Akukho ukubamba ukuhamba, akukho imithwalo yemodeli: umsolwa we-kinematics ufunda i-Motion Score futhi ukhiqiza i-clip ye-animation yangempela ongayihlanza, uyihlele nge-beat ngayinye, futhi uyithumele njenge GLB.

motion.no_motion_capture_no_model_weights_nothi: Akukho ukubamba ukuhamba, akukho imithwalo yemodeli, akukho okukhishwayo. Chaza ukuhamba futhi umsolwa we-kinematics uzobala ukujika kwejoints kuzo zonke izithombe: izinyawo phansi, isisindo phezu kwazo, ama-shoulders enza lokho ama-shoulders akwenza. Hlanza, hlela noma iyiphi i-beat, futhi uthumele i-clip edlalayo kunoma iyiphi i-rig ye-humanoid.
motion.reverse_any_two_of_these_and_the: Phinda noma yiziphi ezimbili zalezizinto, umphumela uzoba nephutha elincane ngendlela engalungiseki phansi. Xazulula izandla ngaphambi komzimba, futhi yonke imisebenzi ibekwe lapho isifuba sasikhona.

motion.the_centre_of_mass_is_a_mass: Isikhungo somthwalo siyisamba esisuselwa emithonjeni ethwala umthwalo womzimba, futhi izinqe zishintsha kuze kube umthwalo uhlele phezu kwezinyawo ezithwala umthwalo. Phakamisa unyawo olulodwa, umzimba ushintsha phezu kolunye ngokwakho.
motion.the_clip_plays_on_any_humanoid_rig: Ikliphu idlalwa kunoma iyiphi i-humanoid rig nge-one-tag embed kanye ne-retargeter, ehlela amagama ezitho ze-Mixamo, Avaturn, VRM, Unreal kanye ne-Daz kumsetho ofanayo.
motion.the_intermediate_format_is_anatomy_and_t: Ifomethi ephakathi iyisakhiwo somzimba nesikhathi: isimo: "crouch", izandla.zakwesokudla: "chin", ukubheka: "aside". Akukho magama ezitho, akukho ama-quaternions. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukukubhala ngemuva kwemodeli yolimi, ukufundeka ku-diff, nokuhlelwa ngesandla ebhokisini elingaphezulu.
motion.the_order_each_beat_is_solved_in: Uhlelo lokuthi i-beat ngayinye ixazululwa kanjani
motion.the_same_score_compiles_to_the_same: Isikhumbuzo esifanayo sihlanganiswa sibe yikliphu efanayo, byte nganye, kuze kube phakade. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi isenzo sikwazi ukugcinwa emaphethelweni, sitholakale ekuhloleni, futhi sibe ne-pinned ku-regression test.
motion.type_a_movement_above_or_pick_one: Thayipha isenzo ngenhla, noma ukhethe esinye sezibonelo.
motion.weight_time_and_flow_pick_the_easing: Umthwalo, isikhathi nokuhamba kukhetha i-easing curve, kukala ukuhamba, futhi kusethe ukuthi ubude bokuqala bukhona ngaphambi kokuthi buphume. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi lezi zimo ezintathu zifundeke njenge-wave, i-swat, noma i-salute.

news_aws_agentic_economy_three_ws.aws_published_a_builder_s_guide_to: I-AWS yabhalela incwadi yomhleli ngalekonomi ye-agentic, umzekelo oseyenziwe ngaphakathi uyilo three.ws stack. news_aws_agentic_economy_three_ws.aws_publishes_the_agentic_economy_is_her: I-AWS Ishicilela "I-Agentic Economy Is Here", Incwadi Yomhleli Ebekwe three.ws Stack

Kepha iyahamba ngokuhle ngokwemisebenzi eyenza konke lokhu kube khona.

news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.embedding_a_persistent_on_chain_3d_agent: Ukushumeka i-agent ye-3D eqhubekayo, esekelwe ku-blockchain kunoma iyiphi ipulatifomu kufanele kube lula njengokushumeka ividiyo ye-YouTube. Umgomo walokho kusabalalisa okungenazinkinga: ukungenisa izigidi zabantu ezilandelayo ku-AI ebonakalayo ngaphandle kokucela noma ubani ukuthi alande noma yini.

Le nkundla isivele isebenza ku-Alibaba Cloud Marketplace futhi ibhalwe ku-BNB Chain Dappbay, i-Model Context Protocol Registry, naku-x402scan — i-AWS ijoyina isu lokusabalalisa lamafu amaningi elihleliwe.

news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_the_first_fully_on: three.ws iyinkundla yokuqala ye-ejenti ye-AI e-3D esebenza ngokugcwele ku-chain ku-AWS Partner Network. news_text_to_3d_is_live.forge_is_live_on_three_ws_type: Forge is live on three.ws. nvidia_index.the_field_report_a_memory_backed_that: Umbiko wensimu: i-/tmp esekelwe yimemori e-SIGKILLs isibonelo esingu-32 GiB phakathi nokulayisha, ama-cu124 wheels angenazo izinhlamvu ze-sm_120, kanye ne-quota yesifunda eyashintsha ukukhetha kwethu kwe-GPU.
nvidia_index.twelve_cloud_run_gpu_services_each_a: Izinsizakalo ze-Cloud Run GPU eziyishumi nambili, ngasinye singumsebenzi osonga imodeli eyodwa, zishintsha ngokuzenzakalela ngendlela ngayinye. Eziyishumi nanye ku-nvidia-l4, eyodwa ku-nvidia-rtx-pro-6000 (Blackwell). Lena yindawo lapho kuhlala khona izindlela zokungokoqobo ezikhokhelwayo, nalapho kwenziwa khona izinto ze-PBR, ukulungisa, nenyakazo.
nvidia_index.two_tutorials_you_can_follow_end_to: Izifundo ezimbili ongazilandela kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni, kanye nezicucu ezimbili ezijulile zokuthi isitaki sakhiwe kanjani.
nvidia_index.type_a_sentence_get_a_textured_3d: Thayipha umusho, uthole imodeli ye-3D ene-texture. Leyo ndlela isebenza kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni ku-NVIDIA silicon, futhi ku-three.ws indlela yokuqala yayo yamahhala, engenakhiye, futhi evulekile. Leli khasi imephu eqotho yokuthi kanjani: ukuthi yimaphi amamodeli aphethwe yi-NVIDIA enza ini, ukuthi yimaphi ama-GPU esiwasebenzisa thina, nokuthi yini esiyifundile ngokuwafaka ekukhiqizeni.
nvidia_index.what_we_run_ourselves_and_on_which: Esikusebenzisayo thina, nokuthi kusiphi ikhadi. Ulayini ngamunye uyisevisi ehlukile ye-Cloud Run enenqubomgomo yayo yokukala, ngakho-ke umsebenzi wokwakha okuhamba kancane awulokothi ulinde ngemuva komsebenzi wokuhlanganisa.

objects.a_curated_library_of_cc0_3d_objects: Umtapo wolwazi ohlungiwe wezinto ze-CC0 3D kanye nezinsiza — ifenisha, izibani, izinto zikagesi, iziqukathi, umhlobiso. Yonke into iyindawo yomphakathi: imahhala ukusetshenziswa kwezentengiselwano, akukho ukubalula okudingekayo. Buka kuqala noma iyiphi into bukhoma kusiphequluli sakho, noma landa i-GLB bese uyisebenzisa noma kuphi.
objects.free_3d_props_ready_to_drop_into: Izinsiza ze-3D zamahhala, ezilungele ukufakwa kunoma iyiphi indawo
objects.meta_description: Amakhulu ezinto ze-CC0 3D zamahhala kanye nezinsiza — ifenisha, izibani, izinto zikagesi, iziqukathi, umhlobiso. Buka kuqala noma iyiphi bukhoma, noma landa i-GLB ukuze uyisebenzise noma kuphi. Akukho ukubalula okudingekayo.
objects.meta_og_description: Izinto ze-3D ze-CC0 mahhala, zivamele ukufakwa noma yisiphi isikhungo. Bheka ngokuphelele noma hlola GLB, akudingeki ukuthi ubhale umthombo.
objects.meta_twitter_description: Izinsiza ze-CC0 3D zamahhala, ezilungele ukufakwa kunoma iyiphi indawo.
objects.something_went_wrong_loading_the_object_: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle ngenkathi kulayishwa umtapo wolwazi wezinto.
objects.the_cc0_object_library_is_being_staged: Umtapo wolwazi wezinto ze-CC0 uyafakwa. Buyela emuva ngomzuzwana, noma khiqiza owakho kusuka kumbhalo.

offline.three_ws_needs_a_connection_to_load: three.ws idinga uxhumano ukuze ilayishe ama-agent e-3D futhi signing ne-Seed Vault. Akukho okulahlekile: iseshini yakho namakhi ayahlala kudivayisi.
