onchain_index.paste_a_solana_transaction_if_it_contain: Namathisela i-Solana ukuthengiselana. Uma iqukethe ifayela noma umyalezo ku-Memo, sizokukhombisa lapha ngaphandle kokukopisha i-data URI engacacile.
onchain_index.this_viewer_reads_public_signed_transact: Lo mbonisi ufunda idatha yokuthengiselana esayiniwe, yomphakathi ngqo kwi-Solana. Thatha ukunakekela amafayela ongawazi ngendlela efanayo oyithatha kuyo nayiphi na ukulanda ku-inthanethi.

openai_index.add_a_humanoid_skeleton_to_an_existing: Faka ithambo lomuntu ku-GLB elikhona ukuze likwazi ukwenziwa izithombe ezinyakazayo.
openai_index.add_it_as_a_connector_with_no: Yengeze njengesixhumi esingenakho ukuqinisekiswa. Iyaphendula zonke izicelo ngesikhathi esifanayo nge-POST.
openai_index.an_mcp_connector_for_chatgpt_with_eleven: Ikhonekhitha ka-MCP ye-ChatGPT enezinto ezishumi nanye ezimahhala. Imiphumela ibonakala e-widget-ini ye-model-viewer eyehambisana phakathi kwinkulumo, ne-CSP yewidget eyachazwa ukuze imodeli izithole e-ChatGPT eqinile.
openai_index.an_open_cc0_response_shape_for_returning: Ifomu lokuphendula elivulekile, le-CC0 lokubuyisa isimo se-3D esibukhoma njengomphumela wethuluzi lokuqala: isimo GLB, ikhamera, indawo, izithombe ezinyakazayo, ukudluliswa kwe-AR. Noma yimuphi iklayenti lingayiveza, hhayi elakithi kuphela.
openai_index.art_directed_mesh_generation_from_text_o: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-mesh okuqondiswa ubuciko kusuka kumbhalo noma esithombeni.
openai_index.assistants_are_excellent_at_text_and_ima: Abasizi bahamba phambili embhalweni nasezithombeni, kodwa abakaze basho lutho ezinhlangothini ezintathu. Imodeli ongayizungezisa, uyihlele, uyenze iphile, futhi uyibeke egumbini lakho lokuphumula iyimpendulo ehlukile kunokuba isithombe sayo. I-three.ws ikhona ukuze yenze lolo hlobo lwempendulo lube olujwayelekile: isakhiwo sephrothokholi esivulekile, isixhumi samahhala, kanye ne-stack yomthombo ovulekile ngaphansi kwakho konke. Ukuqokwa njengoMlingani Okhethiwe we-OpenAI kuyisivumelwano sokwakha okwengeziwe ngakho.
openai_index.collect_a_generation_that_outran_its_too: Qoqa isizukulwane esidlule ucingo lwaso lwethuluzi. Okufundeka kuphela, futhi akulokothi kudle isabelo sokukhiqiza.
openai_index.every_generated_model_carries_a_one_tap: Yonke imodeli ekhiqiziwe iphethe isixhumanisi se-AR sokuthinta kanye. I-iOS ithola i-Quick Look USDZ eguqulwa ngokushesha, i-Android ithola inhloso ye-Scene Viewer, ideskithophu ithola isibukeli se-WebGL.
openai_index.four_live_surfaces_all_free_and_keyless: Izindawo ezine ezibukhoma, zonke zimahhala futhi azidingi ukhiye. Yonke yazo ingumthombo ovulekile.
openai_index.generate_a_3d_avatar_from_a_prompt: Khiqiza i-avatar ye-3D kusuka kumbhalo wokuyala noma esithombeni esiyireferensi.
openai_index.generate_a_textured_3d_model_from_a: Khiqiza imodeli ye-3D enokuthungwa kusuka kumbhalo wokuyala. Ibuyisa i-GLB.
openai_index.iterate_by_describing_a_change_make_it: Phinda wenze ngokuchaza ushintsho ("yenze ibe nensimbi"), ngomlando wenguqulo ongabuyiselwa emuva.
openai_index.make_the_body_speak_a_line_lip: Yenza umzimba ukhulume umugqa: ukuvumelanisa izindebe, ukubonakaliswa, kanye nokushukuma komzimba kuhlanganiswe ndawonye.
openai_index.meta_description: I-three.ws ingumlingani Okhethiwe we-OpenAI ku-OpenAI Partner Network. Xhuma iseva yamahhala ye-three.ws 3D Studio MCP ku-ChatGPT futhi uguqule umbhalo wokuyala ube imodeli ye-3D esebenzisanayo, ehlelekayo, elungele i-AR ngqo engxoxweni.
openai_index.meta_og_description: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D kwamahhala ngaphakathi kwe-ChatGPT: xhuma iseva ye-three.ws 3D Studio MCP futhi uthole imodeli esebenzisanayo ngqo, ehlelekayo, eyenziwe iphile, futhi engabekwa ku-AR.
openai_index.meta_twitter_description: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D kwamahhala ngaphakathi kwe-ChatGPT: xhuma iseva ye-three.ws 3D Studio MCP bese uthola imodeli esebenzisanayo ngaphakathi.
openai_index.none_no_key_no_account_no_wallet: Lutho. Ayikho ikhiyi, ayikho i-akhawunti, ayikho i-wallet.
openai_index.one_call_generate_the_mesh_and_rig: Isicelo esisodwa: khiqiza i-mesh bese uyihlanganisa, ngemuva kwesango elingumuntu.
openai_index.reload_a_persona_in_a_fresh_session: Layisha kabusha i-persona kuseshini entsha. I-id yikhono.
openai_index.render_any_public_glb_from_several_angle: Beka yonke GLB eyomphakathi ezinhlanganisela ezahlukene futhi ufunde ukuphinda ukuyibuka igeometri yayo, ukuze umsizi abone imodeli ngaphambi kokuyixhumanisa.
openai_index.six_generation_tools_a_collector_an_insp: Izinto ezintathu zokwakha, icollector ethatha imodeli eyathatha isikhathi esingaphezulu kwe-turn elinye, i-inspector eyabeka imodeli ephelele ukuze umsizi abone umsebenzi wayo, kunye nezinto ezintathu ze-persona ezinika umsizi umzimba ophilayo, ovumelana namaliphu. Zonke ezishumi nanye zimahhala, zonke zifakwe ngomphathi.
openai_index.the_same_free_lane_as_a_rest: Umzila wamahhala ofanayo njengendawo ye-REST Actions ye-GPT yangokwezifiso ye-"three.ws 3D Studio", enesango lokuphepha leminyaka engu-13+ nezimpendulo ezihlanzekile esitolo. Ihlanganisa izinhlelo ezingasekeli ukuxhuma.
openai_index.three_ws_has_been_named_an_openai: I-three.ws iqanjwe njenge-OpenAI Select Partner ngaphakathi kwe-OpenAI Partner Network. Isixhumi se-3D Studio samahhala senkundla siguqula umusho ube imodeli ye-3D esebenzisanayo, enokuthungwa, ehambisana ngaphakathi engxoxweni, bese iyihlanganisa, iyenze inyakaze, bese iyibeka ekamelweni lakho ku-AR. Ayikho ikhiyi, ayikho i-akhawunti, akukho mali.
openai_index.three_ws_is_an_independent_member_of: three.ws ilungu elizimele le-OpenAI Partner Network ezingeni le-Select. Leli khasi lichaza imikhiqizo ye-three.ws ehlangana nezinkundla ze-OpenAI; akuyona imikhiqizo ye-OpenAI futhi ayigunyazwanga yi-OpenAI ngaphezu kwesikhundla sobambiswano esibonisiwe. I-OpenAI, i-ChatGPT, kanye nebheji le-OpenAI Partner Network yizimpawu zokuthengisa ze-OpenAI. Funda kabanzi ngenethiwekhi ku-openai.com/business/partners.
openai_index.turn_a_generated_avatar_into_a_persisten: Guqula i-avatar ekhiqiziwe ibe umzimba ohlala njalo, onegama olayisha kabusha nge-id.

oracle.best_ath_multiple_among_coin_title: I-ATH ephindwe kabili ehamba phambili phakathi kwezinhlamvu zemali i-Oracle eyazibiza ngempela (izinga le-Lean noma ngaphezulu) — chofoza ukuze ubone igalari yobufakazi.
oracle.best_ath_view_proof: I-ATH ehamba phambili× →—buka ubufakazi
oracle.call_win_rate: Izinga lokuwina kwezibikezelo →—
oracle.coins_at_strong_tier_right_n_title: Izinhlamvu zemali ezisezingeni le-Strong njengamanje — chofoza ukuze uhlunge okuphakelayo.
oracle.coins_oracle_actually_called_title: Izinhlamvu zemali i-Oracle eyazibiza ngempela — izinga le-Lean noma ngaphezulu.
oracle.coins_sitting_at_prime_tier_title: Izinhlamvu zemali ezisezingeni le-Prime njengamanje — chofoza ukuze uhlunge okuphakelayo.
oracle.coins_the_oracle_called_at_conviction_an: Izinhlamvu zemali i-Oracle eyazibiza ngokukholwa — nokuthi zaxazululeka kanjani. Ikhadi ngalinye libonisa amaphuzu ngesikhathi sokungena uma kuqhathaniswa nomphumela wangempela: ziphothuliwe, i-ATH ephindwe kabili, noma kokubili. Ubufakazi, hhayi izithembiso.
oracle.coins_whose_oracle_conviction_score_move: Izinhlamvu zemali amaphuzu azo okukholwa kwe-Oracle anyakaza kakhulu emahoreni angu-24 adlule — izinhlelo ezakha ngokushesha okukhulu nokuwa okubukhali kakhulu. Abanyukayo yizinhlelo ezithola inzuzo ngaphambi kokuba zifike ezingeni le-Prime; abehlayo yizimfundiso ezichithwa ngesikhathi sangempela.
oracle.distinct_agents_currently_ar_title: Ama-ejenti ahlukile ahlomile njengamanje ngokukholwa kwe-Oracle — chofoza ukuze ubone ibhodi labahamba phambili.
oracle.every_move_your_agent_makes_simulated_or: Konke ukunyakaza kwe-ejenti yakho — okulingisiwe noma okubukhoma — kufika lapha, bese kulinganiswa nomphumela. Lena yirekhodi lezinga lokuwina le-ejenti yakho.
oracle.every_oracle_armed_agent_action_in_real: Yonke isenzo se-ejenti ehlomile nge-Oracle ngesikhathi sangempela — ukuthi yini ethengwa yindawo yokuhweba ezimele, yini eyaholela ekuwineni, yini engazange. Izenzo ezilingisiwe nezibukhoma ndawonye.
oracle.every_scored_coin_as_a_sphere_in: Yonke imali eshayiwe amaphuzu njengebhola esikhaleni se-3D. Usayizi = amaphuzu okukholwa. Umbala = izinga. Hudula ukuze ujikeleze, skrola ukuze usondeze. Chofoza noma yiliphi ibhola ukuze uvule ukuhlaziya kwayo okugcwele kokukholwa.
oracle.every_scored_coin_including_title: Yonke imali eshayiwe amaphuzu, kuhlanganise ne-Buka/Gwema — umongo wemakethe, hhayi ubufakazi bobuhlakani.
oracle.every_wallet_oracle_has_judged_ranked_by: Yonke i-wallet i-Oracle eyayihlolile, ihlelwe ngomlando wayo wangempela — ukuthi ivame kangakanani ukuba umthengi wokuqala wezinhlamvu zemali ezaqhubeka zaphothula, uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthi ivame kangakanani ukuchitha ezintweni ezingasebenzi noma ukulahla abalandeli bayo. Lena yimvelaphi enika amandla amaphuzu okukholwa.
oracle.meta_description: I-Oracle ihlanganisa ukuthi ubani othengayo, ukuthi bathenga kanjani, ukuthi iyini imali, nokuthi ihamba kanjani kube isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka esibukhoma sawo wonke umkhankaso we-pump.fun — futhi ivumela i-ejenti yakho ye-3D AI ukuthi yenze izenzo ezinokuqiniseka okuphezulu. Uma sibuka idatha eningi, isikolo ngasinye siba bukhali kakhulu.
oracle.meta_og_description: Isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka ngomkhankaso ngamunye we-pump.fun, esihlanganiswe kusuka kudatha ephelele yesikhwama + yemali + yesakhiwo. Sibuke bukhoma. Hlomisa i-ejenti yakho ukuthi yenze ngakho.
oracle.meta_twitter_description: Isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka esibukhoma ngomkhankaso ngamunye, esihlanganiswe kusuka kudatha eningi kakhulu ku-pump.fun. Hlomisa i-ejenti yakho ukuthi yenze ngakho.
oracle.oracle_agents_ranked_by_their_real_convi: Ama-ejenti e-Oracle ahlungwe ngokusekelwe kumlando wawo wokuqiniseka kwangempela — ucingo ngalunye luhlolwe ngokuqhathaniswa neqiniso elingumgogodla. Kuboniswa kuphela ama-ejenti anemiphumela esixazululiwe. Bhalisa ukuze ukopishe abenza kahle kakhulu.
oracle.oracle_fuses_four_reads_on_every_pump: I-Oracle ihlanganisa ukufundwa okune kuwo wonke umkhankaso we-pump.fun — ubani othengayo (ubufakazi besikhwama esifakazelwe), ukuthi ithengwa kanjani (iqoqo vs. isakhiwo semvelo), ukuthi iyini (indaba yamasiko), futhi ukuthi ihamba kanjani — kube isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka esisobala esingu-0–100. Uma sibuka izinhlamvu zemali nezikhwama eziningi, isikolo ngasinye siba bukhali kakhulu. Bese uhlomisa i-ejenti yakho ye-3D ukuthi yenze izenzo ezidlula umkhawulo wakho. Funda imibhalo ↗
oracle.prime_now_filter_feed: Okuyinhloko manje →—hlunga okuphakelayo
oracle.proof_not_promises_every_conviction_verd: Ubufakazi, hhayi izithembiso. Isinqumo ngasinye sokuqiniseka sihlolwa ngokuqhathaniswa neqiniso elingumgogodla — ingabe imali yaphumelela, yawa, noma yabaleka? Silinganisa izinga lokunqoba elifezekile ngesigaba, sibonise ibhande lokuzethemba elingu-95% kunombolo ngayinye, futhi sidwebe ukulinganisa ukuze ubone ukuthi isikolo sihlunga ngempela izinhlamvu zemali ngamathuba. Inzuzo ibalulekile kuphela uma ukuqiniseka kunqoba ukuthenga okungaboni — futhi sikukhombisa ngisho nalapho kungaqhubeki.
oracle.share_of_resolved_lean_stron_title: Isabelo sezingcingo ze-Lean/Strong/Prime ezixazululiwe eziwine (eziphumelele, noma ≥2× ngaphandle kokukhohlisa) — chofoza ukuze ubone ukuhlaziya okuphelele kwe-edge
oracle.show_only_coins_on_your_watc_title: Bonisa izinhlamvu zemali kuphela ezisehlwini lakho lokubuka
oracle.strong_now_filter_feed: Iqinile manje →—hlunga okuphakelayo
oracle.your_agent_watches_the_live_conviction_s: I-agent yakho ibuka ukusakazwa kwesiqiniseko okubukhoma futhi yenza ngokushesha lapho uhlamvu lwemali ludlula umkhawulo wakho — ithenga isikhundla esincane kusuka ku-wallet yayo ye-custodial Solana. Setha imithetho ekhasini lokusetha eligcwele; nansi ukucushwa kwayo kwamanje ngokubuka nje.

oracle-lab.ladder_h: Ingabe isigaba ngasinye sithola lokho esikukhulumayo
oracle-lab.ladder_sub: Umugqa wesikhumbuzo awuyona iphesenti: 86 ikhuluma ngethuba le-45%, hhayi le-86%. I-rung ngalinye iyisithembiso esivulekile mayelana nezikhathi ezilinganisiwe, ngakho nansi isithembiso eduze kokulinganiswa, kumakhankaso imodeli engakaze ibone. Imodeli enebhendi ephezulu eyeka ukuhamba kwayo ibhujiswa ngemuva kokuphakanyiswa kunokuthunyelwa.
oracle-lab.lede: I-Oracle ibheka yonke pump.fun ukuqalwa kwemizuzu yayo yokuqala engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili futhi iyayilinganisa. Le khasi iyimishini eyenza isikhumbuzo, hhayi isifinyezo sayo: isisindo ngasinye sokubamba nembobo yokuhlola, izikhumbuzo ezibanjwe, umlando wemodeli yokufunda nokuthi kwenzekeni, kanye nomlando ophelele wenguqulo ngayinye eyazama, kuhlanganise nezo eziphikisiwe.
oracle-lab.lede2: Iyi-tabhula yokubheka, cishe 32KB. Landa futhi ungakwazi ukuphinda ulinganise noma yisiphi isikhumbuzo esake saphezulu, offline, ngaphandle kwesikhumbuzo.
oracle-lab.meta_desc: Imodeli yokukholwa ye-Oracle, ephelele: isisindo ngasinye sokubamba nembobo yokuhlola, izikhumbuzo ezibanjwe, umlando wenguqulo yokuthi imishini ifunde nini, kanye nomlingani ophilayo ongawuqhuba ngesandla.
oracle-lab.og_desc: Isisindo ngasinye, inani lesampula ngasinye, inguqulo ngayinye. Landa imodeli futhi uphinde ulinganise noma yisiphi isikhumbuzo offline.
oracle-lab.registry_sub: Imodeli ibuyekezwa njalo ezinsukwini eziyisithupha futhi ithatha kuphela uma idlula eyamanje ekubhaleni okukhishwe. Ababambiqhaza abaphikisiwe bahlala lapha, nangesizathu: i-registry ekhombisa kuphela abaphumelele iyirekhodi yokuhlola, hhayi umlando.
oracle-lab.scorer_sub: Yonke ukulawula ngezansi kudlulisela izisindo zangempela, ku-browser yakho. Akukho okuthunyelwa noma kuphi. Lokhu kuyisibalo esifanayo esilinganisa ukudla okuphila.
oracle-lab.scoring_sub: Imodeli ethile le platform esebenzisa lesi sikhathi, ngezibalo ezitholakele kumakhankaso akhululiwe emfundweni yayo.
oracle-lab.twitter_desc: Imodeli yokukholwa ye-Oracle ngokuphelele: isisindo sebhakede ngalinye kanye nenani lokukhishwa okukhululiwe ngemuva kwalo kanye nalokho okwenzekile, i-curve yokwethembeka ebambelekile yeziqondiso ngazinye, umlando wenguqulo yokulungiswa ngakunye kuhlanganise naleyo eyayiphikisiwe, kanye nomphumela ophilayo ophatha izisindo zangempela ku-browser yakho. Yilanda futhi uphinde uveze noma iyiphi inombolo offline.
oracle-lab.use_note: verify() iyona ebalulekile. Faka ukukhishwa okunezimpumelelo ozitholile uqobo futhi izokwenza kabusha i-AUC yethu, i-Brier score kanye ne-curve yokwethembeka kudatha yakho. oracle-lab.use_sub: Akukho okuncike kuyo. Node, Deno, Bun, Workers, ibhrawuza. Isicelo esisodwa, bese kuba izibalo zendawo kuze kube phakade.

oracle_docs.oracle_is_a_thin_fast_conviction_layer: I-Oracle iyisendlalelo esincane, esisheshayo sokukholisa phezu kobuchopho bedatha obugcwele pump.fun. Ayiphindi ifake iketango — ifunda amathebula obuchopho, yengeza izinto ezimbili ubuchopho obungenazo (ukulandisa kwamasiko kanye neluphu yesenzo), bese ivala iluphu ngokuphathelene nemiphumela.
oracle_docs.oracle_is_an_analytics_and_automation_to: I-Oracle iyithuluzi lokuhlaziya nokuzenzakalela. Izikolo zokukholisa, amasignali, nezenzo ze-ejenti ziwulwazi. Ukuhweba bukhoma kubeka engcupheni izimali zangempela; lingisa kuqala, beka umkhawulo oqinile, bese uphatha yonke inombolo njengokufaka okukodwa phakathi kokuningi.
oracle_docs.oracle_owns_five_tables_classified_story: I-Oracle inamathebula amahlanu: oracle_narrative (indaba ehlukanisiwe + ukusabalala), oracle_conviction (inqolobane yesinqumo esibukhoma, umugqa owodwa ngeminti), oracle_conviction_history (uchungechunge lwesikhathi lwesikolo, olubhalwa kuphela lapho kushintsha amaphuzu ≥3, ukugcinwa kwamahora angu-72), oracle_agent_watch (ukulungiselelwa kwe-ejenti ehlomile), kanye ne-oracle_watch_actions (incwadi yokubala yezenzo). Amakholomu agcwele ku-data model.
oracle_docs.oracle_owns_five_tables_the_verdict_cach: I-Oracle inamathebula amahlanu. Inqolobane yesinqumo iyinhliziyo; okunye umlando, ukulungiselelwa, kanye nencwadi yokubala yezenzo.
oracle_docs.oracle_reads_every_pump_fun_launch_the: I-Oracle ifunda konke ukuqaliswa kwe-pump.fun ngesikhathi kuvela bese iphendula umbuzo owodwa: ubungakanani bokukholisa obusekelwa ubufakazi obuseketangweni? Ihlanganisa ukufunda okune okuzimele — ubani othengayo, kanjani ukuqaliswa kuhlelwe, yini indaba ekugibelayo, kanye nokuthi kanjani ihamba — ibe yisikolo esisodwa esibonakalayo sika-0–100, bese ivumela i-ejenti yakho ye-3D ukuthi yenze izenzo ezidlula umkhawulo wakho. Lokhu yireferensi ephelele: ithesisi, izibalo eziqondile, idatha, ubufakazi, i-API, imikhawulo, nokuthi izoya kuphi ngokulandelayo.
oracle_docs.oracle_reads_from_a_separate_full_covera: I-Oracle ifunda kubuchopho bedatha obuhlukile obugcwele kunokuba ithinte iketango ngokwalo. Ubuchopho bufaka pump.fun futhi bugcina igrafu yodumo; I-Oracle ihlanganisa, ihlukanise, futhi ihlanganise. Ukuhlukaniswa yilokho okugcina ukushaya amagoli kungumsebenzi ohlanzekile, osheshayo.
oracle_docs.oracle_s_wager_is_that_a_transparent: Ukubheja kwe-Oracle ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa okubonakalayo, okulinganisiwe kwe-ubani / kanjani / yini / ukuhamba kudlula kokubili umuzwa wamathumbu nanoma yisiphi isikhombi esisodwa, ngoba izindlela zokwehluleka zizimele. Indaba enhle (YINI) ayikwazi ukusindisa ukuqaliswa lapho unjiniyela esedayise (KANJANI). Inqwaba yama-wallet emali ehlakaniphile (UBANI) ayisho lutho uma esenciphisa (futhi UBANI). Ukuhlanganisa ukufunda okuzimele kuqeda umsindo futhi kuveze ukuqaliswa okungavamile lapho yonke i-eksisi ivumelana.

oracle_docs.the_blob_on_each_conviction_row_is: I-blob yezinto kulayini ngamunye wokugwetshwa iyirekhodi eliphelele lokuhlola lokufaka okujwayelekile okukhiqize umphumela — isiqinisekiso sokukhiqizeka kabusha ngendlela yokugcina.
oracle_docs.the_cap_step_is_the_whole_philosophy: Isinyathelo somkhawulo siwumqondo wonke ngomugqa owodwa: izinsika ziyahlanganisa, kodwa uphawu olubomvu olunzima ku-HOW (noma umdali onobuqili ku-WHO) lubeka umkhawulo isilinganiso esingeke sewele. Uhlamvu lwemali olunesizinda esihle kakhulu kanye nefulegi lebhundle alulingani "kahle kakhulu" — lukhawulelwe ku-~46 futhi luwela ku-watch, lapho kufanele lube khona.
oracle_docs.the_coarse_band_a_score_falls_in: Ibhendi elikhulu umphumela owela kulo: okuyinhloko / okuqinile / okuncikile / okubukwayo / okugwenywayo.

oracle_docs.the_four_pillar_scores_collapse_into_one: Imiphumela yezinsika ezine ihlangana ibe inombolo eyodwa ngesilinganiso esinesisindo — bese imikhawulo yesakhiwo nesizinda iyayibamba, iyindilinga, futhi iwela esigabeni.
oracle_docs.the_fused_0_100_score_the_weight: Umphumela ohlanganisiwe ongu-0–100 — isisindo sobufakazi obuse-chain bokuthi ukwethulwa kuzowina.
oracle_docs.the_how_pillar_is_a_guardrail_against: Insika ye-HOW ingumgoqo wokuvikela ekukhohliseni okwaziwayo — amabhundle, amapulazi ezikhwama ezintsha, amaqoqo abaxhasi — kodwa abagezi imali bayaphinda. Amaphethini amasha okugwema abanjwa yi-loop yemiphumela (bayakhohlisa, idumela liyabuyekezwa) ngaphambi kokuba babanjwe umthetho. Ukuvikela yi-loop evaliwe, hhayi ukuhlola okukodwa.
oracle_docs.the_intended_semantics_is_that_where_cal: Incazelo ehlosekile ithi s(x)/100 ≈ P(win | x), lapho win = graduated ∨ ATH ≥ 2×. Ukulinganisa kukhombisa umehluko phakathi kwenhloso neqiniso.
oracle_docs.the_live_floor_every_agent_action_simula: Izinga elibukhoma — yonke into eyenziwa yi-ejenti, kungaba eyokulingisa noma ebukhoma, njengoba yenzeka.

oracle_docs.the_live_surface_every_launch_in_the: Indawo ebukhoma. Konke okwethuliwe emahoreni angu-12 adlule, kuhloliwe futhi kwahlungwa, kunebha yokukholisa ebukhoma kanye nezilinganiso ngokuya ngendaba ngayinye. three.ws/oracle

oracle_docs.the_machine_ready_endpoint_and_the_actio: I-endpoint elungele umshini /signal kanye ne-action loop kwenza i-Oracle ibe yinto yokuqala amanye ama-ejenti akha phezu kwayo — etholakalayo, ekhokhelwayo, futhi ehlanganisekayo kuwo wonke umnotho wama-ejenti we-three.ws kanye ne-MCP.

oracle_docs.the_pedigree_leaderboard_every_judged_wa: Ibhodi yabaphambili yofuzo — yonke i-wallet ehlulelwe ihlungwe ngomlando wayo.
oracle_docs.the_pillars_are_venue_agnostic_who_how: Izinsika azinandaba nendawo — ubani/kanjani/yini/ukuhamba kujwayelekile kunoma iyiphi indawo yokwethulwa enezinyathelo ze-on-chain. Ukucabanga kobuchopho yindawo lapho kuxhunywa khona iketango elisha.
oracle_docs.the_product_is_keyboard_driven_focuses_s: Umkhiqizo usetshenziswa ngekhibhodi (<kbd>/</kbd> igxilisa ukusesha, izinkinobho zezinombolo zigxuma phakathi kwamathebhu, imicibisholo ihamba phakathi kwawo), uphendula ngokugcwele, futhi wakhiwe ngephalethi elilodwa elimpunga elipholile lapho ukukhanya kubonisa amandla — okukhanyayo kusho ukukholisa okunamandla.
oracle_docs.the_proven_wins_gallery_ordered_by_ath: Igalari yokuwina okufakazelwe, ihlungwe nge-ATH multiple, enesifinyezo.
oracle_docs.the_question_is_real_buying_pressure_act: Umbuzo: ingabe ingcindezi yangempela yokuthenga iyavela ngempela, manje? I-momentum ifunda umkhondo wokuqala — ibhalansi yokuthenga/ukuthengisa, ukuthi abathengi abahlukile bangena ngokushesha kangakanani, kanye nobukhulu bokuthenga komthuthukisi njengophawu.
oracle_docs.the_question_is_this_a_fair_launch: Umbuzo: ingabe lokhu ukwethulwa okulungile noma okuklanywe ngobunjiniyela? Isakhiwo yisivikelo. Sifunda ukusatshalaliswa nesikhathi sokwethulwa — amathuba okuhlanganisa, ukugxila kwabanikazi, ingcindezi yokudubula, ukulima kwe-wallet entsha, amaqoqo abaxhasi ababodwa, ukuthengisa komthuthukisi — futhi siklomelisa izisekelo ezibanzi, zemvelo ngenkathi sijezisa ukuhlela nokugxila.
oracle_docs.the_question_what_is_this_coin_about: Umbuzo: imayelana nani le mali, futhi ingabe le ndaba inezinyawo zamasiko? Indaba ihlukanisa ukwethulwa kube yizigaba eziyishumi nanye (i-meme, i-ai, isiko, izindaba, isilwane, usaziwayo, ezombangazwe, umphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, usizo, okungaziwa) futhi ilinganisela ukusabalala kwayo — ngokukhethekile ngemodeli yolimi enikezwa izihloko zezindaba ze-crypto ezibukhoma ukuze ikwazi ukubona imali ehambisana nezindaba zanamuhla.
oracle_docs.the_question_who_is_already_in_this: Umbuzo: ubani oseyile mali, futhi yimuphi umlando wabo? Ufuzo luklomelisa ukwethulwa lapho ama-wallet anomlando ofakazelwe wokungena kubawinile kusenesikhathi esewathenga — futhi lijezisa ukuba khona kwabakhwabanisi abaziwayo, abalahli, nabakhi bokwethulwa okuhlulekile ngokulandelana.
oracle_docs.the_scoring_is_a_pure_function_of: Ukushaya amaphuzu kuwumsebenzi omsulwa wolwazi oluhlanganisiwe. Konke okunesimo — ukungenisa, ukugcina, ukusebenzisa, ukuxazulula — kuhlala ngaphandle kwayo. Lowo mngcele yingakho izibalo zihlolweka, izinqumo ziyaphindeka, futhi injini efanayo inika amandla okuphakelayo okubukhoma, i-API, nesinqumo se-ejenti ngemiphumela efanayo.
oracle_docs.the_snapshot_above_is_a_thin_low: Isithombe esingenhla siwumbono omncane, onokungabaza okuncane — amazinga okuwina aqinisekisiwe ahlala ngaphansi kwamaphuzu aphakathi nendawo futhi izinhlamvu zemali ezimbalwa zafinyelela emazingeni aphezulu. Lokho kuyabonakala, akufihliwe. Ikhasi lakhelwe ukubonisa ubungozi obuncane kalula njengobukhulu, ngoba ukuhlolwa kwangemuva okwethemba kuphela uma kukuthopha akulona ukuhlolwa kwangemuva.
oracle_docs.the_system_gets_sharper_the_more_it: Uhlelo luba bukhali kakhulu lapho lubuka kakhulu, ngezinhlelo ezimbili ezijikelezayo. Uhlelo olujikelezayo lwedatha data flywheel: umphumela ngamunye oxazululiwe ubuyekeza igrafu yesithunzi sesikhwama semali esinamandla ensika ye-WHO, ukuze incazelo "yemali ehlakaniphile" ihlale izuzwa kabusha, ingalokothi ibhalwe phansi. Uhlelo olujikelezayo lokulinganisa calibration flywheel: umphumela ngamunye ohloliwe uqinisa ukuhlolwa kwangemuva, uveza kahle ukuthi amaphuzu anokuzethemba okweqile noma okuncane, ukuze imodeli ikwazi ukulinganiswa kabusha ngokuya ngesimo sangempela kunokuba kube umuzwa.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_depends_on_a_language: Insika ye-WHAT incike kumodeli yolimi kanye nokuphakelwa kwezindaba; zombili zingahumusha kabi indaba noma ziphuthelwe eyodwa esheshayo. Yiyo insika enesisindo esincane ngenxa yalesi sizathu, futhi yehlela kumhlukanisi oqinisekile kunokuba yehluleke.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_is_the_only_place: Insika ye-WHAT yiyona kuphela indawo i-Oracle efika kuyo ngaphandle kobuchopho. Ukuze ihlukanise indaba yokwethulwa, ithola izihloko zezindaba ze-crypto ezibukhoma kusuka ku-API yezindaba zomphakathi (igcinwe cishe imizuzwana engu-90), izifaka kumyalo wemodeli yolimi, bese icela isigaba, indaba yomugqa owodwa, isilinganiso sokusabalala, kanye nokuzethemba. Uhlamvu lwemali oluhambisana nesihloko sezindaba zanamuhla luyabonakala kanjalo futhi luthola amaphuzu aphezulu. Uma imodeli ingatholakali, umhlukanisi wamagama angukhiye oqinisekile uyathatha indawo ukuze isinqumo sihlale sithunyelwa.
oracle_docs.the_wins_gallery_resolved_calls_with_the: Igalari yokuwina — izingcingo ezixazululiwe namaphuzu azo okungena uma kuqhathaniswa nomphumela oqaphelekayo.
oracle_docs.the_worker_is_configured_entirely_by_env: Umsebenzi ulungiswa ngokuphelele yindawo. Izilungiselelo ezikhethiwe (ezinokuzenzakalela): ORACLE_MODE=simulate, ORACLE_NETWORK=mainnet, ORACLE_SCORE_INTERVAL_MS=15000, ORACLE_AGENT_INTERVAL_MS=3000, ORACLE_SETTLE_INTERVAL_MS=60000, ORACLE_SCORE_BATCH=20, ORACLE_RESCORE_AFTER_SEC=180, ORACLE_MAX_TRADE_SOL=0.25 (umkhawulo ophelele wokuhweba ngakunye), kanye ORACLE_GLOBAL_KILL=1 (umisa yonke imisebenzi ye-agent + yokuhlala ngenkathi ukushaya amaphuzu kuqhubeka). Imodi ebukhoma idinga futhi imfihlo esetshenziselwa ukukhipha izikhwama zemali ze-agent, futhi iyala ukuqala ngaphandle kwayo.
oracle_docs.these_docs_are_written_in_two_layers: Le mibhalo ibhalwe ngezigaba ezimbili ukuze ikhasi elifanayo lisebenzele umuntu osaqala ofuna ukwazi kanye ne-quant efuna ifomu elivaliwe.

oracle_docs.transparency_over_magic_every_score_ship: Ukungafihli lutho ngaphezu komlingo. Wonke amaphuzu athunyelwa nezizathu eziwakhe. Akukho okukhiphayo kwemodeli okungacacile ocelwa ukuthi ukwethembe — ungafunda ukuthi kungani uhlamvu lwemali luthola u-82 noma lwafinyelela kumkhawulo ka-46.
oracle_docs.two_coins_can_both_score_70_for: Izinhlamvu zemali ezimbili zingathola amaphuzu angu-70 ngezizathu ezihluke ngokuphelele — eyodwa ngenxa yomlando ohlanzekile onomfutho obuthakathaka, enye ngenxa yendaba esabalalayo phezu kwesisekelo esincane. Izinga likutshela ukuthi kunamandla kangakanani; izizathu zikutshela ukuthi kungani, futhi lokho kungani yikho okuhweba ngakho.

oracle_docs.two_win_rates_are_published_deliberately: Kukhishwa amanani amabili okuwina, ahlukaniswe ngamabomu: i-call win rate (izinhlamvu zemali ezixazululiwe i-Oracle ezilinganise nge-Lean, Strong, noma i-Prime — amazinga ekutshela ukuthi wenze ngokuya ngawo) kanye ne-market base rate (konke ukuqaliswa okulinganisiwe — okungukuthi ukuthenga konke ngokungaboni kuzobuyisa ini). Kuze kuxazululwe izingcingo zangempela, i-call win rate ifundeka ngokuthi "azikho izingcingo ezixazululiwe okwamanje"; i-base rate ayikaze ivezwe njengekhono lenjini.
oracle_docs.unlike_the_normal_approximation_the_wils: Ngokungafani nokulinganisa okujwayelekile p ± z·√(p(1−p)/n), i-Wilson interval ihlala ngaphakathi ku-[0,1], ayihlangani ibe ububanzi obuyiziro ku-p=0 noma ku-p=1, futhi iziphatha kahle ku-n encane enayo ama-backtest amasha. Kungumehluko phakathi kokwethembeka "asikazi okwamanje" nokungathembeki "0% ± 0%."

oracle_docs.who_and_how_together_carry_nearly_two: UBANI kanye NOKWENZA ndawonye kuthwala cishe izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zesisindo ngoba ubani othengayo kanye nokuthi ukuqaliswa kunobulungiswa kangakanani yilawo maqiniso amabili ahlukanisa ngokuthembekile abagijimi kubakhwabanisi. YINI kanye NOKUNYAKAZA kulula — kuqeda ukulingana futhi kuqinisekise, kodwa indaba enhle noma umzuzu wokuqala oluhlaza akukwazi ukusindisa uhlamvu lwemali izinsika ezinzima ezizilahlayo.
oracle_docs.who_s_in_is_the_live_pedigree: Ubani-ongaphakathi uhlu lomlando olubukhoma — yonke isikhwama esibalulekile, ilebula yaso, nomlando waso.
oracle_docs.why_this_score_is_the_array_each: “Kungani leli phuzu” luyinhlu yezizathu[], umugqa ngamunye uqondiswe ensikeni eyawukhiqiza. Kulesi sibonelo: "azikho izikhwama ezifakazelwe ezitholakele okwamanje" (UBANI), "isakhiwo sokuqaliswa esihlanzekile, esisatshalaliswe" (KANJANI), "indaba ye-meme, ukusabalala 45/100" (YINI), "akukho mfutho ocacile okwamanje — kusenesikhathi kakhulu" (NYAKAZA). Ukuqaliswa okusha okuhlanzekile kodwa okungafakazelwe — ngendlela efanele ukubukwa, hhayi ukugwema futhi hhayi ukuthenga.
oracle_docs.wilson_1927_probable_inference_the_law_o: Wilson (1927), Probable inference, the law of succession, and statistical inference — i-score interval. Brier (1950), Verification of forecasts expressed in terms of probability. Platt (1999), probabilistic outputs for SVMs (Platt scaling). Zadrozny & Elkan (2002), isotonic calibration. Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (2005), Predicting good probabilities with supervised learning.
oracle_docs.wilson_interval_the_95_score_interval_on: Wilson interval: i-95% score interval kumanani okuwina esigaba/ebhini ngalinye (ukutholakala ku-evidence deep-dive), kulungile ku-n encane futhi kukhawulelwe ku-[0,1].
oracle_docs.win_loss_isn_t_known_until_a: Ukuwina/ukulahlekelwa akwaziwa kuze kuxazululwe uhlamvu lwemali, ngakho-ke i-backtest ihlala ilandela okwamanje. Amafasitela akamuva mancane futhi amabhande awo okuzethemba abanzi — futhi ikhasi libonisa ububanzi kunokuba libufihle.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_honest_error: Izinga lokuwina ngesigaba, ngamabha amaphutha athembekile
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_wilson_cis: Izinga lokuwina ngezinga nge-Wilson CIs, isitebhisi sokulinganisa, i-Brier, kanye nesifinyezo somphetho. Izihlungi: isikhathi, izinga, inethiwekhi.
oracle_docs.win_the_coin_graduated_or_its_peak: Wina — uhlamvu lwemali lwaphasisa, noma inani lalo eliphakeme lafinyelela ku-≥2× kuhlamvu lwemali olungazange luwe futhi olungamakiwe ngaphansi kwengxenye yokungena.
oracle_docs.with_no_signal_yet_it_returns_too: Ngenxa yokuthi alikho isignali okwamanje libuyisa "kusenesikhathi kakhulu," ligcina insika ingathathi hlangothi kunokuba kuqanjwe umfutho ongekho.

partners.every_agent_gets_a_verifiable_on_chain: Yonke i-agent ithola ubunikazi obuqinisekisekayo obuse-chain. Ipulatifomu yakho iba yingxenye yomnotho wama-agent ongenamvume.

partners.if_your_platform_powers_ai_cloud_or: Uma ipulatifomu yakho inika amandla i-AI, i-cloud, noma amathuluzi onjiniyela futhi ufuna ukuyibeka phambi kwama-agent akha i-internet elandelayo, asikhulume.
partners.meta_description: I-ecosystem yabalingani be-three.ws — AWS, IBM, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Intel, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Oracle, Quicknode. Amapulatifomu engqalasizinda ye-cloud, i-AI, ne-blockchain anika amandla ama-agent e-3D AI ezingeni lebhizinisi.

partners.ship_a_first_class_mcp_server_that: Thumela iseva ye-MCP esezingeni eliphezulu ama-agent angayithola futhi ayibize ngokwemvelo ngaphakathi kwe-three.ws Forge kanye ne-marketplace.
partners.three_ws_3d_agent_identity_and_x402: Ubunikazi be-agent ye-3D ye-three.ws kanye nezindlela zokukhokha ze-x402 kuhlanganiswa ne-IBM watsonx kanye ne-IBM Granite. Ama-agent asebenzisa amamodeli e-AI ebhizinisi ngenkathi egcina ubunikazi obuse-chain futhi enza izinkokhelo ezincane zangempela — konke kusuka kuphrofayela eyodwa ye-agent.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_nvidia: three.ws iyilungu le-NVIDIA Inception, uhlelo lwe-NVIDIA lweziqalo ezakha nge-accelerated computing. Yonke indlela yokukhiqiza i-3D isivele isebenza ku-NVIDIA silicon: umbhalo ube yi-3D, isithombe sibe i-avatar, i-auto-rigging, kanye ne-motion capture, kanye nendlela ye-NIM yamahhala esingathwe ngemuva kwe-forge.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_the: I-three.ws iyilungu le-Quicknode Startup Program enemali yesikweletu yesisekelo esivunyiwe. Izindawo zokugcina ze-RPC ze-Quicknode ezisatshalaliswe emhlabeni wonke zifaka amandla nokungaphazamiseki ekufinyeleleni kweketango ngemuva kwama-wallet ama-agent, ukuqinisekiswa kokukhokha kwe-x402, nedatha yemakethe ebukhoma ye-Solana.
partners.three_ws_is_an_openai_select_partner: three.ws yi-OpenAI Select Partner e-OpenAI Partner Network. I-3D Studio connector ye-three.ws eyamahhala inika uChatGPT izinto ezishumi nanye ze-3D ezingasebenzisi ikhi: ukusuka kwetekstesi kuya kumodeli, amavathara anobumba, ukulungisa ngokuxoxisana, ukubheka umodeli oqediwe kwezinhlobo ezahlukene, nomzimba womphathi ophilayo, konke kuyabonakala ngokuhambisana inline ekuxoxweni.
partners.three_ws_runs_on_and_integrates_with: I-three.ws isebenza futhi ihlangana nezinkundla ezihamba phambili zamafu, ze-AI, nezamathuluzi — inikeza wonke ama-agent amandla okubala asezingeni lebhizinisi, ubunikazi, nokufinyelela.

pay_simulator.hint_calls: https://api.example.com/data x12 ibuye iyaxhumana. @0.05 ibeka inani engakubeki ngokuhlola.
pay_simulator.hint_free: Akukho akhaunti efunekayo. Iwalethi ayithintwa, iseshini ayidaliwa, namakredithi ayahamba.
pay_simulator.hint_hosts: Kwahlukaniswe ngekomishi. Okungapheleli kusho ukuthi noma uyiphi ihosti inokukhokhelwa.
pay_simulator.idle_p: I-preset iselwe ngokuphelele. Phinda ibhutoni bese i-platform ihlola ngamunye i-endpoint ngenani eliphilayo le-402, iphindze ihambe ipholisi yakho ngemiphumela.
pay_simulator.lede: Ngaphambi kokunika umphathi ibhajethi, thola ukuthi le bhajethi ithenga ntoni ngempela. Lokhu luhambisa ipholisi oyikhiphileyo ngokudinga ama-endpoints oya kuwaxhumana umphathi, usebenzisa imigomo efanayo eyenza iqhuba seshini yokuphazamisa, sibonise kanjalo ezinye izingxoxo ezihlala, ezivalelwe ngenkathi, nalapho imali iyaphela khona.
pay_simulator.meta_description: Yenza ukuhlola kwezinga lokusebenzisa komphathi we-AI ngokwemibono ye-x402 ngaphambi kokuvumela idola. Bheka ezinye izingxoxo ezihlala, ezivalelwe ngenkathi, nenani eliqinile le bhajethi elidingekayo.
pay_simulator.next_docs_d: Ukugcina, amandla, nokwenza: ngoba umphathi akayigcini ikhi.
pay_simulator.next_sessions_d: Guqula ipholisi eyakhiwe kuze ibe yibhajethi eqinileyo netokheni yomphathi.
pay_simulator.next_tutorial_d: Kusuka kwiseshini yokuqala kuya kumphathi osebenza, qede qede.
pay_simulator.tag: Ukuhlola kuphela. Akukho okusayinwa, akukho okusetyenziswa.
pay_simulator.tip_budget: Inani eliphelele elingasebenzisa umphathi kulolu seshini. Lilushwa kwama-kredithi akho ngesikhathi iseshini idalwa futhi libuyiselwe uma ukhansela.
pay_simulator.tip_calls: I-https URL enye ngalinye. Yongeza "x12" ukubuyeza uxhumano olwamashumi amabili, kanye ne-"@0.05" ukubeka inani ngaphandle kokuhlola eliphilayo. Ngamunye i-endpoint ehlukile ihlolwa kanye, ingakhokhi.
pay_simulator.tip_hosts: Kulokhu amahosti anokukhokhelwa. Isidomaine esiphansi kwe-domeyni elibhalwe liyavumelwa; idomeyni efanayo ayivumelwi. Shiya ngaphandle ukuvumela noma uyiphi ihosti.
pay_simulator.tip_network: Icheyini evela kuya kuphazamisa iwalethi ye-platform. Solana yiyo eyodwa. I-endpoint engakuniki ireli kuwo le nethiwork ayinokukhokhelwa lolu seshini.
pay_simulator.tip_pertx: Iphakamile kakhulu enye imali. Iyavimela i-endpoint elingakubeki kakulu ukusebenzisa ibhajethi eliphelele ngexhumano elilodwa. Shiya ngaphandle uma kungekho iphakamile.
pay_simulator.tip_ttl: Itokheni iyakwazi ukusebenzisa isikhathi esingakanani. Lapho seliphelile iseshini iyayeka ukwamukela izipazamiso noma yimali engasetyenziswanga ibuyiselwa ngokuzikhandla.

payment_outcomes.every_way_an_x402_payment_can_fail: Zonke izindlela x402 zokukhokha ezingaphumelela, ngaphambi kokuthi kumiswe umnotho. Qinisekisa ukwenqaba, xazulula ukuphumelela okungasebenzi kanye nezitifiketi eziphindaphindiwe ezifundwa kwi-ledger yokukhokha eqinile; umshini wokuhlola we-ring kanye nezibalo ze-wallet eziphilayo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuwa kuyiphutha le-rail noma umxhaso ongenamali, okubonakala kufana ngaphandle kodwa kunezixazululo eziphikisanayo. Amathuluzi angaphakathi, hhayi indawo yomphakathi.

pill.meta_desc: pump.fun iqinisekisiwe $THREE njengokwakho. Sihlanganise umfanekiso wabo we-pill ukuze sithi ngiyabonga: isikhumba se-52-bone, ama-clip ayisithupha akhiwe ngesandla, kanye nesiteji ongahamba kuso ku-browser yakho.
pill.og_desc: pump.fun iqinisekisiwe $THREE njengokwakho. Ngakho sathumela umfanekiso wabo we-pill: izandla, izinyawo, ama-clip ayisithupha, kanye nesiteji ongahamba kuso.
pill.skeleton_intro: I-mascot ifike ngendlela ejwayelekile yokuthi imodeli ezakhiwe nezitholiwe zifike: isikhumba esivuliwe, akukho maphiko, akukho zixhumi, imile phakathi kokuhamba, futhi ibhityile ngokwanele ukuze ibhujiswe ifoni. I-auto-rigger yethu ye-humanoid ibheka ikhanda phezu kwenhlangothi nezandla ezimbili ezinde, futhi i-capsule enezinhlangothi ezine ayinakho lokho. Ngakho ithole umgudu wayo, futhi lowo mgudu ukwi-repo: scripts/rig-pill-mascot.py.
pill.skeleton_outro: Le nombolo yokugcina iyona ebalulekile ngemuva kwale khasi. I-skeleton isebenzisa amagama ezitho ezijwayelekile, ngakho i-pill ayinakho ukuncishiswa kumakliphu ayisithupha ayithumele: yonke i-animation epulatifomu iyayishayela, kuhlanganise naleyo ongakayenzi. Ukubhalwa okuphelele ku-the docs.
pill.stage_canvas_aria: Isigcawu se-3D. I-pump.fun pill mascot, eqanjwe futhi edrivable.
pill.stage_help: I-capsule eluhlaza nephuzi enobuso obuhle obuphekiwe, izandla ezimbili ezincane nezinyawo ezimbili ezincane, imile esigcawini esijikelezayo. Sebenzisa u-W, A, S no-D noma ama-arrow keys ukuhamba, Shift ukuhamba ngokushesha, Space ukujika, E ukuvuma nokuthi Q ukudansa. Izinkinobho ezingezansi zidlala ama-animation afanayo.
pill.stat_size: iqanjwe, yehliswe kusuka ku-12.6 MB static
pill.step1: Thola izitho ngaphandle kokuthi uthole ukuthi zikhona kuphi. Voxelize i-mesh, thola ukuguqulwa kwayo kokude, futhi umzimba ungaphezu kokuthi kube thick kunesitho. Izinhlangothi ezine ziwela phansi njengokuthi yini esele.
pill.step2: Landela i-nub ngayinye ibuyela emzimbeni. Umgwaqo ophansi wezindleko okhetha okukhululekile ulandela i-curve yangempela yesitho esikhuluma esikhundleni sokucabanga umugqa oqondile, okuyinto eyenza ukuthi unyawo oluphambene lube nephimbo eliphambene.
pill.step3: Bopha ngokuthi okukhona ngaphakathi, hhayi okuseduze. I-pose eyakhelwe ibeka isandla esisodwa ohlangothini lwekhanda. Noma iyiphi indlela yokukala ibiza lezi zindawo ezimbili njengezihlobo futhi ibopha, ngakho izisindo zinqunywa ngokuhamba kwe-vertex ngayinye ngaphakathi kuya kwi-axis yesigaba esikhuluma ngaso. Ngaphakathi kwe-mesh, leso sandla sikhona kude kakhulu nalolo hlanga.
pill.step4: Bind phakathi kokuhamba, phumula imile. glTF igcina i-bind pose ne-rest pose zihlukaniswe, futhi i-retargeter yethu idlala i-clip motion njengedelta ku-rest pose. I-walk cycle kufanele iqale ezinyaweni ngaphansi kwezinqe, ngakho i-neutral stance ibekwe kwi-geometry ethunyelwe.
pill.step5: Animate ngezilinganiso ezithile ezikhona. Amakliphu ayisithupha, abhalwe ngokumelene ne-mascot enezitho ezincane futhi engenanhlangothi kunokuthi aboleke kwi-human mocap library: idle, walk, run, wave, jump, dance.
pill.tw_desc: pump.fun iqinisekisiwe $THREE njengokusemthethweni kwethu. Ngakho sathola i-pill mascot yabo futhi sabanika izinyawo. Hamba nayo ku-browser yakho.
pill.verify_p1: pump.fun uphawu lokuqinisekisa lwenza imali ibe ngokusemthethweni ku-projekthi eyingqayizivele. Lokhu kuyisixhumanisi phakathi kwe-$THREE yangempela kanye nezinkopho ezabelana ngegama layo kanye ne-ticker yayo, futhi kuyindlela esheshayo yokuthi umthengi akwazi ukuzihlukanisa ngaphambi kokuchitha noma yini.
pill.verify_p2: $THREE iyona kuphela imali le platform eyikhuthaza, futhi iphila ku-FeMbDoX7R1Psc4GEcvJdsbNbZA3bfztcyDCatJVJpump. I-badge manje iboniswa eduze kwayo ku-token page, ifundwa bukhoma ku-pump.fun kuyo yonke isicelo se-stats esikhundleni sokuba hardcoded, ngakho i-badge lapha njalo ibonisa into efanayo ne-badge lapho. Okunye konke okwenziwe nge-three.ws kuyilokho umsebenzisi aqala, futhi wonke wabo ubhaliswe nomdali wabo ku-Agent Launches.

play_economy.meta_description: Inani ngalinye, umklomelo kanye ne-gate emnothweni we /play: lokho isitolo esikukhokhela ngalokho okuqoqayo, lokho esikuthengisayo, indlela ibhange elivikela ngayo imali yakho ngokufa, lokho $THREE boutique ikhokha, kanye nepaytable ephelele ye-wheel enezinhloso zangempela. Funda ezitobhini ezifanayo ezisebenza ngentengo yokuhweba ye-game server.
play_economy.meta_og_description: I-referensi ephelele ye /play economy: amanani esitolo, imithetho yebhange, $THREE boutique, kanye nepaytable ephelele ye-wheel enezinhloso zangempela. Akukaze kubhalwe phansi, funda ngqo ezitobhini zegeyimu.
play_economy.meta_twitter_description: Amanani esitolo, imithetho yebhange, $THREE boutique, kanye nepaytable ephelele ye-wheel enezinhloso zangempela.
play_economy.nothing_below_is_transcribed_by_hand_the: Akukho okungaphansi okubhalwe ngesandla. Le khasi ifunda ezitobhini ezifanayo ezisebenza ngentengo yokuhweba ye-game server, ngakho inombolo lapha iyinombolo ozokhokhelwa ngayo.
play_economy.the_catalogs_gates_and_odds_on_this: Izikhangiso, ama-gates kanye nezinhlelo kuleli khasi zisetshenziswa ngu /api/play/economy, ezithatha ku-modules zegeyimu esikhundleni sokuziphinda, ngakho le referensi ayikwazi ukuphuma kulokho okukhokhelwa yi-server. Imali iyinsiza yegeyimu futhi ayishiyi umhlaba; kuphela ama-boutique avuleka kanye nezinsiza ezikhokhelwayo ezithinta uchungechunge, futhi kokubili kuqinisekiswa ku-chain ngaphambi kokuthi kukhishwe noma yini. I-USDC cosmetics rail ehlukile ye-standalone character creator ibhalwe ngaphansi kwe-Fits.
play_economy.the_open_world_runs_a_real_economy: Umhlaba ovulekile uphatha umnotho wangempela: iphakethe ongawulahlekisa, ibhange elivikela, isitolo esibiza yonke ukuhweba kwi-server, i-cosmetics boutique ethola ku Solana, kanye ne-wheel enezinhloso ezishicilelwe. Kuze kube manje bekudingeka uhambe uye ku-NPC ngayinye ukuze ufunde noma yini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa konke, endaweni eyodwa.

play_solver.every_yield_rule_in_the_open_world: Yonke imithetho yokukhipha emhlabeni ovulekile iyifunction ehlanzekile ye-level yakho yokusebenza kanye ne-node okh standayo kuyo, futhi yonke i-swing inenhloso eqinile eyenziwa yi-server. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imali elindelekile, XP nezimpahla ngehora akukhona okudingeka ukugxila kukho futhi ulinganise. Ziyakwazi ukusombululwa, kahle, ngedlula eyodwa.
play_solver.meta_description: Umnotho we /play world, osombululiwe. Imali elindelekile ne-XP ngehora ye-node ngayinye emhlabeni kuzo zonke izinga, isikhathi esifanele sokudoba nokupheka, lokho isitolo esikukhokhela emizuzwini nase-swing, inani langempela le-wheel, kanye nenani lokulwa ngalinye. Kubalwa ngendlela evaliwe kusuka ezitobhini zegeyimu, akukaze kulinganiswe.
play_solver.meta_og_description: Imali elindelekile ne-XP ngehora ye-node ngayinye emhlabeni kuzo zonke izinga, osombululiwe ngendlela evaliwe kusuka ezitobhini zegeyimu. Shintsha izinga bese ubuka umhlaba wonke uphinde ubize.
play_solver.meta_twitter_description: I-node ngayinye emhlabeni we /play, ibhajethi kahle, kuzo zonke izinga. Indlela evaliwe, hhayi elinganisiwe.
play_solver.served_by_which_imports_the_authoritativ: Ithunyelwe ngu /api/play/solver, ethatha imodyuli zomdlalo ezisemthethweni esikhundleni sokuziphinda: ama-yield curves avela ku items.js, ama-cadences avela ku activities.js, amanani avela ku shop.js kanye nokulungiswa kwe-per-node avela ku world-features.js. Akukho inombolo kuleli khasi eyalinganisiwe, yathathwa noma yabhala, ngakho ayikwazi ukuphuma kulokho okwenziwa yiserver. Izinkolelo zomodeli zishicilelwe nazo zonke imiphumela futhi zibalwe phansi kwaleli khasi, ngoba izinga elishiwo ngaphandle kwezinkolelo zalo liyiqiniso. Imali iyinsiza yomdlalo engashiyi umhlaba; kuphela ukuvuleka kwe-boutique nezinsiza ezikhokhelwayo ezithinta uchungechunge.
play_solver.so_we_solved_them_move_the_level: Ngakho sixazulule. Phakamisa izinga elingezansi futhi umhlaba wonke uphinde ubize: yonke imithi, wonke itshe, wonke umfula, isondo, isitolo kanye nezinhlanga zakhona.

pocket.controls_p: Ikhibhodi, ukuthinta kanye ne-gamepad yangempela konke kuqhuba i-console efanayo. Xhuma i-controller futhi i-D-pad esikrinini iyavela nayo.
pocket.embed_p: I-iframe eyodwa. Iphatha umphakathi owulandiwe njengamanje, ivula umzimba wayo we-3D, futhi isebenza kunoma iyiphi imvelaphi. Akukho SDK, akukhona ukwakhiwa, akukho okhiye be-API.
pocket.hero_sub: Bonke badweba amaphothifoliyo ngaphakathi kwezikhombisi ezibukwayo. Le yodwa ivula. Kunomphakathi we-3D ophilayo ohamba ngaphakathi kwesikrini, i-D-pad ikwazi ukusihola, ama-cartridge angama-agent abukhoma abanye abantu ku-three.ws bawakhe, futhi umugqa owodwa we-HTML uwela konke lokhu kuwebhusayithi yakho.
pocket.meta_desc: I-console esandleni enomphakathi we-3D ophilayo ngaphakathi kwesikrini. Hola ngayo nge-D-pad, shintsha i-cartridge ye-three.ws yomphakathi, khetha isikhumba, bese uwela yonke i-console kuwebhusayithi yakho ngombhalo owodwa we-HTML.
pocket.rail_hint: Umphakathi wonke lapha ungempela futhi uphumelele. Faka eyodwa, noma ucindezele u-L / R ku-console.
pocket.share_desc: I-console esandleni enomphakathi we-3D ophilayo ohamba ngaphakathi kwesikrini. I-D-pad iyahola, ama-cartridge ashintsha umphakathi, umugqa owodwa we-HTML uwela kuwebhusayithi yakho.

portfolio.fineprint: Amabhalansi nezintengo zifundwa bukhoma ngokucela futhi zigcinwa cishe imizuzu eminingi. Ukunyakaza kwe-24h kufaka ingxenye yamanani anemlandvo ethe xaxa; ukuvikelwa kubhalwe, akukalwe. Ama-tokens anganeni agcina inani lawo futhi akhishwa kumatotal.
portfolio.form_hint: Cindezela <kbd>/</kbd> ukuze ugxile. Uhlaka lutholakala ngokuzenzakalelayo kusuka kukheli.
portfolio.intro1_body: Ibhalansi yemvelo kanye ne-token ngayinye kwi-wallet, ibalwe bukhoma. Ama-tokens angenayo indlela yokuthola intengo abhalwa ngokwethembeka njengama-unpriced, akukalwe.
portfolio.intro2_body: Izibambiso zihlukaniswe zibe ama-stablecoins, ama-majors (SOL, ETH, BTC kanye nezabelo zawo ezitholakalayo), kanye nakho konke okunye, ukuze ubone i-powder eyomile vedwa ne-risks evulekile.
portfolio.intro3_body: I-portfolio ngayinye inekheli le-URL. Yabelana ngelinki futhi noma ubani ubona umbono ofanayo bukhoma, ngqo kusuka kuhla.
portfolio.kicker: Intengo bukhoma · noma iyiphi i-wallet
portfolio.meta_desc: Umbono we-portfolio bukhoma ye-Solana noma i-Ethereum wallet: inani eliphelele, ukunyakaza kwe-24h, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-stable/major/token, ukuphathwa, kanye nezibambiso zonke zibhalwe ngesikhathi sangempela. Mahhala, ngaphandle kokhiye, akukho akhawunti.
portfolio.share_desc: Faka noma iyiphi Solana noma i-Ethereum ikheli bese uthola i-portfolio bukhoma: inani eliphelele, ukunyakaza kwe-24h, ukuphathwa, kanye nezibambiso zonke zibhalwe ngesikhathi sangempela.
portfolio.stale_note: Imithombo bukhoma ayitholakali njengamanje. Ibonisa isithombe sokugcina esiqinisekisiwe sale wallet.

preflight.how_p1: Ikhasimende liyiphakheji. I-fetch, iqinisekisa, futhi iyakwenqaba ukukhokha umthengisi ongakwazi ukuhlela, ibuyisela emuva kumugqa osebenzayo uma utholakala.
preflight.how_p2: Noma kusuka kumtapo, lapho ikhodi yokuphuma iyisiphetho:
preflight.how_p3: Ifomethi ye-wire iyavuma futhi ayinankinga: noma yimuphi x402 umthengisi angashicilela eyodwa futhi noma yimuphi ikhasimende lingayiqinisekisa. Funda imibhalo ye-format, imithetho yokuhlola, nokuthi ungasebenzisa kanjani i-attestation kusuka kumphakathi wakho.
preflight.meta_desc: Bheka ukuthi ngabe noma yimuphi umthengisi x402 angakwazi ukuhoxisa ngaphambi kokukhokha. Ikhupha ubufakazi bokukhokha obusayinwe umthengisi futhi iqinisekisa isiginesha nesikhathi sokuphela kwi-browser yakho.
preflight.share_desc: x402 ikutshela ukuthi imithombo ibiza malini. I-Preflight ikutshela ukuthi ngabe umthengisi angakwazi ngempela ukuthatha imali yakho. Usayinwe, ungesikhathi, uqinisekiswe kwi-browser yakho.
preflight.sub: x402 ikhuluma kumphakathi ukuthi imithombo ibiza . Ayisho lutho mayelana nokuthi umthengisi angakwazi yini ukuhoxisa lokho akukhokhisa, futhi le ngxenye ikhokhwa umthengi: ukudluliswa okusayinwe, i-blockhash esetshenzisiwe, i-502, futhi akukho service. I-Preflight iyayivala. Faka noma iyiphi imvelaphi ngezansi futhi leli khasi likhipha ubufakazi bayo /.well-known/x402-preflight futhi liqinisekise isiginesha ye-ed25519, isikhathi sokuphela nesihloko ngokuphelele kwi-browser yakho. Akukho okuthathwa ngesiqinisekiso sethu.
preflight.title: Ngabe lo mthengisi angakwazi ngempela ukuthatha imali yakho?

press_index.01use_the_files_as_they_are_no: 01Sebenzisa amafayela njengoba enjalo. Akukho ukuguqulwa kwemibala, ukuhlela, ukujolisa, ukujika, noma ukwakha kabusha ikhube ngengxenye. Ukuphuma kwe-chrome kuyisikhumbuzo.
press_index.02leave_clear_space_keep_at_least_half: 02Shiya isikhala esicacile. Gcina okungenani uhhafu ukuphakama kwekhube kukhululekile kuwo wonke amacala. Akukho okukhawulelayo, okuphindaphindayo, noma okukhona ngaphakathi kwalolo mngcele.
press_index.03write_it_lowercase_the_name_is_three: 03Bhala ngencwadi encane. Igama lingu three.ws embhalweni oqhubekayo, hhayi "Three.ws", "THREE.WS", noma "ThreeWS".
press_index.04do_not_lock_our_mark_to_another: 04Ungavali uphawu lwethu kumlogo omunye ngaphandle kokubuza. Umfanekiso we-logo owabelwe ubonisa ubudlelwano obungase bungekho.
press_index.05editorial_use_is_granted_coverage_revi: 05Ukusetshenziswa kwezehlakalo kuvunyelwe. Ukuhlola, ukubuyekezwa, izinhlelo zezingqungquthela, nezinsiza zabalingani azidingi imvume. Ukusebenzisa uphawu njengophawu lomkhiqizo wakho, noma ngendlela ekhombisa ukuthi siyavuma umkhiqizo, kudinga.
press_index.a_platform_for_creating_animating_and_mo: Ipulatifomu yokwakha, ukuhlekisa, nokwenza imali ngama-agent e-3D AI.
press_index.agents_on_three_ws_are_economic_actors: Ama-agent ku three.ws ayizisebenzi zomnotho. Ngamunye angabamba ubunikazi obukhona ku Solana, uchungechunge lwepulatifomu, aphethe i-wallet negama elibhalwe ngababukeli, futhi akhokhe noma athole ukukhokha kwezinye izisebenzi ngokuqhuba i-API ngaphezulu kwe x402, i-HTTP 402 standard yokukhokha. I-coin ye-pulatifomu, $THREE, ikhuluma ku Solana.
press_index.approved_descriptions_at_four_lengths_co: Izincazelo ezivunyelwe ngezikhathi ezine. Zikopishe ngokuqondile; zibhaliwe ukuze zicaphunwe.
press_index.assets_on_this_page_are_regenerated_from: Izinsiza kuleli khasi zikhishwa kabusha emthonjeni ku-repository, ngakho lokho okukhuphayo kuhlala kuyimidwebo yamanje. Uma unedlulelo futhi udinga ifomethi engakatholakali lapha (EPS, ukusika okuthile, ukwakhiwa okuphezulu), cela lokho nge-imeyili futhi kuzobuyiselwa ngosuku olufanayo.
press_index.checkable_claims_only_anything_not_liste: Izimangalo ezihlonzweyo kuphela. Noma yini engalotshwanga lapha, cela ngaphambi kokuphrinta.
press_index.distribution_is_the_point_a_finished_age: Ukusatshalaliswa kuyisihluthulelo. I-agent eqediwe ithunyelwa njenge <agent-3d> web component engangena kunoma iyiphi ikhasi, futhi zonke izinsiza zokwakha nokuhumusha zifinyeleleka ngama-AI assistants nge MCP. three.ws ungumlingani we-OpenAI Select, futhi uxhumano lwakhe lwe-3D Studio lunikeza i-ChatGPT amathuluzi ayishumi nanye angavuliwe akhiqiza, ahlola, ahumusha, futhi abeke ama-models e-3D ku-AR, abhalwe inline engxoxweni. Futhi ungum member we-NVIDIA Inception.
press_index.download_the_whole_kit_zip_6_0: Landa yonke ikit ZIP, 6.0 MB. Imigqa, imidwebo ye-OpenAI, nemithetho yokusetshenziswa njenge README.
press_index.every_avatar_is_a_full_agent_not: I-avatar ngayinye iy-agent ephelele, hhayi imodeli engashintshi. I-runtime ibopha umlingiswa ku-LLM brain elalela, ikhuluma nge-lip-sync yesikhathi sangempela, izenzo, ikhumbula, futhi ibonisa imizwa ngefana yomodeli nezimo, bukhoma ku-browser ngaphandle kokufaka okuthile. Noma iyiphi i-rig yomuntu iyasebenza: uhlelo lokuhumusha luhumusha umtapo wezinyathelo owabelwe kunoma iyiphi iskeleti imodeli ifika nayo.
press_index.every_release_is_public_at_three_ws: Ukukhishwa ngakunye kukhishwa emphakathini ku-three.ws/changelog, ne-RSS ne-JSON feeds.
press_index.horizontal_lockup_dark_type_for_white_pa: Ukubamba okujolile, uhlobo olumnyama. Ukuze iphepha elikhulu, ukuphrinta, nezikhangiso ezikhanyayo.
press_index.horizontal_lockup_light_type_the_default: Ukubamba okujolile, uhlobo olukhanyayo. Okuyisisekelo kumaground amnyama nevidiyo.
press_index.marks_announcement_graphics_boilerplate_: Imigqa, imidwebo yokwazisa, iboilerplate, kanye neziqinisekiso, konke kwamanje futhi konke kungenziwa ngaphandle kokucela noma ubani. Uma udinga okuthile okungakatholakali lapha, partnerships@three.ws izophendula.

reasoning_ledger.meta_description: Zonke izinqumo ezibalulekile ezenziwa yi-ejenti — ukuthi yanquma ini, kungani, yabhula ini, nokuthi kwenzekeni ngempela — kurekhodwe encwadini yokubalwa kwezimali engenakuguqulwa, eqinisekiswa ngokuzimela. Umlando ongawubuza, hhayi ukuwuthemba.
reasoning_ledger.meta_og_description: Irekhodi elingahlolwa, elisekelwe ku-chain lezinqumo ze-ejenti, izibikezelo, nemiphumela yangempela. Ukuba nephutha kuyabonakala — ubuqotho yisignali yokwethenjwa.
reasoning_ledger.meta_twitter_description: Zonke izinqumo ezibalulekile ze-ejenti (ukuthi yanquma ini, kungani, yabhula ini, nokuthi kwenzekeni ngempela) encwadini yokubalwa kwezimali engenakuguqulwa, esekelwe ku-chain, eqinisekiswa ngokuzimela. Vula noma iyiphi i-ejenti ku /ledger/<agentId>. Ukuba nephutha kuyabonakala; ubuqotho yisignali yokwethenjwa.

receipts.fineprint: / ukusesha · e thumela i-CSV. I-receipt ngayinye iyifayela elisayiniwe (JWS) elivela ku-x402 Offer & Receipt extension; ukulanda kwe-JSON kufaka isiginesha ukuze noma ubani akwazi ukukuhlola ngokumelene ne-three.ws okhiye. Ezinye izinkokhelo zishiya i-on-chain tx hash ngenhloso yokuvikela. I-API engemuva kwaleli khasi yi-GET /api/x402/my-receipts, echazwe kwi-API reference.
receipts.meta_desc: Noma iyiphi x402 inkokhelo owake wayenza ku-three.ws, ethola phakade. Xhuma i-Solana noma i-EVM wallet, usayinwe umyalezo owodwa, futhi uthole ubufakazi bokuthenga obusayinwe: i-endpoint, inethiwekhi, i-settlement tx, kanye ne-artifact ephelele njenge-JSON noma i-CSV.
receipts.og_desc: Xhuma i-wallet, usayinwe umyalezo owodwa, futhi uthole zonke izinkokhelo ezisayiniwe x402 three.ws ezake zakhishwa kuwe: ubufakazi bokuthenga bazo zonke izicelo ezikhokhelwayo ze-API, ezithunyelwa njenge-JSON noma i-CSV.
receipts.search_placeholder: Filter nge-endpoint, inethiwekhi, noma i-tx hash
receipts.signin_copy: Siyinika umyalezo olula othi ubhalise ikheli lakho nesikhathi. Isiginesha ivumela ukufunda izinkokhelo zakho kuphela futhi akukho okunye: akukho ukuthengiselana, akukho ukuvuma, akukho imali. Iphela ngemva kwemizuzu emihlanu.
receipts.signin_h: Qinisekisa i-wallet yakho, thola ama-receipt akho
receipts.signin_note: Isebenza ne-Phantom, Backpack, ne-Solflare ku Solana, kanye ne-MetaMask noma iyiphi i-wallet efakwe ku-EVM chains. Ama-receipts asayinwe ngu three.ws ngaphansi kwe x402 Offer & Receipt extension, ukuze abanye abantu bakwazi ukuwafakazela ngaphandle kokuthembela kithi. Akukaze wenze ucingo olukhokhelwayo? Qala ku x402 endpoint catalog.
receipts.sub: Noma yisiphi isicelo esikhokhelwayo x402 osithumelayo ku three.ws sikhupha i-receipt esayinwe, futhi sigcina ikhophi eqinile. Ulahlekelwe yikhanda lokuphendula lokukhokha? Xhuma i-wallet yakho, signa umyalezo ongu-read-only, bese ubuyisa wonke ama-receipt akhishwe kuyo. Lokhu kuyisigaba somthengi se-ledger: wonke ama-receipt lapha yizinto owathengile.
receipts.title: I-Receipt Vault
receipts.twitter_desc: Thola wonke ama-receipt asayinwe x402 three.ws akhishwe kwi-wallet yakho. Ubufakazi bokuthenga, obungathunyelwa, obungafakazelwa ngababukeli.

Uhlelo lwe-DCA lwenza okufanayo futhi luguqula umphumela ube yitokheni. Kokubili kusebenza kumakhroni wehora, kokubili kungama-pause futhi kuqale kabusha ngaphandle kokusayina futhi, futhi kokubili kugcina i-ledger ye-per-charge ongayifunda lapha.

render_lab.hero_p: Hlanganisa i-render yangempela ngokumelene ne-API ephilayo, bese kopisha isicelo esiqondile. Wonke amalawuli lapha ahambisana nompharamitha owodwa we GET /api/avatar/render, futhi ilabhorethri ifunda imodeli ngayinye kuqala: izimo ezingekho nezikhundla isikhumba sayo esingakwazi ukuzibamba zivalwa ngesizathu, esikhundleni sokwehluleka ngokuthula ngesikhathi sokwenza. Akukho akhawunti, akukho SDK, akukho okhiye.
render_lab.meta_desc: Hlanganisa i-render ye-avatar yangempela ku-browser bese kopisha isicelo se-API esiqondile. I-Render Lab ifunda ukuthi imodeli ngayinye ingakwenza kanjani (ARKit morphs, ukuvikelwa kwesikhumba, i-geometry) futhi inikeza kuphela amalawuli azowahlonipha, ukuze akukho okwakhiwa lapha kwehluleke ngokuthula ekukhiqizeni.

render_lab.next_media_body: Wonke umpharamitha, ikhanda lokuphendula, nomthetho we-cache wezindawo zokwenza nokukwazi.
render_lab.next_tut_body: Thumela izithombe ze-avatar ekhasini langempela, kusukela esicelweni sokuqala kuya ekusebenzeni okukhishwe ku-CDN.

restyle.every_ai_restyle_mints_a_real_durable: Konke ukushintsha isitayela nge-AI kudala GLB yangempela, eqinile — ingalokothi ibhale phezu kwaleyo eyandulela. "Gcina inguqulo" ibeka uphawu izinguquko zakho zamanje zokulungisa/izilungiselelo ngendlela efanayo. Chofoza inguqulo ukuze ubuyele kuyo; eyokuqala ihlale iyi-inguqulo 1.

restyle.meta_og_description: Faka izilungiselelo zezinto ze-PBR, shintsha isitayela nge-AI kusuka kumyalelo wombhalo, nezinhlobo ezihleliwe kunoma iyiphi GLB, lungisa kahle izinto bukhoma, futhi uthumele ngaphandle imodeli eqinisekisiwe — ngaphandle kokulimaza.
restyle.meta_twitter_description: Shintsha isikhumba sanoma iyiphi imodeli ye-3D kusiphequluli: faka izilungiselelo zezinto ze-PBR (i-chrome, igolide, ingilazi, ukhuni…), shintsha isitayela kusuka kumyalelo we-AI olula, sabalalisa izinhlobo zombala ezihleliwe njengezinguqulo eziqinile, lungisa kahle ubunsinsimbi nobulukhuni bukhoma, futhi uthumele ngaphandle GLB eqinisekisiwe — ngaphandle kokulimaza, ngomlando wenguqulo wangempela ongabuyiselwa emuva.

rig-doctor.badge: Isebenza ngokuphelele ku-browser yakho
rig-doctor.drop_hint: noma uchofoze ukukhetha ifayela. Akukho okukhishwayo.

rig-doctor.explain1_desc: I-clip ngayinye ku three.ws library ibhalwe ngokumelene nesikhumba esisodwa esiyinhloko: Hips, LeftForeArm, RightUpLeg, ama-joints angu-52 ukuphelele. Umjikelezo obiza LeftForeArm awuqhuba lutho ku-rig ebiza le joint lowerarm_l.
rig-doctor.explain2_desc: Akukho phutha. I-GLB iyalayisha, izinto zikhishwa, umxube uyasebenza, futhi umlingiswa ume endaweni yokubopha. Akekho okukhombisa ukuthi kungani, yingakho leli khasi likhona futhi kungani lisebenza ngaphambi kokuthi ulayishe kunokuthi emva.
rig-doctor.explain3_desc: I-Mixamo, i-Avaturn, i-Ready Player Me, i-Unreal, i-VRM, i-Daz, i-Rigify, i-Biped, i-HumanIK, i-Reallusion, i-MikuMikuDance, kanye ne-MakeHuman bonke babiza amajoints afanayo ngezindlela ezahlukene. I-canonicalizer isivele iyazi zonke lezi zikhulumi, futhi ingabhalela ifayela lakho endaweni.
rig-doctor.explain4_desc: I-rig ivame ukuwehluleka ngokuphelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umzimba nezandla zihlala zixhumene kanti imilenze ayixhumene, ngakho i-avatar ibhoda phansi ngezinyawo ezimisiwe. Ukuhlola iqembu ngalinye lemilenze ngokwehlukana kuyahluka phakathi kokuthi "62% kufakwe" nokuthi "imilenze yakho ayizukuhamba."
rig-doctor.hero_sub: Ama-animation clips abhekisela ezitheni ngegama. I-rig enama-joints abizwa ngokuthi Bip001 L UpperArm ilayisha kahle, ikhishwa kahle, bese ime ifakwe phakade. Faka i-.glb futhi wazi ngesecond, ngaphambi kokuthi uyilayishe noma kuphi.
rig-doctor.meta_desc: Faka i-.glb bese uthola ngesecond ukuthi izokwenza i-animation ku-three.ws. I-Rig Doctor ibiza umthetho wakho wesikhumba, ihlola iqembu ngalinye lemilenze, ilungisa amagama ezitho angajwayelekile kwi-browser yakho, futhi ibuyisela ifayela elilungisiwe. Akukho okulayishwayo.
rig-doctor.next1_desc: Yonke imoto i-rig yakho kufanele ihambisane nayo, iboniswa. Lokhu kuyinto eyenzelwe ama-joints angama-52.

sign-mirror.camera_note: Ukulandela izandla kwenzeka endaweni ngokusebenzisa i-MediaPipe. Vala ithebhu futhi izophela.
sign-mirror.chip: Ukuzijwayeza kwe-Handshape · kuhlolwa kudivayisi yakho
sign-mirror.course_copy: Izandla eziqandisiwe kuqala, izandla ezivulekile ezilandelayo, bese ama-pairs wonke umqeqeshi wokuqala adideka. I-letter iyagreen uma usuyibambe kahle; inqubekela phambili igcinwa kule divayisi. Ungacindezela noma iyiphi inkinobho ye-letter ukuze udlule ngqo kuyo.
sign-mirror.footer_note: Lena ingxenye yokuzijwayeza ye-loop yokusayina. Isikhumbuzo sezinhlamvu zonke nezibalo sitholakala ku-/asl-alphabet, amagama aphelele nezimpendulo zokuxoxa ezisayinwe ku-/sign-language, futhi injini engemuva kwalezi zihloko ezintathu ibhalwe ku-amakhasi ezilimi zokusayina futhi ithunyelwa njenge-@three-ws/sign-language iphakheji, engafakwa kusuka ku-clone kuze kube ukufakwa kwayo ku-rejistri. I-avatar, i-diagram ye-target, kanye ne-grader konke kufunda ispec ye-handshape efanayo, ngakho-ke okukhuluma nokuhlolwa akukwazi ukuhamba kude.
sign-mirror.hint_default: Vula ikhamera ukuze uhlolwe, noma kopisha umdwebo nje.
sign-mirror.lede: Ukubuka incwadi kulula. Lapha uyayenza: i-avatar yakha umgomo, ikhamera yakho ibuka isandla sakho, futhi le khasi lihlola isimo sesandla ngokuqhubekayo, ngofele. Bamba kahle futhi incwadi idlula. Bamba kabi futhi ibiza ifele. Nnothing ikhamera yakho ibona ayishiyi le tab.
sign-mirror.meta_desc: Funda i-ASL manual alphabet ngokuyakha, hhayi ngokuyibuka kuphela. I-avatar yakha incwadi, ikhamera yakho ibuka isandla sakho, futhi le khasi lihlola isimo sesandla ngokuqhubekayo futhi ibiza ifele elingalungile. Konke kuhlala kudivayisi yakho.
sign-mirror.page_title: Sign Mirror: yenza incwadi, uthole ukuhlolwa ngokuqhubekayo · three.ws
sign-mirror.share_desc: I-avatar yakha incwadi ye-ASL, ikhamera yakho ibuka isandla sakho, futhi le khasi lihlola isimo sesandla ngokuqhubekayo. Akukho ividiyo eshiywa kudivayisi yakho.
sign-mirror.share_title: Sign Mirror: yenza incwadi, uthole ukuhlolwa ngokuqhubekayo · three.ws
sign-mirror.title: I-mirror eyazi i-alphabet.
sign-mirror.video_idle: Ikhamera ivaliwe. Vula ukuze uhlolwe ngokuqhubekayo. Ividiyo, izimpawu zesandla, kanye nezikhumbuzo zihlala kule tab: akukho ukufonelwa kwenethiwekhi ku-loop yokuzilolonga. Noma skip ikhamera bese kopisha umfanekiso wesimo somgomo ngamehlo.

sign_language.a_signer_spells_names_and_loanwords_and: Umsayini upela amagama namagama abolekiwe bese esayina konke okunye. Lawa magama anezimpawu zangempela kusilulumagama se-avatar: ukuma kwesandla, indawo emzimbeni, nokunyakaza, esandleni esisodwa noma kuzo zombili. Khetha eyodwa ukuze uyibuke. Konke okunye emshweni kusapela ngeminwe.
sign_language.all_26_asl_letter_handshapes_plus_the: Zonke izimo zezandla zezinhlamvu ze-ASL ezingu-26 kanye nezinombolo 0-9, no-J no-Z abalandelwe kanye nokugxuma kwezinhlamvu ezimbili. Thayipha igama ku-Animation Studio bese uthumela ukusayina njenge-GLB egqwayizayo, noma wabelane ngayo njengesixhumanisi.
sign_language.american_sign_language_live_in_3d: Ulimi Lwezandla LwaseMelika · bukhoma ku-3D
sign_language.api_foot: Incazelo yonke: i-sign API · /api/sign encazelweni ye-API reference · umkhondo ophambene kuye /api/asl-recognition. Amagents angaishumayela njengento sign_text kwi-three.ws MCP server.
sign_language.api_lede: Konke okungaphezulu kuyahlelwa ebrawuzini. Ikhompayila efanayo iyasebenza esevini, ngakho-ke noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-app, i-agent noma i-engine lingacela ukusayinwa kwezinkulumo futhi lithole: i-animation clip ye-three.js ekeyed ku-skeleton esisisekelo se-humanoid, kunye nethayimlayini eyenziwayo. Akukho i-akhawunti, akukho i-key, akukho i-SDK. Bhala phansi uze ubuke umphumela we-endpoint oqinile.
sign_language.best_results_good_light_hand_in_frame: Imiphumela engcono kakhulu: ukukhanya okuhle, isandla esifreyimini, uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Izinombolo kanye nazo zonke izinhlamvu ze-A-Z ziyasekelwa.
sign_language.click_start_fingerspell_a_word_at_your: Chofoza qala, petha igama ekhamera yakho, bese uyama. Isiphequluli sakho siguqula ividiyo ibe izimpawu zesandla nomzimba endaweni; kuphela lezo zixhumanisi ezithunyelwa ukuze zibonwe. Ukupetha ngeminwe nge-webcam akuphelele (lindela uhlamvu olungalungile olungajwayelekile), ngakho-ke buyekeza umbhalo ngaphambi kokuthi uwuthembe.
sign_language.fingerspell_into_your_webcam_and_the_ai: Fingerspella ngewebhukhamera yakho bese i-AI iyifunda ibe umbhalo: izimpawu zikhishwa kudivayisi yakho, ngakho ividiyo ayilokothi ishiye umshini wakho. Idemo engezansi isebenzisa isihlonzi esifanayo.
sign_language.honest_scope_words_with_a_sign_are: Okufanele ukwazi: amagama anophawu ayasayinwa, konke okunye kufingerspellwa uhlamvu ngohlamvu. Izimpawu zihlanganiswa ngendlela yamagama esiNgisi, okuyi-Signed English, hhayi uhlelo lolimi lwe-ASL: i-ASL yangempela ihlela kabusha imisho, iguqula izenzo ngesikhala, futhi iphethe uhlelo lolimi ebusweni. Ulwazimagama olungenhla luyisethi yokuqala futhi luhloselwe ukukhula. Funda incazelo ephelele.
sign_language.meta_description: Ama-avatar e-three.ws asayina nge-American Sign Language. Fingerspella noma yiliphi igama noma inombolo, thola izimpendulo zengxoxo ezisayiniwe, futhi usayinele i-AI ngewebhukhamera yakho: yonke le nqubo, bukhoma ku-3D.
sign_language.meta_og_description: Ama-avatar asayina nge-ASL. Fingerspella noma yini, thola izimpendulo zengxoxo ezisayiniwe, futhi usayinele ngewebhukhamera yakho, bukhoma ku-3D.
sign_language.meta_twitter_description: Ama-avatar asayina nge-ASL: ukufingerspella, izimpendulo zengxoxo ezisayiniwe, nokufaka okusayinwe ngewebhukhamera, bukhoma ku-3D.
sign_language.three_ws_avatars_fingerspell_any_word_or: Ama-avatar e-three.ws afingerspella noma yiliphi igama noma inombolo nge-ASL, asayine yonke impendulo yengxoxo, futhi afunde ukusayina kwakho kusuka kuwebhukhamera. Ingxoxo yonke, izinhlangothi zombili, ku-3D esebenza kusiphequluli.
sign_language.turn_on_sign_mode_in_the_agent: Vula imodi yokusayina engxoxweni ye-agent futhi i-avatar isayina yonke impendulo: izimpawu zomtapo wolwazi lapho zikhona, ukufingerspella okunye. Noma iyiphi i-avatar efakiwe iyithola ngesici esisodwa se-sign-language.

signal_detail.meta_description: Okuphakelayo kwesiginali okukhokhelwayo komhwebi oqinisekisiwe — ukunemba okufakazelwe, imiphumela ebonakalayo, nobufakazi obuseketheni kuyo yonke isiginali. Bhalisa nge-agent yakho ukuze uzenzele isibuko.
