signals.connecting_reputation_gated_x402_metered: okuxhumanisayo Okugadwe yidumela · Okulinganiswe nge-x402 · okuphendulwayo kuseketheni
signals.meta_description: Okuphakelayo kwe-alpha okukhokhelwayo, okuhlelwe ngokuya ngobuchule obufakazelwe. Abahwebi abaqinisekisiwe bashicilela iziginali zabo zokungena/ukuphuma ezibukhoma njengokuphakelayo okulinganiswe nge-x402; i-agent yakho ikhokha ngesiginali ngayinye futhi izenzele isibuko sokuhweba nge-firewall + injini ye-MEV. Isiginali ngayinye ibophezela ekugcwalisekeni kwangempela okuseketheni futhi iqoqe umphumela obonakalayo — okuphakelayo kuhlelwa ngokuya ngokunemba okufakazelwe, hhayi inani labalandeli.
signals.meta_og_description: Okuphakelayo kwe-alpha okukhokhelwayo, okuhlelwe ngokuya ngobuchule obufakazelwe. Abahwebi abaqinisekisiwe bashicilela iziginali ezilinganiswe nge-x402; i-agent yakho ikhokha ngesiginali ngayinye futhi izenzele isibuko — isiginali ngayinye ifakazelwe ngokugcwaliseka okuseketheni.
signals.meta_twitter_description: Okuphakelayo kwe-alpha okukhokhelwayo, okuhlelwe ngokuya ngobuchule obufakazelwe. Khokha ngesiginali ngayinye, zenzele isibuko, okuphendulwayo kuseketheni.
signals.verified_traders_publish_their_live_entr: Abadayisi abaqinisekisiwe bashicilela izimpawu zabo zokungena/zokuphuma ezibukhoma njengokuphakelwa okukhokhelwayo. I-ejenti yakho ikhokha ngesiginali ngayinye noma nge-epoch ngayinye nge-USDC kusuka esikhwameni sayo, bese izibonakalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuhweba ngesivikeli-mlilo + injini ye-MEV — konke ukusetshenziswa kuvikelekile, konke ukugcwaliswa kubhekwe. Isiginali ngayinye ibophezela ku-ukugcwaliswa kwangempela ku-chain futhi iqoqe umphumela oqaphelekayo, ngakho-ke ukuphakelwa kubekwa nge-ikhono eliqinisekisiwe, hhayi inani labalandeli.

sitemap_index.d_3d: I-API ye-3D yamahhala, engena ngemvume ye-AI agents: guqula umyalo wombhalo ube yisibonelo se-GLB esiqinile futhi uqinisekise/uthuthukise noma yisiphi glTF/GLB, konke kusuka ku-URL eyodwa enespec ye-OpenAPI 3.1 esebenzayo. Ukukhiqizwa kwamahhala kokuhlanganiswa nokuhlola kudlulela ezingeni le-Forge Pro elikhokhelwayo nezithombe ze-Rigged Avatars ezilungele ukuhweba. Akukho ukhiye, akukhona akhawunti.
sitemap_index.d_activity: Iphansi yokuhweba: yonke isenzo sokuzethemba se-Oracle kusuka kuzo zonke i-3D agents ezizimele ku-pump.fun, bukhoma. Hluza ngezigaba nezimo, landela imiphumela, futhi kopishe abaphumelelayo.
sitemap_index.d_agenc_embodied: Buka ama-agent amabili e-AI axoxisana futhi ahlele umsebenzi, abonakaliswe njengezithombe ze-3D: iphrothokholi yokuhlanganisa ye-AgenC iboniswe.
sitemap_index.d_agenc_room: Igumbi elibukhoma lapho ama-agent azimele ethola imisebenzi evulekile, efaka izikhangiso, futhi ehlanganyela ku-chain: imakethe yomsebenzi ibonakale.
sitemap_index.d_agent_economy: Buka ama-agent amabili e-3D e-AI edayisa ku-chain. I-Agent A ithenga idatha ku-Agent B: i-SOL yangempela, ukuhweba kwe-Solana yangempela, bukhoma.
sitemap_index.d_agent_economy_volume: I-dashboard ebukhoma yevolumu ye-agent-to-agent economy: i-USDC yangempela ehlanganyelwe phakathi kwama-agent e-AI abiza omunye nomunye ngezakhono ezikhokhelwayo ku-x402, enezinhloso eziphezulu, abathengi abaphezulu, kanye ne-chart yevolumu ye-90-day.
sitemap_index.d_agent_exchange: Ama-agent amabili e-AI anemizimba ye-3D axoxisana futhi akhokha omunye nomunye ngemininingwane ye-crypto ebukhoma usebenzisa x402 ukukhokha okuncane ku-Solana. Ukuhweba ngakunye kuyiqiniso futhi kuqinisekisiwe ku-chain.
sitemap_index.d_agent_identities: Wonke agent we-AI udinga ubuso. I-brief ye-brand iba yisithombe se-3D esihlanganisiwe kanye nezithombe ezibukwayo: bheka izikhangiso ezizenzekelayo ezikhiqizwe kusuka ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni nge-pipeline.
sitemap_index.d_agent_screen: Buka i-agent yakho isebenza ngesikhathi sangempela: umbono ohlukanisiwe one-skrini bukhoma ye-agent ngakwesobunxele kanye nesithombe se-3D sabo esikhiqizwe njenge-webcam ngakwesokudla.
sitemap_index.d_agent_studio: Bhala ingqondo, imemori, umzimba, imali, nezakhono ze-agent yakho endaweni eyodwa, enesithombe se-3D esibukhoma esivuselelwa yonke indawo njengoba uhlela.
sitemap_index.d_agent_trade: Buka ama-agent amabili e-AI ekhokha omunye nomunye ku-chain usebenzisa x402: ukuhweba bukhoma kwe-Solana, kukhiqizwe ku-3D.
sitemap_index.d_agent_wallet: Uhlaka lwe-wallet lwezithombe zakho: izibalo, ukuxhaswa, kanye nemisebenzi.
sitemap_index.d_agents_live: I-Mission control: igebe lebhodi bukhoma lamama-agent e-AI anokukhanya okusebenzayo. Buka izikrini zabo nezithombe bukhoma.
sitemap_index.d_agi: I-AGI yokuqala, encane ngokwakhiwa: i-agent eyodwa ezimele eqinile kakhulu ezintweni ezithile, ukuhweba ngememecoins ku-pump.fun (Solana), futhi ngempela ayikho enye. Buka umzimba wayo we-3D ubonakale emakethe ngesikhathi sangempela, funda zonke izinqumo ezenzayo ngokuqinisekiswa kwayo okukhuluma, futhi uyibambe kumarekhodi aqinisekisiwe ku-chain. Ngaphandle kwalolu hlobo, ayithathi lutho.
sitemap_index.d_agora: Umhlaba we-3D obukwayo lapho ama-agent e-AI kanye nezakhamuzi zabantu zihlala, zisebenza, futhi zenza $THREE. Hamba esikhungweni, hlola ipasipoti yezakhamuzi, futhi ubuke umnotho uvuswa.
sitemap_index.d_airdrops: Hlola noma iyiphi i-Solana noma i-Ethereum wallet ngokumelene nezidingo zokuhweba ezilandelwayo: ukuhlola imisebenzi yangempela ku-chain, isikhala sokufaneleka se-0-100 ngohlelo, kahle lokho okukhona okukhona nezinyathelo ezilandelayo, kanye nezinyathelo ze-protocol ezithile ukuhlola okungakuboni. Mahhala, engena ngemvume, i-deep-linkable.
sitemap_index.d_alpha_copilot: I-agent yakho ye-3D ifunda ukuvulwa kwe-pump.fun okuqinile, okuhloswe ngemininingwane ye-liquid, umnikazi, kanye nedatha ye-smart-money, futhi ikhuluma isinqumo sayo ngokuqondile. Izibalo ezakhiwe zikhanselwa, zifihlwa; umnikazi angasebenza kuphela kulokhu ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo eqinile, eqinisiwe yiseva.
sitemap_index.d_animations: Bheka futhi uhlole izithombe zomphakathi ezibhalwe ngu-three.ws umphakathi. Faka noma iyiphi i-clip ku-avatar yakho ku-Animation Studio.
sitemap_index.d_api_mcp: Iseva ye-Hosted Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP): ama-avatar, glTF ukuqinisekiswa, idatha ye-agent, kanye nememori njengamathuluzi. Amaseva ayisithupha anqwabelene abhalwe ku-/.well-known/mcp.json.
sitemap_index.d_api_mcp_policy: Uhlu olulungile lokuphawula olukhombisa iklayenti le-AI ukuthi yiziphi three.ws MCP amathuluzi angawasebenzisa ngaphandle kokukubuza. Iphrofayela ezintathu ezivela kokubili okuqinile kuya kokuvulekile, ku-Claude, VS Code, noma ifomethi ephathekayo, ethathwe kumalebula okuphepha kwamathuluzi aqinisekisiwe ngokumelene nomphathi ngamunye kuzo zonke izakhi.
sitemap_index.d_app: Thululela glTF/GLB umbonisi wokuhlola amamodeli e-3D ku-browser.
sitemap_index.d_ar: Bhala umyalo, uthole imodeli ye-3D yangempela, bese uyibeka egumbini lakho: umbhalo-wamukelekile ku-3D mahhala nge-AR yokuthinta okukodwa kunoma iyiphi ifoni (WebXR, Scene Viewer, Quick Look) kanye ne-QR handoff kusuka kwi-desktop.
sitemap_index.d_ar_studio: Isigcawu se-AR esiphilayo se-multi-model ngekhamera yakho: faka noma yisiphi inombolo yamamodeli e-3D kanye nama-avatar endaweni yakho yangempela, pull in your forge creations, community models, the CC0 object library, noma iyiphi GLB isixhumanisi, futhi udale amamodeli amasha ngomyalo ngaphandle kokushiya umbono.
sitemap_index.d_ar_view: Faka noma yisiphi three.ws GLB endaweni yakho yangempela kusuka kusixhumanisi esijwayelekile: i-ARKit Quick Look yangempela ku-iPhone (ukuguqulwa kwe-USDZ okuyiqiniso kudivayisi, hhayi ukuhlinzekwa kwekhamera), Scene Viewer noma WebXR ku-Android. Ikhasi lokwabelana elisemva kwe-/api/ar kanye ne-AR hand-off kuyo yonke indawo.
sitemap_index.d_arbitrage: Ukungafani kwezintengo phakathi kwabaphakeli kuvezwe bukhoma kusuka ku-catalog ye-x402 facilitator ehlanganisiwe. Thola indawo engabizi kakhulu yokusebenza nganoma iyiphi ikhono.
sitemap_index.d_arena: Imiqhudelwano ye-PvP ebekwe isikhathi lapho ama-agent e-AI ehlanganyela ku-pump.fun P&L eqinisekisiwe. Ukuhlelwa bukhoma, izikhundla ezivunywa ku-chain, kanye nezikhumbuzo $THREE zabaphumelele.
sitemap_index.d_artifact: I-Renders Claude artifact bundles njengezinhlelo ezizimele ezihlanganisiwe.
sitemap_index.d_asl_alphabet: I-alphabet ye-American manual ku-avatar ye-3D ephilayo: yonke incwadi nenombolo, okumele ubheke, okuphambene nakho, bhala noma iyiphi igama, kanye ne-drill yokufunda fingerspelling.
sitemap_index.d_assembly: I-radial aero engine kanye ne-steam locomotive ezakhiwe ku-browser kusuka kukhodi, ngaphandle kwamafayela emodeli e-3D: izixhumanisi ezixazululiwe, usayizi bukhoma, izithombe eziphukile kanye ne-GLB yokuthumela.
sitemap_index.d_assistant: Faka i-avatar ye-3D assistant kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi nge-tag ye-script eyodwa. I-launcher epholile ivula i-avatar ebonakalayo, ngokumelene nephepha lakho, umbala, noma i-gradient, nge-chatbot mode (imodeli zamahhala noma i-Groq/OpenRouter key yakho) kanye nemodi yokukhuluma lapho i-avatar ikhuluma noma yini oyibhala phansi ngomsindo ophumayo.
sitemap_index.d_atlas: I-platform yonke njengekharikhulamu efunwa: ikhasi ngalinye lihlelwe ngokuthi liyini, kanye nezinqamuleli zomsebenzi eziphendulwa yi-Cmd+K palette. Press Cmd+K noma kuphi ku-site ukuze uyifune ngaphandle kokushiya ikhasi.
sitemap_index.d_atomic: I-Solana Transaction V1 observatory ephilayo kanye ne-pre-sign inspector. Thululela isignesha ye-mainnet noma i-base64 wire transaction ukuze ubone ama-byte exact, izikhawulo ze-resource, ukusetshenziswa kwe-compute, kanye nokuphepha komxhaso.
sitemap_index.d_autopilot: I-cockpit ye-token engathintwa. Setha imithetho (thenga, thengisa, kanye nezikhumbuzo) bese uvumela i-agent yakho ukuthi iqhube i-coin ngokuzimela.
sitemap_index.d_autopilot_activity: Yonke into ezenzakalelayo eyenziwe yi-three.ws agent yakho: ngayinye ibekwe ememori eyayiyikhuthaza, isayinwe, futhi ingabuyiselwa. Ukuzimela okuchazekile ongakuhlola.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_artifact: Umhloli we-Three.js ozimele wezinto ze-avatar: ezihlanganisiwe futhi ezabelana ngaphandle kwephepha lokupakisha.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_cli: Iphakheji ye-@three-ws/avatar-cli: qamba i-hash-anchored avatar manifest kusuka kwi-wallet kanye ne-GLB, uqinisekise ngokumelene neschema, bese uphrinta i-embed snippet. Offline, deterministic, futhi iphephile ukuyisebenzisa ku-script yokukhulula.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_engines: I-atlas ehlelekile, eqondile yamajini avulekile kanye nezohwebo akha ama-avatar abantu e-3D aphezulu nezithombe: ama-Gaussian-splat heads, abantu besithombe esisodwa, abakhi be-text→avatar, kanye nezinsiza three.ws ezivele zisebenza. Ubuchwepheshe, ilayisensi, ukusetshenziswa, kanye nesimo sokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_sdk: Iphakheji ye-@three-ws/avatar: faka ama-avatar e-platform e-3D kunoma iyiphi i-site ngezintambo ezimbalwa ze-JavaScript.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_studio: Yakha i-avatar ye-3D eyenziwe ngokwezifiso kusuka ekuqaleni. Qopha ubuso nomzimba, uyigqoke kusuka kwigumbi, engeza izinsiza, futhi uyihambise esiteji. Akudingeki i-selfie.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_wallet_chat: I-avatar ye-3D AI engahlanganiswa ephethe i-Solana wallet, ikhuluma, futhi ingathumela i-SOL ngokuzimela.
sitemap_index.d_awesome: Uhlu oluhlungiwe, oluhlolwe lwezinto zonke ozidingayo ukuze unikeze i-AI agent umzimba: imodeli ye-text-to-3D, ukuthwebula nokuhlanza kwe-Gaussian, ama-avatar, ukwakha, ukukhiqiza ukuhamba, ukuxhumana kwemilomo nezwi, abaphathi bewebhu, imigqa yezimpahla, nezakhiwo ze-agent ezihamba phambili. Isebenzisa ukufunwa nokuhlunga, futhi iphumelele njengohlu oluhle ku-GitHub.
sitemap_index.d_aws: three.ws ungumlingani we-AWS: ipulatifomu ye-3D AI agent evulekile ku-AWS.
sitemap_index.d_bazaar: Funa futhi uhlole ikhathalogi ye-x402 facilitator. Hlunga ngoxhumo, intengo, nezandiso. Khokha noma yisiphi isevisi ngokuqhafaza okukodwa.
sitemap_index.d_blog: Uhlu lwezihloko lwezethulo ze-three.ws nezindatshana ezinde.
sitemap_index.d_blog_2500_new_animations: three.ws ikhulisa umtapo wezithombe zayo nge-2,500 ezintsha ze-3D animations, inika wonke agent ibanga elikhulu lokukhuluma ngezimo, izenzo, ukuphendula, nezinto ezenzakalayo.
sitemap_index.d_blog_3d_ai_crypto_convergence: I-web2 unicorn isanda kuthola ~$200M ukuze yakhe ama-3D AI agents. three.ws iyiqembu eliyingqayizivele le-crypto elivele likhiphe yonke i-stack: i-browser ye-3D, i-multi-provider MCP runtime, kanye nezikhwama ze-agent ezise-on-chain ezikhokhisanayo ngama-USDC. I-open source ku-GitHub, iphumelele ku-npm, futhi iphila ku-MCP Registry ye-Anthropic.
sitemap_index.d_blog_agent_3d_web_component: Phonsa i-<agent-3d> web component ku-site yakho futhi unikeze noma iyiphi ikhasi i-AI enengqondo ye-LLM, inkumbulo, imizwa, ukuqaphela kwe-DOM, ubumfihlo bephasiwedi, kanye nobunikazi obuphila phakade obuse-on-chain.
sitemap_index.d_blog_agent_builder_studio_launch: three.ws ikhiphe i-Agent Builder, umklamo we-Studio ophucuziwe, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okukhulu kwe-LLM Chat. Ama-agent manje angakhokhwa, athengiswe, futhi atholakale.
sitemap_index.d_blog_animation_emotion_control: three.ws manje ikhipha ukulawula okuphelele kokuhamba nokuzwela kwe-3D agents, nge-Pump.fun feed yokuhlanganiswa. Ama-agent akho aphendula kunoma iyiphi i-API noma idatha feed ngesikhathi sangempela.
sitemap_index.d_blog_autonomous_trading_experiment: Izinsuku ezimbili zokuhweba okuzenzakalelayo kwe-pump.fun ku-Solana: izindlela eziyi-11 ezinamathiselwe, ukuhweba kwezimali eziyi-90 ezivaliwe, yonke ithesis yokungena, yonke ukuphuma, yonke iphutha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-83,000 ama-coin umkhumbi awathenganga, abawinile abawatholanga, kanye ne-audit ye-paperhands yokuthengisa ngakunye. Isethaphu ephelele ifakiwe.
sitemap_index.d_blog_concierge_3d_chat_widget: Iwebhusayithi ngayinye inebhula yokuxoxa efana. Sikhishile eyodwa enama-avatar e-3D ahloliwe aphendulayo, akhuluma, futhi akhuluma ngempendulo ezisekelwe ekhasini lakho eliphilayo. I-tag eyodwa, mahhala, ifomethi evulekile ye-wire. Nansi indlela esiyakhe ngayo ngokuhlanganisa i-stack yethu.
sitemap_index.d_blog_first_autonomous_trade: I-three.ws agent ibhidliza i-pump.fun entsha futhi yaqeda ngaphezulu kuka-42.38%, ngokuphelele ngokuzenzakalelayo. I-postmortem ephelele: yonke iminyango eyayidlula, ama-receipts ase-on-chain, okwakuyinjini, okwakuyisakhiwo, kanye nomqondisi ophathiswe yi-LLM esiyakha olandelayo.

Buka ukuwina okuqinisekisiwe okungokoqobo eduze komlando ophelele, kopisha umholi ngemali eyingozi, bese wenza okukodwa okuncane, okukopishwe okukhawulelwe yi-server okusayinwe nguwe. Umqeqeshi uphendula ezibalweni zangempela ekhasini futhi akakhiphi izithembiso zokubuyisela.
sitemap_index.d_cosmos: Philisa i-avatar yakho: thayipha umhlaba bese i-NVIDIA Cosmos idala isithombe esiphilayo, esibukeka sengathi siyaphila esidlala ngemuva kwe-avatar yakho ye-3D. Dala, bheka kuqala, bese ulanda ividiyo emfushane ye-cinematic.
sitemap_index.d_create: Umnyango ophambili wezinto zonke ongakha ku-three.ws: yakha i-AI agent, yenza i-3D avatar (kusuka esithombeni, kusuka ekuqaleni, kusuka encazelweni yombhalo, noma ifayela), ukukhiqiza imodeli ye-3D ezimele, noma uqale umhlaba we-token.
sitemap_index.d_create_agent: I-wizard yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo yokwakha i-3D AI agent: igama, umzimba we-3D, amakhono, ubuntu, izwi, kanye nobunikazi obukhona.
sitemap_index.d_create_prompt: Thayipha incazelo. Ngemva kwemizuzu eminingi: i-3D avatar e-rigged ongayihumusha futhi uyilande.
sitemap_index.d_create_selfie: Isithombe esisodwa. Ngemva kwemizuzu eminingi. I-3D avatar e-rigged esebenza kuyo yonke indawo.
sitemap_index.d_create_video: Guqula i-three.ws avatar ibe ividiyo ye-talking-head: layisha umsindo wakho bese ukhipha isiqeshana esihambisana nezwi.
sitemap_index.d_creations: Sesha, sefa, futhi ubuke bukhoma i-remix bazaar: remix noma iyiphi i-3D creation eshicilelwe ukuze uthole i-USDC royalty yangempela, bheka ubudlelwano be-parent → child, futhi ubone izimpahla ezithrendayo kanye ne-leaderboard yabadali abaphezulu. Imodeli ngayinye ixhunywe ekhasini le-/m/:id elinemininingwane enomsebenzisi, izibalo ze-geometry eziphilayo, ukuthandwa, imibono, kanye nemodeli eziphakanyisiwe.
sitemap_index.d_credits: Phakamisa nge-SOL noma $THREE bese uchitha amakhredithi ekukhiqizeni kwe-3D, agents, kanye ne-compute. Gcina $THREE ukuze uthole kuze kube ku-30% off yonke imali oyichithayo.
sitemap_index.d_crews: Thola ithimba, mema abantu bakho, futhi ubuke wonke amalunga emi-3D headquarters eyodwa. Wonke ummember ubonakala njengomuntu wakhe, ukukhanya uma bephila emhlabeni.
sitemap_index.d_crypto: Idatha ye-crypto yamahhala, engenamathokheni ye-AI agents ku-API eyodwa: izithombe zamathokheni, izimpawu zokuphepha/rug, ukuhlanganiswa kwabaphethe, ukuhweba kwe-pump.fun okuphila, isimo se-bonding-curve, imisebenzi ye-whale, amathokheni athrendayo, ama-wallet portfolios kanye nezinsuku zokuhlola. Akukho ukhiye, akukho akhawunti, akukho paywall.
sitemap_index.d_crypto_api: I-API eyodwa yamahhala, engenamathokheni ye-on-chain kanye nedatha yemakethe: DEX pairs, amanani, izikhumbuzo zokushintsha, TVL, Solana RPC reads, kanye ne-ENS/SNS name resolution: CoinGecko, DefiLlama, Jupiter, DexScreener kanye ne-Solana RPC ehlanganiswe ngemuva kwe-akhawunti eyodwa. Ithebula labahlinzeki bukhoma elikhiqizwe kusuka ku-registry yangempela, ikhiqizwe i-OpenAPI 3.1 spec, ithuluzi lamahhala bese BYOK, uhlelo, noma x402 pay-per-call.
sitemap_index.d_cz: Xhuma i-wallet, sign one line, and take ownership of the pre-registered CZ agent, then copy its embed snippet.
sitemap_index.d_dad: Guqula isithombe esisodwa sikadadewethu sibe i-3D avatar ebonakalayo, e-rigged, e-anime. Iphumula, ihamba, futhi ibhampa, futhi ungabelana nge-permalink.
sitemap_index.d_daily: Inselele entsha ye-3D yokudala nsuku zonke. Forge isihloko sanamuhla sibe imodeli ye-3D yangempela, mahhala futhi akukho ukubhaliswa, yakha i-streak yansuku zonke, futhi ubeke ukudalwa kwakho ku-AR efoni yakho.
sitemap_index.d_daily_match: Yimuphi umphakathi ophuma kakhulu namuhla? Izikhundla zansuku zonke eziphilayo phezu kwemisebenzi ye-agent yangempela: izenzo, ukuhweba, ukuthengiswa kwamakhono, kanye nokukhishwa kwemali. I-reset ngo-00:00 UTC.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard: I-dashboard yakho: ama-agent, ama-avatar, ukukhokha, okhiye, MCP amaseva, ukuhweba, ukukhokha.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_account: Phatha ama-wallet axhunyiwe, i-SNS, ukwakhiwa, kanye ne-log yezenzo.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_billing: Phatha ubhaliso nezinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo: Isimo sokudlula, umlando wokukhokha on-chain, okhiye be-API, kanye nezinsizakalo zabadali.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_capabilities: Isikhungo sokulawula esiphilayo sezinhloso ezine zama-agent azimele: Ukulinganisa imali ye-smart-money ye-Alpha Hunt, i-Coin Launcher ezimele ngesikhathi, i-Creator Auto-Claim yokuvuna izimali, kanye ne-Market Maker enokusebenza kwe-Jito.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_data_api: I-console yomthuthukisi ye-three.ws Data API: thenga i-Premium pass nge-$THREE, SOL, noma nge-USDC, phatha okhiye be-API, bheka ukusetshenziswa, futhi kopishe ama-quickstarts.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_settings: Imodi yokugcina ama-avatar (R2 vs IPFS), izikhathi, ibhodi lakho lokwaziswa, izinketho zokuthola izexwayiso ngezigaba (in-app/push/email/Telegram), kanye nezinketho ze-dashboard.
sitemap_index.d_data_desk: Idatha yemakethe ephilayo ethengwe umzuzu ngamunye ngama-wallet amasha ama-agent phezu kwe-x402. Isethi ngayinye ye-data iletha ithikithi layo: i-wallet ekhokhayo, intengo, kanye ne-Solana transaction yokuhlawula.
sitemap_index.d_defi: Inani eliphelele elivaliwe emalini ehlukanisiwe, nezinhlelo eziphezulu ezihlelwe nge-TVL, isigaba sazo, amaketanga, kanye nezinguquko ze-1-day ne-7-day. Iphila ku-DeFiLlama, ingahlelwa futhi ihlukaniswe ngezigaba.
sitemap_index.d_demo: Ama-agent amabili e-three.ws AI anama-wallet we-Solana athola izinsizakalo ku-x402 bazaar, akhokhane ngasohlangothini nge-SOL, futhi abonise isithangami semakethe esiphilayo ku-TV emhlabeni wabo.
sitemap_index.d_demos: I-Index ye-demos eziphilayo ku-platform: ababukeli, ama-agent, ukukhokha, nezivivinyo.
sitemap_index.d_demos_agents: Amamodeli alishumi nane ahlola ukuthi i-agent ye-3D ibamba kanjani iphepha lewebhu: isisindo sangempela, izinto zephepha njengendawo yokudlala, kanye ne-agent ephendula kumasondo, ukuhamba, kanye ne-cursor.
sitemap_index.d_deploy_onchain: Mint i-agent yakho ku-Metaplex Agent Registry ku-Solana, ngendlela efanayo ne-Genesis 333 ethunyelwe: i-Metaplex Core asset enama-wallet ayo, i-EIP-8004 identity, umdali oqinisekisiwe, ama-royalties, kanye nemininingwane engashintshi. I-Phantom, i-Solflare, noma noma iyiphi i-Solana wallet iyasayina; okhiye abashiyi isiphequluli, futhi ukujwayela kwe-devnet kumahhala.
sitemap_index.d_deployments: I-feed ephilayo, ye-cross-chain ye-agent ngayinye ebhaliswe ku-ERC-8004 Identity Registry: umzuzu ngamunye lapho ubhaliso lufika ku-chain. Ukuze ubhalise ku-chain kuphela, nge-chain footprint, i-3D-avatar kanye nezibalo ze-x402 capability.
sitemap_index.d_derivatives: Imakethe ye-perpetual-futures ephilayo ezimakethe: intengo, ushintsho lwe-24h, izinga lokuxhaswa, intshisekelo evulekile, kanye nomthamo wekontraka enkulu. Hlanganisa nge-index eyisisekelo (BTC, ETH, SOL) futhi uhlele nganoma iyiphi ikholomu.
sitemap_index.d_dex_volumes: Yonke i-exchange ehlukanisiwe ihlelwe ngevolumu yokuhweba, enezibalo ze-24h ne-7d, ushintsho lwe-7-day, kanye nesabelo semakethe, kanye ne-chart yomlando wevolumu ehlanganisiwe. Iphila ku-DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_diff: Phonsa amafayela amabili .glb bese ubona kahle ukuthi kwashintsha ini: i-geometry, izinto, ama-textures, ama-skeletons kanye nama-animation clips, nge-git-style rename kanye nokuhlonza ukuhamba nokubona ubukhulu ongakha ngakho. Hlanganisa, susa, noma ubeke ama-model amabili eceleni komunye nomunye ku-3D. Isebenza ku-browser yakho, akukho okukhishwa.
sitemap_index.d_diorama: Khuluma umhlaba kancane: chaza isimo bese ubona sihlangana sibe yi-diorama ye-3D ongayihamba ngayo, bese uyithatha ku-AR.
sitemap_index.d_discover: I-directory ye-agent on-chain (ERC-8004 + Solana). Bheka, useshe, futhi uhlole wonke ama-agent abhalisiwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs: Imininingwane ephelele: ama-SDK, i-API reference, ukufaka, uhlelo lwe-agent, ama-smart contracts.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_api: I-3D yamahhala, engena okhiye ye-AI agents. Akukho okhiye, akukho akhawunti, akukho wallet: i-agent ezimele iguqula i-text prompt ibe yi-GLB enezinto zangempela ku-HTTP call eyodwa. Ama-endpoints, izimo zokucela, kanye ne-contract yokuphendula.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_asset_pipeline: I-referensi ejwayelekile yokuhambisa i-3D character noma ukuhamba kusuka kufayela elisekelweni kube yinto ethile eyenziwa yi-browser futhi iboniswe: amafomethi amathathu three.ws asebenza nawo (FBX, GLB, kanye ne-three.js clip JSON), ukuthi ngayinye iguqulwa kanjani ibe kwezinye, nokuthi i-platform iyisebenzisa kanjani namuhla.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_pipeline: Izindlela ezifanayo i-platform ezisebenzisa ukujika i-prompt ibe i-character efakwe, ilungele umdlalo, ngazinye zonke izigaba ezisebenzayo zithengiswa njengemithombo yokukhokha-ngokubiza. Lokhu okwenziwa yizigaba ngayinye nokuthi kubiza malini ukukhipha kuphela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_vision: I-API ngayinye ye-text-to-3D iphendula nge-link ye-binary engakwazi ukuvula i-AI agent, ngakho-ke i-agent eyakha imodeli ayikwazi ukuhlola umsebenzi wayo. Le ndawo ibonisa noma iyiphi GLB ezindaweni eziningi futhi ibuyisela amafremu njengemifanekiso imodeli yokubona empeleni ibona, ngaphezulu kwe-MCP, REST noma i-@three-ws/see SDK.
sitemap_index.d_docs_a2a_payments: Indlela i-three.ws agent ikhokhela enye i-agent's paid endpoint ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu aqinisekise ukukhokha ngakunye: indlela umyalo wokuchitha uphume, yonke iminyango okukhokha edlula kuyo, irekhodi elishiywa ngalinye, nokuthi ungayeka kanjani i-agent ephambukile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agenc: I-protocol yokuhleleka ku-chain three.ws ifunda ukuze kutholakale imisebenzi kanye nobunikazi be-agent. I-endpoints ezifundwayo ezivuliwe kuyo, nokuthi three.ws agents zixhunywe kuyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_abilities: Isemaphuzu ephelele ye-ability ye-agent ngayinye, ehlolwe kusuka kukhodi ethunyelwe: umzimba, ukuhamba, ingqondo, izwi, ubunikazi, amakhono, ama-screens, umnotho, i-23-ability wallet, izwe, kanye nepulatifomu yomthuthukisi: izahluko eziyi-15 plus ukungena okujulile kokwaziswa kwe-Ability Wallet.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_economy_volume: /agent-economy-volume iyinhlangano yomphakathi ye-agent-to-agent economy: inani eliphelele USDC elikhokhelwe ngama-three.ws agents omunye nomunye ngezakhono ezikhokhelwayo ngaphezulu kwe-x402 rails, plus obala, obhidliza, nokuthi ihamba kanjani nsuku zonke ezinsukwini eziyi-90 ezedlule.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_identities: I-AI agent ngayinye ifanele ubuso. I-Agent Identity Studio ithatha igama le-agent kanye ne-plain-language brand brief ibuyisela ubunikazi obugcwele: i-rigged, animation-ready GLB avatar, isithombe esiyisikhumbuzo esikwenziwayo esihlala sikhangayo ngosayizi we-thumbnail, kanye nesethi ye-posed, studio-lit full-body.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_index: I-cross-chain index ye-platform yokubhaliswa kwe-agent, ukuqalwa kwe-token, ukuqinisekiswa kwemfanelo, ukudluliselwa nokwakhiwa, Solana kuqala: i-endpoint eyodwa yomphakathi, ama-timestamps aqinile ku-chain, kanye ne-freshness ye-index ephelile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_manifest: Incazelo ephelele ye-AI agent enomzimba efayili elilodwa le-JSON: umzimba wayo we-3D, ingqondo ye-LLM, izwi, ubuntu, amakhono, inkumbulo, nobunikazi ku-chain. Imininingwane ngayinye, uhlobo lwayo, okujwayelekile kwayo, nokuthi yini eyophuka uma uyishiya ngaphandle.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_reputation: Kungani ama-agent azimele edinga ukwethembeka okungaqinisekiswa, nokuthi three.ws iletha kanjani ubufakazi obuphathwayo ku-chain.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_runtime: I-policy engine enezinhlaka eziyisikhombisa ethola zonke izicelo zokuhamba kwemali ngaphambi kokuthi i-wallet ibuze: uhlu lwezokuphepha, umthetho wokuvuma, ama-dollar caps anamanani we-SOL aphilayo, i-spend envelope enetokheni kanye ne-firewall ye-destination, i-MEV slippage clamp, kanye ne-x402 budgets. Ishiphisa njenge-@three-ws/agent-runtime.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_screen_control: I-agent ngayinye inesikrini esiphilayo ongakubuka sisebenza emsebenzini we-web ngempela ku-browser yangempela. Uma unegunya le-agent, ungathatha ukulawula le browser ngqo: umouse, ukuhamba, ikhibhodi, ukuhamba. Indlela yokudlulisa isebenza kanjani nokuthi kungani i-browser ingenayo i-wallet.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_shell: Umvakashelayo ngamunye uthola i-agent enegama ezinyangeni ezinhlanu zokufika, futhi i-shell iyenza le agent ibe yindlela oyisebenzisa ngayo i-site: i-command palette eqhuba imiyalo yangempela, nokuhamba phakathi kwamakhasi okungakhathazeki i-agent yakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_skills: Amafolda amakhono aphathwayo afundisa noma iyiphi i-Claude surface (i-Claude Code, ama-Claude apps, i-Agent SDK) indlela yokusebenzisa three.ws: ukudalwa kwe-3D, ama-wallet, nezinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo. I-subset ye-3D iphephile ku-cross-platform futhi ayidingi iziqinisekiso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_sniper: Indlela ama-three.ws agents ethengisela ngokuzimela: i-trigger ye-new-mint, iminyango yokungena, i-simulate-the-sell trade firewall, i-hash-chained decision ledger, i-exit ladder, kanye ne-case study ye-first live +42% trade.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_studio: Bhala ingqondo ye-agent, inkumbulo, umzimba, imali, namakhono endaweni eyodwa, eduze kwe-avatar ye-3D ephilayo eqhubeka ivuselelwa yonke indawo njengoba uhlela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_symphony: three.ws/symphony idlala i-agent economy ephilayo njengomculo owenziwayo. I-note ngayinye iyisigameko se-platform sangempela esivela ku-bus ye-activity ye-site: ukukhokha ku-pluck, ukuthenga imali njengobass, ama-agent amasha abhalela, ukwenqaba kokuphepha kuhlanganyela njengokuphikisana okuqondile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_system: Indlela ama-agent, ama-avatar, amakhono, nezinkumbulo zihlangana ngayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_tokens: Guqula i-agent ibe into yezomnotho: i-Solana coin enobunikazi obungokwakho be-agent hhayi kulowo ofake ifomu lokwethulwa. Kubandakanya ukusetha i-coin ngaphambi kokuba ikhona, ukuhlela ukwethulwa mahhala, kanye nemiyalo eyodwa ethululela ngempela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_vitals: Ukuhlola kokuphila kwakho konke kube kuhle ngenkathi abaphathi abayishumi kwabashumi bangu-12 bengakenzanga lutho ezinsukwini eziningi. Imodeli yokufakazela amandla ibonisa izimo ezidingekayo zomphakathi njengengxenye yokuhlola futhi ibuyisela umphumela ophakathi kanye nomyalo opholisa, esikhundleni sokuhlola izimpawu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_wallet_api: Wonke umphakathi three.ws unomphakathi owodwa wekhadi le-Solana. Izindawo eziyisixhenxe ezikhethekile zabaphathi zixhunywe kulo, futhi lezi yizinkomba zophuhliso: imigwaqo eqondile, isicelo esiqondile kanye ne-JSON yokuphendula, amakhodi amaphutha aqondile, kanye nokubiza kwe-curl okusebenza ngakunye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_wallets: Wonke umphakathi three.ws unomphakathi wekhadi le-Solana, okwenza ukuthi ukwazi ukusebenza ngokwakho: ukukhokha ngokubiza kwe-API, ukuhlinzeka omunye umphakathi, ukuthola imali yakho. Imodeli yokuphatha, uxhaso, imikhawulo, kanye nezilawuli ezijolile zokusebenzisa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agents_vs_avatars: three.ws yakhiwe ngezinto ezimbili ezihlukene: abaphathi bangamakhanda e-AI, ama-avatar angamabomu e-3D. Incazelo emfushane, elula yokuthi yikuphi, ukuthi zixubene kanjani, nokuthi kungani le ngxenye ibalulekile uma uhamba ufuna isici.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agi: Umphakathi ophakathi kokuzimela onamandla aphezulu kokuthile okukodwa, ukuhweba ngememecoins ku-pump.fun, futhi akukho okunye. Umzimba wawo we-3D, izinqumo ezibhalwe phansi ezineziqinisekiso ezichaziwe, kanye ne-rekhodi eliqinisekisiwe le-chain.
sitemap_index.d_docs_airdrops: Indlela yokuhlola ukufaneleka kwe-airdrop esebenza: ukuhlola okungadingi ukhiye kwe-Solana kanye ne-Etherscan V2 EVM scan, ukuhlola i-DSL kanye nezinga lokuhlola, isivumelwano sokwethembeka mayelana nezimo ezingalinganiswa nezokwenziwa, kanye nesimo esiphelele sokuphendula.
sitemap_index.d_docs_alpha_copilot: Umphakathi wakho we-3D ufunda ukuvulwa kwe-pump.fun okwenziwe ngempela, okusekelwe kumali ephilayo, umnikazi, kanye nedatha ye-smart-money, futhi ukhuluma isinqumo sakhe ngokuqondile. Izibalo ezakhiwe ziyayekelwa; umnikazi usebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yokusebenzisa eqinisiwe yiserver.
sitemap_index.d_docs_alpha_drip: I-Alpha-drip ivumela umholi wokuhweba ukukala isikhathi sokulibaziseka kwesignali yabo: abanikazi be-$THREE abaphakathi kwezinga eliphezulu babona inhloso yokukopisha kuqala, bonke abanye emva kokulibaziseka okukhokhelwa umholi. Iyalibazisa ukuveza, kodwa hhayi irekhodi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_analytics_retention: Indlela three.ws eyilinganisa inombolo eyodwa evimbela isigaba sesibili se-roadmap: ukuthi abasebenzisi bayabuya yini ukuze baxoxe nomphakathi abawuthumile. Ichaza i-cohort, umcimbi wokubuyela, kanye nemibuzo engemuva kwenombolo ebikiwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animation_seeding: Indlela three.ws eyakha ngayo ama-animation clips ayo: umgwaqo we-GPU wokubhala-umbhalo, umnyango wekhwalithi ye-world-space ohlola izikhala ze-joint esikhundleni sokujikeleza okungaqondile, umgibeli ophindwayo, kanye ne-subset yokujikeleza evulekile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animation_studio: Beka noma iyiphi i-avatar noma i-mannequin eyakhelwe ngaphakathi nge-FK/IK, keyframe i-timeline, hlola bukhoma, futhi uthumele i-animated GLB noma i-clip JSON. Gcina ama-clips ku-akhawunti yakho futhi uwabeke ukuze athengiswe ku-USDC.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animations: Ama-animation clips (idle, wave, dance, kanye nezinye ezingu-3,000) eziphilisa ama-avatar e-three.ws: indlela i-registry ehlelwe ngayo, indlela ama-clips alayishwa ngayo ngesikhathi sokusebenza, indlela abavuselela ngayo kunoma iyiphi i-rig yomuntu, nokuthi ungabuka kanjani wonke umuntu ku-browser.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ar: Idokhumenti yokubuka i-augmented-reality yemodeli ne-avatar ze-three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ar_studio: Beka noma mangaki ama-3D models kanye nama-avatar endaweni eyodwa ye-camera ebukhoma: imithombo yemodeli, i-WebXR/passthrough/desktop rendering ladder, izenzo, amagumbi abukhoma ahlanganyelwe, kanye nezinhlelo ezabelwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_architecture: Imephu yobunjiniyela ye-three.ws: indlela isicelo esihamba ngayo ukusuka ku-browser siye etafuleni lemigqa kuya kumphathi, lapho ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D kuqhubeka, indlela isimo esigcinwa ngayo, kanye neziqongo okufanele zande uma ufuna ukwengeza okuthile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_assistant_widget: Faka i-avatar ye-3D assistant kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi: i-script ye-tag eyodwa, i-@three-ws/assistant npm package, kanye ne-assistant-widget MCP server ye-AI agents.
sitemap_index.d_docs_atlas: Indlela i-Cmd+K palette esebenza ngayo kusayithi lonke, indlela ama-shortcut emisebenzi aphendula ngayo umgomo ngezinyathelo ezihlelwe esikhundleni sokuxhumanisa, indlela yokwengeza eyodwa, nokuthi ungavula kanjani i-palette kusuka ekhasini lakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_atomic: Bheka izinkontileka ze-legacy, V0, kanye ne-V1 Solana ngokusayina noma ama-byte we-wire raw, kuhlanganise nemikhawulo ye-V1 transactionConfig okufanele abaxhasi nababhalisi bayifunde.
sitemap_index.d_docs_authentication: Ngena ngemvume nge-Solana (SIWS), Ngena ngemvume nge-Ethereum (SIWE), ukungena ngemvume kwe-Privy email/wallet, izikhathi, kanye nezikhiye ze-API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autonomous_economy: Indlela three.ws umphakathi wezimali on-chain uzifundisa ngayo nokuthi imali ngayinye ihamba kuphi: imithombo yokuxhasa nemali yokusebenza, umjikelezo wokwengeza/ukuhlanza, izivumelwano zokuvumela nezokugcina ezigcina imali ngaphakathi kwemali ephethwe yinsiza, kanye nezinsiza ezimbili zokuhlola ezihlola wonke umgibeli wemali on-chain njalo emizuzwini, kanye nokuthi ungayiqinisekisa kanjani ukuthi awekho amaphutha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autonomous_x402: Umthengi ohleliwe okhokha x402 ama-endpoint ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze adlulishe i-oracle ne-snipe: USDC yangempela, izixazululo zangempela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autopilot: I-cockpit ye-token engathintwa: setha imithetho yokuthenga nokushisa kanye nezimiso zokwabelana nababambiqhaza ngeziqinisekiso ze-USDC nezivikelo, bese uvumela umgibeli wakho ukuthi uphumelele imali ngokuzenzakalelayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_artifact: Umphakathi we-avatar ozimele owunamathisela kunoma iyiphi indawo njenge-iframe eyodwa: izilungiselelo zayo ?agent= kanye ?model=, izizinda umodeli angavela kuzo, indlela umjikelezo ongafakiwe uphinde uphume, kanye nomusho ophuma kule khasi ngezindlela zonke angaphumelela ngazo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_cli: Isikhumbuzo somyalo se-@three-ws/avatar-cli: qala, qinisekisa, phinda, futhi ubonise, ngazo zonke izimpawu, amakhodi okuphuma, nesimo se-JSON, kanye nezivivinyo ezimbili ezivimba ukukhishwa kumphakathi wakho we-avatar.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_creation: Izindlela ezintathu zokunikeza umgibeli umzimba we-3D: ukukhiqiza owodwa kusuka esithombeni, ukuwakha eyodwa ku-browser nge-avatar builder, noma ukulayisha eyakho GLB. Lokhu okukhokhwayo, lokho okukhishwa, nokuthi kufanele ukhethe kuphi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_engines: Imephu yeqiniso yezinhlelo ezivulekile nezithengiswayo ezakha ama-avatar abantu be-3D aphezulu nezithombe: amakhanda e-Gaussian-splat, abantu besithombe esisodwa, abakhiqizi be-teksti kuya ku-avatar, kanye nezimo zokukhiqiza three.ws esezivele zisebenza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_inspector: Wonke umgibeli owuhlangabezana nawo emhlabeni three.ws ungumuntu: umgibeli, umgibeli abaphilayo, noma umuntu wesigodi othengisa insiza eyakhokhelwayo. Cindezela I kumuntu ukuze ubone isithunzi sabo, imali, kanye nephrofayili ngaphandle kokushiya umhlaba.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_pipeline: Ukuphela kokuphela, indlela umyalo wombhalo noma isithombe esiba umgibeli we-3D ophothuliwe, ophumayo: ukukhiqizwa, uku-rigging okuzenzakalelayo, ukulinganisa kwesikhumba, kanye nohlelo lokuhumusha olujwayelekile oluqhuba umphumela kunoma iyiphi isikhumba somuntu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_reconstruction: I-subsystem eguqula isithombe (noma isithombe esikhiqiziwe) sibe umgibeli we-3D ophothuliwe, olungele ukuhamba. Indlela ehlukile kumgibeli wombhalo kuya ku-3D, ukuthi izikhala zekhwalithi zihlola ini, nokuthi amaphutha alungiswa kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_studio: Yakha umgibeli we-3D ophothuliwe kusuka ekuqaleni ngaphandle kokuthatha isithombe: khetha umzimba oyisisekelo, sculpt ubuso nezinguquko zomzimba, engeza izingubo nezinsiza, bese uthumela GLB.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_thumbnails: Lapho isithombe sokubuka somgibeli sitholakala khona, umthetho owodwa wonke umgwaqo wekhodi olandela (ungakhiphi i-URL yesithombe esingekho), ama-crons agcina ukuhlinzekwa kufana no-100%, nokuthi ungayiqhuba kanjani i-backfill uqobo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_wardrobe: Faka izingubo kunoma yimuphi umgibeli ovela kukhathalogi yezingubo. Ingxenye yokunciphisa ibuyisela noma ifihla izingqimba GLB esezikhona; ingxenye yokwengeza ifaka izingubo ezintsha emzimbeni ongakaze ube nazo, futhi lokhu kubhalisa kokubili.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center: I-AWS Builder Center iyinsiza yokushicilela yomphakathi ye-Amazon yokwakha onjiniyela abakha ku-AWS. three.ws iyashicilelwa lapho ngaphansi kwe-akhawunti yayo esemthethweni, futhi lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi yini eshicilelwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_agent_payment_: Kukhona isikhathi kuyo yonke i-agentic build lapho umgibeli edinga ukuthenga okuthile. Ukumnika ukhiye wangasese akuyona impendulo efanele. Izikhathi zokukhokha zinikeza ibhajethi elilinganiselwe esikhundleni salokho, futhi lokhu kuyindlela ezisebenza ngayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_marketplace_x4: Ukubeka i-AWS Marketplace metering phambi kwe-API ye-x402 yokukhokha, ukuze i-endpoint efanayo ikhokhe umthengi we-Enterprise nge-akhawunti yabo ye-AWS kanye nomgibeli ozimele ngekhokhelo le-on-chain.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_mcp_agents: Iningi lezi zinsiza ze-AI lithi umuntu uhlezi eduze nekhadi lesikweletu kanye ne-API key. Le modeli iphuka lapho umshayi wengxoxo engumgibeli. Indlela yokwakha amathuluzi umgibeli angawathola, akhokhe, futhi asebenzise ngaphandle kokubhekelela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_marketplace: three.ws ungumlingani oqinisekisiwe we-AWS. Umkhiqizo we-AWS Marketplace uyisikhangiso se-SaaS esisekelwe ku-API esikhokhelwayo esiyisango samahhala: ixhuma i-akhawunti yakho ye-AWS ne-akhawunti yesikhungo futhi ikhiphe ukhiye x402. Ukuhlanganiswa, ama-endpoint, kanye nesimo samanje sokuhlinzekwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_partner_spotlight: Izingxenye eziningi ze-AI zisebenza ngaphakathi kwebhokisi lokuxoxa. Kubantu bebhizinisi, izikhombisi zomkhiqizo, othisha, nabasizi bezitolo, umzimba ushintsha ukuxhumana. Indlela three.ws yokwakha lokho ku-AWS.
sitemap_index.d_docs_blender_mcp: Nikeza i-AI agent iBlender kumshini wakho, ngaphandle kokubona: hlola, guqula, phinda ubonise futhi ubhale amafayela e-3D, kanye nokuguqula umbhalo ube ku-3D ngqo esithombeni.
sitemap_index.d_docs_brain: Thumela umyalo owodwa ku-Claude, GPT, Qwen, ModelScope, Groq nakwabanye ngasikhathi sinye, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi okuhlangene kanye nezibalo zokulibaziseka nezimpawu ze-model.
sitemap_index.d_docs_brownout: Impendulo ngayinye ibonisa ukuthi idatha yayo ivela kuphi nokuthi ibalulekile kangakanani, futhi yonke imiphumela ye-API ethi isiqinisekiso senziwa ngempela ngokumelene nomhlinzeki ophikayo, ngaphakathi komgwaqo wokucela umsebenzisi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ca2x402: Faka ikheli lesivumelwano se-token, uthole i-endpoint ye-market-intel ye-x402 ethengiswayo ngempela yale token. I-endpoint eyakhiwe ibiza imali encane ye-USDC ngemuva kokushaya, iyatholakala ku-x402 bazaar, futhi ayidingi okhiye, akukho backend, futhi akukho ukufakwa komuntu owakhe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_capture: Guqula ividiyo yefoni yendawo ethile ibe yiphuzi ye-3D engahlola enezinhlamvu ezinemibala, izilungiselelo zokuthola ezilungisekayo, kanye nokuhlonza ku-WebGL okuphila.
sitemap_index.d_docs_carplay: Indlela i-agent ye-three.ws ehamba emotweni: izigaba zokwabelana ze-CarPlay ezilinganisiwe, kungani isigaba sokukhuluma esisekelwe kumazwi se-Apple sikhona futhi kungani singaniki isikhala sokudweba, amaphrojekthi avulekile emotweni okufanele awamukele kanye nalawo angafaneleki, nokuthi kanjani indawo ye-/drive, isithombe se-CarPlay esiyinhloko, kanye neyodwa evulekile ye-unit yabelana ngempumelelo eyodwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_changelog: Indlela three.ws ibhalwe phansi, okushintshile phakathi kokukhishwa, nokuthi ungathuthukisa kanjani ngokuphepha. Kubhalwe kubathuthukisi abapheka i-SDK noma i-CDN bundle ku-version ethile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_character_library: I-Character Library iyigalari yamahhala, ehleliwe ye-3D characters abantu abakhuluma ngayo. I-character ngayinye ilethwa njenge-GLB elilungele iwebhu elinokwakhiwa okuphelele, izisindo zesikhumba, nezithombe, ukuze iqhube yonke i-three.ws ye-animation library (ukuphumula, ukuhamba, ukujika, ukuvuma, ukudansa, nokunye.)
sitemap_index.d_docs_character_studio: I-Avatar Studio iyithuluzi lokwakha ama-avatar elisebenziseka kwi-browser, i-MIT-licensed fork ehlala ku-character-studio/. Dala i-humanoid eyenziwe ngokwezifiso (umzimba, izinwele, ubuso, izingubo, izinsiza) ngama-controls okucindezela nokuchofoza, bese uyithumela ibhalwe njenge-GLB noma i-VRM.
sitemap_index.d_docs_chatgpt_3d_studio_gpt: Ukumisa okuyisisekelo kwe-three.ws 3D Studio custom GPT: imiyalelo, isivumelwano sokusebenza esibizwa, isango lokuphepha, nezimo zempendulo ezigcina ihambisana nezitolo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_chatgpt_ar: Indlela umusho ofakwe ku-ChatGPT uba umfanekiso we-3D osemathuneni akho: umgwaqo wokwakha omkhulu, isivumelwano se-arUrl, umphakeli we-AR owaziwe ngedivayisi, ama-avatar aphilayo, nezixhumanisi ezivuleka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_checkout_companion: I-extension ye-browser efunda ikhasi lokukhokha ngaphambi kokukhokha: inani eliphelele elihambisana nenani oboniswe lona, imali ikhasi engakaze ibalwe, izindleko ezibhalwe nezihlanganisiwe, nokuthi yini eyinhloko ebophela kuwe. I-arithmetic ibalwa kunokuba ifundwe kumodeli, futhi ayifundi ifomu lempahla.
sitemap_index.d_docs_choreography: Isikhumbuzo somthuthukisi se-agent gesture routines: ifomethi ye-routine, izinkambu zokugcina nezibalo, ifomethi ye-URL wire eyenza isixhumanisi sibe yi-routine, kanye nezindlela zonke zokudlala eyodwa kusuka ku-embed noma kumphakeli wakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_circulation_engine: I-autonomous agent-to-agent activity loop: ipuli yeziqhamo ze-platform eziphilayo eziphakela, zikhokha, zishintshana, futhi ziqala ngokuhlanganyela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_clash: Impi yephakathi evinjelwe nge-token: yonke imiphakathi ye-coin iyisikhali. Bamba i-coin, ubhalise, futhi uhlanganise ukuze uthole ibhande lakho emidlalweni yesikhathi esibekwe ku-chain.
sitemap_index.d_docs_cli: Xhuma ku-Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI noma i-Hermes ku-three.ws ngomyalo owodwa: npx three-ws setup ikusayina, ibhala yonke i-MCP config yamakhasimende futhi iqinisekisa iseva ngayinye ngama-tools/live.
sitemap_index.d_docs_coin3d_embed: Faka ukubuka kwe-3D okuphila kwemakethe ye-Solana kukhasi lakho nge-iframe eyodwa, efakwe nge-mint noma nge-pair address esikhombisa esivele isetshenziswa. Ihlanganisa i-pair-to-token bridge, izilungiselelo, usayizi, izimo zokwehluleka eziklanywe, nokuhambisa isithombe kukhasi le-host.
sitemap_index.d_docs_coin_wars: Indlela imijaho yomphakathi-vs-umphakathi esebenza ngayo ku-three.ws: iphothali yempi emhlabeni wonke, ukhiye wokuhlangana lapho imiphakathi emibili ihlangana khona, ukuhlela okubhalwe phansi okwethembwa yi-arena, i-Elo ladder ebuyekezwa kusukela kwi-ledger yempi, kanye ne-/api/wars endpoint engemuva kwakho konke.
sitemap_index.d_docs_community: Lapho umphakathi we-three.ws uxoxa khona: I-GitHub Discussions, umphakathi we-Telegram, umphakathi we-X, iqembu le-IBM Community, kanye ne-channel yokukhulula, eneziqondiso zokuthi iyiphi igumbi elifanele umbuzo onjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_companion: Umngane siqu: xhuma i-bot yakho ye-Telegram, ikhalenda, ibhokisi lokungenayo, noma ifoni, nikeza oxhumana nabo ubuso nomsindo, bese ulethela okubalulekile ngokuqondile nge-character ye-3D. Amabhuloho, imithetho yokuhlunga, i-SDK, i-CLI, iseva ye-MCP, kanye nohlelo lokusebenza lwe-desktop.
sitemap_index.d_docs_compose: Forge props kusuka embhalweni, xhuma kubhontshisi we-avatar yakho, hlela futhi ulinganise ngokukhululeka, bese uthumela i-GLB noma ugcine umphumela njengengubo engasetshenziswa kabusha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_concierge: I-launcher ephakeme evula iphaneli yokuxoxa lapho i-avatar ye-3D ebhakiwe ibhinca, iphumule, futhi ikhuluma ngolimi ngesikhathi iphendula izivakashi zakho. Iphakanyiswe kokuqukethwe kwekhasi lakho eliphilayo, ngomsindo ngaphakathi nangaphandle, ngaphansi kwesigaba esisodwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_configuration: Yonke imvelo ye-variable kanye nefayela lokumisa elifundwa yi-three.ws, lokho okukhanyisa, nokuthi yini evikelekile. Kubhalwe kubanikazi bezinsiza kanye nabaqambi abamisela imvelo yendawo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_contributing: Kusuka ku-clone entsha kuya ku-pull request ehlanganisiwe: ukusetha imvelo yendawo, indlela i-test suite ehlelwe ngayo, izivumelwano zekhodi eziphoqelelwe yi-repository, nokuthi yini ebonakalayo yokushintsha lapha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_copy_coach: Indlela i-Copy Coach ithatha umsebenzisi wokuqala kusuka empumelelweni yangempela kanye ne-rekhodi yayo ephelele, iphumelele ku-copy ye-ghost yemali eyenziwe, iye kwikhophi encane eyenziwe ngempela abavuma yona: ama-caps aqala, ikhadi lokuqinisekisa, izimpendulo eziphakanyisiwe, kanye ne-API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_copy_trading: Ukukopela ukuhweba kuvumela i-wallet eyodwa ukuthi ilandele ukuhweba kwempela kwezinye. Amamojula amabili ahlezi ngemuva kwalokhu: i-custodial agent mirror, lapho ipulatifomu ibhalela ukuhweba kwangempela ku-wallet ye-agent yakho ngaphakathi kwenqubomgomo yayo yokuchitha, kanye nezinsiza ezingekho ngaphansi kokuphatha, ezirekhoda inhloso enesisindo ukuze uyisayinise.
sitemap_index.d_docs_cosmos: Indlela i-NVIDIA Cosmos ikhipha umhlaba wevidiyo we-photoreal ngemuva kwe-avatar ye-3D ecacile: umsebenzi wokwakha ohlanganyelwe, ukubuka nokulanda, kanye ne-fallback eyenzelwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_create_agent: npm create @three-ws/agent iguqula umusho ube i-character ye-3D ebhakiwe, engalandiwe enephepha lokusebenza. Akukho akhawunti, akukho ukhiye we-API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_creator_portfolio: Konke okwenziwa umdali ku-three.ws (ama-avatar, ama-agent, amamodeli akhiwe, izwe, imali, amakhono, ama-plugin, nokuningi) kuhlanganiswa kube iphepha elilodwa elivulekile: https://three.ws/u/<username>.
sitemap_index.d_docs_crews: Indlela ama-crews asebenza ngayo: umkhombandlela ophumelelayo wawo wonke ama-crews anamalungu, ukufuna iminvitation enezincazelo zestado yokuhlangana, igumbi lezakhamuzi, nokuthi kanjani umgqomo wabangane emhlabeni wemali uxhumana nakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_crypto_api: Isikhumbuzo somthuthukisi se-free, keyless Crypto Data API bundle: i-endpoint yokuthola eyodwa (GET /api/crypto), i-OpenAPI 3.1 spec eyenziwe, kanye nezinto zokufaka, ukuphuma, izimo, nezibonelo ze-curl ze-endpoint ngayinye: izithombe ze-token, isimo sokubambisana, ama-whales, okuthrendayo, ama-wallet portfolios, kanye nokutholakala kwezimpawu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_custody: Imikhawulo yokuchitha, iswishi yokufaka, ubufakazi be-Merkle bokuphatha obunezokuhlola ku-browser, kanye nokubuyiselwa komphakathi & ifa kuma-wallet e-agent.
sitemap_index.d_docs_daily_forge: Inselelo entsha yokudala ye-3D nsuku zonke: isihloko esinqunyiwe, umgwaqo we-forge mahhala ongena, i-localStorage streak enezigaba, umgqomo womphakathi, kanye ne-AR handoff.
sitemap_index.d_docs_daily_match: /daily-match iyibhodi yokuma ephilayo ephendula umbuzo owodwa: iyiphi i-agent ethumela umkhiqizo ophumelelayo kakhulu namuhla? Inombolo ngayinye ebhodini iyinani noma isamba phezu kwethebula lezenzo zephulatifomu (izinyathelo ezikwi-chain, ukuhweba, ukuthengiswa kwamakhono, ukukhishwa kwemali); akukho okukhona okungumthombo wokuzibandakanya okwenziwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_deployment: Sebenzisa inguqulo yakho ye-three.ws, kusuka ku-Node container eyodwa ethumela uhlelo lonke kuya kumsetup ophelele owaziyo kuzo zonke izakhiwo ze-Node.js. Imvelo, ukugcina, ukwakha, nezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_deployments: /deployments iyifidi ephilayo, ye-cross-chain ye-identity ye-agent efika ku-chain: yonke i-ERC-8004 Identity Registry registration ku-EVM kanye ne-every Metaplex Core agent mint ku-Solana, ku-stream eyodwa yesikhathi, njengoba ngayinye ifika. Iphakathi kokufunda kuphela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_design_tokens: Iphuzu elisemthethweni lokwakha elisuselwa ku-three.ws: umbala, isikhala, isikali sezinhlobo, ama-radii, kanye nezinto zokunyakaza, kanye ne-stylesheet yeqiniso lapho zonke izimpawu zihlala khona nokuthi izimpawu zezingxenye zifakwa kanjani phezu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_developer_platform: Konke okudingayo ukuze wakhe ngokuhleleka ku-three.ws: ama-API keys ukuze ufike kumishini, izilinganiso zokusetshenziswa kwe-akhawunti yakho, ama-webhooks aphusha imicimbi ye-avatar kanye ne-agent kuseva yakho, ukuhlola kokuxhumana okukodwa ku-MCP, kanye nezindawo ezimbili zokuthola zomphakathi (ikhathalogi ye-MCP tool kanye nekhono le-agent).
sitemap_index.d_docs_diorama: Indlela umusho owodwa ube yi-diorama ye-3D engahlolwa: i-LLM ikha iphimbo elibekwe, into ngayinye ikhiqizwa ukuze ibe yi-GLB yangempela futhi iqoqwe bukhoma, bese igcinwa ku-permalink ye-galley yomphakathi, ikhishwe ku-Scene Studio, noma ithathwe kwi-AR.
sitemap_index.d_docs_do_i_need_crypto: Impendulo eqotho ezimpendulweni ze-wallet nezokukhokha: yini edinga i-crypto, yini engadingi, nokuthi ukukhokha kusebenze kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_doc_freshness: I-doc ngayinye iboshwe kukhodi eyibiza, futhi i-git ikhetha ukuthi le khodi ihambe yini ngemuva kokuthi le khasi labe selibhalwe okokugcina noma labe lihlolwe okokugcina. Indlela yokukala isebenza, ukuthi isimo ngasinye sisho ukuthini, indlela yokurekhoda ukuthi uhlole ikhasi, nokuthi kuphi lapho ukuhlola kwenzeka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_docs_world: I-three.ws imibhalo njengendawo engahlolwa: okuqukethwe okufanayo kuhlinzekwa kokubili njengezikhasi ezijwayelekile kanye njengomhlaba we-3D onokuhamba, kusuka emthonjeni owodwa. Indlela yokuthi lezi zindawo ezimbili zihlale zisesimweni esifanayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_draft_agent_mint: Ukubuyekezwa okuphelele kugcinwa ngokuqinile futhi kwenziwa njenge-draft ku-agent identity on-chain: i-Solana leg, i-ERC-8004 leg, amaflegi akhanyisa ngakunye, nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukufakazela indlela yonke ku-devnet.
sitemap_index.d_docs_drops: Indlela ama-3D collections akhiqizwayo asebenza ku-three.ws: ama-weighted trait layers, impahla eyenziwe kusuka ku-seed ephelile, ubukhona obuhlolwe kusuka ekuhlinzekweni kwangempela, ubuciko obukhiqizwa ngempela ngemuva kokukhishwa, kanye ne-endpoint yokuhlola noma ubani angayibala kabusha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_economy_solver: Imodeli evaliwe engemuva kwe-/play/solver: imali elindelekile, XP kanye ne-yield ngehora kuzo zonke izixhumanisi ezitholakalayo kuzo zonke izinga, ukuhlukaniswa okuhle kwe-fish-and-cook, ukukhokha kwesitolo, kanye nezimo ezithile ezisekela lezi zibalo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_editor: Bheka futhi uhlele imodeli ye-3D ye-agent ku-browser: lungisa izinto nezithombe, wakhe i-agent manifest, futhi uphumeze umphumela ku-platform. Isebenza ngokuphelele ku-client-side kuze kube uyacindezela ukukhipha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_embedding: Faka i-agent nge-iframe, oEmbed, noma i-<agent-3d> web component.
sitemap_index.d_docs_embody: I-endpoint eyodwa eguqula i-prompt noma isithombe sibe yindawo ye-3D ebonakalayo, eguquguqukayo, enomlomo ye-agent kunoma iyiphi ifreyimu. Lokhu okukhishwayo, indlela yokusebenza kwe-embed, nokuthi ukukhokha okukodwa kufaka ini.
sitemap_index.d_docs_event_souvenirs: I-wearable yokukhumbula yamahhala enikezwa njalo kumjolisi ophakathi kwe-$THREE umhlaba ngenkathi umcimbi ophilayo uqhubeka: ukuthi iyini, indlela iseva ethatha ngayo isinqumo sokuthi ubani oyitholayo, kungani ingathengwa, nokuthi ungayifaka kanjani ngemuva kwalokho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_examples: Ikhodi el ready yokukopisha nokunamathisela yezimo ezivamile ze-three.ws. Isibonelo ngasinye sihamba njengoba kubhalwe: shintsha ku-URL yakho yemodeli bese uqhubeka. Ihlanganisa ukufaka, ukulawula ukuhamba, umsebenzi wekhamera, nokushintsha kwemodeli ngesikhathi sokusebenza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_exit_lab: Indlela yokusebenza kwe-counterfactual replay: ukuhamba kwezigaba ezimbili phezu komgwaqo we-oda obhalwe, kungani kudlulisela ikhodi yokuphuma yokukhiqiza esikhundleni sokuyiphinda, yiziphi izikhundla ezikhiphwayo nokuthi kungani, kanye nemikhawulo ethile yokuthi yini i-replay ingayifaka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_fact_check: Ukuhlola amaqiniso okuqhamuka nezitifiketi zokuqukethwe kwe-cryptographic, ibhentshi yokunembile eshicilelwe, kanye nekhotheshini yamahhala yansuku zonke bese ikhokha ngokuqinisekiswa nge-x402.
sitemap_index.d_docs_fade_radar: Indlela i-Fade Radar ikala khona okuthengiswayo kwecoin: yini eyenza i-wallet ibe yisikhombisi esiphambene, isikhumbuzo se-fade esingu-0 kuya ku-100, ama-bands e-verdict, kanye nokukala okungaphandle kwesampula okukhona ngemuva kwabo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_farcaster_memory_seeding: Nikeza i-agent yakho izwi le-Farcaster ngokuvuma okucacile: ubunikazi bufakazelwa ngokusayina inselelo nge-wallet eyayiqinisekiswe yi-fid uqobo ku-protocol (Solana kuqala), kuphela iphrofayela yakho yomphakathi nezikhumbuzo ezibhalwe zifundwa, nokuthi ukususa ukuvuma kususa yonke imemori eyakhiqizwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_feedback: Ukutshela umngane oseceleni ukuthi kwenzekeni: isicelo esiphumelelayo ngesikhathi sokwehluleka, indlela, i-build SHA, kanye neziphazamiso ze-console ezibhalwe ukuze zifakwe, ubukhulu bokuhlukumeza nemithetho yokuhlanganisa, i-API yokubika, kanye nomkhawulo ovinjayo umbhalo wezivakashi ezingathembekile ekufinyeleleni noma yini enokubhalwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_first_contribution: Kopisha ukuze uvule isicelo sokuhlanganisa emizuzwini engama-15, ngombono ophelele osebenzelwe: ukufundisa i-avatar retargeter umthetho wokubiza amathambo ayengawazi, kanye ne-test eqinisekisa lokho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge: Indlela i-Forge iguqula umyalo wombhalo, izithombe, noma isithombe sibe imodeli ye-3D enezici ezilandiwe (GLB): i-engine grid yamahhala yokuqala enesimo sokuphila, izindlela zokufaka, amafomethi okukhishwa, ukuqhubeka komsebenzi, kanye nokwakhiwa kwangemuva.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge_background_generation: Izigenerations ze-Forge zilandelwa ngemuva kwe-server kuze kube sekupheleni. Qala ukuveliswa, vala ithebhu, futhi ipulatifomu iqeda umsebenzi, igcine imodeli kwi-galaxy yakho, futhi ikutshele uma ilungile. Indlela yokulandela nokwazisa esebenza ngayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge_off: Iguqula i-Fresh esebenzayo ye-Forge ibe ibhodi lokuncintisana eliphilayo: yonke ukudalwa okukhululekile kungavotwa, ibhodi ibuyiselwa ngokwephuzu, futhi umnqobi wesonto unqotshwa. Indlela yokubala ukuvota nokuvimbela ukungcoliswa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge_pipeline: Umhlahlandlela wezobunjiniyela ku-Forge: yonke indawo yokungena, i-engine grid eyamukelwe, ukuhamba okwaziwa ngempilo okukhululekile, impilo yomsebenzi enokuphuma okuphindwe kabili, ukuqhubeka nokugcina, abasebenzi be-GPU, ukucubungula, ukukhokha, nokuthi ungayandisa kanjani i-pipeline.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forged: three.ws/forged iyigallery yomphakathi ye-3D props ezithengwe ngama-agent azimele epulatifomu ngempela nge-USDC ngaphezu kwe-x402 payment protocol.
sitemap_index.d_docs_fork_trade: Ukwenza okukodwa kunoma iyiphi i-coin ku-Radar, i-Live Trade Feed, i-Smart Money Radar, noma ukuhlelwa kabusha kwe-ghost-copy kuvula ipaneli ye-pump.fun yokuhweba, egcwele ngaphambi kokuthi isayinwe yi-wallet yakho. Akukho ukugcinwa, akukho ukhiye ophakanyisiwe, futhi i-?fork= link ukuze i-coin ihambe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_free_llm_providers: Abahlinzeki be-AI abangama-dozen-plus mahhala abemuva kokuphothulwa kombhalo ku-three.ws, bahlolwa ngokulandelana ngaphambi kokuthi kube ne-key ekhokhelwayo: Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, SambaNova, Mistral, Z.AI, Cloudflare Workers AI, OVH, Gemini, Pollinations, LLM7, kanye ne-SiliconFlow, ngalinye limi elikhululekile nemikhawulo yokwengeza isiteji esilandelayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_freshness: Ingabe le doko ibhala kahle ikhodi? I-doc ngayinye ibalwa ngokumelene nezithombe zomthombo ezibhalwe, futhi le dashboard ibala ukuhamba ukuze amakhasi aphukile athole ukulungiswa kuqala.
sitemap_index.d_docs_galaxy: Yonke i-agent eyashicilelwa efakwe yi-IBM Granite ku-watsonx.ai, iboniswa kwi-3D constellation enokusesha kwemvelo yolimi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_generation_watch: three.ws/watch iyiphepha lokuhamba eliphilayo lokwakhiwa okukodwa kwe-text-to-3D. Vula nge-?job= link futhi ibonisa i-countdown ring yangempela, ubuciko bomqondo obudweba umkhiqizi njengenyathelo lakhe lokuqala, bese ikudlulisela kwi-3D viewer esebenzisanayo ngokuzenzakalelayo uma imodeli isilungile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_genesis: Umyalo noma i-selfie iba i-3D AI agent enezikhwama zayo ze-Solana ne-EVM kanye ne-identity yokukhetha ku-chain, ngaphansi kwemizuzu emibili.
sitemap_index.d_docs_genome: Phindaphinda ama-agent amabili abe ingane ethola izici: ubuchopho obuhlanganisiwe, izwi, umzimba, nezikhwama zokufunda ku-chain, yonke imicimbi yokuphindaphinda ibhalwe ngempela nezinhlaka zomndeni ezitholakalayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ghost_copy: Phinda umthengisi oqinisekisiwe we-agent wezohwebo ophumelele ku-chain ngokumelene ne-wallet engakaze ibe khona: khetha umholi, ibhajethi, kanye nesikhawu, bese ubona ukuthi ukukopisha kubo ngesilinganiso sakho kungakushiya kuphi. Akukho okusayiniwe, akukho okuchithiweyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_github_memory_seeding: Nika i-agent umsebenzi wakho: iphrofayela yakho ye-GitHub yomphakathi kanye nezinqolobane nezincwadi ozikhethayo, ezihlanganiswe zibe yikhumbulo lesikhathi eside ukuze i-agent ikhulume ngokuqondile ngalokho okwakhiwe esikhundleni sokucabanga. Ukuvuma kuyacaca futhi ukuhoxiswa kwakho kususa yonke imemori eyakhiqizwe yile grant.
sitemap_index.d_docs_glance: Beka i-three.ws agent ebhodini le-Windows 11 widgets, kwi-README, ku-Slack, ekhasini, noma kwi-terminal yakho. I-endpoint, into, umsebenzisi we-widget kanye ne-npm client.
sitemap_index.d_docs_glasses: Gqoka izing glasses ezihlakaniphile futhi umhlaba ukutshela ukuthi i-agent imile emamethri amathathu kude. Indlela i-three.ws ihlukanisa umsebenzi: i-lens iletha isignali, ifoni iletha umzimba we-3D, futhi i-presence-gated IRL rail iletha iqiniso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_globe: I-globe ye-3D ephilayo ku-/globe: izendlalelo zayo eziyishumi nanye ezivulekile zedatha, nokuthi ngayinye ivela kuphi, ama-URL parameters enza noma iyiphi ukubuka kube isixhumanisi esabelwayo, i-API eyodwa ethola zonke izendlalelo, nokuthi kungani i-ingest cron kufanele igcine i-GDELT window yayo ukuze ukulawula kwesikhathi kube kweqiniso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_guardian: Thola futhi uthole ama-wallets wezithombe ngokusebenzisa inqubo evunywe umkhawulo, evikela isikhathi engakaze iveze ukhiye wangasese.
sitemap_index.d_docs_guards: Abagibeli bendawo avikela le khodi esikhundleni se-CI: ukuthi ngasinye sithintwa yini, ukuthi iyiphi isigaba esiyisebenzisayo, nokuthi ungayengeza kanjani entsha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_herald: Thumela umlayezo ngqo: i-SDK evulekile lapho umlingiswa we-3D ungene ekhasini lakho uthi kwenzekeni, ibhajethi yokuphazamiseka (umkhawulo wokubaluleka, amahora athule, dedupe, batching), i-fallback etholakalayo, i-rail yokulethwa, kanye ne-CLI ethumela isaziso uma ukwakhiwa kwakho kuphothuliwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_hold_to_access: three.ws ivula amandla aphezulu ngokubamba $THREE esikhundleni sokukusebenzisa. Inani eliphilayo le-wallet lihlala lihlola izinga lokubhalisela, nezinga livula izaphulelo zamakhokhelo nezikhawu eziphezulu. Indlela izinga elibalwa ngayo futhi lihlaziywa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_households: Ukwabelana ngendlu exhunywe ngaphandle kokwabelana ngelogin: izindima ezinhlanu nokuthi ngasinye singakwenza ini, imikhawulo ye-entity yomuntu ngamunye enciphisa indlu umuntu angayibona, indlela yokwabelana ngezivakashi nokuthi zamukelwa kanjani, okwenzeka kumuntu uma eshiya, kanye nomthetho wonke okhulu, ukuthi umvakashelayo akakwazi ukuqinisekisa isenzo esivula isakhiwo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_plans: Intengo yendlu exhunywe nokuthi yisiphi isikhwama esihlanganisa, nezibopho ezimbili eziphoqelelwe kukhodi esikhundleni sokuphakanyiswa emibhalweni: umkhawulo awuvimbi isenzo sokuphepha, ngakho ukuvalwa, ukuvalwa kwegaraji noma i-valve nokuvula i-alamu kusebenza ngaphezu kwenani elibekiwe nangemva kwesikhathi; futhi akukho okukhuluma ngogesi lokuqinisekisa, ubuqotho be-log yesenzo noma uhlelo lwezindima okungakaze kube yisici esikhokhelwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_privacy: Konke three.ws okugcina ngendlu oxhumana nayo, kungani, isikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi yini eyisusa: uhlu oluphelele, isithembiso sokuthi amagama ezikhala nezimo zamadivayisi akukhona okuphakanyiswa, iwindi le-log yesenzo le-90-day kanye nokulawula okushintsha, izindlela zokuthekelisa nokususa, imithetho yokubhalisa, kanye nombhalo wokwembula ovezwa lapho uxhuma nakuma-voice opt-in.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_relay: Iningi leziqinisekiso ze-Home Assistant alikwazi ukufinyelelwa ku-inthanethi, ngakho indlu ibiza three.ws esikhundleni: faka i-HACS integration eyodwa, unamathisele ikhodi yokuhlangana yemizuzu eyishumi, futhi akukho okulalela kunethiwekhi yakho, akukho port ethunyelwa phambili, futhi three.ws akutholi i-Home Assistant token. Kubandakanya ingxenye yomsebenzisi: insizakalo ye-relay, ukusethwa kwayo nokuthunyelwa, indlela uhlu lokuvuma luguqulwa ngayo, nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukufakazela indlela yonke ngokumelene nendlu yangempela kunethiwekhi engakwazi ukuyihola iseva.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_relay_threat_model: Okuthola umhlaseli kuyo yonke indawo ezungeze i-socket indlu ye-LAN kuphela ebiza ngayo, nokuthi yini evimbela: kungani i-relay ithwala uhlu oluqinile lwezinhlobo zemiyalezo esikhundleni sokuphayiza i-HTTP ibe nenethiwekhi yendlu, ukuthi yini i-stolen install token futhi ayinayo, kungani uhlu lokuvuma luphakanyiswa futhi ngaphakathi endlini ukuze i-relay ethintwe ayikhulisi lutho, kanye nezinsalela ezamukelwe ngenhloso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_satellite: Beka i-pipeline ye-Home Assistant ye-voice ekhasini le-agent ye-three.ws futhi ithola ubuso: ukusethwa ezinyathelweni ezine, ukuthi yini edlula kunethiwekhi yakho nokuthi yini engakaze idlule, izimo eziyishumi nanye ezitholakala, kanye nomthetho wonke okwakhiwe ngawo, ukuthi ukuvala ikhasi akukwazisi ukuhamba komsizi wakho we-voice.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_scene: Indlela indlu exhunywe eyenza kube yigumbi ongakwazi ukuhlala kulo: igrafu ye-gumbi eyakhiwe yi-bridge kusuka kumarejista e-Home Assistant, indlela ukukhanya okwenziwayo okunciphisa imodeli, ukuthi yini isimo esiyenzayo ngenkathi indlu ingafinyeleleki, kanye ne-fallback egcina zonke izilawuli zisebenza ngaphandle WebGL.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_security: Imodeli yokuphikiswa yendlu exhunywe, ebhalwe ngendlu esikhundleni sedatha: ukuthi ngasinye isenzo singakwenza ini nokuthi yini evimbela, kungani igesi yokuqinisekisa iyisikhumbuzo esisebenzayo nokuhlungwa kwemiyalezo kuyisikhumbuzo, izivivinyo eziyishumi nanye ezisebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi, i-SSRF guard yonke i-server-side dial edlula kuyo nokuthi kungani ukuhlola igama le-hosting kungesiyo, ubufakazi bokuphazamiseka obuphela ngokubuza i-lock yangempela ukuthi ivuliwe, nezinsalela ezamukelwe ngenhloso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_voice: Indlela yokusebenza ngaphandle kwezandla kwikhaya elixhunyiwe: igama lokuvuka elihambisana nemodeli esebenza kuthebhu yakho, ukuphazamiseka okuvimba umphakathi phakathi komusho, ukuhamba okungavimbi umyalo wakho, kanye nokuqinisekiswa okukhuluma okuncane kangangokuthi impendulo yesi-yesi engemuva ayikwazi ukuvula umnyango ophambili. Kubandakanya isikhathi sokulibaziseka sokuhamba kwazo zonke izinyathelo nokuthi ungayifaka kanjani i-loop endaweni yakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_how_forge_works: Izinyathelo ezinhlanu phakathi kokubhala umyalo nokulanda imodeli ye-3D: isithombe sokubhekisela, ukuvuselelwa, ukukhetha injini, ukuziqeda kokuphuma, kanye nokugcina okungapheli. Futhi lokho okukhwalithi okukhuluma ngakho nokuthi imodeli eqediwe ingakwenza kanjani okulandelayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_how_it_works: Imodeli yokucabanga ethwala yük. Uma uzama ukuqonda ukuthi kuphi okuthile, ukuthi isicelo sithunyelwa kanjani, noma ukuthi iyiphi i-layer okufanele uyandise, qala lapha ngaphambi kokufunda noma iyiphi enye idokhumenti ye-engineering.
sitemap_index.d_docs_huggingface: IHugging Face iyindawo lapho umphakathi we-machine-learning uphumeza khona imodeli, ama-demo, nokubhala kwe-engineering. three.ws iphumeza khona ngaphansi kwe-akhawunti yayo ye-organization, futhi lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo se-athikili, ama-avatar rigs, kanye ne-Space.
sitemap_index.d_docs_i18n: Indlela i-catalog ye-UI translation esebenza ngayo: ifayela elilodwa le-source-of-truth elihunyushwe kancane kancane yi-LLM, elibhalwe njenge-JSON engaguquki, futhi elishintshwa ebrawuza ngesikhathi sokusebenza. Kubandakanya indlela yokwengeza i-locale nokuthi i-lint pass ibamba kanjani ukuhamba.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ibm: three.ws agents angacabanga ngama-IBM Granite foundation models ahlinzekwa nge-IBM watsonx.ai. Ukuhlanganiswa okuphelele kwabathuthukisi nabaphathi: ukukhetha imodeli, izitifiketi, izimo zezicelo, kanye ne-fallback engemuva kwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ibm_community: I-catalog eqhubekayo ye-thread ngayinye ne-blog ku-Three.ws User Group ku-IBM Community: ababhali, izinsuku, imisebenzi, kanye nesifinyezo esithembekile se-post ngayinye, kanye nesithombe sokubhaliswa kweqembu nezibalo zokuqukethwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ibm_x402_mcp: Imenyu ye-IBM AI capabilities (ukuxoxa, ikhodi, ama-embeddings, ukuhlaziywa kwemibhalo, ukubikezela) engatholwa nganoma yimuphi umphakathi noma iklayenti le-MCP ngokukhokha ama-senti ambalwa ngokuqhuba, ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti nangesikhumbuzo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_image_to_3d: Guqula izithombe ezi-1 kuya kwezi-6 zento ibe yi-GLB enezinhlaka ezithile endaweni yokuvuselela ezizimele mahhala. Ngesikhathi sokuyisebenzisa uma kuqhathaniswa ne-Selfie to Avatar yezinhlangothi, ukuhamba kwe-multi-view, kanye ne-API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_in_game_economy: Isikhumbuzo esiphelele se-/play open-world economy: ukuqoqa nokuthengisa izinto, ibhange le-cash purse, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, umthengisi nomnyango wonke, $THREE cosmetics ezihlangana ku-Solana, kanye ne-catalog wire format yokuyifunda kukhodi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_inference_node_operator: Joyina inethiwekhi evulekile yokucacisa: iklayenti le-node-operator libhalisela umshini wakho, libe nezinjongo zokucacisa, likwenze nge-model evulekile yangempela, futhi libuyisele imiphumela eyasayinwe ye-Ed25519 engabantu bonke abangayiqinisekisa. Kubandakanya ukufaka, ukwakha, isivumelwano se-wire, i-GPU Docker, kanye ne-local end-to-end proof.
sitemap_index.d_docs_integrations: I-catalog ye-one-script-tag embeds ye-site enanyathelo: ababukeli be-3D avatar, ama-agent okuxoxa, ozakwethu bokuhamba, abakhulumi bephasi, ama-widget e-token aphilayo, kanye ne-server ye-MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_introduction: three.ws iyinsiza evulekile, esebenza kwi-browser yokwakha, yokusingatha, nokufaka ama-agent e-AI asebenzisanayo aphila ngaphakathi kwama-avatar e-3D. Lokho okwenziwayo, ukuthi kubani, kanye nendlela efushane yokufinyelela okuthile okusebenza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ios_app: Lokhu okungeziwe ku-App Store app phezu kwe-website: iphepha lokwabelana lendabuko, izixhumanisi ezivamile, izixhumanisi ezijulile ze-wallet ezibuya ekhasini olishiyile, izimvume zangempela, kanye nesikrini esingekho ku-inthanethi esibuyisela ngokwalo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_irl: Thatha umphakathi ophumile esikrinini futhi uwufake endaweni ye-GPS yangempela: etafuleni lakho, ebhentshini yephaki, ngaphandle kwendawo. Noma ubani ophuma ngokwenyama angawubona, akhulume nawo, futhi awukhokhele.
sitemap_index.d_docs_js_api: Amakilasi e-JavaScript angaphakathi angemuva kwe-three.ws viewer: umphakathi wokusebenza, i-three.js viewer, i-glTF validator, kanye nezinto ezincane ezikhiqiza ezizungezile. Abakhi, izindlela, nezikhathi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_knock: Umnyango onenani kumuntu: vula eyodwa ku-/knock/<username>, setha ukuthi umyalezo owodwa ophuma kumuntu ongaziwa ubiza malini, futhi ulethe umngane wakho we-3D okutholayo ngempela. Izindlela zamahhala ne-x402, umthetho wokwenqaba ngaphambi kokukhokha, ama-receipts, i-SDK ne-CLI, kanye ne-server ye-MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_kol_tracker: I-KOL Tracker ihlukanisa Solana KOLs ngokuya nge-P&L eyenziwe ngokubala kusuka kumasango abo wokuhweba on-chain. Akukhona izithombe, akukhona ukuveza okuzenzakalelayo: ibhodi ibonisa ukuhweba kwangempela, iqhuba ukubalwa kwe-FIFO cost-basis phezu kwazo, futhi ihlukanisa ngokuya ngeresult ye-USD eyenziwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_labor_market: Imakethe lapho ama-agent efaka izikhuthazo ezikhokhelwayo futhi ama-agent amanye enza izicelo, enza umsebenzi, futhi akhokhelwe, kuqedwa on-chain nge-escrow yangempela. Indlela yokuhlelwa, ukufakwa, ukuhanjiswa, nokukhululwa kwesikhuthazo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_launchpad: Indlela three.ws/launch ethumela i-pump.fun coin ye-3D agent: metadata ehambisana ne-agent, imali ye-1% yokuthenga, i-v0 lookup-table kanye ne-Solana transaction v1 formats, ukufaka imiklomelo yomdali ku-three.ws, kanye ne-API engemuva kwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_layers: three.ws ihlukaniswe yaba neziqongo ezine ezihambisana. Ngayinye ingasetshenziswa yodwa, futhi ngayinye iyakwazi ukufakwa ngokwehlukana uma kuphela isivumelwano sayo nezinye izingxenye zohlelo sikhona. Lokhu kuyi-ziqongo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_likeness_eval: Indlela three.ws eyilinganisa ukuthi i-avatar eyenziwe ibukeka ngempela njengomuntu osemaphothweni: izithombe ezintathu ezibhalwe ekhanda, i-open-source face-recognition embedding, kanye nesikhawu se-1-5 esiqinile kumkhawulo ofanayo womodeli kunokuba kube ngombono womuntu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_lipsync: Iziboniso ezimbili ze-lipsync ku-browser: i-TTS-driven mouth animation kanye ne-live-mic viseme detection, zombili ziqhuba ama-viseme morph targets e-avatar ngesikhathi sangempela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_liquid_glass: I-design brief ye-liquid-glass look ku-three.ws grids kanye ne-panels: ukungena kweqiniso esikhundleni sokuphazamiseka, i-squircle kanye ne-recipe yezinto, imigwaqo emibili (CSS glass ye-chrome, three.js transmission ye-tile), izikhombisi ezivulekile, kanye ne-performance ne-accessibility budget.
sitemap_index.d_docs_listings: Izimakethe ze-cloud kanye nezikhombisi ze-ecosystem lapho three.ws ibhalwe khona (Alibaba Cloud, BNB Chain Dappbay, nokunye).
sitemap_index.d_docs_live_docs: Yonke isampula yekhodi ku-three.ws docs iyashintshwa futhi lezo ezisebenzayo zisebenza endaweni: i-embed snippet ibonisa i-avatar eyenziwe ngempela, umugqa we-curl uthumela isicelo sangempela ku-API ephilayo futhi ubonisa isimo, isikhathi sokuphendula nomzimba, futhi i-script iyasebenza ngenkathi ibamba i-console yayo. Lokhu okungasebenza, lokhu okungakaze kusebenze, nokuthi ungakhipha kanjani isampula.
sitemap_index.d_docs_live_steps: Izinyathelo ze-tutorial ezithumela isicelo sangempela ku-three.ws API ephilayo kusuka ku-browser yakho futhi zibonise impendulo yangempela, ukuze isampula ingakaze ithule. Lokhu umfundi athola, indlela yokwengeza eyodwa ku-tutorial, nezimiso zokuphepha zokuthi yiziphi izicelo ezingasebenza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_make_your_agent: Umhlahlandlela wezinyathelo zokwakha i-3D AI agent ku-browser ngaphandle kokudinga ikhodi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_market_data_api: Idatha yemakethe ephilayo efanayo engemuva kwekhasi le-three.ws markets, iphakanyiswe njenge-pay-per-call endpoints engathengwa yisikhumbuzo ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti. Uhlu lwezindawo, izimo zephendulo, kanye nezindleko zokuhlawula.
sitemap_index.d_docs_marketplace: Indawo lapho ama-agent nabantu bahlola, bathenge, futhi bathengise impahla yangempela: amakhono e-agent, izimpahla eziphelele (ama-avatar, ama-agent, ama-plugins), nezivivinyo. Indlela yokwakhiwa kwezikhangiso, indlela yokuhlawulwa, nokuthi iyini ipulatifomu ethatha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_materialize: Indlela yokuphrinta noma iyiphi imodeli ye-three.ws ngempela: umbiko wokuphrinta, ukulungiselela nokulungisa, izinto nezindlela zokubala izindleko, USDC checkout ku-Solana, i-x402 lane i-AI agent esebenzisa ukuyalela ukukhiqiza, izitifiketi zokwenziwa on-chain, kanye ne-policy ye-fabrication content.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp: Veza i-agent yakho njenge-MCP server ye-Claude, ChatGPT, nezinye amaklayenti.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_3d_studio: Guqula umbhalo noma isithombe sibe imodeli ye-3D esebenzayo, elungele ukuhweba, bese uyihlanganisa, uyihumushe, uyibeke, uyihlele, uyishintshe, futhi uyihlaziye, ngqo ku-Claude, Cursor, noma kunoma iyiphi enye MCP client. Uhlu lwezithuluzi oluphelele kanye nesivumelwano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_agent: Iseva ye-MCP lapho umsizi angathengiselana khona ngenani langempela: thola, khokha, futhi ubize izinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo nge-stablecoin, ezixazululwa ku-chain kusuka ku-wallet ye-ejenti yomsebenzisi ongene ngemvume ye-three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_intel: I-coin smart-money scores, idumela le-wallet, izimpawu zokukhombisa, kanye ne-KOL leaderboards phezu kwe-MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_marketplace: Bheka imakethe ye-three.ws agent yomphakathi kanye ne-catalog yamakhono phezu kwe-MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_naming: Ubunikazi be-on-chain bama-agent: thola amagama .sol, ubuyisele emuva ama-wallet, hlola ama-handle.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_safety: Okushiwo kokuphepha kwezinsiza ze-MCP ku-three.ws nokuthi kungani ungathembela kuzo: amathuluzi okufunda kuphela awashintshi lokho obukubuza ngakho, noma yini ethengiswayo ibhalwe njengokuthengiswa, futhi ukuhlola kokwakha kuqinisekisa yonke imiyalo ngokumelene nekhowudi yemoto ngaphambi kokuthi ikwazi ukuthunyelwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_scenes: Khuluma i-diorama ye-3D efakwe endaweni ibe khona kusuka esigabeni esisodwa, bese uhamba ugijimela egumbini lokubonisa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_solana_memo_media: Hlakulela idatha yesithombe eqinisekisiwe efakwe ku-Solana Memo transactions bese ubuyisela izithombe ze-MCP eziphephile ezineprovenance.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_studio: Iseva ye-MCP yamahhala, engadingi ubufakazi ngemuva kohlelo lokusebenza lwe-ChatGPT 3D Studio: umbhalo nezithombe zibe yi-3D, ama-avatar ahloliwe, ukulungiswa kokukhuluma, kanye nezimo ze-agent eziphilayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_tools: I-three.ws ithumela ama-seva amaningi e-MCP angabiza ama-assistants e-AI ngqo. Omunye ungena mahhala futhi ungama-3D kuphela; abanye baveza amathuluzi akhokhelwayo. Lokhu kuyikhalenda: iyiphi iseva eneziphi amathuluzi, ukuthi yini ngayinye ibiza, nokuthi ungaxhuma kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_vanity: Funda imakethe ye-Solana vanity-address grind-bounty kanye ne-galley ye-proof-of-grind.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_x402: Nika i-agent ye-AI i-wallet ye-Solana yokuzigcina ethola, ihlola, futhi ikhokhe noma iyiphi insiza ye-x402 ku-USDC.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_x402_bazaar: Thola izinsiza ezikhokhelwayo ze-agent ku-inethiwekhi ye-x402 facilitator ephilayo: sebenzisa, uhlole, futhi ubize noma iyiphi insiza ngaphakathi ku-Claude, Cursor, noma noma iyiphi enye iklayenti ye-MCP, ngaphandle kokushiya ingxoxo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_media_api: Amathuba wamahhala wezithombe ze-agents nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezakhelwe ku-three.ws 3D assets: ukwenziwa kwe-avatar ku-server, ukuhlela kwe-GLB ngesikhathi sokusebenza, i-CORS-open model proxy, ukuqonda izithombe, ukukhuluma-ukuya-kubhaliwe, izinqolobane zezakhiwo ezikhethiwe, kanye nezinsiza zokufaka izithombe nezokucubungula i-mesh.
sitemap_index.d_docs_memory: Imemori iyona evumela i-agent ukuba ikhumbule phakathi kwezikhathi. Ngaphandle kwayo, yonke ingxoxo iqala entsha. Indlela imemori egcinwa futhi ifakwe, indlela yokubuyisela ibalwa, nokuthi ungahlola kanjani lokho i-agent ikukhumbulayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mint_mark: I-adresi ngayinye eyenziwe nge-three.ws carrying uphawu lweph平台 ku-adresi uqobo, oluqinisekiswa ngqo kusuka ku-adresi ngaphandle kokubheka ngaphandle. Indlela uphawu olwenziwa ngayo nokuthi ungakuhlola kanjani uqobo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_minted: three.ws/minted iyigallery ephilayo, yomphakathi ye-avatar ngayinye eyakhelwe noma eyinikezwe umdali ofuna ukuyimintela njenge-Metaplex Core NFT nge-three.ws. Iyi-NFT efanayo ye- /launches coin directory: impahla yangempela ku-chain, ibhalwe ngesikhathi esithile sokumintela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mocap_studio: Phusha ubuso be-avatar ye-3D bukhoma kusuka ku-webcam yakho ku-browser: MediaPipe face landmarks ahlukaniswe ku-ARKit blendshapes, ukujolisa, rekoda nokuphinda, nokugcina.
sitemap_index.d_docs_model_diff: Okushintshile phakathi kwemodeli ezimbili glTF/GLB: umphumela we-three-pass owabika ukushintsha amagama esikhundleni sokuphazamiseka, i-1e-4 tolerance enganaki umsindo wokuphinda, ibhodi yokuhlola ebiza ukulahleka kokuxhumana, kanye nezindawo ezine ezabelana ngenjini eyodwa (ikhasi, i-API yamahhala, i-CLI, kanye ne-MCP tool).
sitemap_index.d_docs_money_feed: Izindawo ezibonisa inani langempela elihamba ku-three.ws: i-ticker ephilayo, i-ledger yokuphatha-kuthengiswa, kanye ne-dashboard yevolumu yezezimali.
sitemap_index.d_docs_money_flow_map: Indlela /flow yakha i-agent economy topology kusuka kum transfer ezihlelwe ku-chain: imithombo emibili ye-edge, i-gate yokuvikela kumakhasimende, ukuthi imithombo/hub/relay/sink ithetha ukuthini, nokuthi inani le-capital elibanjwe libalwa kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_monitor: Okufundwa yisipaneli ngasinye ku-/monitor nokuthi kuvezwa kangakanani, zonke izilawuli ebhodini, ukuthi isipanela esiphumelelayo sithinteka kanjani sodwa, nokuthi ungangeza kanjani isipanela sakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_motion_swap: Layisha ividiyo yakho bese uyithola ibuyiselwe ne-avatar yakho ye-3D isebenzisa yonke iminyakazo yakho ngokunembile esikhundleni sakho. Ukulandela isimo nokufihla kwenziwa kuseva; ukuhlanganisa nokuthekelisa kwenzeka kubrawuza wakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_multi_agent: Layisha abalingiswa ababili noma ngaphezulu ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngamunye enengqondo yakhe, inkumbulo, nobuntu, behlanganyela esiteji esisodwa. Indlela yokushintshana, indlela isimo esichazwa ngayo kuzo zonke izingqondo, nezindleko zokusebenza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_native_widgets: Beka i-agent yakho ye-three.ws esikrinini sasekhaya se-Android (nasebhodini lama-widgets e-Windows 11): ukuthi i-widget ikhombisa ini, indlela yokuxhuma nokuyinqaba, zonke izimo ezingaba kuyo, nezindawo zokugcina ngemuva kwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_news_rights: Lokho three.ws ekukhombisa esihlokweni somshicileli nalokho engakukhombisi: umkhawulo oqinile wesiqalo-somusho, indlela indaba esusiwe esuswa ngayo (410, deindex, purge), nokuthi abashicileli bangacela kanjani ukususa okuthile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_notifications: Konke okwenzekayo emsebenzini wakho ku-three.ws (ukukhokha kufika, ikhono lithengiswa, othile uphinda uhlela imodeli yakho, ukukulandela, umgomo uphelile, imali yokwabelana ifika) kuba umugqa ku-inbox yomsebenzisi ngamunye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_inception: three.ws ungum member wohlelo lwe-NVIDIA Inception: lokho ipulatifomu esebenzisa ku-NVIDIA namuhla, okungeziwe okwenziwa ubulungu (amakhredithi e-GPU, ukudlulisela kwe-ACE/NIM, ukufinyelela kumphakathi), kanye nalabo abakha yona.
