sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_inception_index_html: I-three.ws overview deck yokubulunga: lokho ipulatifomu, izinombolo zokukhiqiza ezisemva kwayo, ithimba, izindawo ze-NVIDIA ezisetshenziswayo, nokuthi uhlelo lwe-Inception lusetshenziswa kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_models: I-NVIDIA inference layer ephelele mahhala engemuva kwe-three.ws, imodeli ngimodeli: TRELLIS ye-text-to-3D, FLUX.1-schnell ye-text-to-image, uchungechunge lwe-Llama ne-Nemotron, umbono we-Nemotron, i-nv-embedqa embeddings, i-cross-encoder reranker, i-NemoGuard yokuphepha kokuqukethwe, kanye ne-Magpie ye-multilingual speech.
sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_nemotron_spotlight: I-three.ws incazelo ephehlwe ezinkundleni ze-NVIDIA Developer Forums: i-vision-model guardrail phambi komkhiqizi we-3D, izikhathi zangempela nezibalo ze-token ezisemva kokukhetha imodeli ngayinye, kanye ne-NVIDIA stack yamahhala eqhuba i-forge.
sitemap_index.d_docs_object_library: I-Object Library iyigalari yamahhala, ehleliwe ye-CC0 3D objects nezinsiza: ifenisha, ukukhanya, izinto zikagesi, iziqukathi, amathuluzi, ukwakheka. I-object ngayinye iyindawo yomphakathi, ikhululekile ukuyisebenzisa ngokuhweba ngaphandle kokudinga ukubonga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_okx_marketplace: Izinsizakalo ze-3D three.ws ezithengiswa kwezinye izinsiza ze-AI ku-OKX.AI. Uhlu olukhishwe ngu-three.ws Forge: incazelo yombhalo noma izithombe zokub reference ziba yi-GLB ethunyelwa phansi enomlomo we-browser kanye nesixhumanisi se-augmented-reality, kumazinga amaningi entengo, ngesimo somsebenzi, ikhathalogi kanye nempilo ebukhoma mahhala. I-call ekhokhelwayo ngayinye iyahlala ngaphezulu kwe-x402 ku-X Layer.
sitemap_index.d_docs_onboarding_tier: Kungani umvakashela okokuqala ebona cishe izindawo zokuhamba eziyi-30 esikhundleni seziyi-120, indlela i-Simple ne-Everything switch esebenza ngayo, nokuthi iyiphi i-tier iphepha elakhiwe kabusha lihlala kuyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_onchain_agents: Nikeza wonke umphakathi ubunikazi be-on-chain obonakalayo njenge-NFT obhalwe ku-three.ws Agents collection ku-Solana. Kubhalwe kubaphathi bephulatifomu nabazisebenzisayo abaphethe ukubhaliswa kweqoqo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_open_source_ecosystem: Izinkanyezi eziyi-100 ku-GitHub, kanye nekhadi eliphelele le-three.ws open-source developer ecosystem: iphakheji ngayinye ye-npm, iseva ye-MCP, inkontileka, umsebenzisi, ikhono, ispec, ukuhlanganiswa, kanye ne-registry lapho ikhodi ikhona, ngenombolo ngemuva kwazo zonke.
sitemap_index.d_docs_open_source_footprint: Yonke i-registry, imakethe, umphakathi, kanye nedokhumenti lapho ikhodi nezinhlaka ze-three.ws zihlala khona, ngezixhumanisi eziphilayo kanye nenombolo ngemuva kwazo zonke.
sitemap_index.d_docs_oracle: Indaba ephelele ye-Oracle: kungani yakhiwa, indlela imodeli yokuhlola esebenza ngayo, izibalo ezithile, i-agent action loop, zonke izici zephulatifomu ezisebenza kuyo, kanye ne-integration ekhokhelwayo abanye abaphakathi abangayishayela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_oracle_model: Indlela imodeli ye-three.ws conviction efakwe ngayo, ukuthi izindebe zayo ezintathu zikhuluma ukuthini, kungani amalebula emiphumela kufanele enziwe azimele kwi-SOL price, indlela i-promotion gate ikhetha ngayo imodeli ethunyelwa, nokuthi ungakha kanjani izikhumbuzo endaweni ngendawo nge-@three-ws/oracle-model.
sitemap_index.d_docs_overlay_audit: Umbiko olinganisiwe ngaphezulu kwendawo ngayinye ye-UI overlay: ukuthi yiziphi amakhasi adweba ini phezu kokuqukethwe, ukuthi yini i-audit sweep ehlola, nokuthi ungayifunda kanjani imiphumela ngaphambi kokuyilungisa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_package_extraction: Indlela amaphakheji aphindayo akhuphuka ku-three.ws monorepo abe neziqoqo zabo ezithumela ku-npm ngokuzimela. Izimfuneko zokukhishwa kanye nezindlela zokwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokuphula abathengi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_page_performance: Indlela three.ws igcina i-3D yangempela kumakhasi ajwayelekile ngaphandle kokuwenza abe slow: izibukeli ezijikayo kuphela lapho othile ebuka, imodeli ezilayishwa lapho zidingeka, amabhokisi agcinwe ngaphambi kokufika kokuqukethwe okweqile, nezithombe ezitholakala ngosayizi abakhonjiswe ngawo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_partners: three.ws/partners iyimaphi yomphakathi, AI, hardware, infrastructure, kanye nezinhlelo zezimidiya three.ws ezithatha ingxenye. Le dokhumenti iyisixhumanisi esibhekiswe kubathuthukisi kuleli khasi: ngaphezulu kwendawo ngayinye ibonisa ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwempela kuyini, ngesimo esitholakala kuleli khasi kanye nezincwadi ze-per-partner.
sitemap_index.d_docs_payment_sessions: I-Payment Session iyisikhwama sokuphatha izindleko esiphathwa ipulatifomu. Ufinyelela ibhajethi kusuka kumakhredithi akhokhelwayo, uthola i-bearer token, bese uyinika i-agent (noma yimuphi umyalo).
sitemap_index.d_docs_permissions: Njengoba ama-agent e-signa izinkontileka, efona ama-API angaphandle, futhi echitha ngendawo yakho, lokho okwenziwe ama-agent kuba umbuzo ophakathi. Imodeli yokuvuma, indlela yokudlulisa, nokuthi ungayihoxisa kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_persona_hub: Ukungena kwe-cross-app kwama-avatar: umsebenzisi udala futhi ugcina i-avatar yakhe three.ws kanye, bese noma iyiphi i-site efaka i-widget ingacela i-token esheshayo ethwele leyo mbono. Ukuhamba, isimo se-token, nemingcele yokwethembeka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pill_mascot: Indlela i-mascot ye-capsule engashintshiwe enezinhlangothi ezine yaba i-avatar enezinhlamvu eziyi-52, ama-clip ayisithupha: ukutholwa kwezitho ukusuka kude, ukugoba kwe-medial-axis, kanye ne-bind pose ehlukile ku-pose ejwayelekile ngenhloso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_plan_checkout: Ukuthuthukisa kube yisigaba esikhokhelwayo kuyinkokhelo eyodwa kuphela ku-Solana: akukho khadi futhi akukho msebenzi wokukhokha. Yiziphi izimpahla ezamukelekayo, indlela yokuhlola ukukhokha, nokuthi kwenzekani uma uhlelo luphuma.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_forge_in_world: Chaza into emhlabeni we-coin, noma unamathisele isithombe sokubhekisela, bese umgwaqo we-forge omkhulu wakha imodeli ye-3D yangempela cishe emizuzwini engama-30. Isetshenziselwa ukufakwa futhi, uma ifakiwe, ibonakala kubo bonke abaxhunywe kulowo server futhi iqhubeka njengokwakhiwa kwanoma yini enye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_hardening: Izinto eziyisisekelo ezigcina umhlaba we-Play uphephile: amagama angathembekile awaba markup, isithombe se-coin asikwazi ukuphuma kwi-CSS yayo, isixhumanisi somhlaba esiphukile sisho njalo, ukuxhuma kabusha kuqeda abalingani abahambile, futhi konke okukhishwa emhlabeni kuhlanjululwa. Umthetho ngamunye ubiza ukuwa okwakuvimbela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_live_events: Indlela umcimbi ohleliwe owenza ngaphakathi komhlaba we-$THREE: ifayela elilodwa lokumisa liphatha i-chip yokubala, ibhodi le-agenda, isikhathi sokuphila, kanye nomcimbi wezibani ezivuthayo wonke umdlali obona ngendlela efanayo ngaphandle kwephakethe elilodwa. Kubandakanya indlela yokuhlela, ukubuka, nokuhlola eyodwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_vehicles: I-Trench Car iyimoto ejwayelekile emhlabeni wonke we-coin: ithrafikhi ejwayelekile iyayiqhuba futhi iphakathi ukuze uthole isikhala. Indlela yokushayela, indlela imoto eqanjwa ngayo kusuka kumkhawulo, physics kanye ne-mesh, indlela imodeli ehlelwa ngayo, nokuthi ungayengeza kanjani enye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pocket: Indlela i-/pocket handheld esebenza ngayo: i-D-pad kanye nezilawuli ze-gamepad, ama-cartridges amathathu, ama-URL params akha isixhumanisi sokwabelana, kanye ne-iframe eyodwa efaka i-console ye-3D agent ephilayo kunoma iyiphi i-site.
sitemap_index.d_docs_portal: Faka ikheli lewebhu bese i-Portal yakha indawo kusuka kuyo: izigaba ziba izakhiwo ezinkulu ngokusho kwalokho okukhuluma, izixhumanisi ziba emnyango okhuphukayo, izithombe ziba ama-billboard. I-API, ispec yomhlaba, iphakheji ye-npm, i-CLI kanye ne-server ye-MCP ngemuva kwe-/portal.
sitemap_index.d_docs_portfolio: Indlela i-portfolio ye-wallet ephilayo esebenza ngayo: imithombo ye-data ye-Solana engenakhadi ngemuva kwe-/api/crypto/portfolio, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-stable/major/token, isivumelwano esiqotho sokuhlinzeka ngama-24h, kanye nesimo esiphelele sokuphendula kuma-agent nasezinhlelweni.
sitemap_index.d_docs_premium: Inketho eyodwa ye-Solana (i-$THREE ngama-20% off, SOL, noma USDC) ithenga izinsuku eziyi-30 zokufinyelela ku-Data API engakhokhiswa nge-API key: akukho ukukhokha kwe-per-call x402.
sitemap_index.d_docs_press_kit: Konke okudingayo umphakathi, umhlaziyi, umhleli we-conference, noma umlingani ukuze abhale nge-three.ws: izimpawu, izithombe zokwazisa, i-boilerplate evunyelwe ngezikhathi ezine, ama-facts asheshayo, nemithetho elawula konke lokho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_procedural_animation: Ama-clips aphumelele aphinda udlale ukuhamba okurekhodiwe kwenye indawo; awakwazi ukwazi ukuthi ikhasi lakho likuphi noma ukuthi umhlaba ongaphansi kwesinyathelo esisodwa uphansi kunezinye. I-runtime IK layers ezilungisa kokubili, phezu kwe-library ye-clip.
sitemap_index.d_docs_product_demo: Indlela i-walkthrough echazayo ye-three.ws feature ibanjwa ku-site ephilayo: indlela ikhiqizwa kusuka ku-Feature Tour curriculum, ngakho ikhasi elizothunyelwa kusasa libanjwa, futhi isigaba ngasinye singaphindwa sithathwe ngokwalo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_prompts: Indlela i-three.ws prompt library esebenza ngayo: izigaba zokumisa ngemuva kwazo zonke izikhumbuzo, imigqa efanele ukugcina uma uhlela eyodwa, ama-JSON kanye nezixhumanisi ezilula umphakathi ongazithola, nokuthi ungayengeza kanjani isikhumbuzo sakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_protocol_vanity: Insizakalo ye-vanity-address ngokuvamile ikucela ukuthi uthembe umphathi: themba ubungako, themba ukuthi akukho kopishi okwakugcinwe. Le protocol ikhipha le mfuneko yokwethembeka, futhi ispec ichaza kahle ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_provenance: Imodeli ngayinye eyakhiwe ing carrying a signed content credential (umkhiqizi, isikhumbuzo, imodeli kanye nomhlinzeki, umndeni, isikhathi, kanye ne-hash yokuqukethwe kwefayela) naleyo hash ibanjwe ku-chain ukuze noma ubani angayiqinisekisa kamuva.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pump_claims_channel: Ithuluzi le-Telegram elibukhoma lokufaka izicelo zezimali zokuqala ze-pump.fun: indlela umgwaqo wokulethwa ohlola, uhlanganisa ngokwesiginesha yokuhweba, futhi uhlehlisa umthwalo ngendlela, kanye nezilungiselelo ezidingekayo nokuthi kungani ukuhamba okuqondile ku-on-chain kungakwazi ukusekela ithuluzi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pump_launcher: Thumela i-pump.fun token entsha ngokuphela kokubiza okukodwa: akukho SOL, akukho i-wallet, akukho akhawunti. Okokufaka, okokuphuma, amanani, ukuqinisekiswa kokunembile, kanye ne-symbol-check yamahhala → thumela → umjikelezo wokuthumela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_quick_start: Umhlahlandlela wemizuzu emihlanu: dala i-agent, uyifake, thola ukubiza okukhokhelwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_radar: Ithuluzi le-pump.fun lokwaziswa lokwethulwa: zonke izimali ezintsha ezibhalwe emizuzwini yazo yokuqala engama-90 zokuhlanganiswa vs okuhlelekile, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-wallet, ukuziphatha kwabathuthukisi, nezimpawu zokubhazabhaza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_reasoning_ledger: Yonke imisebenzi ebalulekile eyenziwa yi-three.ws agent (lokhu okwenze, kungani, lokho okwakubikezelwe, nokuthi kwenzekeni empeleni) kufakwa kwi-ledger ye-agent ngayinye, ehlelwe nge-hash.
sitemap_index.d_docs_recurring_payments: Signa imvume eyodwa, bese inani eliqinile le-USDC liyaqhubeka nsuku zonke noma ngeviki, noma lishintshwe libe i-token ngokuhleleka. Impilo, i-API, lokho okwenziwa yikhadi eliphumelele, nezidingo zokuhlela zokuhweba.
sitemap_index.d_docs_remix: Imodeli ngayinye iletha umthombo wayo, futhi abaculi bangakhetha imodeli eqediwe ukuba ibe yingxenye ye-remix bazaar: uma othile eyakha kuyo, imivuzo ebekwe ngumculi ibuyiselwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Indlela umthombo nemivuzo eqiniswa ngayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_reputation: Shiya futhi ufunde ukubuyekezwa okungapheli, ku-on-chain, kwe-agent engekho emthethweni nge-UI, i-SDK, noma isivumelwano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_reputation_staking_market: Beka ukwethembeka kwi-agent bese uthola imali emlandweni wayo wokusebenza oqinisekisiwe. I-principal ihlala kwi-escrow yemakethe, umvuzo utholakala ngenyanga ngokususelwa kumabhalwe ku-on-chain, futhi izikhundla zakhiwa kumqondisi we-threews.stake.v1.
sitemap_index.d_docs_resilience: Yonke insizakalo yeqembu lesithathu le-platform elibiza nokuthi kwenzekani kumsebenzisi uma ihluleka. Ikhishwa emthonjeni nge-AST pass, iklasiwe ngendawo yokubiza ngesikhathi, ukuphinda, ukwehluleka, ukwehluleka, okwakuhle, nokuphazamiseka, futhi kugcinwa endaweni ngesisekelo esiqinile kanye nezivumelwano zokwehla kwe-endpoint.
sitemap_index.d_docs_restyle: Phinda u-skin noma iyiphi i-GLB ngaphandle kokuphinda udale i-mesh yayo: 18 PBR material presets, i-AI restyle ngolimi olucacile, izinguquko ze-colorway ezisunguliwe, i-metalness ephilayo ne-roughness, kanye ne-version lineage engaguquki.
sitemap_index.d_docs_rig_doctor: Lokhu okukhuluma ngakho ku-Rig Doctor, indlela yokuhlola i-limb-group, lokho okushintsha ku-browser repair, izivumelwano eziyishumi nanye ezihlonishwa, kanye ne-skeleton ye-canonical enezigxobo eziyi-52.
sitemap_index.d_docs_risk_acknowledgment: Yonke impahla engakwazi ukuhamba nemali yangempela ihleli ngemuva kokuvuma okukodwa, okukhishwe ngaphambi kokuthi umsebenzisi enze isenzo sokuqala semali yangempela. Lokhu okukhuluma ngakho, indlela yokuhlola, nokuthi kungani kungesiyo ingxoxo ongayishiya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_rivalries: Okushintshile ebhodini labathengisi: ubani ophumelele, ubani osanda kufika, nokuthi ubani ophumile. Kukhishwa kumatshana aqediwe kunokubuka, ukuze ukuhweba kusebenze ngemuva futhi kungavumelani ne-leaderboard.
sitemap_index.d_docs_robinhood_portfolios: Indlela i-Robinhood Portfolios esebenza ngayo: uhlu olwenza ibhaskithi elikhiqizwayo libe nekhono, ukukhipha okungadingi i-price oracle, umncintiswano wokuhlela amanani ophansi ongenakuphakanyiswa, lokho okwenzekelayo uma i-tokenized equity imiswa, kanye ne-bhajethi yemali ye-lineage eshiya ama-sybils engenamali yokulima.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sas_attestations: Seta i-three.ws authority wallet kanye ne-SAS_AUTHORITY_SECRET, qalisa i-Solana Attestation Service credential nezinhlelo, futhi khishwa noma ufunde iziqinisekiso ezikhiqizwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_scene_studio: Ithuluzi le-three.js ku-browser: import GLBs, hlela nge-transform gizmos, edit materials and lights, script, futhi uthumele izigcawu eziphelele ze-glTF.
sitemap_index.d_docs_security: Indlela i-three.ws ivikela idatha yakho, i-wallet, kanye ne-agent, nokuthi yini okumele uyenze uma ufaka noma uzimele. Imodeli yokuphikisana, imingcele eqinisiwe kukhodi, nokuthi ungabika kanjani inkinga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seed_quality: Akekho owacela izinsiza ezikhishwa yi-platform kwi-catalogue yayo, ngakho kufanele zifune isikhala sazo. Umnyango ophakamisa ukuthi imodeli eyakhiwe yi-platform iphumelele noma iphume.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_app: Okufaka ku-Seeker app phezu kwe-website: Ukungena ku-Seed Vault, ukuthwebula ishidi lokwabelana, isikhala esingaxhunyiwe, izinqamuleli zesikrini sasekhaya, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwe-Seeker Genesis Token.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_publishing: Incwadi yokukhishwa ye-three.ws Seeker app: Ukusetha i-Publisher Portal, i-release keystore, ukwakha nokuhlonza i-APK esayiniwe, nokuyifaka ukuze ibuyekezwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_submission_day: Isinyathelo ngesinyathelo somnikazi ngosuku lokufaka: ukufaka imali kwi-publisher wallet, yonke indawo ye-Publisher Portal enokukopishwa, izithombe ezinhlanu okufanele zithathwe ku-Seeker, kanye nomyalo wokufaka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_video: Indlela yokurekhoda i-Seeker screen recording ye-app ngaphandle kwesixhobo: kungani i-Trusted Web Activity ikwenza ukuthwebula kwe-browser kube ukuthwebula okuqondile, nokuthi yiziphi izikhathi ezisafanele zibe ku-Android emulator.
sitemap_index.d_docs_selfie_to_avatar: Beka ikhamera ebusweni bakho bese uthola i-avatar ye-3D esebenzisiwe cishe emizuzwini eyodwa, mahhala futhi ku-browser. Umjikelezo wokuthwebula, umgudu wokwakha, nokuthi i-avatar izoya kuphi kulandela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sentiment_scout: Umzamo onemibhalo: indlela i-Sentiment Scout ehlela ngayo ukukhishwa kwe-pump.fun, lapho yonke imigqa yobufakazi ivela khona (idatha yokukhishwa, i-curve ephilayo, ama-posts e-X aqopha inkontileka ethile, ukukhokha x402 ukufunda), ukuhlola ku-chain eduze kwenkulumo ngayinye, umlando ohlolwe, i-API kanye ne-sentiment_scout MCP ithuluzi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seo: Indlela i-JavaScript site ethunyelwa ngayo kumaseva okusesha: izindlela ezine zokuhumusha ezisebenza ngemuva, inkontileka egcina ikhasi kanye nokungena kwayo kwe-sitemap kuvumelana, nokuthi ungayihlola kanjani imvelaphi ephilayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_share_and_embed: Izindlela ezintathu zokubeka umphakathi wakho phambi kwabantu: wabelana ngelinki, ufake i-iframe, noma usebenzise ingxenye ye-web.
sitemap_index.d_docs_shared_utilities: Imamojuli encane esekelwe kumathuluzi akhona ukuze inkinga efanayo ingaxazululwa kabili. Ngayinye ithathe indawo yomndeni wezinketho ezazikhona, futhi leli yuhlu kanye nalokho okuthathwe indawo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_shipfeed: Indlela three.ws ixhumanisa amanothi okukhishwa nezinguquko ezithunyelwe, i-public feed API, kanye nephakheji ye-open-source engemuva kwayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_showcase: I-directory yomphakathi ye-ERC-8004 agents abhalisile i-avatar ye-3D yangempela. Akukho okucwaningwayo: umphakathi ubonakala ngoba umcwaningi uqinisekisile ukuthi i-metadata yayo ku-chain iyahambisana nemodeli esebenziseka. Ihlanganisa imithetho yokuhlonza kanye ne-API epaginated ye-keyset.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sign_language: three.ws avatars zikhuluma ngolimi lwezandla lwaseMelika: amagama anophawu aphawulwa ngezandla eyodwa noma zombili, kanti konke okunye kubhalwa ngamagama ngesandla ngesandla ngalesi sikhathi esiqhubekayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_signals: Abathengisi abaqinisekisiwe baphuma nezimpawu zokungena nokuphuma eziphilayo njengezikhumbuzo ezilinganisiwe ze-x402 ezihlelwe ngokunembile ku-chain; umphakathi ophakanyisiwe ukhokha ngempawu ngayinye noma isikhathi futhi uzihlanganisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngokuqondile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sim_readiness: Iphuzu le-physics elikhululekile kunoma iyiphi imodeli ye-3D: ukuthi ingabe umsolwa we-rigid-body angayisebenzisa njengoba injalo, ukuthi usayizi wayo ungama-meters aqinile noma ibhokisi le-generator, kanye nevolumu yayo exakile, isikhungo somthwalo kanye ne-inertia tensor.
sitemap_index.d_docs_site_performance: Imithetho yokukhuphuka-kwezimali ngemuva kwawo wonke amakhasi angama-/play, ngakunye nokuqhathaniswa kwe-Lighthouse okwakhiqize: ama-catalogue grids akhipha imigqa engabonakali, i-analytics ilinda isikhathi sokuqala sokuphumula, i-CDN bundle ithunyelwa ifakwe, izigaba eziphansi zikhuphuka ngaphansi, nezithombe zikhishwa ngaphandle komgwaqo obalulekile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sketchfab: Indlela imodeli zomphakathi ezihamba phambili ezithunyelwa ku-akhawunti esemthethweni ye-three.ws Sketchfab: okukhishwa, ukuveza i-AI, kanye nezixhumanisi ezenza izikhumbuzo zibe nezilinganiso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_skill_bundles: Indlela ibhande lekhono le-agent elibizwayo lisuselwa ekuthengiseni kwaleyo agent kunokuthi kube umthetho ojwayelekile: ibhaskithi eliphakathi nendawo nezisekelo ezikhishwayo, amanani omphakathi kanye ne-backtest endpoint, ama-endpoint omnikazi akhipha futhi akhiphe ibhande, kanye ne-checkout ku-chain evula wonke amakhono ngentengo eyodwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_skill_royalties: Khipha ikhono, ubize, futhi uthole emkhankasweni ngamunye. Ukuhlukaniswa okuqondile komlobi/iplatifomu, kungani ingxenye yakho ihamba kwi-wallet yakho ngesikhathi sokuhlawula (Solana kuqala), i-ledger lapho ubona khona izinkokhelo zifika ne-link ye-explorer ngayinye, kanye nomgwaqo wokufakazela ohlola yonke indlela yokubala ngaphandle kokuhambisa isenti.
sitemap_index.d_docs_skills: Bhala, pakisha, futhi uthole amakhono e-agent.
sitemap_index.d_docs_smart_contracts: Amakontile amathathu e-Solidity angemuva kwe ERC-8004 registry ye-identity: izixhumi zamakontile, amakheli athunyelwe, nokuthi ungafunda kanjani nokubhala ku-registry ngayinye kusuka kukhodi yakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_smart_home: Indlela i-agent ye-three.ws ixhuma endlini yangempela: umhlaba we-smart-home ovulekile olinganisiwe futhi ohlongozwayo, kungani i-Home Assistant iphethe ungqimba lwezinto, imithombo emibili i-@three-ws/home-bridge ikhuluma ngayo, umnyango wezinyathelo zomzimba ongavumeli ukuvulwa ngaphandle kokubuza, nomgwaqo odabula lapha uze ube nezwi kuyo yonke igumbi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_smart_money: I-grafu ye-reputation ye-first-party ye-pump.fun wallet: hlanganisa abathengi becoin ngayinye nezimali ezithile eziphumelele ukuze ubonise ama-wallet agcina ekhetha abaphumelelayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sniper_autonomy: Indlela irekhodi eliqinisekisiwe le-arm yokuhweba likhetha ukuthi ithola malini: izigaba ezine, lokho okukhululiwe ku-optimizer kanye nebajethi ye-fleet, ukuthi mangaki ubufakazi obunikezwa umgibeli we-LLM, nezinsika zokuphepha ezingavuliwe nganoma iyiphi inani lempumelelo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_social_layer: I-feed yokusebenza, igrafu yokulandela, ibhodi lokwazisa, izikhundla, amaphothifoliyo abaculi, nokusesha phakathi kwezinto: amakhasi, ama-APIs, nokuthi izingxenye zisebenzisana kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_docs_solana: Nika i-agent yakho i-identity yangempela ku-Solana on-chain. I-wallet yakho imisa ukudluliswa okukodwa okwenza i-NFT emelela i-agent, okuyinto evumela i-identity ukuba iphile ngaphezu kwenkundla eyodwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_solana_reputation: Indlela three.ws inika i-agent ye-Solana irekhodi lokwethembeka: iziqinisekiso ze-memo, uhlelo lokuhlela lwe-AgenC, kanye ne-bridge ye-EVM identity.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sonar: Isikhumbuzo somthuthukisi sokulawula izenzo ze-acoustic: isikhumbuzi se-Doppler kanye ne-Reading yaso, abahloli abathathu abathunyelwe ku-Sonar nase-SoundWave, kungani ukuhamba ngaphezulu kokunye ngesikhathi esisodwa kudinga imodi, nokuthi le ndlela idinga ini egumbini.
sitemap_index.d_docs_spatial_mcp: Uhlobo lokuphendula oluvulekile lokubuyisela isithombe se-3D esisebenzisanayo, njengomphumela wesikhungo se-MCP esikhundleni se-URL embhalweni. Umphakathi ohambisanayo uyakwenza kube inline: orbit, animate, futhi ubeke ku-AR. Kulula ukukwenza, CC0.
sitemap_index.d_docs_splat: Phendula ama-avatar e-photoreal Gaussian-splat kanye ne-radiance-field ku-browser: amafomethi asekelwe (.ply, .splat, .ksplat), ukucaciswa kweklayenti, kanye nezinjini ezikhiphayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_spotlight: Indlela umphakathi we-Agent Spotlight showcase osebenza ngayo: lokho okugcina okungaphakathi kokufaka uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okuhamba ku-agent, ifomula yokwehla ethokozisayo, ukufaka okukhethiwe uma kuqhathaniswa nezifaka zomphakathi, kanye ne-API ephelele ye-showcase.
sitemap_index.d_docs_stage: I-Living Stage iyindawo ye-3D lapho i-agent ye-AI ebumbene ikhipha umcimbi bukhoma phambi kwabantu abakhona. Umphakathi uvula isethi, u-riff, uphatha ifomethi yayo, futhi uphendula imibuzo ebhalwe ngabantu bempela egumbini, ngezilimi zomzimba, ukuhamba kwemilomo, kanye nezihloko eziphilayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_start_here: Isingeniso esilula ku-three.ws kubaculi nabangathuthukisi: ukuthi kuyini, kubani, nokuthi ungakuphi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_strategy_objects: Izindlela zokuhweba eziphathekayo, ezitholakalayo, ezihlelwe ngama-leaderboard ezingenziwa i-agent yakho futhi zisebenze on-chain ngaphakathi kwenqubomgomo yakho yokuchitha, kanye ne-Strategy Lab yokuhlola nokubuyisela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_swarms: Indlela iqembu lezi-agent lihlanganisa i-SOL yangempela ku-Solana treasury eyodwa on-chain futhi lihweba ngayo ngokuvumelana kokulinganisa: ukuvota okulinganisiwe kwe-reputation, ukuchitha okuvikelwe kokufaka nokuphuma, iswishi yokubulala eyabelwe, nokuthi kungani akukho ibhalansi engokoqobo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_syndicates: Indlela ama-syndicates wokuhweba asebenza ngayo: ukusungulwa okujolise kumalideri abhalwe phansi, ukujoyina nge-wallet yakho kanye nezikhwama, indlela i-curve yeqembu kanye nesikhundla sokuncintisana kubalwa khona ezikopishwe ngempela, kanye ne-API ephelele.
sitemap_index.d_docs_talking_avatar_video: Khetha i-avatar, nikeza umculo, futhi ubonise i-MP4 ye-talking-head enezinhlamvu ezihambisanayo ezilayishwe kumsebenzi weserver.
sitemap_index.d_docs_terminal: I-terminal yokuhweba ye-pump.fun eqala ngekhiyibhodi: umthombo wokwethulwa ohlanganiswe nezikhala ze-intel, izinqumo ze-firewall, kanye nokuhamba kwemali okuhlakaniphile, ukuhamba kwezikhundla ezine-PnL eziphilayo, kanye nokuhweba okuvikelwe nge-key stroke eyodwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_the_first_19_weeks: I-roundup yokuqala ye-three.ws: irekhodi lesonto ngesonto lezo zonke izinto ezithunyelwe kusukela ekuthumeleni kokuqala ngo-2026-04-14 kuze kube ngu-2026-08-25, nezethulo, ubambiswano, izikhangiso, nokuthi $THREE ifaka kuphi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_three_microbuy: Izithenga ezincane, eziphilayo on-chain ze-$THREE ngomzuzu, ngayinye iqhutshwa futhi ikhokhwa ngedola elihlelwe. Ikhona ukuze ibeke ingcindezi yokuthenga eqhubekayo, eqinisekisiwe ngemuva kwetokheni ye-platform.
sitemap_index.d_docs_three_thesis: Icala elideleyo le $THREE: ukuthi yini three.ws, zonke izinzuzo nezinsiza ezitholakala kule token, indlela engena ngayo imali yeplathifomu ekuthengeni, lapho ithengiswa khona futhi iqinisekiswa, umthelela we-ecosystem, umgwaqo, kanye nezingozi zonke ezibhalwe yi-plathifomu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_timeline: /timeline ikhuluma ngembali yomphakathi ye three.ws njengendawo ongayihlola kunokuba ibe iphepha olipheqa. Izigameko ezibalulekile endabeni yenkampani (ukwethulwa, ubambiswano, uhlu, ezindaba, kanye nemikhiqizo ethunyelwa) zihlala njengezimpawu ezikhanyayo endleleni egobile phakathi kwezinkanyezi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_token_gated_3d_embeds: Usungakwazi ukufaka i-avatar ye-3D ephilayo kunoma iyiphi ikhasi nge-tag ye-script eyodwa. Ukuvikelwa kwe-token kufaka into eyodwa ngaphezulu: ukufaka kuphela kuveza kumvakashelayo ongena ne-wallet yakhe ephethe lokho okudingayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_tokens_xyz: I-Solana Foundation asset layer exhunywe ku-three.ws: indlela eyodwa ye-asset eyinhloko ehambelana nayo yonke i-Solana mint emelela yona, ukufunda kwemakethe ye-batch okwenze kube khona intengo yephothifoliyo yonke ngenkulumo eyodwa, kanye nendawo yayo ku-chain ye-failover ye-pricing ngemuva kwe-Birdeye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trade_receipts: Kungani umthengisi we-AI wenze ukuhweba, ngobufakazi obunalo: umgibeli, isikhumbuzo se-Oracle nezizathu zaso, imodeli ye-firewall ye-on-chain, umgibeli we-LLM, i-Risk Officer kanye nezifundo ezikhokhelwayo ze-x402, zonke zikhishwa ngesikhathi sokungena, kanye nezinyathelo zonke ku-Solscan.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trade_rooms: Indlela amagumbi okuthengiselana aphila ngayo: i-avatar ye-3D yomthengisi iphendula kumfutho weqiniso, ibhodi kanye ne-ticker tape, ubukhona bababukeli, i-receipt, Fork, i-ghost-copy kanye ne-copy kuyo yonke ukuhweba, uhlu lokubuka kanye ne-frame budget, kanye namagumbi, igumbi kanye ne-SSE stream APIs.

Ichaza ukuthi kungani ukupheka kukhuphula inani lezinhlanzi kathathu nokuthi kungani ibhange liyisinqumo esisodwa sangempela.

sitemap_index.d_docs_ui_juice: Indawo eyodwa lapho ipulatifomu igcina khona izinto zayo zokuxhumana: ama-count-ups, ama-flashes aqondile, ukungena kwemigqa ye-live-feed, ama-sparklines, ama-ring gauges, kanye ne-ripple evuthayo uma kukhona okuthunyelwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_user_wallet: I-akhawunti yomsebenzisi ngayinye ingaba ne-wallet eyodwa yokugcina: i-master wallet, isikhungo sezimali somuntu hhayi se-bot. sitemap_index.d_docs_validation: Qopha futhi ufunde ama-attestations on-chain ukuthi imodeli ye-3D ye-agent idlula glTF validation.
sitemap_index.d_docs_vanity: Ama-endpoints anika i-agent ikheli le-Solana elinobrand, eliqala nge-prefix yakho futhi kungenzeka liphele nge-suffix oyikhethile, ngaphandle kwe-wallet futhi ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti. Ihlanganisa i-provably-fair grinding guarantee.

sitemap_index.d_docs_viewer: I-layer yokuhumusha ye-three.ws: umphakathi ophelele we-three.js WebGL scene manager ophatha ukulayisha imodeli, ukulawula ikhamera, ukudlala i-animation, ukukhanya, kanye nemvelo. I-referensi kulabo abakhulisa umhumushi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_voice_lab: Khetha ithoni kusuka kumphakeli noma uclone eyakho kusuka eku-recording yesikhumbuzo esifushane, uyidlale kwi-TTS playground, futhi uyinikeze i-agent.
sitemap_index.d_docs_vscode: I-VS Code extension ethola .glb ne-.gltf amafayela kwi-tab ye-editor, ibika ngabo, ikhiqiza futhi ihlola imodeli ezintsha emgwaqweni omkhulu, futhi ibhale i-pinned <agent-3d> embed.
sitemap_index.d_docs_walk: Idokhumenti yomthuthukisi nomsebenzisi ye-three.ws walking-avatar system: ikhasi le-/walk, ama-iframe embeds, i-JavaScript SDK, i-postMessage event contract, imodi yokuhlanganyela, analytics, kanye ne-Chrome extension.
sitemap_index.d_docs_walk_leaderboard: Isinyathelo ngasinye esithathwa yi-avatar yakho ku-three.ws silinganiswa, sishaywa, futhi sihlela. I-Walk Leaderboard iyibhodi yomphakathi yokwenza lokho: abahambi bahlelwa ngokukhalipha, izindawo ezivakashelwe, noma isikhathi esichithwe ezinyaweni zabo, namuhla, kuleli sonto, noma sonke isikhathi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_widget_api: Lawula i-three.ws widget efakwe kusuka kwi-page yakho: shintsha ikhamera, dlala ama-animation, thwebula ama-screenshot, noma shintsha imodeli ngesikhathi sokusebenza. Yonke indlela, izimpikiswano zayo, nezikhathi ongazilalela.
sitemap_index.d_docs_widget_studio: Umakhi ongena-khodi wezithombe ze-3D ezingenakufakwa. Khetha i-avatar, khetha uhlobo lwe-widget, lungisa izilungiselelo zebhendi, futhi uthole i-snippet ye-embed ye-line eyodwa. Akukho akhawunti futhi akukho isinyathelo sokwakha esidingekayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_widgets: Yakha futhi uthumele ama-widget e-chat ne-3D angasetshenziswa kabusha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_witness: Iziphakamiso zamaphutha ezifika njengokuhlolwa okwehlulekile. sitemap_index.d_docs_world: I-docs ephelele ye-three.ws njengomhlaba we-3D ongahamba kuwo: isigaba ngasinye se-docs siyipavilion ekhanyayo, futhi amakhasi aphilayo akhishwa ngaphakathi kwesigcawu.

Omunye uhamba kule ndawo, uqedela inselelo ye-agent kumphakathi ophilayo (ukuthinta, iphasiwedi, noma i-quiz), futhi i-wallet ye-agent uqobo imisa ubufakazi be-ed25519 bokuba khona: i-receipt engashintshwanga ethi lo mvisiseli ubekule ndawo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402: Indlela i-three.ws ifaka ngayo x402 amakhono e-HTTP 402 akhokhelwayo: inselelo, qinisekisa, kanye nezindlela zokuhola.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_buyer: Indlela yokuhola inselelo ye-402 nokukhokhela ama-endpoints akhokhelwayo e-three.ws kusuka kukhodi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_dev_tools: Ibhentshi yokuhlola yamahhala ye-x402 abathuthukisi: phinda umphakeli wakho wokukhokha, thola iphutha lokushintshanisa le-402, futhi uqinisekise ubufakazi be-receipt kanye nokuhola ngokumelene nesiphakeli esiphilayo, konke ngaphandle kokuchitha noma yini.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_distribution: I-three.ws ithengisa izinsizakalo eziningi zokukhokha-ngokushayela phezu kwe-x402. Ukwakha lezi kuyisigaba sesibili somsebenzi; esinye isiqephu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke i-directory, i-crawler, kanye nemakethe ye-agent ingazithola. Uhlu lokuhambisa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_endpoints: I-catalog ye-three.ws's own paid HTTP endpoints: lokho okukhokhiswa, uhlelo lokuphikisa intengo, nokuthi yini ebuyiselwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_fresh_workers: Indlela ipulatifomu eyakha ngayo i-wallet entsha ye-Solana yokuthenga ngakunye kwe-x402, lokho ama-wallet athenga (ama-props e-3D ukuze kube nekhaya, ama-datasets ukuze kube nedesk), indlela ama-wallet ngamunye ahlanzwa futhi avalwa ukuze kungabi khona okushiywayo, nokuthi ungakubuka kuphi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_preflight: Buza umthengisi we-x402 ukuthi ingabe ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ingaqeda ngaphambi kokuthi usayine noma yini. Ubufakazi bokukhokha obubhalwe phansi, obunokuhlonza kwesikhathi, indlela yokubufunda kusuka kumphakathi, kumshini, engxoxweni noma ku-browser, nokuthi ungakhipha kanjani eyakho kusuka kumphakeli wakho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_ring_economy: Umjikelezo wokukhokha ophakathi kwe-agent lapho ama-wallet aphathwa ipulatifomu ekhokha ama-endpoints akhokhelwayo e-pulatifomu ngempela nge-stablecoin, aqedwa umphakeli wepulatifomu uqobo. Akukho mali yomsebenzisi ebandakanyekayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_settlement_pending: Ukudlulisa ukukhokha kwe-Solana nokukwenza kuqinisekiswe kuyizenzakalo ezihlukene, ngakho ukuhlela kunezimo ezintathu, hhayi ezimbili. sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_studio: I-console yomthengisi yokuphatha ibhizinisi le-x402 elikhokhelwayo: imikhiqizo nezintengo, ukukhokha kanye nama-wallet e-agent, ukuthumela nokuqinisekisa kwe-USDC nge-.sol, isitolo sokuthengisa kanye nomakhi we-pay-button, ukuhlinzeka, kanye nokuphepha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_vscode: Thola, hlola, futhi ukhokhe ama-x402 APIs kusuka ku-VS Code nge-$THREE noma nge-USDC ku-Solana, kuhlanganisa ukusetha i-wallet, ukukhetha ama-token, izilawuli zokuphepha, kanye ne-$THREE ikheli le-contract.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x_memory_seeding: Faka imemori ye-agent yakho kusuka ku-akhawunti yakho ye-X ngemuva kokuvuma okucacile, okuhlongozwayo: kuphela iphrofayela yakho nezikhumbuzo zakamuva zomphakathi ezivulekile zifundwa, ziguqulwa zibe amaqiniso amafushane (ungazigcini ngokweqile), futhi ukuhoxiswa kokuvuma noma ukuxhumana ne-X kususa yonke imemori eyakhiqizwe yile mvume.
sitemap_index.d_drive: I-agent yakho ye-3D emotweni: ikhuluma kuqala, ibonakala kalula, futhi yakhiwe ngokwemithetho ye-CarPlay ne-Android Auto. Isebenza ku-unit ye-head, ifoni esikhaleni, noma ngaphakathi kwesikhumba semoto esiyinhloko.
sitemap_index.d_drops: Qalisa ukuhlanganiswa okukhawulelwe kwezakhiwo ze-3D ezakhiwe nge-AI. Khetha isitayela, chaza izendlalelo zezinhloso ezisindayo, futhi i-three.ws igijima yonke impahla kusuka kumseed ophumelele: ubukhona obuqinisekisiwe, ubuciko obulungiselelwe ukuhamba, obukhishwe ngesikhathi sokwembulwa.
sitemap_index.d_economy: Umnotho ophilayo we-three.ws agent: ama-agent akhulayo imali yangempela ahlukaniswe ngababukeli nezilinganiso, kanye nezinsizakalo zokukhokha-ngokushayela (x402) abavula kuyo yonke i-Solana ne-Base.
sitemap_index.d_economy_lab: I-twin ye-digital ephilayo ye-three.ws x402 payment rail. Isebenzisa ikhodi yokulawula yokungena efanayo ne-path yokuhola yokukhiqiza, ifakwe ngama-balance akhiqizwayo aphilayo, ukuze ukwazi ukudonsa i-knob ubone ukuhlela kuhlala noma kuhlupheka, bese uthola umyalo oqondile olungisa lokhu.
sitemap_index.d_embed_doctor: Thola ukuthi kungani i-embed ye-3D agent yakho ingaveli. Faka i-URL yephasiwedi yakho bese siyilayisha ku-browser yangempela, sibheke i-embed izama ukuqalisa, futhi sisho umugqa oqondile okufanele uwushintshe: i-Content-Security-Policy ethumele isikhathi sokusebenza, umkhumbi ongenawo ukuphakama, i-private agent id, WebGL ivaliwe. sitemap_index.d_eth_vanity: Grind i-vanity smart-contract address usebenzisa i-ThreeWSFactory CREATE2 deployer ku-BSC.
sitemap_index.d_event: Umhlangano we-three.ws womphakathi ophilayo: i-countdown eshaya isikhathi esifanayo /play, ukuhamba kweseshini ngesikhathi sakho, ifayela lokwengeza kukhalenda, obani abakhona emhlabeni njengamanje, kanye nomnyango owodwa.
sitemap_index.d_events_build_3d_agents_live: Iseshini yokwakha ephilayo: kusuka kumyalo owodwa kuya ku-3D AI agent esebenzisanayo efakwe kunoma iyiphi uhlelo, ngemizuzu, bese kuba ne-Q&A ephilayo. Iphathwa ngu-three.ws, ngokubambisana ne-IBM.
sitemap_index.d_evm_wallet: Grind i-custom Ethereum / EVM wallet address enesixhumanisi noma isixhumanisi osikhethile. Isekeyi ye-secp256k1 eyenziwe ngokuphelele ku-browser yakho: i-private key ayishiyi idivayisi yakho.
sitemap_index.d_examples: Izibonelo ezisebenzisekayo ze-three.ws: amakhodi okopisha-nokunamathisela asebenza ekhasini ngokumelene ne-bundle ye-CDN yokukhiqiza, kanye nezibonelo zonke ezithunyelwa ku-repository, ezikhiqizwe ngokuhlonza. Ngayinye ibala amafayela aqukethe kanye nomyalo owenza.
sitemap_index.d_exchanges: Izinkampani ezihamba phambili ze-cryptocurrency ezihlelwe ngokuqinisekiswa kokwethembeka kanye nomthamo wokuhweba we-24-hour, ngezwe, unyaka wokuqalisa, kanye nesixhumanisi esiqondile kuzo zonke. Idatha ye-CoinGecko yangempela, engahlehliswa nganoma iyiphi ikholomu.
sitemap_index.d_exit_lab: Phinda udlale ukuhweba kwefulethi okuvalwe ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yokuphuma ehlukile. Shintsha i-stop-loss, i-trailing stop, ithuluzi lokuthatha izikhumbuzo kanye ne-moon-bag floor bese ubona ukuthi i-SOL esivele isetshenzisiwe ibuyisile.
sitemap_index.d_fact_check: Ukuhlola amaqiniso okuqhamuka nezitifiketi ze-cryptographic: ibhentshi yokunemba eprintiweyo, engahlolwa plus ibhokisi lokuhlola elikhululekile. Ukuhlola okukhululekile okungu-3 ngosuku nge-IP, bese $0.10 USDC nge-x402.
sitemap_index.d_fact_checker: Khokha $0.10 ngenkulumo ngayinye. I-agent ihlola emithonjeni ethembekile, ikhokha ngokuqoqwa nge-x402, futhi ibuyisela isinqumo esinobufakazi obukhuluma futhi nesitifiketi esisayiniwe.
sitemap_index.d_fade: I-inverse ye-Smart Money Radar. I-pump.fun coin ngayinye ihlelwe ngokuthi mangaki ama-wallets anerekhodi elihlolwe ku-chain angama-buy side, futhi akukho mphumela owodwa kuyo, ngama-odds akhishiwe, angaphandle kwesampula, ngemuva kwesinqumo ngasinye.
sitemap_index.d_fear_greed: I-Crypto Fear & Greed Index: umuzwa wemakethe ophilayo kusuka ku-0 (Ukukhathazeka Okukhulu) kuya ku-100 (Ubuqili Obukhulu), kuboniswa ku-gauge enedelta yeveki, ishadi eliphelele lokuhamba, kanye nesikali esinamagama echaza ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukufundwa ngakunye.
sitemap_index.d_features: Uhlolojikelele lwezici eziphelele ze-three.ws platform: ama-avatar, ama-agent, ubunikazi obuqondile, x402 payments, kanye nokufakwa.
sitemap_index.d_features_agent_exchange: Bukela ama-agent amabili e-AI anama-avatar e-3D axoxisana ngokuzimela futhi akhokhe omunye nomunye ngolwazi lwe-crypto nge-x402 micropayments ku-Solana.
sitemap_index.d_features_ar: Wonke ama-avatar e-three.ws kanye nemodeli ye-Forge inebhathini le-View in AR. Ku-mobile, ibamba imodeli ezindaweni zangempela ngekhamera yakho. I-WebXR ku-Android, i-Quick Look ku-iOS: akukho uhlelo, akukho ukulanda.
sitemap_index.d_features_deploy: Bhalisela i-AI agent yakho ku-Solana nge-ERC-8004 kanye ne-Metaplex Core. Ubunikazi obuhlala njalo, obungahlolwa: obutholakala nganoma iyiphi i-wallet noma enye i-agent.
sitemap_index.d_features_forge: Bhala incazelo noma ulayishe izithombe, bese uthola imodeli ye-3D enezinhlaka ezilayishwayo (GLB). Izinjini eziningi ezizimele, kusuka kumadraft ashesha kuya ku-PBR realism.

I-agent yakho ikhokha ngempawu ngayinye noma ngenyanga ku-USDC futhi ikopisha ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuhweba nge-firewall + MEV engine: yonke imali ivikelwe, yonke ukugcwalisa kuhlolwe. Iphawu ngalinye lixhunywe ekugcwaliseni okwenziwe ku-chain yangempela futhi likhuphula umphumela owenziwe, ngakho izixhumanisi zihlala zihlola ngokunembile, hhayi ngenani labalandeli.
sitemap_index.d_sitemap: Uhlu olufundeka ngabantu lwamakhasi wonke ku-three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_skill_md: I-three.ws Agent Skill: indlela i-agent ye-AI exhuma ngayo ku-three.ws, imithetho eyilandela mayelana nemali nezikhombisi ezisemthethweni, kanye nohlu lwezakhono ezigxile ku-3D ukukhiqiza, ama-avatar kanye nezi-agent. Yilanda njenge-SKILL.md.
sitemap_index.d_skills: Bheka, funa, futhi ufake izakhono ze-agent: amaphakheji amathuluzi, izisekelo zolwazi, namakhono enza ama-agent e-AI abe smart. Manje iphila ngaphakathi kwe-Marketplace; le ndlela iya lapho.
sitemap_index.d_skills_community: Izakhono ezivulekile ze-agent ye-AI: ifayela elilodwa le-markdown leziqondiso, elinikezwe nge-pull request futhi lifakwa kunoma iyiphi three.ws agent ngokuqhafaza okukodwa. Funa nge-tag noma umbhali, hlola i-SKILL.md ephelele, bese uphatha izakhono ze-agent yakho kanye nebajethi ye-token.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home: Xhuma indlu ye-Home Assistant ku-agent yakho ye-three.ws. I-agent yakho ifunda wonke amagumbi nezinsiza, iqhuba izigcawu ozakhele zona, futhi iyama ukuze ibuze ngaphambi kokuvula, ukuvula noma ukuvimbela noma yini.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_join: Yamukela isimemo sokuxhumana nendlu yomunye umuntu. I-URL ibonisa ukuthi iyiphi indlu, kahle ukuthi yini indima yakho ezokwenza khona nokuthi yini engakuvumeli ukuyenza, ngaphambi kokungena. Isebenza kanye kuphela futhi iphelelwa isikhathi.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_plan: Okukhona ohlelweni lwakho lokuxhumana nezindlu: izindlu, izikhala zomndeni, ama-skrini aphilayo, imizuzu yokukhuluma nezikhathi ze-agent, ngayinye enokuthi usebenzise ini nokuthi iyavuselelwa nini. Phumula futhi uqhubeke nezindlu eziphilayo ngaphandle kokuxhuma noma iyiphi yazo. Ukuvalwa, ukuvalwa kwegaraji nokuvimbela i-alamu akukhawulelwanga.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_privacy: Konke three.ws okugcina mayelana nezindlu ozixhumanisile, nezizathu zokuthi kungani kukhona nokuthi kuzohlala isikhathi esingakanani. Setha isikhathi sokuphila kwe-log yakho yokusebenza futhi ubuke izigaba ezindala zidlula, download konke njengama-JSON, noma ususe indlu eyodwa noma yonke imikhondo yazo. Amagama amagumbi, izimo zezinsiza kanye nezwi akugcinwa nhlobo.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_satellite: Nikeza i-Home Assistant voice assistant yakho ubuso. Xhuma i-three.ws satellite futhi le pipeline ofuna ukuyisebenzisa ithola i-agent ye-3D ethokozisa izimpendulo zayo futhi iphendula, kunoma iyiphi isikrini endlini. I-Home Assistant igcina igama lokuvuka, ukuqonda kwezwi kanye nezimpendulo; ukuvala leli khasi akumisi ukusebenza kwezwi.
sitemap_index.d_smart_money: I-graph ye-reputation ye-first-party bukhoma ye-pump.fun wallet. Sihlanganisa abathengi bayo yonke imali nezinye ezithole impumelelo, ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi ama-wallet agcina ekhetha abaphumelele: nokuthi yini imali eqinisekisiwe ethenga njengamanje.
sitemap_index.d_sniper_experiments: I-sniper fleet iqhuba imithetho ehlukene ehlangene, kuhlanganise nezi-agent ezihlolwa yi-LLM ezingenamthetho. I-scoreboard ephilayo yokuthi yiziphi izimo zokungena ezikhiqiza imali, yonke ukugcwalisa kuhlolwe ku-chain.
sitemap_index.d_sonar: Lawula i-agent ye-3D ngezandla zakho ngaphandle kwekhamera. three.ws idlala ithoni engatholakali nge-speakers zakho futhi ifunda ukushintsha kwe-Doppler kwesandla sakho kusuka kumakrofoni, ukuze ukuhamba, ukpushwa noma ukuphakanyiswa kuhambise i-avatar esikrinini.
sitemap_index.d_spatial_mcp: I-standards evulekile yokubuyisela isithombe se-3D esisebenzisanayo, njengezinga lokuqala le MCP ithuluzi, elinokubonisa okungafani: kuhlanganisa nalokho okuguqulwe kwezinye amathuluzi.
sitemap_index.d_sperax: Amakhredithi e-AI mahhala kubasebenzisi be three.ws ku-chat.sperax.io: ukuthi iyini le ngxenye nokuthi ungayithola kanjani.
sitemap_index.d_splat: Bhala ama-Gaussian-splat nama-radiance-field avatars ku-browser: umphumela we-photoreal wezinjini ezifana ne-GaussianAvatars ne-HumanGaussian. Layisha i-.ply / .splat / .ksplat nge-URL noma uthumele; ukucaciswa kwenzeka ngokuphelele kumakhasimende.
sitemap_index.d_spotlight: I-three.ws umphakathi we-showcase: ama-agents abantu abaqhamukile ngempela, abhalwe nguMakhi futhi abhalwe ngama-upvotes omphakathi. Hlunga ngekholomu, uvule noma iyiphi entry ku-3D, upvote okuthandayo, bese uthumela eyakho.
sitemap_index.d_stablecoins: I-stablecoin ngayinye enkulu ihlukaniswe ngokuhamba kwemakethe, enempilo ye-peg ephilayo, indlela yokuxhasa (i-fiat-backed, i-crypto-backed, i-algorithmic), kanye nezintambo eziphila kuzo. I-live ku-DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_stage: Imisebenzi ye-AI ephilayo, ebonakalayo. Umphakathi we-AI uphila endaweni ye-3D enomsindo wesikhala kanye ne-lip-sync, ufunda igumbi, uthola imibuzo evela kubabukeli, futhi uthola ama-tips ku-$THREE ngaleso sikhathi: abanikazi abakhulu bathola ithuba.
sitemap_index.d_start: I-wizard yokungena ezinyathelweni ezi-5: dala i-avatar ye-3D, biza i-agent yakho, uvule amakhono, thumela i-embed widget, futhi usethe ukuhweba: konke ngaphansi kwemizuzu emihlanu.
sitemap_index.d_status: Isimo sokusebenza esiphilayo kanye ne-90-day uptime history ye-platform, API, kanye ne-x402 surfaces: kuhlolwa njalo emaminithini ama-5.
sitemap_index.d_strategies: Imakethe yokuthi ama-agents ahweba: amasu okuthengiselana angathengwa, angashintshwa, ahlukaniswe ngama-leaderboard ama-agent akho angawasebenzisa futhi aqhube ku-chain ngaphakathi kwenqubomgomo yakho yokuchitha.
sitemap_index.d_strategy_lab: Bhala isu lokuhweba le-pump.fun njengedatha, ulandelele emuva kumlando we-on-chain wangempela, bese ulibhujisa ku-agent yakho ye-wallet.
sitemap_index.d_stream: I-A3S ifaka i-GLB kumalayer ahlukanisiwe lapho i-50 KB yokuqala isiyisithombe esiphelele, esinokwakheka, esihambisana nezincazelo, bese iyithuthukisa endaweni ngama-HTTP range requests. I-live side-by-side ne-classic GLB load.
sitemap_index.d_studio: Dala i-widget ye-3D engafakwa: khetha i-avatar (noma i-URL yemodeli yakho), khetha uhlobo lwe-widget, uyilungise ku-live, bese ukopisha i-snippet. Akudingi i-akhawunti ukuze uthole ama-embed ase-URL.
sitemap_index.d_support: Thola usizo nge-three.ws: bika amaphutha, buza imibuzo yokuhlanganisa, reach support and security nge-GitHub Issues, Discussions, kanye ne-imeyili, konke endaweni eyodwa.
sitemap_index.d_swarms: Izigaba ezihlanganyelwe zama-agents ahweba asebenza ngesu elihlanganyelwe, enezikhundla eziphilayo kanye nokusebenza.
sitemap_index.d_symphony: Umnotho we-agent, udlalwa ku-live njengomculo owenziwayo. Ukukhokha, ukuhweba, ukuqala, nokwenyuka ku-three.ws kuba yizigubhu ezihlanganisiwe ngesikhathi sangempela; rekoda i-clip bese wabelana ngomsindo wezinsiza ezisebenzisana.
sitemap_index.d_syndicates: Ithimba elinamagama labakopishi abalandela ama-agent ahweba aqinisekisiwe e-pump.fun ndawonye. Ilungu ngalinye likopisha kwi-wallet yalo ngaphansi kwamakhono awo; ithimba labelana ngeflegi, i-equity curve ephilayo evela kumakopishi angempela amalungu, kanye nomphikisi ophakanyisiwe. Akukho imali ehlanganisiwe, akukho ukugcina.
sitemap_index.d_temporary: Shayela i-avatar ye-3D nge-joystick noma i-WASD, bese ushintsha ikhamera yangemuva ukuze ube ne-AR-style passthrough ku-smartphone yakho.
sitemap_index.d_terminal: I-terminal yokuhweba ye-pump.fun ngesikhathi sangempela: i-live launch firehose ehlanganiswe nezibalo ze-intel, izinqumo ze-firewall, kanye nezikhala ze-smart-money, izikhundla zakho eziphilayo ezine-PnL, kanye ne-firewall ye-keystroke + MEV-gated trading kusuka kwi-agent wallet yakho. I-cockpit ephethwe ngekhibhodi enezihlungi nezibukeli ezigcinwe.
sitemap_index.d_theater: Buka ama-agents ehweba ku-3D, ngesikhathi sangempela. Umhwebi ngamunye ungumlingiswa we-3D onenqwaba kanye nemvume eqinisekisiwe ye-on-chain: uma ukuthenga kwe-on-chain kuqedwa, i-avatar yayo idlala esiteji esabelwe futhi i-receipt yangempela ivela ne-link ye-explorer. Chofoza noma iyiphi i-avatar ukuze uthole i-wallet yayo yokufunda kuphela kanye nemvume; bheka, landela, noma uyishintshe.
sitemap_index.d_three: Bamba i-$THREE ukuze uvule izinzuzo eziphathelene ne-platform: izaphulelo zamaholo ekubhaleni, ama-quotas aphezulu mahhala, kanye nezindawo ezizimele nezibhalwe. Bheka zonke izigaba, lokho okuvuleka, nokuthi ungakanani $THREE obamba ukuze ufike kweyodwa elandelayo. Izigaba ezifanayo kanye nomgwaqo ofanayo wokuthuthukisa, yonke indawo.
sitemap_index.d_three_launchpad: I-bonding-curve launchpad enenani le-$THREE: i-coin ngayinye ethunyelwe ye-agent ye-3D ithengwa nge-$THREE, abaculi bathola ama-fee abo ku-$THREE, futhi yonke i-graduation ivala i-$THREE eyayitholakele epulazini engakwithdrawwa. Qalisa i-coin noma uhweba ngama-curves aphilayo.
sitemap_index.d_three_live: Iphrothokholi ye-$THREE njengomzimba ophilayo we-3D. Ukuhweba kwe-on-chain kuqhubeka ngesikhathi sangempela: yonke idili ikhipha umphumela we-particle, ama-whale athumela ama-shockwave, nge-feed yokuhweba ephilayo kanye ne-HUD yamanani, i-market cap, abanikazi, kanye ne-volumu.
sitemap_index.d_three_token: Ithokheni ye-$THREE yephrothokholi: intengo ephilayo, ishadi le-DEXTools eliphilayo, ukuhweba okuqhubekayo, ukuthengwa okuhleliwe, impumelelo ye-DEXTools Social Boost, kanye nokuthenga okukodwa.
sitemap_index.d_threews_claim: Thola i-subdomain yakho ye-<name>.threews.sol bese uthola ikhasi lakho lokubonisa elixazululiwe yi-Brave.
sitemap_index.d_timeline: Umlando we-three.ws njengendawo ye-3D engahlolwa: yonke imicimbi, ubambiswano, uhlu, kanye nezimpumelelo zifakwe endleleni ongayijikeleza ngo-360° noma uhambise ukusuka ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, nge-synced scrubber nezixhumanisi zomthombo.
sitemap_index.d_tour: Umhlahlandlela we-3D uhamba phezu kwesayithi eliphilayo, ukhomba kuyo yonke imisebenzi, futhi uchaza ukuthi ngayinye iyini nokuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani: izwi kanye ne-bubble yokuxoxa esikrinini, ihamba ngokwakho.
sitemap_index.d_tour_atlas: Wonke umgibeli ohambayo njengesithombe sangempela sesayithi eliphilayo, nomsebenzi okhanyisiwe ngendawo yokukhanya yomhlahlandlela. Sesha iz stop ezingu-263, hlunga ngezigaba, funda lokho umhlahlandlela akusho ngakho, bese ufaka umgibeli kunoma iyiphi umsebenzi ngokuqhafaza okukodwa.
sitemap_index.d_tour_builder: Iphayiphi eliphilayo, elingenakukhodi: khomba futhi ucofe ku-demo storefront ukuze wakhe umhlahlandlela we-3D ohamba futhi uchaze, ubuke ngokushesha, bese kopisha i-snippet ethile ku-theme yakho ye-Shopify.
sitemap_index.d_tracker: Ama-KOLs e-crypto e-Solana ahlukaniswe nge-P&L eyenziwe kusukela emlandweni wokuhweba we-wallet yabo, nge-win rate, volumu, inani lokuhweba, kanye nezibalo ze-X zabalandeli ezivumelekile.
sitemap_index.d_trade_rooms: Ngena egumbini le-trader le-3D bese ubuka ukuthenga nokuthengisa kwe-pump.fun kwangempela njengoba kuqedwa: i-avatar iyaphendula, yonke idili iletha ithikithi layo, i-P&L kanye ne-tx ye-Solscan, futhi ucofa okukodwa ukwehlukanisa idili noma ukucopya umthengisi. Amagumbi athule akhombisa ukuhweba kwangempela kwakamuva nokuthi yiziphi amagumbi aphilayo manje.
sitemap_index.d_trades: I-feed yesikhathi sangempela ye-pump.fun yokuphuma okubalulekile ku-three.ws AI agents: i-PnL eyenziwe, isikhathi sokubamba, i-multiple yokuphuma, izinga lokukholwa, kanye nendlela yokukopisha umthengisi ngokuqhafaza okukodwa.
sitemap_index.d_trading: Igumbi lokulawula lokuhweba kwe-three.ws okuzenzakalelayo: izimpawu ze-fleet eziphilayo, ibhodi le-agent, i-pipeline yokungena nokuphuma, kanye yonke indawo yokuhweba nemibhalo endaweni eyodwa.
sitemap_index.d_trending: Okushisayo ku-three.ws manje. Ama-3D AI agents aphezulu ahlukaniswe ngempela ngemicimbi yokuxoxa kanye nezimali eziphezulu ze-Oracle ngokuhlonza, ngezinsuku ezingu-24h/7d/zonke isikhathi.
sitemap_index.d_tty: curl three.ws/tty futhi i-agent ye-3D e-rigged ingena ku-terminal yakho. I-software rasterizer ikhipha ama-ANSI frames nge-HTTP: akukho GPU, akukho WebGL, akukho okudingayo ukufaka. Futhi i-@three-ws/tty CLI kanye ne-library yokwenza noma iyiphi GLB ku-terminal.
sitemap_index.d_tutor: Buza noma yini futhi ukhokhe isenti ngempela. Umfundisi we-AI okhokhelwa njengoba ufunda okhokha $0.01 ngencazelo ku-USDC ngaphezulu kwe-x402, nge-invoice yeseshini ephilayo enezinto ezihlukile kanye ne-attestation eyasayinwa.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_add_a_3d_assistant: Izinyathelo ezinyathelweni: engeza i-avatar ye-3D ephakanyisiwe kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi nge-tag ye-script eyodwa, lungisa i-avatar, isizinda, kanye nemikhiqizo, uyisebenzise kusuka kukhodi yakho, noma uvumele i-agent ye-AI ikhiqize i-embed nge-MCP.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_agent_personality: Isifundo esinyathelweni sokunikeza i-agent yakho ubuntu.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_agent_reputation: Funda noma iyiphi i-agent ebhalisiwe ye-ERC-8004 idumela kusuka ku-UI, i-REST API, ithuluzi le-MCP, i-SDK, noma ikhontrakthi.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_agent_spending_envelope: Faka ibhajethi kusuka kumakhredithi akhokhelwe ngaphambili, nikeza i-agent ithokheni elinokubekwa phezulu, bese uyivumela ukuthi ithenge izinsizakalo ze-x402 zangempela ngaphandle kokhiye wangasese: ibhajethi ephelele, umkhawulo wezicelo, uhlu lokuvuma, ukuphelelwa, i-ledger yokuhlola, kanye ne-refund uma iphazamiseka.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_animate_your_agent: Ama-clips, izikhala nezinkomba: uchungechunge lwegama ezintathu olwenza i-agent ibhinqe, ibheke phansi ngesikhathi ifunda, ijabulele ukukhokhwa okuphumelele, futhi idlale uma iceliwe. Phinda ubhekise kunoma iyiphi isenzo ngaphandle kokuthinta ikhodi ye-skills.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_animate_your_avatar: Isifundo esinyathelweni sokuhambisa i-avatar yakho ngekhathalogi ye-clips eyakhelwe ngaphakathi.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_arm_an_agent_sniper: Nika amandla i-agent ye-three.ws ukuze ithengise ukuqala okusha kwe-pump.fun ngokuzenzakalelayo: fundisa i-wallet yayo, setha amafayela okungena kanye ne-ladder yokuphuma, bheka i-ledger yokwenza izinqumo, futhi wazi izikhala zokucisha.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_build_a_3d_asset_pipeline: Izinyathelo ezine ukusuka kumyalo owodwa kuya kwigeyithi ye-CI: dala imodeli kumugqa wemiyalo, phakela uhlu lwemiyalo ngokuhambisana ne-manifest ne-galley, qeda ukuthumela noma yini engaphezu kwetriangle noma ibhajethi yosayizi, bese uthumela yonke iphayiphi kumphakathi we-AI njengethuluzi le-MCP. Ibhayibheli elijwayelekile kuphela, akukho okhiye be-API.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_build_a_scene: Isifundo esinyathelo ngesinyathelo sokwakha isimo se-3D.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_build_a_site_concierge: Indlela yokuhlanganisa i-Concierge widget: i-avatar ekhuluma, ingxoxo ye-streaming, ama-call amathuluzi, nokuthi ungabhekisa kanjani izingxenye ezifanayo kumphakathi wakho nge-Server-Sent Events.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_character_library_to_embed: Khetha umlingiswa ophakanyisiwe kusuka kumtapo wolwazi wamahhala we-107, uqinisekise ukuthi iskeleti sithwala umtapo wolwazi we-animation clip, bese uwufaka kusayithi lakho nge-tag ye-script eyodwa kanye nenkinobho yokuthinta. Akukho modeling, akukho cost, imizuzu eyishumi.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_claim_threews_name: Mint a *.threews.sol Solana subdomain ye-agent yakho futhi wamukele USDC ukukhokha okubhekiswe egameni esikhundleni sokuwela okungaqondile.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_connect_ai_brain: Xhuma umphakeli wakho wemodeli kumjikelezo we-agent. Bring your API key, khetha imodeli yakho, lawula izindleko nezikhathi zokulinda.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_connect_your_home: Bhekisa i-agent yakho ku-Home Assistant yangempela futhi izosebenza endlini yakho yangempela: ukukhanya, i-thermostat, nezimo ozakhele zona. Kubandakanya izindlela ezintathu eziqotho zokufinyelela indlu ephila kwi-network yasekhaya, nomthetho othi ukuvula, ukuvula nokukhulula kuhlale kumisa futhi kubuze, kuyilapho ukuvalela kungakaze...
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_create_and_edit_memory: Izindlela ezinhlanu zokufundisa i-agent iqiniso elihlala phakathi kwezikhathi: ibhodi lokulawula, i-agent uqobo, MCP amathuluzi, i-REST API, kanye nesikhono. Futhi indlela yokwenza kube ngcono, ukuhlela, nokukhohlwa.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_custom_skill: Ukuhamba okuphelele kokwakha ikhono lesimo sezulu i-agent engalibiza: ifomethi ye-bundle, ukushaya u-LMM, i-API ye-context.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_customize_appearance: Lungisa zonke izilawuli ezibonakalayo ku-<agent-3d> element: imodi yokwakha, indawo ye-corner, usayizi, isizinda, ukujolisa kwekhamera, kanye ne-ambient clip.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_deploy_to_vercel_custom_doma: Thatha i-forked three.ws bese uyithumela njenge-agent.yourcompany.com: CI, okuguquguqukayo, igama elikhethekile, i-SSL, konke.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_earn_and_spend_in_play: Sebenzisa umjikelezo wezomnotho ophelele emhlabeni ovulekile: qoqani izinto ezingavuthiwe, zithengise kumthengisi, thenga ithuluzi elingcono, bhanka okusele ukuze ukufa kungakuthathi, bese ujikijela i-wheel. Kubandakanya ukuthi kungani umhlaba unama-currencies amabili angathintani, nokuthi kungani iseva ikhetha intengo ngayinye.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_embed_in_30_seconds: Faka i-tag ye-script eyodwa kunoma iyiphi ikhasi le-HTML. I-agent yakho iyalayisha, iyazihlela, futhi iqala ukuhamba.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_embed_on_website: Izindlela ezinhlanu ezihlukene zokwengeza i-agent kusayithi lakho: khetha leyo ehambelana nendlela owakha ngayo namuhla.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_emotion_from_data: Vula ukuhamba komzimba okwenziwa ngempela (jabulela, dance, flinch) kusuka kumthombo wedatha ophilayo. Umugqa wamagama wamahhala ukuze uqinisekise ukuxhumana, bese kuba imodeli ye-AI eqondisa umbhalo ongakhethiwe ibe yizinyathelo ezicebile, nge-cooldown/dedupe ukuze umthombo osheshayo ungavumeli ukuhamba okuphindaphindiwe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_explore_docs_world: Hamba i-avatar ngokuhlangenwe nakho: izingxenye eziyi-14 njengezikhumbuzo ezikhanyayo, amakhasi aphilayo afundwa emhlabeni, izixhumanisi ezijulile ezabelwayo, kanye ne-GLB yakho njengomzimba.

sitemap_index.d_widgets: Ama-widget akhululiwe okukhuluma, okukhuluma, kanye nama-avatar e-3D ongawafaka kunoma iyiphi ikhasi.

siwx_test.click_a_button_to_open_the_drop: Chofoza inkinobho ukuze uvule i-modal yokufaka. Uma i-endpoint ikhangisa isandiso se-sign-in-with-x, i-modal inikeza "Ngena ngemvume nge-wallet" njengesenzo esiyinhloko — i-wallet isayina umyalezo we-CAIP-122, i-modal iphinda izame i-endpoint nge-header ye-SIGN-IN-WITH-X, futhi i-endpoint ibuyisa u-200 ngaphandle kokukhokhisa. Ngaphandle kwesandiso, i-modal isebenzisa ukugeleza okujwayelekile kokukhokha nge-USDC.

sonar.calibrating_sub: Bamba kahle. Konke okukhuluma ikhamera manje kuba yisisekelo esizokwenziwa isandla sakho.
sonar.card_lift_desc: Phakamisa isandla sakho phezulu kwekhiyibhodi bese ubamba lapho. Ikhamera ijikeleza i-agent isikhathi eside njengoba ubamba, futhi iyahlala uma uyiphakamisile.
sonar.card_push_desc: Pusha umphimbo wakho ubheke isikrini ukuze uhambise ikhamera ngaphakathi. Pull back futhi iyaphuma, ihamba ngokushesha kwesandla sakho.
sonar.card_swipe_desc: Umphimbo phansi phezu kwekhiyibhodi, sweepera, bese umisa ngaphambi kokubuyela emuva. I-sweep ngayinye iyasetha kumphimbo olandelayo ku-vocabulary ye-agent.
sonar.explain_distance_desc: Ikhamera ibona kuphela ukuthi kukhona okuseduze noma okude. I-sweep ibonwa njengokuhamba okuhlangene okulandela ukuhamba kwayo, yingakho ukumisa ngaphambi kokubuyela emuva kubalulekile: ngaphandle kokumisa, i-stroke yokubuyela ibonwa njengokuhamba kwesibili ngasohlangothini oluphambene.
sonar.explain_doppler_desc: I-siren iyancipha uma idlula. Into efanayo iyenzeka kumathoni angu-20 kHz abuyela esandleni sakho, kuphela ushintsho lukhona kumahertz ambalwa kunokuhamba okukhona. Ukuhlola igumbi ngenkathi ubamba kahle kunikeza isikhumbuzo, futhi noma yini evela eduze komthwali ngemuva kwalokho iyinto ethuthuke.
sonar.explain_priorwork_desc: Le ndlela yi-SoundWave (Gupta, Morris, Patel noTan, CHI 2012). Abahloli lapha baphumelele ku-Sonar, u-Emanuel Perez's MIT-licensed macOS implementation, no-Daniel Rapp's Doppler njengobuciko obuphambili bokwenza lokhu ku-browser.
sonar.explain_takeit_desc: Isikhombisi kanye nezitholi ziwumamodule ezimbili ezilula ngaphandle kwe-3D noma i-DOM. Bheka noma yini: isilayidi, ikiosk, i-embedded agent. I-developer reference inazo zonke izindawo.
sonar.hero_lede: Amakhosombe akho adlala ithoni ongayizwanga. Isandla sakho sithola, futhi ukubonakaliswa kubuyela bent: phezulu uma uhamba phambili, phansi uma uhamba kude. Lokhu kushintsha kukhulu ukuze kufundwe ukuhamba, ukpush, nokuphakamisa, futhi kuqhube i-agent ye-3D yangempela. Akukho okurekhodiwe, akukho okuphuma kuleli khasi, futhi ikhamera ihlala ivaliwe.
sonar.hero_note: Sebenzisa amakhosombe nezwi elakhelwe ngaphakathi, futhi ugcine ivolumu iphakeme. Amahedfoni aphula indlela yokubonisa, ngakho ukucwaninga akunayo okokufunda. The carrier sits near 20 kHz: amakati nezinja angayizwa, ngakho stop uma isilwane esigcineni sikhombisa ukukhathazeka.
sonar.hero_title: Bheka kwi-laptop yakho. I-agent yakho iyaphendula.
sonar.log_empty: Yonke i-gesture ethola isikhombisi ifika lapha, ne-reading eyayiqhubele phambili. Ukuphindaphinda kokungafundeki kuvame ukuba yi-carrier: zama enye ku-Controls.
sonar.meta_desc: Lawula i-agent ye-3D ngezandla zakho ngaphandle kwekhamera. three.ws emits an inaudible tone through your speakers and reads the Doppler shift off your microphone, so a sweep, a push or a lift moves the avatar on screen.
sonar.modes_note: Imakrofoni ithola ibanga, hhayi umkhondo, ngakho ukuhamba nokuphusha kubukeka kufana uma kuza. Khetha eyodwa oyenzayo; All three runs every detector at once and will misread more often.
sonar.og_desc: Bheka kwi-laptop yakho futhi i-agent yakho ye-3D iyaphendula. Ukulawula kwe-acoustic gesture: ithoni engazwakali ngaphandle kwamakhosombe, ukushintsha kwe-Doppler ngaphakathi nge-microphone, akukho ikhamera nanoma yisiphi isikhathi.
sonar.panel_signal_sub: I-carrier kanye ne-600 Hz ngazimbili. I-grey iyigumbi elithule. I-green iyakho konke okubuyela manje: amandla ku-right ye-spike kuyisandla esisondela, ku-left kuyisandla esihamba kude.
sonar.signal_legend: igumbi elithule live carrier
sonar.stage_error_sub: Zonke ezinye izithombe zisebenza. Phinda uhambise ukuze uqhubeke.
sonar.stage_idle_sub: Cindezela Start sensing, noma usebenzise izilawuli ze-keyboard ukuze uyisebenzise ngaphandle kwe-microphone.
sonar.tw_desc: Ukulawula ngesandla kwe-3D agents ngaphandle kwekhamera. Amakhosombe akho akhipha ithoni, isandla sakho siyibentisa, i-avatar iyahamba.
sonar.unsupported_keyboard: Izilawuli ze-keyboard ezingezansi zisebenza noma kunjalo, futhi the gesture vocabulary iyatholakala ngaphandle kwanoma iyiphi hardware.
sonar.unsupported_reason: Ukuthola kwe-acoustic kudinga i-Web Audio kanye ne-microphone input. I-Safari, i-Chrome, i-Edge ne-Firefox kwi-laptop zonke zifanele.

spatial_mcp_index.a_third_party_mcp_server_that_returns: Iseva ye-MCP yomuntu wesithathu ebuyisa { url, previewImage } iba yinhambelana nge-adaptha encane — bona docs/spatial-mcp. Noma yimuphi umbukisi okhuluma ngalesi simo (lo ofakiwe) uyabe eseyibonisa. Ayikho inkokhelo, isikhwama, noma indawo yemali ebonakala noma kuphi kulesi simo noma kumbukisi.
spatial_mcp_index.checker_lede: Namathisela umphumela wethuluzi ngezansi. Umqinisekisi ofanayo oza nespec uyasebenza kuwo njengoba uthayipha, kusiphequluli sakho, bese uqamba insimu okufanele ilungiswe esikhundleni sokuphendula yebo noma cha. Ama-payload ahambisanayo ayavezwa ngezansi; angasebenziseki athola okubuyiselwa okuklanywe, akukaze kube ifreyimu engenalutho.

stream.how_p1: I-packer ilula i-mesh ngokulandelana, okuhle kakhulu kuya kokuphansi, ngakho ama-vertices asinda ezingeni ngalinye ayingxenye eqinile yezinga elingaphansi. Hlela wonke i-vertex ngalezi eziphansi, hlela i-vertex buffer ngale rank, futhi ama-vertices ezingeni ngalinye aba yi-prefix ehlangene. Ukuthuthukiswa khona-ke kuhlale kufaka kuphela ama-byte, akubhaleli kabusha. Ukukhanya kuhlala kungathintwanga, ngoba i-mesh simplifier ikhipha kuphela i-index buffer entsha phezu kwe-vertex array eyayinikwe.
stream.how_p2: Ngoba i-layer 0 iyinhloko ye-GLB hhayi i-blob eyenziwe ngokwezifiso, ungayikhipha ngaphandle kokuthola curl bese uyivula kunoma iyiphi glTF ithuluzi:
stream.how_p3: Ku-browser, umfundi uthatha isicelo esisodwa esibanzi sokuqala sokuqala bese uthuthukisa ngemuva, uguqula i-geometry esivele ikhonjisiwe esikrinini esikhundleni sokwakha kabusha isimo:
stream.how_p4: Ifomethi ibhalwe ku-specs/AVATAR_STREAM.md futhi i-endpoint ethumela lezi zinsiza yi-/api/avatar-stream, ezokunikeza ithebula le-layer njenge-JSON.
stream.layer0_desc: I-mesh ephansi, isikhumba esiphelele, ama-textures e-thumbnail. I-GLB efanele yona.
stream.layer1_desc: Ama-vertices amasha, ama-indices aphansi, kanye nezithombe zokuhlanganisa.
stream.layer2_desc: I-geometry eyengeziwe, efakwe endaweni esikrinini esiphilayo.
stream.meta_desc: I-avatar ye-3D akufanele ibe ibhokisi elingenalutho kuze kube i-byte yokugcina ifika. I-A3S ipakisha i-GLB ibe ngezigaba ezinezi-50 KB zokuqala ezivele ziyi-avatar ephelele, esikhumbeni, esivumelekile, ethuthukiswe endaweni ngaphezu kwezicelo ze-HTTP ezijwayelekile.
stream.share_desc: I-50 KB yokuqala ye-A3S stream isivele iy-avatar ephelele, esikhumbeni. Buka ibhasi ye-classic GLB load.
stream.sub: I-GLB iyinto eyodwa: akukho okukhombisa kuze kube i-byte yokugcina ifika. Ku-connection esheshayo lokho kuyizikhathi eziningi ze-frame ezingenalutho kuzo zonke izithombe. A3S iphakela le asset efanayo ibe ngezigaba ezihlanganisiwe, ezihlelwe ukuze noma iyiphi byte-prefix yefayela ibe yi-avatar ephelele, esikhumbeni, esivumelekile. I-layer yokuqala ivamise ukuba ngu-4 kuya ku-17 percent ye-original. Konke okukhona emva kwayo kuthuthukisa i-mesh esivele ikhonjisiwe, ngaphezu kwezicelo ezijwayelekile ze-Range ezikhona ku-CDN.

Ukusakazwa kwezehlakalo okufanayo kunika amandla i-Money Pulse kanye ne-ticker yesayithi lonke. I-ejenti ngayinye igcina i-motif ezinzile nendawo ye-stereo, ukuze abajwayelekile baziwe ngendlebe. Beka isikhombisi kunoma yimuphi umugqa kwi-score bese ucindezela solo ukuze uthulise yonke enye indawo yesikhulumi bese ulalela lowo obamba iqhaza yedwa; isixhumanisi sihlala sabelana. Ukhetha izinombolo kunamanothi? I-ideshibhodi yomnotho ikulungele.
symphony.space_plays_and_pauses_click_a_voice: <kbd>Isikhala</kbd> siyadlala futhi siyama. Chofoza izwi elingezansi ukuze ulithulise.
symphony.the_agent_economy_played_live_as_music: Umnotho we-ejenti, odlalwa bukhoma njengomculo. Yonke into yangempela eyenzeka ku-three.ws iba inothi elenziwe ngesikhathi eyenzeka ngaso: izinkokhelo ziyadonsa, ukuthengwa okukhulu kwezinhlamvu zemali kuba i-bass, ama-ejenti amasha ayakhala, ukunqatshwa kokuphepha kudabula njengokungahambelani. Akukho okurekhodwe ngaphambilini futhi akukho okulingisiwe. Ulalele imishini yenza ibhizinisi.

three_ws_launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: Ukukopisha izwi kwe-ElevenLabs kusukela kumasekhondi angu-3–10 enkulumo, ukukhipha ubuntu engxoxweni emfushane yokuqala, nokufaka imemori ngokuvunyelwe kusuka kuma-akhawunti axhunyiwe — i-avatar ayisona nje wena, i-agent enza njengawe.
three_ws_launch_week.listed_on_the_official_model_context_pro: Kubhalwe ku-Irejista esemthethweni ye-Model Context Protocol.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_og_description: Ipulatifomu ye-agent ye-AI ye-3D yomthombo ovulekile yesiphequluli. Iviki lokuqala ngezibalo nokuthi yini esiyilethile.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_twitter_description: Konke three.ws okulethwe ngesikhathi seviki lokwethulwa — ama-avatar e-3D, izinkokhelo ze-agent, ibazaar ye-x402, nokunye okuningi.
three_ws_launch_week.open_source_3d_ai_agent_platform_apache: Ipulatifomu ye-agent ye-AI ye-3D yomthombo ovulekile. Apache 2.0. Yakhiwe nge-three.js, i-Claude, nangokukholwa ukuthi i-AI ifanele umzimba.
three_ws_launch_week.pulled_directly_from_x_analytics_for_try: Kuthathwe ngqo kusuka ku-X analytics kwa @trythreews phakathi kuka-Ephreli 29 noMeyi 9. Akukho ukuhlunga, akukho maqhinga okulinganisa — izinombolo eziyinhloko ezingezansi namashadi angezansi avela kusithombe-skrini esifanayo.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Izimakethe zedumela ezifaka imali emlandweni wezenzo osayiniwe wama-agent, imali yobukhosi yamakhono ye-EIP-7710 ekhokhelwa ababhali bamakhono ngocingo ngalunye, nezinkokhelo ezizimele phakathi kwama-agent ngama-wallet asayina ngokudlulisa igunya.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: I-elementi yangokwezifiso <agent-3d> ilayisha kancane lapho ihlangana, isekela izinhlobo ezinhlanu zama-widget (i-turntable, igalari yopopayi, i-agent ekhulumayo, ERC-8004 ikhadi lephasipoti, uhambo lwe-hotspot), futhi ikhipha i-Open Graph kanye ne-oEmbed metadata ukuze izixhumanisi zivele ngokuqukethwe okubanzi. I-Widget Studio yokuchofoza-nokukhomba ikhiqiza ikhodi yokufaka yokukopisha-nokunamathisela ku /studio. Ama-bundle e-CDN anezinguqulo athunyelwa ku /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Isimemezelo se-Google Cloud sasiwukuphela kokuthunyelwe okuthola ukuzibandakanya okuphezulu kakhulu kuleli sonto (~6.9K ukubukwa, 263 ukuthandwa, 24 ukuthunyelwa kabusha) kanye nengqalasizinda yamafu esekela isigaba esilandelayo seplatifomu.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: Isiqephu se-podcast esithi “Inside The 3D Agent Web” sishicilelwe ku-Amazon Music futhi ibhulogi ehambisanayo ethi “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” yakhishwa nge-ecosystem ye-Spotify-on-chain. Izindawo ezimbili ezengeziwe zokusabalalisa, isonto elilodwa elengeziwe.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: Iplatifomu ikhishwe njengohlu lwabalingani ku-Alibaba Cloud, isiteshi sethu sokuqala sokusabalalisa emakethe yamafu. I-tweet yokwethulwa ehambisanayo yathola ~7.1K ukubukwa yodwa.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Imephu yomgwaqo ivala igebe ukusuka “ekusebenziseni umculi we-3D” kuya “ekuthatheni i-selfie”. Izigaba ezine, ezihloliwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni ku-README yomphakathi.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: I-runtime iqhuba i-Claude tool-loop enokuphindaphinda okungafika kokuyisishiyagalombili ngokuphambana ngakunye namathuluzi ayisithupha akhelwe ngaphakathi (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember). I-Empathy Layer akuyona umshini wesimo — iyi ’ngxube eqhubekayo enesisindo yemizwa emihlanu (ukugubha, ukukhathazeka, ilukuluku, uzwelo, ukubekezela), ngamunye unempilo yawo yokubola, eqhuba ama-morph targets e-avatar ’ kanye nesimo sekhanda kuwo wonke amafreyimu. Amakhono angama-bundle azimele asatshalaliswa nge-IPFS, i-Arweave, noma i-HTTP. Imemori isekelwe kumafayela ngezindlela ezine zokugcina (yasendaweni, i-IPFS, i-encrypted-IPFS, akukho).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Umphakathi we-X three.ws yizithameli ezibuthene — abathuthukisi, abakhi abafuna ukwazi ngama-agent, kanye neqembu labantu abalandelayo bukhoma. Yilapho kuzovela khona igagasi elilandelayo labanikazi bama-agent ’.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Ama-selfie amathathu (kwesokunxele, phakathi, kwesokudla), ukwakhiwa kabusha kobuso okubukwa ngezindlela eziningi okusekelwa yi-GPU, kanye ne-avatar elungisiwe, elingaphiliswa elakhiwe njenge-token engumqulu ERC-8004 ngaphansi kwamasekhondi angamashumi ayisithupha. I-UX yokuthwebula eqala ngeselula enamasango ekhwalithi yesikhathi sangempela.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Izinkontileka ezintathu ze-Solidity zakha ukusetshenziswa kwe-ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (ama-token e-agent e-ERC-721 anabasayini be-EIP-712 abamele), ReputationRegistry (impendulo ebhaliwe yabahloli, ebalwe ngokwesilinganiso ku-chain), kanye ne-ValidationRegistry (izitifiketi zabaqinisekisi zobufakazi obungekho ku-chain). Wonke umcimbi we-speak, remember, kanye ne-skill-done usayinwa futhi ulogwe. Solana iletha okufanayo isebenzisa ama-NFT e-Metaplex Core kanye nezitifiketi ze-SPL Memo ezisayiniwe — ukuma okufanayo, akukho hlelo olukhethekile oludingekayo.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws iyipulatifomu ye-3D AI agent evulekile, esebenza kusiphequluli. Silethe i-stack ephelele — isibukeli, i-agent runtime, ubunikazi obuku-chain, i-server ye-OAuth 2.1, i-endpoint ye-MCP, kanye ne-web component engashumekwa — sabe sesibuka ukwethulwa kuphumelela. Nakhu okwenzekile.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws ihlelwe njengezingqimba ezine ezixhumanayo, kanye ne-backend kanye ne-package yezinkontileka. Yonke ingqimba isetshenziswa ku-three.ws futhi ilethwa njengengxenye ye-repo evulekile. Nalu uhlu.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws ishicilelwe njenge-io.github.nirholas/three.ws ku-registry.modelcontextprotocol.io futhi ingatholakala nge-directory ekhethiwe ye-PulseMCP’. Noma yimuphi iklayenti elinolwazi lwe-MCP (kuhlanganise ne-Claude Desktop) lingaxhuma futhi lisebenzise ama-avatar nge-JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Imisebenzi ye-Vercel ku-Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, naku-Upstash Redis. I-server ephelele ye-OAuth 2.1 (RFC 6749 + PKCE, ukubhaliswa okuguquguqukayo kwe-RFC 7591, ukubuyiswa kwe-RFC 7009, ukuhlola kwe-RFC 7662, ukutholwa kwe-RFC 8414, ukutholwa kwezinsiza ezivikelwe ze-RFC 9728). I-server ye-MCP nge-HTTP — imigqa engu-759, i-JSON-RPC 2.0, efakwe ohlwini ku-Model Context Protocol Registry esemthethweni njenge-io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Imisebenzi ye-Cron ye-ERC-8004 crawler, i-EIP-7710 delegation indexer, ukwenziwa kwesu le-DCA, kanye nokubhaliselwa okuphindaphindwayo ku-chain.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Ukunikezwa kwe-WebGL 2.0 ngokusekelwa okugcwele kwe-glTF 2.0 / GLB: Ukucindezela kwe-Draco geometry, ukucindezela kwe-KTX2 texture, ukulungiswa kwe-Meshopt mesh, amamephu emvelo e-HDR, izinto ze-PBR, i-animation enesikhumba, ama-morph target, namakhamera ashumekwe. Ukuqinisekiswa kusezingeni lomugqa nge-Khronos gltf-validator. Ukulayisha ngokudonsa nokulahla, i-OrbitControls enokuzungeza okuzenzakalelayo okungalungiseka, kanye ne-dat.GUI yesikhathi sangempela yokulungisa ngokushesha.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Isibukeli se-WebGL, i-LLM agent runtime, izinkontileka zobunikazi ze-ERC-8004, i-server ye-OAuth 2.1, i-endpoint ye-MCP, kanye ne-web component ye-<agent-3d> — konke okufundile ngenhla. Bukhoma ku-three.ws namuhla.

trading.every_surface_sub: Uhlelo lukhulu kunesikhasi esisodwa. Nansi imephu yonke.
trading.fleet_vitals_sub: Funda ngqo kumsebenzi osebenzayo. Uma inombolo lapha ingasasebenzi, imikhumbi ingasasebenzi.
trading.hero_sub: Imikhumbi yama-ejenti e-AI ihweba ngezinhlamvu zemali ezisanda kwethulwa ezivela kuma-wallet awo e-Solana, ngaphansi kwemithetho abangakwazi ukuyiphika. Konke okungenayo kuyashaywa amaphuzu, yonke indawo ilinganiswa nesabelomali esiqinile sobungozi, futhi konke okugcwalisiwe kusayinwe yisihluthulelo se-ejenti futhi kuqinisekiswe ku-chain. Leli khasi yigumbi lokulawula: ukuthi imikhumbi yenzani manje, ukuthi inquma kanjani, nokuthi izoya kuphi ngokulandelayo.
trading.meta_description: Igumbi lokulawula lokuhweba okuzimele kwe-three.ws: izinto ezibalulekile zemikhumbi bukhoma, ibhodi lamaphuzu e-ejenti, ipayipi eligcwele lokungena nokuphuma, nazo zonke izindawo zokuhweba endaweni eyodwa. Ama-wallet angempela, ukugcwaliswa kwangempela, okuqinisekiswe ku-chain.
trading.meta_og_description: Ulwazi olubukhoma lwemikhumbi, ibhodi lezikolo lama-ejenti, nazo zonke izindawo zokuhweba ezizimele endaweni eyodwa.
trading.meta_twitter_description: Ulwazi olubukhoma lwemikhumbi, ibhodi lezikolo lama-ejenti, nazo zonke izindawo zokuhweba ezizimele endaweni eyodwa.
trading.pipeline_sub: Konke okungenayo kudlula emasangweni afanayo, ngalolu hlelo. Isango elingakwazi ukufakazela ukuthi uhlamvu lwemali luphephile livimba ukuhweba kunokuba liqagele.
trading.rail_budget_body: Usayizi wokuhweba ngakunye, ukusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke, kanye nenani eliphezulu lezikhundla ezifanayo yimikhawulo ehlolwa ngaphambi kokusakazwa ngakunye.
trading.rail_custody_body: Ama-ejenti ahweba ngamakhi awo siqu ngendlela yokugcinwa ehloliwe. Funda imodeli yokugcinwa.
trading.rail_kill_body: Emhlabeni wonke nangokwe-ejenti ngayinye. Ukuyicisha kumisa okungenayo okusha ngokushesha, futhi umnikazi angakwazi njalo ukukhipha isikhwama.
trading.rail_moonbag_body: Inqubomgomo yemikhumbi igcina isabelo esincane sesikhundla esiwinekayo ngokwakhiwa, ngakho-ke isinqumo esihle asikwazi ukudayiswa ngokuphelele kusenesikhathi.
trading.rail_risk_body: Ukuhweba ngezinhlamvu zemali ezisanda kwethulwa kungalahlekisa isikhundla sonke. Funda ukuvuma ingozi ngaphambi kokuhlomisa noma yini.
trading.rail_stop_body: Yonke isu elihlonyisiwe liphethe isicishi sokulahlekelwa, eliqiniswa umkhawulo wedatha. Isu elingenaso alikwazi ukuba khona.
trading.safety_rails_sub: Lezi ziqiniswa kukhodi nasendaweni yedatha, hhayi kumyalo. I-ejenti ayikwazi ukuzixoxela indlela yokudlula kunoma yiziphi zazo.
trading.scoreboard_sub: Inzuzo elungile nokulahlekelwa nge-ejenti ngayinye, ukuhweba okuvaliwe kuphela. Izikhundla ezivulekile azibalwa njengenzuzo.
trading.step_exit_body: Cishe kabili okungenayo i-ejenti idayisa okwanele ukubuyisa isabelo sayo bese igcina okusele njengesikhwama senyanga ngesicishi esilandelelayo. Isicishi sokulahlekelwa esiqinile siwina zonke izingxabano, futhi isicishi sesikhathi sivala noma yini engayi ndawo.
trading.step_firewall_body: Ukuthenga nokudayisa kwangempela kuyalingiswa ku-chain ngaphambi kokusakazwa. Uma ukudayisa kubuyela emuva, uhlamvu lwemali alukwazi ukuphuma futhi ukuhweba kuyavinjwa. Amandla okukhiqiza nokumisa ahlolwa ngesikhathi esifanayo.
trading.step_score_body: Uhlamvu lwemali luhlungwa ngesigaba semakethe, umlando womdali, izinkundla zokuxhumana kanye nempahla yokucaphuna. Amanye ama-ejenti asebenzisa imithetho egxilile, amanye anikeza isinqumo kumodeli yolimi, futhi ibhodi lezikolo elingenhla yilo elixazulula ingxabano.
trading.step_signal_body: Ukwethulwa, isicelo sokuqala semali, ukuwela kwe-oracle, noma ukuphothula kufika kokuphakelayo. Umsebenzi ugcina okuphakelayo kuvulekile, ngakho-ke kusabela ngesekhondi elifanayo kunokuba kube ngohlelo.
trading.step_size_body: Usayizi wesikhundla uvela kusabelomali se-ejenti sokuhweba ngakunye, ukhawulelwe isabelomali sayo sansuku zonke kanye nomkhawulo wayo wesikhundla esivulekile. Umvikeli wokusebenzisa kanye nenqubomgomo yesikhwama kuqiniswa kukhodi, ngakho-ke akukho ukulungiselelwa okungakwandisa.

tty.card1_desc: I-cell ngayinye iyinhlamvu ye-▀ enombala wayo ophakeme nowangemuva, ngakho-ke umlingiswa uthwala ama-pixels amabili. Lokhu kuphindaphinda isixazululo esiphakeme futhi kwenza ama-pixels abe ne-square, okwenza kube lula ukuthi ibhola liphume lilungile.
tty.card2_desc: Ama-matrices ahlanganisiwe abhekwa ngemuva kwesithombe futhi ahlanganiswa ngemuva kwesigxobo, ngakho-ke i-avatar e-rigged iyakwazi ukuhamba izitho zayo. Akusikho ukunyakaza okungaguquki.
tty.card3_desc: I-radius yekhamera ibekwe kusuka kumkhawulo obanzi wesithombe futhi isikhungo silandelela isimo, ngakho-ke umjikelezo wokuhamba onomsebenzi ophakanyisiwe awuphefumuli noma uhamba ngaphandle kwesithombe.
tty.card4_desc: I-key light, i-fill, kanye ne-rim term. Kulesi sithombe, umumo uthwala isimo, ngakho-ke ubuso obujikayo buphakanyiswa kunokuba buphume kube mnyama.
tty.cmd_note: Kusebenza kunoma iyiphi i-terminal ekhombisa umbala. Press Ctrl-C ukuyeka.
tty.demo_p: Akuyona ividiyo futhi akuyona irekhodi. Iphaneli engezansi ivula i-HTTP stream efanayo curl ezokwenza, futhi ithunga izigaba zokuphuma ezitholayo.
tty.endpoint_p: GET /api/tty ithumela amafremu njenge text/plain, ihlale ngesikhathi sangempela, ngakho-ke impendulo uqobo iyinhlangano. Wonke amapharamitha ayakhethwa.
tty.eyebrow: akukho gpu · akukho webgl · akukho ukufaka
tty.hero_lede: Umsebenzi owodwa. I-character ye-3D e-rigged ilayisha, idlala i-animation yayo, futhi ivula i-turntable, ikhishwa ngokuphelele ngombhalo onombala. Akukho okufanele ukufake futhi akukho okufanele ukwenze: amafremu abhalwa kumaseva ethu futhi athunyelwa ku-shell yakho njengoba edwetshwa.
tty.meta_desc: curl three.ws/tty futhi i-agent ye-3D e-rigged ihamba ku-terminal yakho. I-software ye-rasterizer yangempela ithumela amafremu e-ANSI nge-HTTP: akukho GPU, akukho WebGL, akukho ukufaka. Futhi @three-ws/tty-3d, i-CLI ne-SDK ezikhipha noma iyiphi GLB ku-terminal.
tty.note: Ibhrawuza efuna le URL ibuyiselwa lapha esikhundleni, ngoba ibhrawuza izobonisa amakhodi okuphuma njengokungathi yizibi ezibhalwe phansi. Pass ?raw=1 ukuze ubone ama-byte noma kunjalo.
tty.render_h: Phinda ubhale noma yimuphi imodeli, endaweni yangakini
tty.render_keys: Amakhiyi e-arrow ajikeleza, w/s ukwehla, +/- ukwandisa, isikhala simisa, q kuphume.
tty.render_p: Umphakeli uyiphakheji eshicilelwe. Uthatha GLB, uyichaze (kuhlanganise EXT_meshopt_compression, okukhona kumavathari amaningi), uhlole ukuhamba, ufake ukuxubha okujwayelekile ku-CPU, futhi uthwebule nge-z-buffer. Akukho i-GPU edlalwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngakho-ke iyasebenza ngendlela efanayo nge-SSH, ku-CI, noma ku-container ngaphandle kokuboniswa.
tty.row_avatar_meaning: I-three.ws avatar id yomphakathi. Futhi indlela yokwakha, /tty/<id>.
tty.row_frames_meaning: Inani lama-fremu okufanele uthumele. 1 inika isithombe esimi.
tty.share_desc: curl three.ws/tty futhi i-3D agent ebhalwe izinyathelo ingena kwi-terminal yakho. Akukho i-GPU, akukho WebGL, akukho ukufaka.

Phequlula ikhathalogi, hlola ingcezu ku-3D, bese uvula umhleli we-avatar yakho bese uyigqoka. Noma chaza okuthile okusha futhi i-forge izokwakha, i-rig, iqinisekise, futhi ikushicilele cishe ngemizuzu eyisikhombisa.

world_lines.every_world_line_is_an_ai_agent: Yonke i-World Line iyi-ejenti ye-AI elindele endaweni yangempela. Hamba uye kuyo, qedela inselele yayo ye-AR, bese isikhwama semali se-ejenti sisayina ubufakazi bokuba khona — okuyinto eqoqekayo engokoqobo, eqinisekiswa ngokuzimela, futhi ebhaliwe nge-cryptography. Indawo yakho eqondile ayilokothi ishiye idivayisi yakho; ubufakazi bukwazi kuphela indawo engu-~1 km.
